article.articleHeadline: BMKG Rilis Peringatan Dini Cuaca Lampung, Kenali Gejala Leptospirosis yang Mirip Flu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BMKG Releases Early Weather Warning for Lampung; Know the Symptoms of Leptospirosis That Resemble Flu.
article.articleSummary: On 26 November 2026, BMKG issued an early weather warning for Lampung, Indonesia, citing heavy rainfall and flood risks that raise leptospirosis exposure. Leptospirosis is a bacterial zoonosis caused by Leptospira interrogans, transmitted via urine or blood of infected animals and common in tropical regions during flooding. Bacteria persist for months to years in animal kidneys and contaminate water or soil. Infection occurs through skin contact with contaminated water or soil, or ingestion. At-risk groups include outdoor workers (farmers, fishermen, miners), animal handlers, sanitation workers, flood-prone residents, and recreational water users. Symptoms appear 2 days to 4 weeks post-infection and resemble flu or dengue: high fever, chills, nausea, muscle pain, and rash; some progress to Weil disease requiring hospitalization. Diagnosis uses ELISA/rapid tests, PCR, MAT; treatment ranges from supportive care to IV antibiotics for organ involvement. Prevention emphasizes protective gear, wound care, safe water, and animal vaccination. Monitor updates via BMKG.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: reportaron 11 casos importados en Argentina durante la temporada 2026-2027
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: 11 imported cases reported in Argentina during the 2026–2027 season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue: 11 imported dengue cases reported in Argentina for the 2026–2027 season. In detail, Córdoba records two cases and Santa Fe one, all with travel history to Peru, and Santa Cruz reports another case after visiting Costa Rica. Across Argentina, 1,584 suspected dengue cases have been tallied, with 797 discarded, 760 under investigation, and 16 classified as probable. The first two imported Córdoba cases have been confirmed. Chikungunya: no new locally acquired cases in the latest week; one imported case detected in Salta’s Orán department, with travel history to Bolivia. Overall transmission risk remains low, but the NOA outbreak underscores the need for active surveillance, particularly to identify acute fever patients without diagnosis and to detect potential new transmission foci early.

article.articleHeadline: 天津流感预警升至Ⅲ级，三种流感毒株叠加来袭
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tianjin Influenza Alert Raised to Level III as Three Influenza Strains Converge
article.articleSummary: Influenza season alert in China: as of the latest national surveillance (through 2026-11-15), three strains are circulating concurrently. In positive samples nationwide, H1N1 accounts for 56.2%, H3N2 for 15.5%, and B/Victoria lineage for 28.3%. Tianjin has raised its influenza alert to Level III, where H1N1 is dominant, followed by B/Victoria and H3N2. Vaccination strategy has shifted to predominantly trivalent vaccines, with multiple manufacturers supplying. Officials emphasize that influenza vaccination remains the most cost-effective method to prevent illness and reduce severe disease and death. Beyond oseltamivir, several single-dose antivirals have entered the market, including baloxavir marboxil alongside two other agents, broadening treatment options.

article.articleHeadline: SC está entre os 21 estados com alta de casos de covid-19, mas risco continua baixo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina is among the 21 states with an increase in COVID-19 cases, but risk remains low.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Santa Catarina is rising in 21 states, but activity remains low risk. As of November 21, 2026, the state logged 281 severe cases and 42 deaths, with Florianópolis contributing 63 severe cases and 4 deaths. The uptick began mid-October, yet 2026 levels remain below 2025. Infectologist Fábio Gaudenzi notes COVID-19 now peaks from late spring to summer (October–March) rather than winter. The elderly are most affected: 116 of the severe cases are 70+, and 34 of the 42 deaths are over 60. Nationally, through November 16, 2026, there were 135,378 influenza-like illness episodes attributed to COVID-19, with a six-week rise; Week 43 saw 124,940 cases vs 387,144 in 2025. Rio de Janeiro shows a higher surge in severe cases; hospitalizations for severe respiratory syndromes remain stable. SUS vaccination prioritizes 60+, immunocompromised, 6 months–<5 years, and pregnant women, with boosters every six months for these groups; SBIm advises annual boosters.

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Sentuh Bangkai Tikus Sembarangan, Waspadai Leptospirosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't touch rat carcasses indiscriminately; beware of leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, caused by Leptospira bacteria, is transmitted mainly via urine from infected rats contaminating soil, water, or damp surfaces. The bacteria can survive for weeks to months in favorable environments. Transmission occurs when contaminated rat urine enters the body through small wounds, skin abrasions, or mucous membranes such as eyes, nose, or mouth. Standing water around sewers, garbage dumps, or areas with heavy rat activity should be monitored; simply seeing rat carcasses does not automatically cause infection. Risk increases with contact with contaminated material. Symptoms often resemble flu and may appear after an incubation period ranging from a few days to about a month, averaging around 10 days. The article emphasizes preventing exposure by avoiding contact with rat urine-contaminated water and surfaces and being aware of rat presence in urban settings.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue au Cambodge : l'IA pourrait-elle donner l'alerte plus tôt ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Cambodia: Could AI give earlier warning?
article.articleSummary: Cambodia recorded 28,074 dengue cases and 38 deaths as of July 12, 2026, up 58.1% from the same period in 2025, with climate change accelerating mosquito and virus development and rainfall creating new larval habitats. A WHO Western Pacific Region report argues that artificial intelligence paired with climate data could forecast dengue outbreaks and give health authorities extra time to respond, though forecasts are only useful if they trigger concrete actions. Regional examples show progress: Singapore since 2013 uses machine learning to predict dengue up to three months ahead, helping hospitals, diagnostics, larval-control, and public campaigns; Guangdong, China, favored a support-vector-machine model using weekly surveillance, weather, and online searches; the Philippines’ Manila model links local weather to incidence. Cambodia currently lacks an operational AI dengue forecast system; Laos is piloting climate-based early warning within DHIS2, offering a potential template for Cambodia.

article.articleHeadline: 流感进入高发期疾控专家提醒：接种疫苗要趁早
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza enters peak season; disease-control experts remind: get vaccinated early.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is rising in schools with influenza‑like illness (fever ≥38°C plus cough or sore throat). City CDC officials urge early vaccination. Influenza differs from the common cold with higher fever; vaccination is the main preventive measure. Unvaccinated students should get vaccinated promptly; current strains match circulating viruses. Protection typically appears after 2–4 weeks and lasts through the season. The vaccines used are trivalent; inactivated vaccines suit all ages from six months, while 3–17-year-olds wary of injections may use nasal spray live attenuated vaccine. After infection, immunity is strain-specific. National policy provides one free dose of trivalent split vaccine for rural schoolchildren; guardians must accompany and bring IDs. Other groups pay; insured workers can use medical accounts. Ongoing circulation of H1N1, H3N2, and influenza B requires continued hand hygiene, masking, and ventilation in schools; fevered students should be kept at home, and antiviral treatment started within 48 hours when advised.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox among prisoners in Alappuzha district jail; new inmates will not be admitted.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox outbreak at Alappuzha district jail in Kerala leads to a halt on admitting new inmates. Sixteen inmates were initially infected, with the first case reported on October 15; eight more were later confirmed, including a healthcare worker. By month’s end, 24 prisoners had contracted the disease. Infected individuals were moved to a dedicated isolation cell, and preventive immunization or prophylaxis was administered to others to curb transmission. The Health Department notes poor ventilation and severe overcrowding: the district jail, designed for 84, currently houses 126 inmates, with some cells holding up to 12 people. Human rights concerns have been raised regarding conditions. Prisoners will be relocated to sub-jails or other jails; if sub-jails fill, transfers to the Central Jail will follow. Similar overcrowding issues exist in other state jails. 26 November 2026.

article.articleHeadline: തമിഴ്‌നാട്ടിലെ പക്ഷിപ്പനി മുട്ട വിപണിയെ തളര്‍ത്തുന്നു; എട്ട് ദിവസത്തിനിടെ വിലയില്‍ 20 ശതമാനം വരെ ഇടിവ്; കയറ്റുമതി നിലച്ചതോടെ ആഭ്യന്തര വിപണിയില്‍ മുട്ട കുമിഞ്ഞു കൂടുന്നു; തീറ്റച്ചെലവ് 50 ശതമാനം...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza in Tamil Nadu upends the egg market; prices fall by as much as 20% in eight days; with exports halted, eggs pile up in the domestic market; feed costs rise by 50%.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza was confirmed in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, on November 13, prompting culling in affected zones and a 90-day poultry farming ban; exports paused, driving a domestic egg glut. Namakkal, the hub handling over 90% of India’s egg exports, faced export stoppage, and egg prices fell from 6.70 to 5.60 rupees per egg by November 11 (about 19%). Across the south, prices dropped by more than 15%; Delhi, West Bengal, Gujarat, Maharashtra saw 6–10% declines. Last year Namakkal shipped about 1 crore eggs daily. Rising feed costs—corn up ~50%, soybean ~30%, plus peanut meal and other feeds—pressured farmers even before the outbreak. With feed shortages and subdued demand, egg and poultry production remain unprofitable: producing 1 kg of chicken costs over Rs 120, while market price hovers around Rs 80 (roughly Rs 40 loss). Officials urge urgent intervention until exports resume and domestic demand rebounds.

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose: associação ajuíza ação solicitando medidas para conter doença que atinge gatos e humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis: Association Files a Lawsuit Seeking Measures to Contain the Disease That Affects Cats and Humans.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil: The Associação Nacional de Advogados Animalistas (Anaa) filed a public civil action against the state to confront sporotrichosis, the gardener’s disease, a fungal infection that affects cats and humans. The suit seeks free medications for the most affected municipalities, expanded veterinary diagnostic laboratories, and mandatory notification of animal cases across Rio Grande do Sul. It also requests a facility for collecting and disposing of carcasses of infected felines and the creation of a State Plan for Sporotrichosis Response. The action argues that coordinated state-level actions are needed due to multi-regional spread in the state’s metropolitan area. In 2026, RS registered over 1,400 human cases; Canoas 156, Porto Alegre 142, Alvorada 119 lead in the metropolitan region. Animal notifications exceed 2,500 (99% cats, 1% dogs). Transmission is mainly via contact with infected cats; human treatment under SUS lasts 3 months to a year. A preliminary injunction will be reviewed; no deadline yet.

article.articleHeadline: Ba lý do trẻ bị sốt lại sau mắc cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three reasons why children develop fever again after contracting influenza A
article.articleSummary: Fever relapse after influenza A in children can reflect three scenarios: the illness not yet finished, bacterial coinfection, or a new infection. In Hanoi, a 14‑month‑old girl with influenza A had fever around 39°C for four days, then improved but two days later fever rose again to above 38°C; examination showed a red throat, with ears and lungs normal, and a positive influenza A test. In Da Nang, a 15‑month‑old boy recovered by day 3 but by day 9 developed fever and was diagnosed with acute otitis media following influenza, treated with antibiotics. Dr. Huỳnh Trần An Khương (VNVC) outlines three scenarios: ongoing flu; bacterial superinfection (often otitis media or pneumonia); or a new infection such as RSV, adenovirus, or another influenza strain. Seek re‑evaluation if fever returns, especially with malaise, poor feeding, or breathing difficulty. Vaccination is advised: inactivated influenza vaccine for 6 months+, live attenuated nasal spray for 2–18 years; yearly booster per WHO.

article.articleHeadline: Clinicians Advised to Reopen Tuberculosis Differential During Complex CAR T
article.articleSummary: Active Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection can masquerade as common post–infusion syndromes in CAR-T recipients, creating a diagnostic dilemma when patients develop unexplained fever or new pulmonary findings after infusion. TB risk in CAR-T patients reflects cumulative prior therapies and host vulnerabilities—cytopenias, lymphodepletion, steroids, hypogammaglobulinemia, and delayed immune reconstitution—rather than the infused product itself. The commentary emphasizes targeted, not automated, second-pass evaluation to reopen evolving differential diagnoses. Direct clinical evidence is limited: a 2023 single-center retrospective of 427 CD19/CD22 CAR-T recipients identified five microbiologically confirmed TB cases (23 days to 11 months post-infusion) with pulmonary, CNS, pleural, osseous, lymph node, and soft-tissue disease. A 2026 Brazilian cohort noted one TB episode among 23 CD19 CAR recipients; a peri-infusion report described active pulmonary TB diagnosed before infusion, with CAR-T proceeding after 11 weeks of anti-TB therapy. Guidelines advocate rigorous pre-treatment infectious screening and risk-adapted evaluation.

article.articleHeadline: HIV Incidence Remains Consistently High Among Rio MSM and Transgender Women
article.articleSummary: HIV incidence remains consistently high among men who have sex with men (MSM) and transgender women at a major referral center in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, from 2018–2023. Among 8,103 adults tested, 937 HIV-positive (seropositivity 11.6%); stored samples from 810 were AVIDITY-tested, with 193 (23.8%) recent infections. Estimated overall annualized incidence: 5.32% (95% CI 4.03–6.60%), higher in MSM at 5.56% (95% CI 4.17–6.94%) and transgender women at 4.33% (95% CI 2.59–6.07%). Linear trend analysis showed a non-significant negative average annual percent change for MSM (−7.7%/yr, p=0.058) and transgender women (−8.1%/yr, p=0.328). Breakpoint tests with a 2020 breakpoint did not significantly improve fit (MSM p=0.159; TW p=0.192). Authors conclude incidence remains unacceptably high, requiring intensified, targeted prevention for these key populations in Rio de Janeiro.

article.articleHeadline: 55 दिनों में 120 डेंगू पीड़ित! काशी में तीन गुना बढ़ी रफ्तार, प्लेटलेट्स की डिमांड भी दोगुनी | Varanasi Dengue Cases Rise Health Department Platelet Demand
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 120 dengue patients in 55 days! In Varanasi, the rate has tripled, and platelet demand has also doubled.
article.articleSummary: Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India is experiencing a dengue fever surge. As of 26 November 2026, the district reports a total of 176 dengue cases (126 urban, 50 rural). July–September saw 56 cases; October–November added 120 cases in 55 days, signaling a rapid rise in transmission, with urban areas more affected. Hotspot areas are being sprayed regularly, larval surveys conducted, and vector-control efforts intensified, including fogging at 282 sites between 1 September and 22 November. Seventeen wards have been identified for targeted intervention, with cleaning and debris-removal to curb mosquito breeding. Platelet demand has risen alongside cases; medical facilities (IMA and BHU blood banks) report requests for 10+ platelets, up from 5–7 two months earlier. Authorities stress sustained surveillance and public health actions to contain dengue.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus Antibodies Cross-Neutralize 2026 Bundibugyo Virus Glycoprotein
article.articleSummary: Existing Ebola-virus–derived polyclonal and monoclonal antibody preparations retain cross-neutralizing activity against vesicular stomatitis virus pseudotypes bearing the surface glycoprotein of the 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak strain. In the context of the ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak (2026), researchers evaluated convalescent plasma from three Ebola virus disease survivors infected with Makona in Liberia (2014) and Spain (Madrid), aged 36, 44, and 45, along with equine hyperimmune plasma, murine immune serum from a mosaic GP immunogen, and therapeutic monoclonal antibodies including atoltivimab, maftivimab, odesivimab, and the Inmazeb cocktail. Equine batches LV15-0003 (2015) and MP25-0004/MP25-0005 (2025) were tested. Murine serum used a mosaic GP comprising Makona, Gulu, and Bundibugyo antigens. The 2026 Bundibugyo GP differs from 2007 by 12 amino acids. Pseudoviruses expressing these GPs and rVSV-ΔG-luc were used for neutralization assays, with the 2026 Bundibugyo sequence derived from a May 2026 Congo clinical specimen (PP_0075ZFN.1).

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス抗体が2026年ブンディブギョウイルス糖タンパク質を交差中和

triage.notes: 記事は実験室レベルの抗体交差中和研究が主題であり、DRCでの『2026年ブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイク』は背景情報として言及されているのみで詳細な疫学情報（症例数・死亡数等）は記載されていない。リベリア・スペインは2014年感染歴を持つ回復者血漿の提供地であり、現アウトブレイクの発生地ではないため対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Combates en el Congo obligan a trabajadores médicos que luchan contra brote de ébola a evacuar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clashes in Congo force medical workers fighting Ebola outbreak to evacuate
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) worsens as armed clashes north of Bunia in Ituri Province force medical teams to evacuate, hindering containment. The outbreak, the deadliest of the DRC’s 17 Ebola outbreaks, has infected more than 11,700 people and caused over 5,700 deaths since May. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of the sick or deceased, emphasizing rapid isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. Fighting between government forces and the rebel CRP disrupted road access, delaying supplies and patient transfers; about a dozen people, including two WHO staff and Congolese health officials, were evacuated to Bunia after three days trapped at Akwe. In North Kivu, recent attacks displaced over 20,000 people, complicating contact tracing. Some response teams have returned to work, and Ebola operations in Bunia continue amid volatile security.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの戦闘によりエボラ出血熱対策の医療従事者が避難を余儀なくされる

article.articleHeadline: 今年流感季已来！孩子得了流感 出现这些症状要及时就医
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's flu season has arrived! If your child contracts influenza, seek prompt medical care if these symptoms appear.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, influenza activity in China is at a mid-level, with the north showing a notable rise in positive rates this winter. Three circulating strains—Influenza A H1N1, Influenza A H3N2, and Influenza B Victoria lineage—are active and shifting in proportion. Children, especially preschool and primary school students, are the high-risk group. Flu symptoms are abrupt, with fever of 39–40°C, sore throat, headache, chills, fatigue, and muscle aches; Influenza B may also cause nausea or diarrhea. Seek care if fever lasts over 3 days, recurs after fever breaks, or there are breathing difficulties, vomiting with dehydration, lethargy, irritability, seizures, or a week with no improvement. Do not use antibiotics or aspirin; use fever reducers per doctor guidance. Antivirals include oseltamivir (Tamiflu) for 5 days and baloxavir marboxil (Xofluza) as a single-dose option for eligible children, both prescription-only.

article.articleHeadline: भिवंडीत शोरमा विषबाधेचा कहर! रुग्णांचा आकडा 116 वर; 4 जणांना ठाण्यात हलवले; महापालिकेचा शहरभर बुलडोझर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shawarma poisoning wreaks havoc in Bhiwandi! The number of patients rises to 116; four shifted to Thane; citywide bulldozers by the municipality.
article.articleSummary: 116 people in Bhiwandi have fallen ill after consuming chicken shawarma from A.K. Shawarma in the Vanjarpatta Naka area, with vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea and fever. The affected comprise 56 men, 35 women, and 25 children; two children and two women were shifted to Thane District Hospital for further care. Nine patients have been discharged; 107 remain under treatment. This is not the first such incident—earlier in Kandupada, a famous shawarma shop triggered 107 poisonings. In response, Bhiwandi Municipal Corporation has launched a citywide bulldozer drive against unauthorized food stalls and street encroachments, though clashes with residents were reported. Questions remain whether the crackdown will lead to permanent food-safety measures, focusing on quality and hygiene to protect public health.

article.articleHeadline: 三种毒株叠加，流感防护别松懈
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains are co-circulating; don't let your guard down against the flu.
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains are co-circulating in China as temperatures drop, with flu activity fluctuating upward. A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and influenza B are simultaneously active, yielding a more complex strain mix and a longer season. Reinfections with different strains are increasing, though simultaneous dual infections remain uncommon; the elderly and those with chronic diseases face higher complication risks, particularly with A/H3N2, while influenza B can include gastrointestinal symptoms. No cross-protection exists between subtypes, so prior infection does not guarantee protection against others. Antivirals remain broadly effective: all A/H1N1 strains are neuraminidase inhibitor sensitive; 0.2% of A/H3N2 and 0.3% of influenza B show reduced sensitivity; all three are susceptible to polymerase inhibitors. Vaccination uses WHO-recommended trivalent vaccines that match circulating strains; rural elderly 65+ and schoolchildren may receive free vaccines in some policies, with typical 2–4 weeks to develop protection. Sentinel hospitals continue monitoring regional spread and strain dynamics.

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi bệnh dại ở Cà Mau chạy qua 2 xã cắn 7 người bị thương
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog Suspected of Rabies in Ca Mau Runs Through Two Communes, Biting Seven People and Injuring Them.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau, Vietnam: A dog suspected of rabies, about 18 kg from Mr. Lâm Hồng Sơn’s household in U Minh, ran through U Minh and Nguyễn Phích communes on Nov 23–24 and bit seven residents. After the attacks, locals captured and threw the dog into a river; the carcass has not been recovered, so rabies testing could not be performed. All seven bite victims received wound care and rabies vaccination. The provincial Department of Livestock and Veterinary Medicine says the situation poses a high transmission risk and has ordered comprehensive outbreak control: contact tracing, isolation/quarantine of dogs and cats linked to the case, vaccination campaigns across U Minh and Nguyễn Phích and neighboring areas, and disinfection along the dog’s route. Separately in Vĩnh Long, a stray dog suspected of rabies bit nine people and one other dog.

article.articleHeadline: 东方生物及子公司共获11项医疗器械注册证，新冠/甲乙流抗原三联检产品境内获批
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oriental Biotech and Subsidiaries Obtain a Total of 11 Medical Device Registration Certificates; COVID-19/Influenza A and B Antigen Three-in-One Test Products Approved Domestically.
article.articleSummary: Oriental Biotech and its subsidiary Shanghai Wanzi Jian Bio announced on Nov 24 that they obtained 11 medical device registrations—4 domestic and 7 overseas. The domestic approval includes a SARS-CoV-2/Influenza A&B antigen three-in-one qualitative test for nasal swab samples, suitable for professional and home self-testing; registration is valid 2026-11-08 to 2031-11-07. Other domestic items include a Hemoglobin/Transferrin fecal qualitative kit for home use; a six-analyte Hormone panel; and a Total IgE kit (flow-based) for allergy assessment. Overseas, Vitamin D, Ferritin, and Fecal Occult Blood rapid self-test kits gained EU IVDR Class C certificates, valid five years from 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-04; the first two target adults 18+. The firm notes broader home-testing expansion in China; the three-in-one test earned US FDA De Novo in Oct 2024, the first respiratory multi-pathogen OTC self-test in the US. Oriental Biotech has 130+ certifications for respiratory pathogens, including EU IVDR, US FDA, China NMPA registrations.

article.articleHeadline: Cauvery Delta Study Finds Scrub Typhus Pathogen in Rodents and Chiggers
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus pathogen Orientia tsutsugamushi was detected by genetic analysis in both vector mites and host tissues across five landscape types in Thiruvarur district, Tamil Nadu, from September 2023 to December 2024, evidencing active local circulation in an intensively cultivated agricultural basin. Sequencing clustered with Karp-related lineages. In a field survey of 282 small mammals (193 Rattus rattus, 40 Millardia meltada, 40 Bandicota indica, 9 Suncus murinus), 134 hosts (47.5%) harbored trombiculid mites, yielding 3,747 larvae (mean infestation 13.29 larvae/host; mean intensity 27.96). Six mite taxa were found, dominated by Leptotrombidium deliense (62.9%) and L. rajasthanense (36.5%). Riverine habitats along the Vennar/Vettar had the highest infestation (71.1%), mangroves 63.2%, urban/peri-urban/paddy 41.1–43.3%. Paddy sites had the most chiggers (1,128) and highest mean intensity (49.04). Millardia meltada showed 31.85 larvae/host; Suncus murinus (nine hosts) carried 89.67 larvae/host. National surveillance reports 127 scrub typhus outbreaks (2009–2023): 3,751 human cases and 93 deaths; rural Tamil Nadu hospitalization approximates one-fifth of diagnosed cases. The study clarifies environmental distribution, transmission ecology, and reservoir associations, underscoring ongoing scrub typhus risk in rural Tamil Nadu.

article.articleHeadline: Dual Hepatitis B and HIV Functional Cure Requires Dedicated Coinfected
article.articleSummary: Global HBV/HIV-1 coinfection affects about 3.4 million people among roughly 40.8 million living with HIV-1 at end-2024, with HIV-positive individuals showing 8.4% HBsAg positivity. Regional variation is substantial: West/Central Africa 12.4%, Asia-Pacific 9.8%, Latin America 5.1%, and Western Europe/North America 6.0%. Nigeria, Ghana, and Ethiopia report 10–15% coinfection; China’s registry shows 8.7% of 33,861 patients. Coinfection accelerates liver disease and hepatocellular carcinoma risk: HCC incidence ~1.8 per 1,000 person-years in North America and 1.7 in Swiss cohorts. Key risk factors include age >40, HCV coinfection, alcohol, HIV viremia >500 copies/mL, HBV >200 IU/mL, low CD4 counts, and cirrhosis. Tenofovir-containing ART reduces HCC incidence, but longer survival raises lifetime risk. Functional cure requires HBV seroclearance of HBsAg for ≥24 weeks with undetectable HBV DNA and durable HIV control after stopping therapy. HBV and HIV persistence in hepatic reservoirs—HBV cccDNA and HIV in hepatocytes, Kupffer cells, and liver CD4 T cells—complicates cure.

article.articleHeadline: Why kissing newborns can be dangerous and how parents can prevent infections
article.articleSummary: Newborns are highly vulnerable to infections in the first weeks due to immature immune systems, especially premature babies or those with health conditions. From New Delhi, the guidance warns that kissing a newborn on the face, lips or hands can transmit germs via saliva and droplets, notably herpes simplex virus which can cause serious illness in infants, and respiratory viruses like RSV and influenza. Because many infections are contagious even without symptoms, parents should set boundaries: wash hands before touching the baby, avoid kissing, limit the number and duration of visits, and ensure visitors with fever, cough, cold, sore throat, skin infections or illnesses postpone visits. For premature infants, extra precautions and adherence to the paediatrician’s guidance on vaccination, hygiene, and avoiding crowded places are advised. Seek medical care for fever ≥38°C in a baby under 3 months, poor feeding, sleepiness, breathing difficulties or changes in skin color.

article.articleHeadline: Escalating fighting in eastern DRC drives civilian displacement and forces Ebola team evacuations
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, intensified fighting in Djugu territory, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, between the Congolese army and the CRP rebel group led by Thomas Lubanga, has displaced thousands and disrupted Ebola response activities. The clashes near Bunia forced evacuations of World Health Organization personnel, Congolese health ministry staff, and Africa CDC colleagues from Akwe hospital after sheltering there for days, with response teams also relocated from Mongbwalu to Bunia. The Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain has infected nearly 12,000 people and claimed more than 5,800 lives since its declaration on 15 May; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. The United Nations has restricted staff movements, complicating humanitarian aid. WHO Director‑General Tedros warned that heavy combat near a hospital endangers both facilities and the broader response, though the outbreak remains designated a public health emergency of international concern due to insecurity.

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn nhiều người dân ở Cà Mau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dogs suspected of having rabies bite many people in Ca Mau
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau, Vietnam — A dog suspected of rabies attacked seven residents across two communes, U Minh and Nguyen Phich, on 23–24 November 2026. The 18 kg dog was reported by owner Lâm Hồng Sơn. After biting in Nguyen Phich, residents beat the dog to death and dumped its carcass into a river, preventing laboratory confirmation. The seven bite victims received wound care and were given post-exposure vaccination; they are under medical observation. Authorities say this is a high-risk situation due to multiple attacks, and have launched an integrated response: compiling the seven cases; tracing contact with the dog; ring-vaccinating dogs and cats in the two communes and neighboring areas; sanitation and disinfection of premises and routes used by the animal; and ongoing search for the carcass for proper disposal.

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A gia tăng, cảnh báo nguy cơ biến chứng trong mùa lạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the rise, warning of the risk of complications during the cold season.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising in Nghe An Province, Vietnam, with increasing hospital visits. At Nghe An Friendship General Hospital, 59 influenza A cases were treated in September 2026; 289 in October; by mid‑November the figure surpassed 300, with some days near 50. Nghe An Obstetrics and Pediatrics Hospital reported admissions among high‑risk patients for potential pneumonia and respiratory failure. The provincial CDC records over 2,000 seasonal flu cases province‑wide, with no deaths to date. Common symptoms include fever, headache, cough, myalgia and fatigue. Authorities urge prevention in schools and communities: hygiene, regular cleaning, access to soap and water, ventilation, and rapid outbreak reporting. Influenza is mainly A and B; annual vaccination with updated strains is advised. Dosing guidance: children 6 months–<9 years may require two doses if never vaccinated; others typically one dose yearly. Pregnant women should receive inactivated vaccine to protect mother and newborn.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型が増加、寒冷期における合併症リスクへの警告

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加パターンであり、重症例や死亡例の報告はない。地域の公衆衛生当局が予防策を呼びかけている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Malaria Parasite in Thailand Exhibits Broad Host Plasticity and
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium collidatum, the avian malaria parasite in Thailand, shows host plasticity across pheasants, doves, pigeons, and rails yet strict geographic structuring among provinces. Five isolates collected 2018–2025 from three Thai provinces (Nakhon Sawan, Chonburi, Nakhon Pathom) were analyzed; near-complete mitochondrial genomes (~5.8 kb) revealed distinct regional lineages with zero interprovincial haplotype sharing. Infection prevalences were 2% in feral pigeons (2018), 7% in kalij pheasants and Siamese firebacks (2021), 6% in white-breasted waterhens (2023), and 5% in spotted doves (2025). Diagnoses began with nested cytb PCR, followed by mitogenomic amplification and BLAST confirmation of lineage pFANTAIL01. The results imply environmental filters, geographic distance, or local vector communities constrain dispersal more than host barriers, highlighting the value of mitogenomes for fine-scale phylogeography.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : gratuité des soins dans 14 zones de santé de l'Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Free healthcare in 14 health zones of Ituri
article.articleSummary: Free healthcare now covers 14 of Ituri province's 36 health zones during the Ebola outbreak to sustain general health services alongside the outbreak response. Presented at a 24 November 2026 technical meeting in Bunia, the measure operates under the 'direct service financing' mechanism. It addresses facility challenges such as reduced patient visits and staff departures by providing medicines, covering operating costs, and supporting human resources, with the aim of keeping clinics and hospitals functioning and ensuring continuity of care for malaria, tuberculosis, HIV, hypertension, and diabetes while Ebola response continues. Financing comes from the World Bank and the European Union. The plan was previously announced on 19 June 2026 by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba for free care across all Ituri health facilities during the Ebola period.

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi dại cắn 7 người ở Cà Mau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog suspected of rabies bites seven people in Ca Mau.
article.articleSummary: A dog in Ca Mau Province suspected of rabies bit seven people across U Minh and Nguyễn Phích Communes on 23–24 November 2026. The animal, about 18 kg, belonged to L.H.S. from ấp Cái Tàu, xã U Minh. After displaying unusually aggressive behavior, it ran through two hamlets before biting residents in both communes. Local residents killed the dog and dumped the carcass into a river. Authorities have attempted to locate the carcass for rabies testing, but it has not been found. All seven bite victims were taken to health facilities for wound care and administration of post-exposure rabies vaccination. The Livestock and Animal Health Station has forwarded exposure details to the two commune health stations to monitor and follow up exposures and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省で狂犬病疑いの犬が7人を噛む
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病流行地であるベトナムでの散発的な犬咬傷事例であり、被害者は全員暴露後ワクチン接種済みで地元当局が対応中。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 死体が発見できず確定診断は未実施だが、咬傷被害者は全員医療機関で暴露後ワクチン接種を受けており、地域の家畜衛生当局が追跡調査を実施中。狂犬病はベトナムで地方流行性であり、本事例は単発的な動物咬傷事案として扱うのが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Microtubules restrict Ebola replication in new BSL-2 model
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus (EBOV) replication machinery, including L polymerase, NP, VP35, VP30, can be studied under BSL-2 using stable cell lines with Strep-tagged L, enabling sustained minigenome replication and infectious virus-like particles (iVLPs). Purification allows low-speed pelleting of iVLPs and delipidated RNPs, followed by density-gradient ultracentrifugation. Proteomics revealed tubulin isoforms associating with core RNPs, suggesting cytoskeletal linkage. Depolymerizing microtubules with nocodazole increased viral RNA synthesis, inclusion-body formation, and particle output; 3D confocal shows inclusion bodies in gaps of the microtubule network, implying physical constraint on replication. The system removes BSL-4 requirements for L/RNP research, aiding antiviral screening and host-factor studies, and can be adapted to other ebolaviruses, including Bundibugyo virus. Research led by Jin Zhong at ShanghaiTech University, published in Virologica Sinica.

triage.headline_ja: 新規BSL-2モデルにおいて微小管がエボラウイルスの複製を制限する

triage.notes: 記事は上海科技大学の研究室で行われた細胞培養系を用いた基礎研究の報告であり、実際のエボラ発生事例ではない。発生地域として上海・中国が付与されているが、これは研究実施場所であり、感染症の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Mẹ mắc viêm gan B có lây cho con?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can a mother with hepatitis B transmit it to her child?
article.articleSummary: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection can be transmitted from mother to child, mainly during childbirth and sometimes in pregnancy. Transmission risk depends on maternal HBV DNA level and HBeAg status; with proper monitoring, treatment, and timely infant vaccination, the risk is reduced. Before pregnancy, women should be evaluated (HBsAg, HBeAg, HBV DNA, liver enzymes) to plan prevention. If HBV DNA ≥200,000 IU/mL (≈5.3 log10 IU/mL) and HBsAg positive, antiviral therapy may start around week 14 of gestation under medical supervision. At birth, all newborns should receive hepatitis B vaccine as soon as possible, ideally within 24 hours; infants of HBsAg-positive mothers should also receive HBIG within 12 hours. Infants are tested at 9–12 months for HBsAg and anti-HBs to assess infection and vaccine response. Daily caregiving is safe; breastfeeding is allowed after full prophylaxis, unless nipples are cracked or bleeding. Location: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: B型肝炎の母親は子どもに感染させるか？
triage.triage_reason: 母子感染予防に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Demam Anak Turun Belum Tentu Sembuh, Kemenkes Ingatkan Fase Kritis DBD di Musim Hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Child's Fever Subsides, Not Necessarily a Sign of Recovery; the Ministry of Health Reminds of the Critical Phase of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DBD) During the Rainy Season.
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, in Indonesia, Dengue Fever can progress to Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) during the rainy season, when Aedes mosquitoes proliferate. The Ministry of Health warns that the critical phase often occurs as fever subsides, with risks of plasma leakage, bleeding, and shock. Early warning signs include bleeding from nose or gums; seek care promptly. Dengue symptoms typically start 4–10 days after a bite from Aedes aegypti or Aedes albopictus and include sudden high fever for 2–7 days, rash, and sometimes epistaxis. Lab findings commonly show thrombocytopenia and elevated hematocrit. There is no specific antiviral for dengue; management is supportive: fluids, fever reducers per doctor, regular monitoring, and hospitalization if danger signs appear. Prevention emphasizes 3M Plus—drain and cover standing water, recycle or bury containers—plus repellents, protective clothing, and good sanitation, with BMKG rain alerts in NTB.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱に関する一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常な増加や重大なアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Újabb súlyos fertőzés sújtja Borsod megyét! Lázzal, fáradtsággal és izomfájdalommal kezdődik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another severe infection is ravaging Borsod County! It begins with fever, fatigue, and muscle pain.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, Hungary’s National Public Health Institute (NPHI) reported multiple infectious-disease events. In Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, counts include campylobacteriosis 4, salmonella 5, rotavirus 4, infectious hepatitis 21, hepatitis A 19, scarlet fever 5, chickenpox 11, and pertussis 1, with national totals for these diseases: campylobacteriosis 139, salmonella 81, rotavirus 34, infectious hepatitis 40, hepatitis A 31, scarlet fever 57, and chickenpox 57. Two gastroenteritis outbreaks were reported: Somogy county elementary school outbreak, 66 ill of 212 exposed (diarrhea, vomiting); Fejér county nursing-home outbreak, 35 ill of 140 exposed (fever, vomiting, diarrhea), one hospitalization, suspected food source. In Budapest, a lab-confirmed imported measles (morbilli) case in a 38-year-old man who had been in India during incubation and was unvaccinated. Five lab-confirmed mpox cases: four in Budapest, one in Csongrád-Csanád; ages 23–36; none vaccinated against mpox. Hepatitis types A–G are described.

triage.headline_ja: ボルショド県でまた重篤な感染症が蔓延！発熱、倦怠感、筋肉痛から始まる

article.articleHeadline: Over 12.000 smittet av ebola i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 12,000 infected with Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 12,000 people have confirmed Ebola infections in the Congo as of 26 November 2026, with over 5,700 deaths. This outbreak is the second-largest and second-deadliest on record, surpassed only by the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016 (more than 28,600 infections and about 11,000 deaths). It is caused by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus, for which no approved vaccines or treatments exist. Late detection, armed conflict, and a strained health system have accelerated spread compared with previous waves. Ebola has also been detected across East, Central, and West Africa, representing the widest geographic distribution recorded for Ebola on the African continent.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1万2千人以上がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で12,000人以上の感染、5,700人以上の死亡という史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、ワクチン・治療法が未承認のブンディブギョ株による拡大、紛争下での医療体制逼迫という深刻かつ異常な事態のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行を主題としており、モザンビーク・アンゴラは地理的分布の言及のみで主題ではないため対象国リストに含まれないこともあり除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola cases exceed 12,000 as responders struggle to contain outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 12,000, according to government data released on Thursday. Responders continue to struggle to bring the outbreak under control, which is described as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The brief highlights the scale and persistence of transmission within the DRC and the ongoing strain on public health responses. The report focuses on totals and containment challenges rather than detailing deaths, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources. The outbreak remains active across affected regions, underscoring the sustained effort needed from national authorities and international partners to monitor new infections, advance surveillance, and sustain response activities in the face of continued case growth.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が12,000人を超える、対応者らは流行の抑制に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が史上2番目の規模の流行となり12,000例を超え、制御に苦慮している状況はIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 死亡者数、検査確定数、感染源の詳細は記事中に記載なし。史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行とされ、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الأردن خالٍ من إيبولا وبروتوكول للتعامل مع أي إصابة محتملة - سواليف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jordan Ebola-free and a protocol for dealing with any potential infection - Sawaleef
article.articleSummary: Jordan remains Ebola-free with no infections reported. The National Center for Epidemic Control, in coordination with the Ministry of Health, WHO, and UNICEF, has an integrated protocol to manage any suspected case and prevent transmission. WHO classifies Jordan as low-risk; preventive measures have been prepared since June. Arrivals from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda are halted, with Jordanian citizens quarantined if asymptomatic; symptomatic individuals are isolated. Uganda’s outbreak ended after two incubation periods with no new cases; Congo’s outbreak continues. The airport-to-hospital protocol covers entry screening, rapid-response teams, ambulance transfer, a designated receiving hospital, lab testing, and sample handling. Bundibugyo ebolavirus's case fatality in DRC is about 49%; transmission via body fluids, not air. Separately, Jordan intensified polio surveillance after three cases in Deir ez-Zor, Syria among unvaccinated children; two recovered, one under surveillance. Sewage testing is underway; initial environmental results are clear. Vaccination coverage exceeds 95%; vaccines are safe; the national immunization program is among the region’s most successful.

triage.headline_ja: ヨルダンはエボラフリー、感染疑い対応のための対応プロトコルを整備 - Sawaleef
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（致死率約49%）が継続中であり、ヨルダンが渡航制限や入国停止などの対策を講じていることから、深刻な公衆衛生影響と渡航・貿易制限の両基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はヨルダンの予防対応体制であり、エボラの新規発生情報ではなくDRCでの既知の継続流行への言及。ウガンダのアウトブレイクは終息済みと記載。シリアのポリオ症例も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات "إيبولا" المؤكدة بالكونغو الديمقراطية تتخطى 12 ألف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 12,000, according to government data released on 2026-11-26. The figure underscores recurrent waves of Ebola outbreaks across the country and the ongoing challenges they pose to public health. Authorities say outbreak patterns have driven intensified surveillance and health-response efforts aimed at limiting transmission. Ebola is characterized as a highly infectious viral disease with severe and rapidly evolving symptoms and, in some outbreaks, high mortality rates, highlighting the persistent health threat in the region. The report notes the scale and persistence of Ebola in the DRC, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods or infection sources. The update reinforces the need for sustained vigilance and robust public health measures to control the disease.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の累計確認症例が12,000人を超えたとの報道であり、IHR基準の複数該当（深刻性・国際拡大リスク）とWPRO基準の複数該当が認められるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch bệnh sốt xuất huyết tại TP.HCM tăng gần 5 lần sau 10 năm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever epidemic in Ho Chi Minh City has nearly quintupled over the past 10 years.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains Ho Chi Minh City’s top public health burden, with daily cases in all 168 wards and communes. From 2015–2025, city dengue cases ranged 22,679–111,420 annually, averaging about 50,000 and accounting for roughly half of Vietnam’s total dengue cases. Transmission typically peaks June–November, with higher incidence in peri-urban and industrial areas undergoing rapid urbanization. Climate-change vulnerability is highlighted, with studies linking rising temperatures to more hospitalizations and dengue among children. On November 26, 2026, the city launched two climate-health projects for 2025–2028: (1) strengthening community response to climate-related disease risks (HCDC) and (2) improving access to protective health services for children and families in hardship (Center for Social Work and Vocational Education for Youth). Implemented in six wards, the initiatives aim to benefit 790,000 residents, train 80 health workers, and extend early-warning and prevention reach toward 10 million nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市のデング熱流行、10年間で約5倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、既知の季節的流行パターンの範囲内であるため国際的な異常事態とは言えないが、継続的な発生動向と気候変動影響の観点から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市における長期的なデング熱流行の統計分析と、気候変動対応プロジェクトの開始を報じるもので、突発的なアウトブレイクではなく既知の風土病の経年動向に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Gavi Signs Agreement With Serum Institute of India to Secure Rapid Access to Bundibugyo Vaccines
article.articleSummary: ChAdOx1 BDBV, a Bundibugyo strain Ebola vaccine candidate developed by Serum Institute of India with the Oxford Vaccine Group, could supply up to 1.5 million doses for the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, pending positive trial results, regulatory approvals, and WHO SAGE policy recommendations. Gavi signed an advance purchase commitment funded by its First Response Fund to secure rapid access for affected populations if trials succeed. ChAdOx1 BDBV is one of two novel vaccines WHO has recommended for testing in the ongoing outbreak, which has recorded more than 11,600 cases and 5,700 deaths, predominantly in the DRC. SII has manufactured drug substance for over 500,000 doses to enable swift deployment. FRF support includes up to US$40 million for vaccine access and US$10 million to protect routine immunisation; Ervebo doses (70,000) are deployed under research protocols. Disbursements reach the DRC, Uganda, Africa CDC, WHO and UNICEF. Adar Poonawalla highlighted rapid, collaborative action.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：GaviがインドのSerum Institute社とブンディブギョ株エボラワクチン迅速供給確保のための契約を締結
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関する記事で、症例数11,600件超・死者5,700人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際機関（WHO、Gavi、UNICEF）による大規模支援が行われているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン供給契約に関する内容だが、背景として進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（DRC、11,600症例以上、5,700死亡以上）の深刻性を示している。ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Serum Institute of Indiaはワクチン製造元であり発生国ではないためインドは含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Phế cầu khuẩn: Mối nguy thầm lặng ẩn sau những tiếp xúc thường ngày
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcus pneumoniae: The silent danger lurking behind everyday contact.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus pneumoniae (pneumococcus) is presented as the silent, everyday risk in Vietnam via a 15-image public awareness campaign titled 'Pneumococcus – the silent agent.' The bacterium colonizes the oropharynx in roughly 5–90% of healthy individuals depending on population and context and can spread through respiratory droplets during coughing or talking or via contaminated surfaces. Globally, pneumococcus-related diseases—pneumonia, meningitis, and bacteremia—cause about 1.6 million deaths annually. The World Health Organization lists S. pneumoniae on the Bacterial Priority Pathogens List (2024) in a medium-priority category. Economic burden is noted: community-acquired pneumonia costs per case range from USD 4,851–27,661 in some countries; in Vietnam, average adult CAP treatment costs about USD 795 per case with an ~11-day hospital stay. Prevention emphasizes nutrition, hygiene, and handwashing; high-risk groups (children under 5, adults 50+) should consult healthcare providers for vaccines and preventive measures per US CDC.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola cases exceed 12,000 as responders struggle to contain outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 12,000, with 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus species, was declared in mid-May in Ituri province in northeastern Congo and has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this species. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, and strained health services have accelerated transmission, making this the second-largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak on record after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). Control remains elusive, with only about 15% of new cases linked to known contacts, indicating many transmission chains are being missed. A Reuters satellite analysis suggests the official death toll may be substantially underestimated in two hard-hit areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染者数が1万2000人を超え、対応者は流行の抑制に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱が12,000人超・死者5,904人に達し、治療薬・ワクチンもない史上2番目に大きい流行であり、接触者追跡率も低く制御不能な状態が続いているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（8州への拡大）のみ言及されており、Angolaでの発生は記載されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn 7 người tại Cà Mau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog suspected of having rabies bites seven people in Ca Mau.
article.articleSummary: A dog suspected of rabies bit seven people in Ca Mau Province, Vietnam, crossing U Minh and Nguyen Phich communes before being subdued. The 18‑kg dog belonged to Mr. Lam Hong Son of Cai Tau Hamlet, U Minh Commune. All seven victims received wound care and rabies vaccination at medical facilities. With no specimen available for laboratory testing, veterinary authorities assess a high risk of transmission and have activated disease-control measures. The U Minh regional Livestock and Veterinary Station is tracing dogs and cats that interacted with or were bitten by the dog, requiring owners to isolate and monitor those animals to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省で狂犬病疑いの犬が7人を噛む
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの一地域で発生した狂犬病疑い事例で、被害者全員がワクチン接種済みであり、拡大の兆候や国際的な懸念材料は認められない。狂犬病はベトナムで風土病的存在であり異常性は低い。
triage.notes: 地元の家畜獣医当局が接触した動物の追跡・隔離を実施しており、地域レベルで管理されている事案。ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتخطى 12 ألف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 12,000.
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, official government data from the Democratic Republic of the Congo show a notable rise in Ebola virus disease activity, with confirmed infections surpassing 12,000. The latest statistics indicate a sustained increase in cases across the country. The report mentions only confirmed infections and does not provide a breakdown of deaths, regional distribution, laboratory methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The update underscores the ongoing public health challenge Ebola poses for the DRC, which has experienced previous outbreaks in multiple regions. The information comes from government authorities and reflects the Ebola situation in late November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス確定感染者数が1万2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ確定感染者数が1万2000人を超え、持続的な増加が確認されており、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 死亡者数、地域分布、感染源などの詳細情報は不明。続報と公式統計の更新を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Một bữa ăn có thể đưa vi khuẩn kháng kháng sinh vào cơ thể như thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How can a meal introduce antibiotic-resistant bacteria into the body?
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant bacteria can enter the body through meals—especially undercooked meat, unwashed produce, and cross-contamination in kitchens. WHO warns that resistant bacteria can move from animals to humans along the food chain when farming, slaughtering, processing, and storage are unsafe. In livestock, antibiotics are widely used; susceptible bacteria are killed, while resistant strains survive and multiply. In Vietnam, studies find drug-resistant E. coli in chicken, pork, beef, fish, and shrimp sold in markets, with some samples carrying colistin resistance genes, last-resort antibiotic. Transmission occurs from farm to table during slaughter, transport; produce can be contaminated by polluted water or manure. Household risks include using the same knives, boards, and surfaces for raw and cooked foods, and inadequately washed vegetables. Preventive steps: cook thoroughly, separate utensils, wash hands, sanitize surfaces, and refrigerate promptly. From 2026-01-01, Vietnam plans to end antibiotic use in animal feed within defined scope. WHO notes resistance remains high.

triage.headline_ja: 一食の食事がどのように抗生物質耐性菌を体内に取り込ませるのか？
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや急性感染症イベントではなく、抗生物質耐性(AMR)に関する一般的な啓発・教育記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、食品を介した薬剤耐性菌（AMR）のリスクに関する一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事。ベトナム政府の2026年からの家畜飼料への抗生物質使用禁止方針に言及あり。継続的な動向把握は有用だが、即時のシグナル対応は不要。

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Penyakit DBD di Lamongan, Dinkes Waspadai Lonjakan Saat Musim Hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating Dengue Fever in Lamongan, Health Department Warns of a Surge During the Rainy Season.
article.articleSummary: Lamongan Regency, East Java, Indonesia, braces for dengue as the rainy season approaches. As of November 2026, the district recorded 86 dengue fever (DF) cases with severe symptoms, including Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS). There were 110 mild dengue fever cases and 12 suspected cases. The shift from dry to rainy weather raises concerns about Aedes aegypti breeding, with the mosquito’s life cycle potentially producing adults in about a week. Despite a lower cumulative total than nearly 400 cases in 2025, authorities remain vigilant. Public health measures emphasize 3M Plus and prompt medical evaluation if fever lasts three days, advising visits to a puskesmas (community health center). Prevention concentrates on eliminating standing water to curb vector breeding and mitigate outbreak risk ahead of the wet season.

triage.headline_ja: ラモンガンでのデング熱対策、保健局が雨季中の急増を警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行であり、前年より症例数は減少しているが、雨季を前に引き続き監視が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地域の季節性デング熱流行に関する通常の公衆衛生対策報道。重症例（DSSを含む86例）が報告されているが、前年同期より総数は少なく、地方当局により管理可能と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Skræktal: 12.000 smittet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking statistic: 12,000 infected.
article.articleSummary: More than 12,000 confirmed Ebola infections have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, government data cited by Reuters show. The outbreak, declared in May, has spread across large parts of the eastern and northeastern DR Congo, a region long plagued by violent conflict for more than three decades. The Bundibugyo variant driving the outbreak is less common, and there are currently no vaccines or treatments for this strain. Ebola typically causes severe fever and can progress to uncontrollable bleeding, often fatal. WHO data from mid-November indicate more than 5,600 deaths linked to the current outbreak in DR Congo. The situation reflects ongoing transmission in conflict-affected areas, highlighting the need for effective countermeasures and public health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 衝撃的な統計:12,000人感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が1万2千人超感染、5600人超死亡と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、ワクチン・治療法がなく紛争地域での拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による大規模アウトブレイクで、紛争地域での対応困難さが懸念される。既存のWHO/フルRRA評価が進行中である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Zhejiang Scrub Typhus Surveillance Reveals Summer Surges and Persistent
article.articleSummary: From 2021–2025, Zhejiang Province in southeastern China documented 1,950 scrub typhus cases, with an average annual incidence of 0.59/100,000 and one fatality in 2021 (Pingyang County, Wenzhou City). Five-year surveillance shows endemic transmission with summer surges and persistent county clusters, plus diagnostic delays in about 30% of patients (>7 days from onset to diagnosis). Annual counts fluctuated: 2021, 480 cases (0.74/100,000; 24.6%); 2022, 259 (0.40); 2023, 416 (0.63); 2024, 231 (0.35); 2025, 564 (0.85; 28.9%). Older rural residents and farmers were disproportionately affected: 60+ accounted for 57.9% (1,130 cases); 40–59 for 33.7% (658); <40 for 8.3% (162); females 56.2%. Transmission is driven by Leptotrombidium deliense in summer and L. scutellare in autumn–winter. Lab confirmation used Weil-Felix, Orientia tsutsugamushi IgM (IFA or colloidal gold), PCR, or culture; reporting occurs through NNIDRIS.

triage.headline_ja: 浙江省のツツガムシ病サーベイランス、夏季の増加と診断遅延の持続を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 2021〜2025年の浙江省における既知の風土病（ツツガムシ病）に関する定期サーベイランスのまとめ記事であり、異常な増加や新規性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はベクター媒介性の風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。5年間の累積データに基づく学術的サーベイランス報告であり、緊急対応を要する新規アウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie eboly v Kongu dál sílí. Počet potvrzených případů překročil 12 tisíc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo continues to intensify. The number of confirmed cases has surpassed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to intensify, with confirmed cases surpassing 12,000 and 5,904 deaths; total infections reach 12,021 as of 26 November 2026. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo lineage, for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. The disease has spread to eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces, with many fatalities occurring outside health facilities. Transmission remains largely uncontrolled, with only 15% of new cases linked to known contacts. Contributing factors include late detection, ongoing armed conflict, and an overburdened health system. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history; only the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was larger. Nigeria reported a case by late October, with additional imported cases in Kenya and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行がさらに拡大。確認症例数が1万2千人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が進行中で、感染者1万2千人超・死者5,904人、国際的拡大（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダへの輸出症例）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダへの輸出症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。シエラレオネ・リベリア・アンゴラは2014-2016年の過去の流行への言及であり、現行アウトブレイクの発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Một con chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn nhiều người dân ở Cà Mau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dog suspected of having rabies bites many residents in Cà Mau.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, seven residents in two communes of Ca Mau Province, U Minh and Nguyễn Phích, Vietnam, were bitten by a dog weighing about 18 kg suspected of having rabies. The dog described as rabies-suspect attacked multiple people in the area. In response, residents killed the dog and disposed of its carcass by throwing it into a river. The report notes no laboratory confirmation of rabies and provides no details on post-exposure treatment or follow-up actions. This event highlights potential exposure risk in rural Ca Mau communities and underscores the need for rapid veterinary assessment, rabies risk communication, and public health measures to manage suspected rabies cases and exposures, including monitoring for additional bites within U Minh and Nguyễn Phích communes.

triage.headline_ja: カーマウ省で狂犬病疑いの犬が多数の住民を噛む
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑いの犬による複数人咬傷事例だが、検査確認なし・曝露後予防措置の詳細も不明であり、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムの農村部で散発的に発生する風土病であり、本件も地域ニュースレベルの事案。検査確認や曝露後予防（PEP）実施状況の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число заболевших Эболой превысило 12 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of Ebola cases has surpassed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 12,000 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths (case fatality 49.1%). In the past 24 hours, 66 new cases and 37 deaths were reported; 85.1% of contacts are being traced. There are 1,092 patients in medical isolation or quarantine with suspected Ebola. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, beginning in May in DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in Ituri province; there are no WHO-licensed drugs or vaccines for this strain. Uganda declared the outbreak over on July 28 (confirmed by WHO); Kenya reported its first Ebola case on October 6; Nigeria detected Ebola on October 20, illustrating cross-border transmission and import/export risks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が1万2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率49.1%の大規模エボラ流行で死者数が急増しており、国際的な越境伝播（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは7月28日に終息宣言済み、ケニア・ナイジェリアでも症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない（DRCのみ対象国リストに該当）。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株にはWHO承認薬・ワクチンが存在しない点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ bệnh dại trên các tuyến đường vận chuyển chó, mèo tại Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies risk on transport routes for dogs and cats in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: FOUR PAWS investigations reveal illegal transport of dogs and cats across Vietnam and from Laos, with trucks carrying up to 400 animals and intermediaries moving as many as 1,000 daily. Highway 1A is the trafficking artery, linking southern supply hubs to demand in Hanoi. With Vietnam recording about 70–100 human rabies deaths per year, shipments of unvaccinated animals without veterinary certificates or border checks heighten cross-border transmission risks and hinder national and regional disease controls, undermining the Zero by 30 target to end dog-mediated human rabies by 2030. Jon Rosén Bennett of Four Paws warns that each unvaccinated animal may carry deadly viruses, and highlights enforcement gaps—uneven inspections and weak interagency coordination among border control, veterinary, and regulatory bodies. Welfare concerns include overcrowding, injuries, and deaths. Calls for stronger enforcement and a nationwide ban on dog and cat meat.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおける犬猫の輸送ルート上の狂犬病リスク
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病は既知の風土病であり急性のアウトブレイクではないが、違法な動物輸送による感染拡大リスクの指摘があり、継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の狂犬病流行状況下での違法な犬猫輸送（ラオスからベトナムへの越境輸送を含む）に関する動物福祉・公衆衛生上の懸念を扱ったもので、急性のアウトブレイク報告ではない。ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。年間70-100人の人獣共通感染症死亡者数は既知の背景値であり、新規の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Okay News Daily Briefing, November 26: Ports, Elections and Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola funding: Africa CDC and WHO estimate US$1.576 billion through May 2027 for the continental Ebola response, centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid conflict and displacement that hinder access. Nigeria port modernization: Nigeria starts US$1 billion Lagos port upgrade (Tin Can Island, Apapa) financed by UK Export Finance (£746 million loan) with KUKE reinsurance; project aims to rebuild quay walls, replace paving, and install new equipment to shorten vessel turnaround times and reduce trade costs, with emphasis on local hiring and domestic procurement. Owerri airport: Sam Mbakwe International Cargo Airport reopens for daytime flights after runway extension to 3.2 km; night flights await runway lighting. Other items: US tariff consultation on 14 economies; Nigeria not listed, with comments due January; university calendar considerations around the 2027 elections and related travel implications."} }{

triage.headline_ja: Okay Newsデイリーブリーフィング、11月26日：港湾、選挙、そしてエボラ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国における継続中のエボラ対応への資金調達計画に関する報道であり、新規の症例増加や異常な公衆衛生事象を示す情報は含まれていないため。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases surpass 12,000 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed Ebola cases, according to government data released from Kinshasa. The country has a history of repeated Ebola outbreaks, prompting authorities to bolster disease surveillance and containment efforts. Ebola is a serious viral disease with rapid symptom progression and case fatality rates that can be high in some outbreaks. The reported figure underscores Ebola’s ongoing public health challenge in the region and the need for sustained response measures to detect, contain, and manage cases within the DR Congo. The article highlights continued government surveillance to curb transmission and strengthen outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例が12,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例が12,000人を超える大規模流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 症例数12,000人超という大規模感染拡大であり、致死率や死亡者数などの詳細情報は記事本文に記載なし。続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn 7 người bị thương
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog suspected of having rabies bites seven people.
article.articleSummary: Rabies suspected in Ca Mau, Vietnam. A dog, about 18 kg from the Lam Hong Son household in U Minh, ran through U Minh and Nguyen Phich communes on 23–24 November, biting seven residents. After captures, locals disposed of the dog in a river; the carcass has not been found, so laboratory confirmation cannot be obtained. The seven bite victims received wound care and post-exposure prophylaxis, with medical follow-up. Authorities consider this a high-risk animal incident and have initiated control measures without awaiting test results: enumerate the seven cases, conduct contact tracing for dog/cat exposures, vaccinate dogs and cats in the two communes and adjacent areas, and perform sanitation and disinfection of affected areas, with ongoing searches for the animal if found. No imported or exported rabies cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病感染が疑われる犬が7人に噛み付き負傷
triage.triage_reason: 単発の犬による咬傷事件で、地元当局が曝露後予防や衛生対策など適切に対応しており、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ベトナム・カーマウ省での単発の狂犬病疑い事件。咬傷者7名は曝露後予防を受けており、当局が接触者追跡・ワクチン接種・消毒等の対応を実施済み。検体確保ができず確定診断には至っていないが、地域的に管理可能な事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Broj slučajeva ebole u Kongu premašio 12.000: Preminulo više od 5.900 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in Congo has surpassed 12,000: More than 5,900 people have died.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 12,021 Ebola infections and 5,904 deaths as of 2026-11-26, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus first detected in Ituri province (northeast) and spreading to eight of 26 provinces. No approved therapeutics or vaccines exist for this strain. Late case detection, armed conflict, and an overwhelmed health system have accelerated spread versus prior outbreaks. Africa CDC notes only about 15% of new cases involve individuals already known to authorities, indicating numerous undetected transmission chains. The current outbreak is the second-largest and deadliest on record, after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 cases and >11,000 deaths). Reuters satellite analysis suggests official death tolls in the two hardest-hit provinces may be substantially understated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万2000人を突破：死者5900人以上
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）がDRCで大規模に拡大し、死者数5900人超・感染者1万2000人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、多数の未検出感染連鎖が存在するためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリー中で言及されていないため除外。承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しない株であること、武力紛争による保健システムの機能低下、検出漏れが多いことから国際的拡大・管理困難性が高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: صحيفة عمون : حالات إيبولا في الكونجو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 12 ألفا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ammon News: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000.

Reuters satellite analysis suggests the official death toll may undercount deaths in two hardest-hit areas.

triage.headline_ja: アンモン・ニュース：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例が12,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで12,000例・5,904死亡と大規模化し、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、紛争や検知遅延で感染連鎖の追跡も不十分であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: حالات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 12 ألفاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo exceed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths reported. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain and began in mid-May in Ituri province in northeastern DRC, spreading to eight of the 26 provinces. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this strain. Delays in detection, ongoing conflict, and strained health services have accelerated transmission compared with previous outbreaks. triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が12,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（まれなブンディブギョ株）がDRCで12,000人以上の症例・約5,900人の死者を出し、史上2番目に大規模な流行となっており、承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在せず、紛争下で感染経路の追跡も困難なため国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Науковці створили модель для дослідження реплікації Ебола в умовах BSL-2 -- News-Medical
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists created a model for studying Ebola replication in BSL-2 conditions.
article.articleSummary: Researchers at ShanghaiTech University have developed a stable cell-line system enabling study of Ebola virus polymerase L replication under BSL-2 conditions. The cell lines express Ebola L with a Strep tag together with viral NP, VP35, and VP30, and a clone supporting long-term replication of a minigenome and the formation of infectious virus-like particles was selected. This allows detection of L via the tag without L-specific antibodies. Proteomic analyses of purified virus-like particles and RNP complexes revealed an association between tubulin isoforms and core RNP proteins, a previously undescribed link between the replication apparatus and the cytoskeleton. Partial disruption of microtubules with nocodazole increased viral RNA synthesis, intracellular inclusions, and particle egress; 3D confocal imaging placed inclusions within microtubule network gaps, suggesting the network constrains replication. The system could be used for antiviral screening, study of cellular factors, and adaptation to other ebolaviruses, including Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちがBSL-2条件下でエボラウイルスの複製を研究するためのモデルを作成
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は上海の研究機関による基礎研究（細胞株モデルの開発）に関する内容であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ発生事例ではなく、BSL-2環境でのウイルス複製研究のための実験モデル開発に関する学術的報告である。中国（上海）は研究実施地であり、感染症発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC supera la barrera de los 12.000 casos de ébola, incluidos más de 5.900 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses the 12,000 Ebola cases threshold, including more than 5,900 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 5,904 deaths, according to the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) data as of November 24. Declared on May 15 in the DRC, the epidemic is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the country and the second deadliest globally. The latest tally shows 12,021 infections and a case-fatality rate of 49.1%. The figures come from INSP’s update and underscore the ongoing severity of the outbreak in the DRC. The brief note does not provide details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例数が1万2000人を突破、死者数は5900人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染の懸念から国際的拡大リスクも高く、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言された第17次エボラ流行で、既に12,000例・致死率49.1%に達する大規模流行。症状詳細や感染源、輸出入症例の情報は本記事には記載なし。継続的なフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: حالات إيبولا في الكونجو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 12 ألفا... - الوكيل الإخباري
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 12,000, with 5,904 deaths, according to official data. Health authorities report that response teams are still struggling to contain what is described as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form of Ebola, which was first detected in mid-May in Ituri Province in northeastern DR Congo. Since May, transmission has extended to eight of the country’s 26 provinces, indicating broad geographic spread beyond the initial northeastern hotspot. A Thursday update confirms these figures and emphasizes the ongoing nature of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が1万2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が記録史上2番目の規模に拡大し、8州に拡散しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の多くに該当するため。
triage.notes: 史上2番目の規模とされるエボラ流行で、死亡者数5,904人、感染拡大が8州に及ぶなど重大な公衆衛生事案。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Број обољелих од еболе премашио 12.000: Преминуло 5.900 људи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases exceeded 12,000: 5,900 people have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, began mid-May in Ituri province (northeast) and has spread to eight of 26 provinces. Reported cases exceed 12,000 with about 5,900 deaths. There are no approved medicines or vaccines for this strain. Late case detection, armed conflict, and an overwhelmed health system have accelerated spread compared with prior outbreaks. Africa CDC notes only about 15% of new cases originate from known health authorities, indicating many transmission chains remain unidentified. triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者数が12,000人を超える：5,900人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で、史上2番目の規模・致死数に達し、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争による対応困難、追跡不能な感染連鎖が多数存在するなど深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及なし（Ituri州・DRC内8州への拡大のみ記載）のため除外。承認薬・ワクチンがない株であり、致死率把握も過小評価の可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hujan Turun di Banyak Wilayah, Kemenkes Ingatkan Diare dan ISPA Mengintai saat Banjir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain Falls Across Many Regions as the Ministry of Health Warns that Diarrhea and Acute Respiratory Infections Lurk During Floods
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces health risks from ongoing floods as rain is forecast across Riau and the Riau Islands, with Jakarta also expected to be wet. The Health Ministry warns seven diseases to monitor during the rainy season: diarrhea, dengue fever, leptospirosis, acute respiratory infections (ARIs), skin diseases, other gastrointestinal infections such as typhoid fever, and worsening of chronic illnesses. Diarrhea risk rises when floods contaminate drinking water, especially shallow wells; clean water access becomes limited. Preventive steps include boiling drinking water, and hygiene measures: washing hands with soap before meals, before food preparation, after defecation, after feeding a child, and after touching dirty objects or animals. ARIs spread easily in shelters; management focuses on rest, symptom-based treatment, and reducing transmission by covering coughs and not spitting. Citizens are urged to seek local health care promptly if diarrhea or ARI symptoms appear, and to maintain general hygiene and food safety.

triage.headline_ja: 各地で降雨、インドネシア保健省が洪水時の下痢・急性呼吸器感染症に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団発生報告ではなく、雨季・洪水に伴う一般的な疾病予防の注意喚起であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数の報告はなく、保健省による季節的な予防喚起情報にとどまる。続報で具体的な集団発生が報告されれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا المؤكدة بالكونغو الديمقراطية تتخطى 12 ألف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has more than 12,000 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, according to government data released in Kinshasa. The country continues to experience recurrent Ebola outbreaks, prompting intensified epidemiological surveillance and health-response efforts to curb transmission. Ebola virus disease is a viral infection characterized by severe illness with rapid onset of symptoms, and high fatality rates have been reported in some outbreaks. The report highlights persistent transmission within the DRC and the ongoing need for robust public health action to detect, isolate, and manage cases, trace contacts, and strengthen outbreak response. The data underscore the ongoing challenge Ebola poses to national health systems and the importance of sustained control measures.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpass 12,000, death toll nears 6,000
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak remains severe, with 12,021 laboratory-confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths (up 37 in the past day). 66 new cases were recorded in the last 24 hours. The case fatality rate is 49.1%, and contact tracing covers 85.1% of contacts. About 1,092 people suspected of infection are in medical isolation facilities or quarantine. The outbreak began in May in DR Congo and Uganda and is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, for which WHO has not approved vaccines or treatments. The epicenter is DR Congo’s Ituri Province. Uganda declared its outbreak over on July 28, a decision subsequently confirmed by the WHO. The figures come from DR Congo’s National Institute of Public Health, as reported by TASS.
