article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông ở Đắk Lắk tử vong vì sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man in Đắk Lắk dies from dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: A 25-year-old man from Ea Knốp, Đắk Lắk Province, Vietnam died from dengue fever (dengue shock syndrome). On 18 November he developed high fever, self-medicated, and was admitted on 20 November to 333 General Hospital. NS1 antigen was positive; he was diagnosed with dengue shock syndrome on day 3, with obesity and Down syndrome as comorbidities. He was transferred to Tây Nguyên Regional General Hospital ICU, and at 22:30 on 22 November was moved to Ho Chi Minh City Tropical Diseases Hospital, where he died at 2:00 on 23 November en route. PCR at the Tây Nguyên Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology confirmed Dengue virus serotype 2. This is the fourth dengue death in Đắk Lắk in 2026. Investigations found no dengue cases in the 7 days prior among 17 nearby households; vector indices BI 41.1 and DI 0.17 (larvae per house) in hamlet 1. Provincial authorities urge intensified dengue prevention, surveillance, vector control (adulticiding and larval source reduction), environmental sanitation, and adequate treatment resources.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省の男性、デング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による死亡例（2026年ダクラク省で4例目）で、重症化・媒介蚊指数の上昇が確認され、行政が対策強化を呼びかけている。感染拡大の持続可能性とベクター管理の必要性から要注視と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで流行性疾患であり、本件は単発の死亡例報告だが、同省で2026年に4例目の死亡であり媒介蚊指数（BI41.1）も確認されている。地方当局による対策強化の呼びかけがあり、社会的・行政的関心が高いと判断。ただし新規・異常な発生パターンではなく、国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi dại chạy qua hai xã ở Cà Mau cắn 7 người, địa phương cảnh báo dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected rabid dog runs through two communes in Ca Mau, bites seven people; local authorities warn of an outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau, Vietnam: A suspected rabid dog, ~18 kg with unusually aggressive behavior, bit seven people across two communes, Nguyễn Phích and U Minh. On 23 November at about 10:30, it attacked Lê Hồng Liên on the right leg and then two others, later biting another on the right leg and left upper arm. Four injured were treated and given rabies prophylaxis. The dog’s owner, Lâm Hồng Sơn of ấp Cái Tàu, xã U Minh, kept the animal in a pen; it escaped the next day, biting three more in ấp 9, xã Nguyễn Phích. Villagers killed the dog and dumped its carcass in a river; authorities have not located the body for testing. Seven bite victims sought medical care. The Ca Mau Department of Livestock and Veterinary deemed a high rabies risk and ordered immediate measures: tracing contacts, restraining/monitoring dogs and cats, vaccinating nearby dogs and cats, disinfecting surroundings, and surveillance to locate the animal for testing if found.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省で狂犬病疑いの犬が2つの集落を駆け回り7人を咬む、地元当局が流行警戒
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑いの動物による咬傷事例でヒト7名が曝露し予防措置が取られたが、検査未確定・ヒト-ヒト感染なしの局地的事例であり、IHR基準には該当しないためWATCH。
triage.notes: 狂犬病ウイルスの検査確認は未実施（死骸未回収）。地元当局は犬猫へのワクチン接種・監視等の対応を実施済み。人への二次感染（ヒト-ヒト感染）のリスクは通常狂犬病では極めて低い。

article.articleHeadline: 86 Kasus DBD Berat Tercatat di Lamongan hingga November 2026, Dinkes Waspadai Dengue Shock Syndrome
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 86 cases of severe dengue fever recorded in Lamongan as of November 2026; Health Department warns of Dengue Shock Syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Lamongan, East Java, Indonesia recorded 86 dengue fever cases with severe symptoms through November 25, 2026, according to the Lamongan Health Department. The district also reported 110 dengue cases with mild symptoms and 12 suspected cases. As the dry season gives way to the rainy season, authorities warn that Aedes aegypti mosquitoes could rapidly proliferate in neighborhoods with standing water, potentially fueling transmission. While the total case load this year remains substantially lower than 2025's nearly 400 cases, officials say the shift in weather could reverse the trend as the mosquito life cycle from larva to adult can take about a week. The Health Department has heightened vigilance for Dengue Shock Syndrome, a life-threatening complication that requires urgent medical care. The report underlines the need for fever monitoring and early treatment amid weather changes.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア・ラモンガン県、2026年11月までに重症デング熱86例を記録、保健局がデングショック症候群に警戒
triage.triage_reason: 地域流行性のデング熱であり前年より症例数は少ないが、季節変化による再拡大懸念があり、デング出血熱・ショック症候群への警戒が継続的に必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシア東ジャワ州ラモンガン県の地方風土病的流行であり、例年と比較して現時点では症例数は少ない。乾季から雨季への移行に伴う蚊の増殖リスクが指摘されており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заражения вирусом Эбола в Конго превысило 12 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola virus infection cases in the Congo has exceeded 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths as of 26 November 2026, according to government data cited by Reuters via Armenpress. The outbreak is caused by a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; there are no approved treatments or vaccines for this strain. The epidemic began mid-May in Ituri province in the northeast and has since spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. The current outbreak is the second-largest and deadliest on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that infected more than 28,600 people and killed over 11,000. Africa CDC notes that only about 15% of new cases are among people previously identified as contacts, indicating many transmission chains remain undetected. The article highlights ongoing challenges from armed conflict and health-system overload.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス感染者数が1万2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が8州に拡大し、感染者1万2千人超・死者5900人超と歴史的規模に達しており、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ武力紛争下で対応能力が限定的なため、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないブンディブギョ株による史上2番目に大きい流行であり、接触者以外からの感染が85%を占めるため伝播連鎖の把握が困難。武力紛争による保健システム機能不全も拡大要因。

article.articleHeadline: Çatışmalar arasında salgınla mücadele çabası: Vakalar 12 bini aştı!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Efforts to combat the outbreak amid clashes: Cases have surpassed 12,000!
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 cases and 5,900 deaths amid intensified clashes between government forces and armed groups in Ituri's Bunia and surrounding areas. WHO Ebola Incident Manager Dr. Catherine Smallwood noted that fighting has forced response teams to pull back, hindering contact tracing and safe burials. The main response hub is Bunia, Ituri's capital, with Mongbwalu being a site of initial detection; due to road blockages, WHO temporarily relocated staff to Bunia. An incident in Akwe hospital left about 12 health workers and authorities stranded for three days under crossfire; aid convoy disruptions worsen supply of medical materials and safe dignified burials. In neighboring North Kivu, 20,000 people displaced by attacks further disrupt surveillance. Some CRP clashes are repelled, but security remains fragile.

triage.headline_ja: 紛争の中でのアウトブレイク対応努力：症例数が1万2千人を超える！
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の症例が1万2千人、死者5900人を超え、武装勢力との衝突により対応チームの活動が妨げられるなど深刻かつ異常事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 武装勢力との衝突により接触者追跡や安全な埋葬などの対応活動が妨げられており、北キブ州での2万人の避難民発生もサーベイランスに悪影響を与えている。致死率が高く（約49%）、治安悪化による対応困難が続いているため継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا في الكونجو الديمقراطية.. الإصابات تتجاوز 12 ألفا والوفيات تقترب من 6 آلاف - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: cases exceed 12,000 and deaths approach 6,000 - Libya 24 News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases and approached 6,000 deaths as of November 2026, with 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths reported. The flare-up began in mid-May in Ituri province (northeast) and is linked to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, extending across eight of the country’s 26 provinces. Response efforts confront ongoing containment challenges due to delayed detection, persistent conflict in parts of the country, and strained health services, contributing to wider spread. Africa CDC data from November indicate only about 15% of new cases are linked to known contacts, underscoring gaps in tracing. There are no vaccines or approved therapeutics for Bundibugyo. A Reuters satellite-analysis suggests official death tolls may be undercounted in two heavily affected areas; the outbreak ranks as the second-largest by cases and deaths, after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱:感染者数は12,000人を超え、死者数は6,000人に迫る - リビア24ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が8州に拡大し、死者数が6,000人に迫る深刻な流行であり、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認で接触者追跡率も低いため国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争地域での対応困難、接触者追跡率15%と低く、西アフリカ2014-2016年流行に次ぐ規模とされる。Reuters衛星分析では死者数が過小報告されている可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation Supports Severe Viral Lung Failure in
article.articleSummary: China, a 43-year-old woman with systemic lupus erythematosus on long-term immunosuppression developed influenza A-associated ARDS with refractory hypoxemia and septic shock, accompanied by pancytopenia and coagulopathy. Despite antimicrobials and immune therapy, she required intensive care; chest imaging showed diffuse bilateral infiltrates. Influenza A PCR was positive on Jan 8; TORCH serology suggested CMV reactivation (CMV IgG/IgM) with HSV-1 IgG detected. Marked cytopenias and elevated D-dimer persisted, complicating management. Given bleeding and circuit-thrombosis risks, clinicians used individualized veno-venous ECMO with lung-protective ventilation and tailored anticoagulation. The patient stabilized, was weaned from ECMO and mechanical ventilation, and discharged from The Second Hospital and Clinical Medical School of Lanzhou University, Lanzhou, China. This case highlights ECMO feasibility for lupus patients with severe influenza A–related viral pneumonia.

triage.headline_ja: 全身性エリテマトーデス患者における重症ウイルス性肺不全に対する体外式膜型人工肺（ECMO）支援
triage.triage_reason: 単一の免疫抑制患者における症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 基礎疾患（全身性エリテマトーデス）を有する個別患者の臨床症例報告であり、公衆衛生イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus HIV/AIDS di Kota Sorong Capai 4.711 Orang, 488 Jiwa Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV/AIDS cases in Sorong City reach 4,711 people, with 488 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Sorong City, Indonesia reports 4,711 cumulative HIV/AIDS cases from 2004 through October 2026, with 488 deaths. HIV cases are 1,534 in men and 2,028 in women; AIDS cases are 659 in men and 490 in women. Public health officials cite ongoing challenges: low consistent condom use among key populations, rising high-risk groups, and stigma and discrimination that deter care. Areas of concern include entertainment venues, cafes, bars, massage parlors, sex-work locales, and boarding houses not yet fully reached by outreach or services. KPA Sorong urges involvement of religious leaders, community figures, youth, women, universities, and civil society to broaden education and strengthen prevention and control. The S-TOP strategy - Suluh, Temukan, Obati, Pertahankan - emphasizes education, HIV testing, antiretroviral therapy, and adherence support to sustain treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ソロン市のHIV/AIDS累計症例4,711人、死亡488人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 累計統計データであり、急性の公衆衛生緊急事態や異常な増加を示すものではなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない慢性的な疾病管理の報告である。
triage.notes: 累計症例報告（2004年〜2026年10月）であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。地域保健当局による既存のHIV/AIDS対策プログラム（S-TOP戦略）の文脈での定期報告。

article.articleHeadline: إلى أين وصل تغول فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How far has the Ebola virus's rampant spread reached in the Democratic Republic of Congo?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has surged in the Democratic Republic of Congo to 12,021 laboratory-confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths, six months after its outbreak was declared. An Africa CDC report says the outbreak remains out of control, with transmission crossing eight provinces amid security and health-system challenges, including attacks on healthcare workers, unpaid salaries, and resource shortages that hinder response efforts. Ongoing surveillance and response continue amid recurrent outbreaks. Gavi plans to supply up to 1.5 million doses of an experimental vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, developed by Oxford University and Serum Institute of India, currently in clinical trials in the DRC where no licensed vaccines or treatments exist for this strain. The Bundibugyo outbreak has killed more than 5,700 people to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルスの猛威はどこまで達しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が8州に拡大し12,021例・5,904人死亡、制御不能とされ、医療従事者への攻撃や資源不足も重なっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大なアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: インドは治療薬（オックスフォード大学・インド血清研究所開発のワクチン）開発に関連して言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外。英国も言及なしのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kháng hóa chất diệt muỗi: Thách thức mới trong phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito insecticide resistance: A new challenge in dengue fever prevention and control
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a major public-health challenge in Vietnam in 2026, with 170,600+ cases and 28 deaths reported through November across the country. The Aedes vectors—Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus—are increasingly resistant to common insecticides (DDT, permethrin, deltamethrin), driven by target-site mutations and metabolic mechanisms, complicating vector-control efforts. Dengue transmission now shows year-round activity and a geographic expansion from urban to rural, mountainous areas, straining local health systems. Experts advocate a shift to integrated vector management: regular insecticide susceptibility monitoring, rotating chemical classes, reducing selection pressure, researching new products, and prioritizing non-chemical measures. Larval source reduction (removing standing water) and community participation remain foundational. Southern region (Nam Bo) and Central Highlands-South Central regions face ongoing challenges. A move from pre- to post-market surveillance begins May 1, 2027, requiring firms to demonstrate safety and efficacy, with a national database and enhanced interagency information sharing to detect noncompliant products.

triage.headline_ja: 殺虫剤耐性蚊：デング熱予防・対策における新たな課題
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで例年発生しているデング熱の季節報告であり新規性は低いが、殺虫剤耐性の拡大や地理的拡大（都市部から山岳地域へ）という公衆衛生上の懸念があり、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年ベトナムで流行する風土病であり、本記事の主眼は殺虫剤耐性拡大という技術的・政策的課題。感染者数・死亡者数は深刻だが、IHR基準上の「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」は低いと判断。継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Najbardziej śmiertelna ebola w historii. Podano liczbę ofiar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadliest Ebola outbreak in history. A death toll has been reported.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Detected mid‑May in Ituri province (north‑east), the outbreak has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. It is the second‑largest and most deadly on record, with more than 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths reported from the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic as a comparator. For this strain, there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Africa CDC data published in early November show not all transmission routes are detected; only about 15% of new cases link to a known infected contact. Reuters satellite analysis suggests the official death toll may be undercounted in the two hardest‑hit regions. Transmission begins with spillover from fruit bats and other wildlife, followed by human‑to‑human spread via blood, secretions, and bodily fluids; incubation is 2–21 days. Early symptoms resemble other febrile illnesses, and laboratory testing is essential for diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最も致死率の高いエボラ出血熱流行。死者数が報告される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模とされるエボラ出血熱流行が8州に拡大し、承認済み治療法・ワクチンもなく、感染経路の多くが未特定であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（イトゥリ州発端、8州に拡大）のみが言及されており、Angolaへの越境拡大の記述はないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Zahl der Infektionen steigt auf über 12.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: the number of infections rises to over 12,000.
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 12,021 confirmed Ebola infections and 5,904 deaths, making this the second-deadliest outbreak on record. The epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. It began in mid-May in the north-eastern Ituri Province and has since spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. Public health officials say the outbreak remains uncontrolled, with only about 15% of new cases linked to known contact persons, implying many transmission chains go undetected. By comparison, the worst outbreak occurred from 2014–2016 in West Africa, with over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths. Ongoing monitoring and response efforts continue across affected areas in the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：感染者数が12,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 死者5,904人を含む12,000人超の感染が確認され、ワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ株による制御不能な拡大が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内のエボラ流行拡大に焦点を当てており、アンゴラへの言及はサマリー中に見られないため、Angolaはverified_locationsから除外した。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株であること、接触者追跡率が約15%と低く多くの感染連鎖が検出されていない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương phòng dịch sau vụ chó cắn 7 người tại Cà Mau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent disease-control measures after a dog-bite incident involving seven people in Ca Mau
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Ca Mau province, Vietnam, faces a potential rabies outbreak after a dog suspected of rabies ran loose through U Minh and Nguyen Phich communes, biting seven people on 23–24 November. The 18‑kg dog displayed unusually aggressive behavior before being killed in Nguyen Phich; its carcass was discarded into a river, preventing laboratory confirmation of rabies. All seven bite victims received wound care and post-exposure prophylaxis (rabies vaccination), with rabies immunoglobulin given per medical indication when appropriate. The Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Medicine, in collaboration with the two commune health stations, is conducting contact tracing, enforcing confinement of potentially exposed animals, and carrying out perimeter vaccination around the two communes and nearby areas; sanitation and disinfection are being performed. Authorities urge residents not to let dogs roam or to discard animal carcasses into waterways, and will bolster vaccines, disinfectants, and supplies.

triage.headline_ja: カーマウ省で犬による7人咬傷事件を受け緊急の防疫対策
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑いの犬による咬傷事件だが、全被害者に曝露後予防（PEP）が実施され、地元当局が接触者追跡・周辺ワクチン接種で対応しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 死骸が川に廃棄されたため狂犬病の検査確定はできていないが、全被害者がPEPを受け、地元当局が封じ込め・周辺ワクチン接種を実施中であり、ベトナムでは狂犬病疑い事例は比較的一般的な地域的対応事案と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Students at Sekolah Rakyat in Bandung Report Food Poisoning, Minister: Not Linked to MBG
article.articleSummary: In Bandung, West Java, 270 of 533 students at the Integrated Sekolah Rakyat (SRT) in Soreang reported digestive symptoms after meals, with nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and diarrhea; five were hospitalized and three required dehydration treatment. Kemensos says the incidents are not linked to the Free Nutritious Meals program (MBG); meals are either prepared by the school or served via catering, and the events occurred as Sekolah Rakyat operates in permanent buildings during an early phase. An investigation is underway to determine whether food poisoning or other factors caused the disturbances. Similar reports have emerged in Cilacap, but causation remains unconfirmed. Authorities continue examinations and case management, noting not all affected students required hospitalization, and no laboratory confirmation or infection source has been disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: バンドンの人民学校（Sekolah Rakyat）で生徒らが食中毒を報告、大臣は無料栄養給食プログラム（MBG）とは無関係と説明
triage.triage_reason: 多数の生徒（270/533人）に消化器症状が発生し入院例もあるが、原因（食中毒か感染症か）は未特定で検査結果も未公表。類似事例が他地域（Cilacap）でも報告されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 食中毒の原因（感染性病原体か化学的要因か）は調査中であり、検査結果が判明次第、再評価が必要。類似症例が他校（Cilacap）でも報告されている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Congo supera la barrera de los 12.000 casos de ébola, incluidos más de 5.900 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo surpasses the 12,000 Ebola cases threshold, with more than 5,900 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths as of November 24, 2026 (12,021 infections, 5,904 fatalities; CFR 49.1%). The epidemic, the 17th in the DRC and second deadliest globally, spans 69 health zones across eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, and North and South Ubangi. WHO Director‑General Tedros reiterated the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, signaling late detection and insufficient contact tracing. Africa CDC warns security and displacement in the east could fuel a continental outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatments; two vaccines are in Phase 1 trials. Ervebo vaccination started in late August, with early positive signals against Bundibugyo. Cases have reached Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths), Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), Nigeria (1), France (1); four evacuees to the Netherlands, UK, and Germany.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の感染者数が1万2000人の大台を突破、死者数は5900人超
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続宣言している大規模エボラ流行で、致死率49%、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、オランダ、英国、ドイツへの症例波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Charity Hands Congo Ebola Centre to State
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's Ituri province, with MSF handing over the Mongbwalu Ebola treatment centre to the Ministry of Public Health on 30 November 2026. During a gradual transition the centre will operate with 10 beds for suspected and 10 for confirmed cases, with MSF stressing the epidemic is not over and that it remains in the region. WHO first reported the outbreak on 16 May 2026; by 30 July there were 3,605 confirmed cases, of which 3,176 (88%) were in Ituri, and Mongbwalu health zone had 541 confirmed cases by 1 August, behind Bunia (880) and Rwampara (627). The ECDC update (16 November) cites 11,504 confirmed cases and 5,630 deaths across eight provinces, with ongoing community transmission. May 2026 MSF note said there is no approved vaccine or treatment; clashes in Djugu disrupt access to care, signaling limited surveillance and testing in some areas.

triage.headline_ja: 慈善団体、コンゴのエボラ治療センターを国に引き渡す
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州を中心にエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続中で、確定症例11,504件・死亡5,630件、8州に拡大し地域内伝播が続いているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し高リスク。
triage.notes: 記事内でルワンダ（Kigali Province）は発生地域タグに含まれるが、サマリー本文では言及がなく、DRC国内（イツリ州・Mongbwalu・Bunia・Djugu等）が主題であるため除外。ECDC報告では8州にわたる大規模流行で地域内伝播が継続しており、紛争による医療アクセス制限も監視体制の課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn 7 người bị thương
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog suspected of having rabies bites seven people, injuring them.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau Province, Vietnam: On 23–24 November 2026 a dog suspected of rabies, about 18 kg and owned by Lam Hong Son of Cai Tau Hamlet, U Minh, attacked seven people across U Minh and Nguyen Phich communes. Local residents killed the dog and dumped its body in a river; the carcass has not been recovered, so rabies testing cannot yet be performed. Seven bite victims received wound care and rabies prophylaxis. Authorities are tracing all pets that had contact, urging owners to leash animals, and launching vaccination campaigns and ring vaccination in the two communes and nearby areas to contain the outbreak. Vinh Long Province, Giao Long Commune: a dog confirmed to have rabies bit nine people; eight sought medical care for vaccination and preventive treatment; local authorities are deploying outbreak-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病が疑われる犬が7人を噛んで負傷させる
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は地域で散発的に発生する疾患であり、咬傷者への暴露後予防は実施済みで人から人への感染リスクはないが、確定診断前の事例であり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染がなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。地元当局がワクチン接種キャンペーンとリング接種を実施しており管理可能と考えられるが、カマウ省の犬は死体回収ができず検査未確定。ビンロン省では確定例があり、咬傷者への対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les soignants en première ligne face aux risques de contamination
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: frontline healthcare workers facing the risk of infection.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by Bundibugyo strain, with over 5,300 deaths in six months and ongoing transmission in Ituri and North Kivu. More than 2,900 MSF health workers are deployed to treat patients and curb spread, including nurses, doctors, ambulance crews, and sanitation staff who face persistent infection risk despite PPE and protocols. Testimonies from Mongbwalu (Ituri) describe centers with initial weeks of no survivors; physician Sylvain Radjabu Lubangi contracted Ebola and survived, reshaping his view of patient fears. Ambulance teams report severe-illness transports and exposure to biological fluids. Insecurity and distrust—armed clashes in Ituri, population displacement, and a burned MSF tent—hamper access to care. MSF emphasizes that protecting health workers is essential to improving access, sustaining early detection and treatment, and interrupting transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：感染リスクに直面する最前線の医療従事者
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が継続的に流行し、6か月で5,300人以上が死亡、医療従事者への感染リスクや治安悪化によるアクセス制限など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 死亡者数5,300人以上という記載は非常に大きく、通常のエボラ流行規模を大きく上回るため、数値の正確性について続報確認が必要。治安悪化やMSFテント焼失など人道的アクセスの問題も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев заболевания вирусом Эбола в ДР Конго превысило 12 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 5,904 deaths (case fatality ~49.1%). The National Institute of Public Health reports 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths across eight of 26 provinces in the northern and eastern DRC. The outbreak was officially declared May 15 in Ituri. Cross-border transmission has included cases in Uganda and South Sudan; in August the WHO said Uganda’s outbreak was no longer spreading. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the epidemic remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Africa CDC warns that humanitarian crises, instability, and population movement in eastern DRC could fuel a large continental Ebola flare. Ongoing surveillance and response efforts are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス病確定症例数が12,000人を超過
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言している大規模アウトブレイクであり、致死率約49%、複数国への越境伝播が確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も非常に高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境伝播が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めず。WHOはPHEICを維持しており、Africa CDCは地域的拡大リスクを警告している。

article.articleHeadline: حالات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 12 ألفا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000, with 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths reported. The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, began in mid-May in Ituri province in northeast DRC and has since spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this strain. Prolonged detection delays, ongoing conflict, and overburdened health services have fueled faster spread than in previous outbreaks. The event is the second-largest and deadliest Ebola epidemic on record after the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016, which sickened more than 28,600 and killed over 11,000. Africa CDC data this month show only about 15% of new cases stem from known contacts, leaving many transmission chains undetected. Reuters satellite analysis suggests official death toll may be undercounted in two hard-hit areas. Source: RT and Reuters. 26 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者1万2000人超に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、12,000人超の感染者・6,000人近い死者を伴う大規模アウトブレイクで、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがなく、紛争により対応が困難、追跡不能な感染連鎖も多いためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株による稀な流行で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が特に懸念される。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ史上2番目の規模。Reuters衛星分析では死者数が過小評価されている可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Już ponad 12 tys. zakażeń wirusem ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: Over 12,000 Ebola virus infections.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded 12,021 Ebola infections and 5,904 deaths, according to Reuters citing the Health Ministry. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, was declared in mid-May in Ituri Province, in the northeast of the country. Since then it has spread across eight of DR Congo's 26 provinces, reflecting a substantial geographic expansion since the start of the outbreak. For this Bundibugyo strain, there are no approved treatments or vaccines, underscoring the absence of licensed medical countermeasures specifically targeting this variant, as reported by Reuters.

triage.headline_ja: DRK:エボラウイルス感染者12,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、12,000人超の感染者を伴う大規模アウトブレイクがDRCの8州に拡大しており、承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事例。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済み治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないことが特に懸念される。26州中8州に拡大しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Peste 12.000 de cazuri de Ebola confirmate în RDC, dintre care aproape jumătate sunt decese
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 12,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC, of which nearly half have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths (case fatality 49.1%), across 69 health zones in eight of the 26 provinces. This is the seventh RDC outbreak and the second deadliest globally. Two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, signaling late detection and weak contact tracing. Africa CDC warns that humanitarian crises, insecurity, and displacement in eastern RDC could fuel a continental outbreak. Outside DRC, Uganda's outbreak status was declared over on 26 August after 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths; Kenya has 9 cases (2 deaths), Nigeria 1 case, and France 1 case. Four patients were evacuated to the Netherlands, United Kingdom, and Germany for treatment. For Bundibugyo, no specific treatments exist; two vaccines in Phase 1 show promise but may take months. DRC began Ervebo vaccination in late August, effective against Bundibugyo as well.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確認症例が12,000件を超え、そのうち約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで12,021例・致死率49.1%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの拡大や欧州への患者搬送も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランス・オランダ・ドイツ・英国への拡大や患者搬送が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生国として唯一該当。

article.articleHeadline: حالات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 12 ألفا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 5,904 fatalities. The outbreak, caused by a rare Bundibugyo strain, began in mid-May in Ituri Province in the northeast and has since spread to eight of the country's 26 provinces. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this strain. Delays in detection, ongoing conflict, and strained health services have accelerated spread compared with prior outbreaks. CDC-sourced figures underscore that this is the second-largest, and deadliest, Ebola outbreak on record, surpassed only by the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000. Data cited by the Centers for Disease Control (CDC) inform these counts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者数が1万2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない稀な株による史上2番目に大きい致死的流行であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC国内（イトゥリ州発、26州中8州に拡大）のみを主題としており、Angolaへの越境拡大の記述はないため除外。致死率約49%（5,904/12,000超）、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンなしの稀なブンディブギョ株である点は特に懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases surpass 12,000 as fighting disrupts response in east
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo species, has surpassed 12,000 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths, according to government data on 26 November 2026. The northeastern Ituri province near Bunia declared mid-May hosts the deadliest outbreak on record, with eight of 26 provinces reporting cases. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola. Response efforts are disrupted by clashes between the Congolese army and the Convention for the Popular Revolution (CRP) led by Thomas Lubanga, with crossfire prompting evacuations of staff. About a dozen people, including two WHO personnel and Congolese officials, were evacuated to Bunia after being trapped at Akwe hospital. Delayed detection, conflict, and strained health services have fueled spread. Aid workers reported gunfire while returning to Bunia, and UN peacekeepers escorted them through fighting zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が1万2000人を超える中、東部での戦闘が対応を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: 12,000人超の感染、5,904人の死亡という深刻な被害に加え、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ種エボラが紛争により対応困難となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ種エボラであり、武装勢力との戦闘によりWHO職員含む医療従事者の避難が発生するなど対応が著しく困難化している。史上最悪の規模の発生であり継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk ghi nhận ca tử vong thứ 4 do sốt xuất huyết, bệnh nhân tử vong trên đường chuyển viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak records its fourth death from dengue fever, the patient dies en route to another hospital.
article.articleSummary: Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, reports its fourth dengue death of 2026. The patient, a 25-year-old male resident of Ea Knốp commune, developed high fever on 18 November, self-medicated, and was admitted to the 333 General Hospital on 20 November after NS1 antigen testing positive for dengue. He was diagnosed with dengue shock syndrome on day 3, with obesity and Down syndrome noted. He was transferred the same day to the Tây Nguyên Regional General Hospital ICU and then, at about 22:30 on 22 November, to Ho Chi Minh City’s Hospital for Tropical Diseases. He died en route around 2:00 on 23 November. PCR at the Tây Nguyên Institute of Preventive Medicine confirmed Dengue virus type D2. No additional cases were found among 17 nearby households; vector indices BI 41.1 and DI 0.17 con/house signal ongoing transmission risk. Authorities urged strengthened vector control, surveillance, environmental sanitation, and larval control to prevent further deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でデング熱による4人目の死亡例を確認、患者は転院中に死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで流行性・季節性の疾患であり、本件は単発の重症死亡例の報告にとどまるが、ベクター指数が高く感染リスクが継続しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はダクラク省在住で発症し、重症化後にホーチミン市の病院へ転送中に死亡。発生地域としてはダクラク省が主であり、ホーチミン市は転院先に過ぎない。ベクター指数（BI 41.1, DI 0.17）から地域での感染継続リスクが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : derrière le masque, la voix de nos soignants en République démocratique du Congo (RDC)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Behind the Mask, the Voice of Our Healthcare Workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest and deadliest in the country’s history, with nearly 11,000 cases and more than 5,300 deaths in six months. In Ituri’s epicenter, Mongbwalu hosts MSF’s Ebola Treatment Center, where over 2,900 staff treat Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid insecurity, misinformation and heavy losses. Frontline workers describe high exposure despite protection, with patients presenting blood, diarrhea and vomiting, and some dying before arrival. Dr. Sylvain Radjabu Lubangi, who tested positive and survived, speaks of fear yet resilience, noting Ebola is treatable and strengthens empathy. Adelard Kasereka Kasisivahwa, from North Kivu, oversees about 60 colleagues in water, sanitation and mortuary safety, including transparent-walled mortuary tents for family participation. The pediatric ward reports most positively tested children die, highlighting ongoing severity and the heavy toll on healthcare teams.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:マスクの奥にある、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の医療従事者の声
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模・最も致死的なエボラ流行（約11,000症例、5,300人超死亡）が継続中であり、深刻な公衆衛生インパクトと国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報道であるが、症例数・死亡者数の規模から引き続きフルリスク評価が妥当。小児病棟での高い致死率など新たな重症度情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola w Kongo. Rozpaczliwa walka z epidemią. 12 tys. przypadków zakażenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo. A desperate fight against the epidemic. 12,000 cases of infection.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed infections, with about 5,900 official deaths reported by the government as of 26 November 2026. The outbreak began in May 2026 in Ituri province in the northeast and is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. So far the disease has spread to eight of the country's 26 provinces. Reuters satellite analysis suggests the fatality toll may be higher than official figures, reflecting delays in case detection, conflict, and an overburdened health system. Public distrust has grown, with hostility toward health workers, including attacks. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals, living or dead; the incubation period ranges from 2 to 21 days (commonly 8-10). The current variant kills roughly half of those infected; only about 15% of new cases have a known source.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱。絶望的な疫病との戦い。感染者12,000人。
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで12,000例超・死者約5,900人に達し、8州へ拡大、ワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ株による深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認された治療法のないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行であり、紛争地域での医療従事者への敵意・攻撃など対応能力の限界も報告されている。致死率は約50%と高く、新規感染源の約85%が不明であり感染拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kota Tangerang Perkuat Prioritas Eliminasi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tangerang City Health Office Strengthens TB Elimination as a Priority
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) elimination is a priority for Tangerang City's Health Office, which is tightening prevention and treatment to curb transmission, improve cure rates, and prevent disease progression. TB elimination is one of four health program priorities, alongside Free Health Check (CKG), stunting reduction, and strengthened immunization. Health official Dr. Dini Anggraeni emphasizes that prevention is key to breaking transmission chains, with the public urged to recognize TB symptoms and seek medical evaluation promptly. Early detection and appropriate treatment help prevent worsening illness and reduce contagion risk. The public should not ignore symptoms and should use health facilities for screening. Treatment adherence is essential, with family and community support aiding patients to complete therapy. Achieving elimination requires coordinated efforts from government, healthcare workers, families, and communities.

triage.headline_ja: タンゲラン市保健局、結核撲滅の優先順位を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行病である結核に関する通常の予防啓発・行政施策の記事であり、異常性や新規性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による結核対策強化の通常の広報記事であり、具体的な症例数増加や異常発生の報告はない。対象国リストに該当する国はあるが、既知の地域流行病に関する日常的な行政活動であるためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Masyarakat Diimbau Waspada DBD hingga ISPA di Musim Hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The public is urged to be vigilant for dengue fever and acute respiratory infections during the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: During the rainy season in Bengkulu Province, Indonesia, public health officials urge vigilance for dengue fever (DF) and acute respiratory infections (ARI). The Bengkulu Health Office (Dinkes) notes weather shifts from hot to rainy, calling on residents to strengthen immunity, monitor diet, maintain physical fitness, and stay alert to environmental conditions. Edriwan Mansyur, Head of Prevention and Control of Diseases (P2P) at the provincial Dinkes, says the seasonal change requires heightened public awareness. People are advised to limit outdoor activities unless necessary. ARI remains among the diseases with the highest case numbers, a pattern previously seen during hot, smoky conditions from forest and land fires (karhutla); with the rainy season, ARI is again a major concern due to weather and environmental changes. The message emphasizes health maintenance throughout seasonal transitions.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季におけるデング熱・急性呼吸器感染症への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・ARIに対する一般的な注意喚起であり、異常な発生報告や具体的な症例数増加等のデータはなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の注意喚起情報であり、具体的な症例数・流行状況のデータは含まれていない。例年の季節変動に伴う一般的な予防啓発記事。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Injuries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with more than 5,678 deaths reported. Government data released on 26 November 2026 indicate the outbreak has persisted for over six months, marked by recurring transmission waves that have triggered intensified surveillance and health-response efforts. The figures come from the DRC Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization. Ebola is a viral infectious disease with rapid symptom progression and high mortality in some outbreaks, underscoring the ongoing public health challenge. The report highlights continued transmission and the need for sustained case finding, contact tracing, isolation, risk communication, and supportive care as authorities work to monitor and curb the outbreak across the country.

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل أكثر من 12 ألف إصابة بفيروس إيبولا

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Τα κρούσματα του Έμπολα ξεπέρασαν τα 12.000

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ：エボラ感染者数が12,000人を超える

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-全球登革热暴发速度惊人，病例数34年间增加了34倍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet - The global pace of dengue fever outbreaks is astonishing, with the number of cases increasing 34-fold over 34 years.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreaks are escalating: global reported cases rose from 430,000 in 1990 to 14.7 million in 2024, a 34-fold increase, according to a new analysis presented at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene (ASTMH) meeting in Maryland. The study compiles multiple databases to track time trends. A promising but counterintuitive approach is releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, which reduce virus transmission. In Brazil (2021–2022), about 32 million Wolbachia mosquitoes were released; followed ~6,000 children from 2020–2024, with dengue infection 68% lower in the release area. However, Wolbachia does not eradicate the vector; combination with vaccines is still needed. Another strategy, spatial repellents, lowered dengue risk by 34% in a Peru trial (2016–2019). In Puerto Rico (2024–2025), over 50,000 repellents deployed did not yield a significant difference after adjusting for baseline rates; more trials are required. ASTMH President Albert Ko emphasizes the era as pivotal for understanding what works and scaling interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 科学網－世界のデング熱流行の拡大速度が驚異的、症例数は34年間で34倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学会発表に基づくデング熱の長期的な世界統計・予防介入研究（Wolbachia蚊、忌避剤トライアル）のレビューであり、特定国における急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 記事は2024年までの世界的なデング熱症例数の推移と、ブラジル・ペルー・プエルトリコでの予防介入（Wolbachia蚊放出、空間忌避剤）の研究成果をまとめた学術的総説。特定時点・地域での新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ対象としての緊急性は低い。ペルー・プエルトリコ・米国（メリーランド）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Τα κρούσματα του Έμπολα ξεπέρασαν τα 12.000 | AlphaTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People's Democratic Republic of Congo: Ebola cases surpassed 12,000 | AlphaTV
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 12,021 confirmed Ebola Virus Disease infections and 5,904 deaths, marking the worst outbreak in the country’s history. The flare-up began in May 2026 in Ituri province in the northeast and has spread to eight of the 26 provinces, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain). There are no approved vaccines or therapeutic regimens for this strain. The response is hampered by delayed case finding, ongoing armed conflict, and overwhelmed health systems, accelerating transmission. It is the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, after 2014–2016 West Africa (about 28,600 cases and 11,000 deaths). Official data show only 15% of new cases come from traced contacts, implying many undetected transmission chains; Reuters satellite data suggest the toll may be higher in two severely affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ症例数が12,000人を超える | AlphaTV
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、12,000例超・死者5,900人超のコンゴ民主共和国史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株であること、武力紛争による対応困難、未検知の伝播チェーンの存在など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、8/26州に拡大。武力紛争により対応が困難で、接触者追跡からの新規症例が15%のみと未検知伝播の懸念が強い。史上2番目に大規模・致死的なエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: Bạch hầu, ho gà, uốn ván: Chủ động phòng ngừa ở nhóm nguy cơ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus: Proactive prevention in at-risk groups.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reported in 2025 366 tetanus cases (27 neonatal), 176 pertussis cases, and 3 diphtheria, highlighting ongoing risk despite vaccination. Adults—especially the elderly with chronic disease—and pregnant women are high-priority groups for proactive prevention. In Ho Chi Minh City, October 2026 data show more than 1.57 million residents aged 60+, 11.4% of the population; among analyzed elderly, over 51% have hypertension, underscoring vulnerability when immunity wanes with age. Tetanus can enter via minor wounds, causing generalized muscle stiffness, seizures, respiratory failure and death; diphtheria can produce oropharyngeal membranes with airway obstruction and may damage heart or nerves; pertussis in adults can resemble influenza and trigger pneumonia or severe coughing fits. For pregnant women, vaccination during pregnancy protects the mother and provides transplacental antibodies to the newborn, especially when administered in the third trimester. Regularly review and update vaccination status, and tailor boosters to age, health status, and pregnancy.

triage.headline_ja: ジフテリア・百日咳・破傷風：リスク群における積極的予防
triage.triage_reason: 予防接種啓発を目的とした一般的な公衆衛生情報であり、異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。2025年通年の統計値を基にした啓発記事であり、緊急性や社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種による予防啓発が主旨であり、既知の疾患（破傷風・ジフテリア・百日咳）の年間発生数を引用しているのみで、急増やアウトブレイクの兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 男子被小奶狗抓伤未冲洗伤口，确诊狂犬病，两名患者均转入ICU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man scratched by a young puppy with an unwashed wound diagnosed with rabies; two patients were transferred to the ICU.
article.articleSummary: Two rabies patients are in the Intensive Care Unit at Wuhan Jin Yin Tan Hospital, Wuhan, China. One man scratched on a finger by an unvaccinated small puppy; the wound was not cleaned, and he later developed fear of wind and water before diagnosis. The second man had his hand injured after a puppy licked the wound; the wound was only wiped with alcohol with no post-exposure prophylaxis, and he subsequently deteriorated and was hospitalized. Rabies, once symptoms appear, is nearly 100% fatal, and the report notes that even very young puppies can carry the virus, challenging the belief that only adult or stray dogs pose a risk. Publicly reported on 2026-11-08; as of 2026-11-26, both patients remain in ICU.

triage.headline_ja: 子犬に引っかかれ傷口を洗わなかった男性が狂犬病と診断、2名ともICUへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は中国で散発的に発生する既知の疾患で、個別症例報告であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。公衆衛生上の重大な新興事象ではない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染せず、個別の予防不徹底による既知の疾病発生。子犬からの感染という点は啓発的だが公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 12.000 Infektionen nach Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12,000 infections after the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths, government figures show as of Thursday. The outbreak, first detected mid-May in Ituri province in the northeast, has spread to eight of the 26 provinces. There are currently no licensed vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola virus. Control remains challenging; only about 15% of new cases are from known contact persons, suggesting many transmission chains go undetected. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record; the worst occurred 2014–2016 in West Africa with more than 28,600 infections and over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにより感染者12,000人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが12,021人感染・5,904人死亡と史上2番目に深刻な規模に達し、8州に拡大、ワクチン・治療薬もなく感染経路の追跡も不十分なためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（8州への拡大）のみが言及されており、Angolaへの越境拡大は記載されていないため除外した。致死率約49%と極めて高く、史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn chặn nguy cơ bệnh dại ở Cà Mau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing the risk of rabies in Ca Mau
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk in Ca Mau, Vietnam: A dog suspected of rabies attacked seven residents in U Minh and Nguyen Phich communes on 23–24 November. The 18 kg dog from Mr. Lam Hong Son's household roamed from U Minh to Nguyen Phich, biting seven people who received wound care, rabies vaccine, and rabies immunoglobulin per guidance. The animal was killed by residents after the attacks, and its carcass was disposed of in a river; no specimen has been located to confirm rabies. Despite the absence of a confirmatory sample, Ca Mau’s Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Medicine activated containment measures immediately, including contact tracing, vaccination and confinement of dogs and cats that had contact with the suspected animal, ring vaccination in the two communes and adjacent areas, and enhanced disinfection and public messaging. Authorities urge residents not to let pets roam and to avoid discarding animal remains into rivers.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省における狂犬病リスクの防止
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の疑いのある犬による咬傷事例だが、曝露後予防措置が速やかに実施され、地域の動物衛生当局が封じ込め対応を行っており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで風土病的に発生しており、本件は地方レベルでの通常の曝露後対応・封じ込め措置が取られた局地的事例。確定診断用の検体は未確保だが、人から人への感染拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Le nombre de cas d'Ebola en RDC dépasse les 12.000, selon des données
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the DRC surpasses 12,000, according to data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths reported, affecting eight of the country’s 26 provinces. The 17th outbreak, declared mid‑May, is the largest in the DRC’s history by case count since late July. It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Only about 15% of new cases stem from known contacts, indicating many transmission chains remain undetected. Satellite analyses suggest the official death toll may be undercounted in two heavily affected regions. The outbreak has crossed borders: Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier this year, and Kenya confirmed its first case in October after a Nairobi death from a Kenyan returning from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱症例数、データによると12,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が同国史上最大規模となり、致死率も高く、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境伝播が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの感染拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、未検出の伝播連鎖が多い点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera las barreras de los 12.000 casos y...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses the 12,000-case threshold and...
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 cases and 5,900 deaths, the deadliest in the country’s history and potentially the largest globally. As of 26 November 2026, 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths are reported, with 66 new cases and 37 deaths in the last day. The case fatality rate is 49.1%. About 1,092 people are hospitalized or in isolation; 3,332 have recovered. Eight provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter, 67.7% of cases), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, Ubangi North, and Ubangi South. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. Response is hampered by funding gaps and conflict in eastern DRC, hindering access and driving displacement. The outbreak could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa totals of 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、感染者12,000人の壁を突破し…
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模（12,000例超、死者5,900人超）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率約49%、ワクチン・治療法未承認株（ブンディブギョ株）、紛争による対応阻害など、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い事例。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは言及されておらず主題でないため除外。史上最大級の致死的エボラアウトブレイクであり、資金不足・紛争による対応困難、ワクチン未承認株という点で極めて深刻。フルリスク評価（RRA）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: शादी से पहले पार्टनर से एचआईवी-पॉजिटिव होने की बात छिपाने पर कोलकाता में युवक गिरफ्तार - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young man arrested in Kolkata for concealing HIV-positive status from his partner before marriage - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, in Kolkata's Bansdroni area, a man working at a private institution was arrested for allegedly concealing his HIV-positive status from his partner before marriage. The partner, a nurse at a private hospital, had met him on social media years earlier; they planned marriage and starting a family. She alleges he hid his infection despite knowing it, prompting trust issues when she pushed for tests. He initially refused medical testing but consented later; HIV tests confirmed his status, and she subsequently tested as well. She claims he disclosed past sexual relations with several other women. The case was filed at Bansdroni Police Station, and the man was arrested on Wednesday under multiple charges, including fraud and deception, police said.

triage.headline_ja: 結婚前にHIV陽性であることをパートナーに隠していたとして、コルカタで男性が逮捕される
triage.triage_reason: これは個別の刑事事件であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態やアウトブレイクを示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人間の詐欺・信頼問題に関する刑事事件報道であり、感染症のアウトブレイクやクラスター発生の報告ではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては対象外。

article.articleHeadline: DZIF-Forschende untersuchen Fledermausviren, um mögliche Risiken für den Menschen besser einschätzen zu können
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DZIF researchers study bat viruses to better assess potential risks to humans.
article.articleSummary: West African fruit bats in Ghana and Benin harbor a bat-derived respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) variant, distinct from human RSV but in the same virus family. In 1,778 bats surveyed, 1.4% carried the virus and 9% had RSV antibodies. Genomic analysis of two bat RSVs showed they are not closely related to human RSV; however, the virus can enter human cells, albeit less efficiently than human RSV, and can dampen the innate immune response. Importantly, sera from individuals previously exposed to RSV neutralize the bat virus, and a broadly neutralizing monoclonal antibody also neutralizes it. The study emphasizes integrating genomic and functional data to assess zoonotic risk and supports development of broad-spectrum antivirals. Published in Science Advances by DZIF researchers led by Dr. Wendy Jo at Charité/ Berlin and collaborators in Hannover; next steps use reverse genetics to study pathogenesis.

triage.headline_ja: DZIFの研究者、人間へのリスクをより適切に評価するためコウモリ由来ウイルスを研究
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ・ベナンのコウモリから発見されたRSV類縁ウイルスに関する基礎研究報告であり、人への感染事例や実際の発生事象は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物（コウモリ）由来ウイルスのゲノム・機能解析による人獣共通感染症リスク評価研究であり、実際のヒト感染事例や発生イベントではないため、対象国としての発生地域認定は見送った。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉確診超1.2萬宗 暴力衝突阻礙抗疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo exceeds 12,000 confirmed cases; violent clashes hinder outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, with 12,021 confirmed cases and nearly half resulting in death. The fast-spreading outbreak—described by government data as the most rapid in history—has been hampered by ongoing clashes between rebels and government forces, which hinder containment, surveillance, and response efforts. The report underscores the severity and the critical background of the crisis and calls for improved security to enable public health teams to reach affected communities and implement control measures, including vaccination campaigns. The article does not detail specific symptoms, laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases. The central concern remains the scale of transmission in eastern Congo and the way armed conflict complicates outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例1.2万人超、暴力衝突が感染対策を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約5割に迫るエボラ出血熱が過去最速ペースで拡大し、武力衝突により封じ込め対応が阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 武力紛争による対応阻害が感染拡大の主要因とされており、治安改善と国際支援（ワクチン接種含む）が不可欠な状況。感染経路や検査方法等の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases cross 12,000 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 12,021 total cases and 5,904 related deaths since May, Health Ministry data show. The surge spans eight provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi—reflecting transmission amid insecurity and response disruptions. WHO said heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri disrupted operations and forced responders to relocate from Mongbwalu after staff were trapped in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. The WHO and Africa CDC unveiled a Bundibugyo virus continental preparedness and response plan for November 2026–May 2027 to strengthen early detection, care, and coordinated action. About $1.576 billion is needed over the next six months to fund the effort, with Tedros urging urgent, united action to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が12,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8州にまたがるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が進行中で、死者数も多く、治安悪化により対応が阻害されているため、WHO/Africa CDCが大規模な国際支援計画を発表しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 累計12,021症例・5,904死亡（5月以降）、8州に拡大。治安悪化で医療対応が阻害され、WHO/Africa CDCが2026年11月〜2027年5月の大陸規模対応計画（約15.76億ドル必要）を発表するなど、国際的関心・支援の必要性が極めて高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo reaches 12,000 cases as violence forces some responders to evacuate
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, centered in Bunia, has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with Congo's Ministry of Health reporting 12,021 infections. It is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, and nearly half of the infected have died, yielding a death toll around 6,000. Violence between rebels and the army has disrupted efforts to contain the spread, forcing some responders to evacuate the area and hindering containment operations. The data reflect a rapidly escalating health emergency in a conflict-affected region, where security concerns are impeding response and ongoing transmission continues to be monitored by authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数1万2千人に到達 暴力により対応要員の一部が避難
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%・12,000例超という大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、紛争による対応阻害も重なり公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 史上最速の拡大ペースとされるエボラアウトブレイクで、紛争地域での対応困難、致死率約50%と極めて深刻。国際的な支援・監視が急務。

article.articleHeadline: No Ebola in SA yet, but 36 hospitals on standby
article.articleSummary: DRC is battling the largest Ebola outbreak in its history, with more than 11,000 cases and about 5,400 deaths, driven by Bundibugyo virus disease spreading from the DRC to Uganda; WHO declared PHEIC in November. Bundibugyo virus transmits via contact with blood or body fluids of a sick or deceased person; incubation up to 21 days. The outbreak has spread to Uganda (≈20 cases), Kenya (9), Nigeria and France (1 each); Uganda and France have been contained, with no active cases remaining. South Africa reports no cases yet, but the risk of importation remains; 36 hospitals designated, health workers trained, and intensified screening at borders, airports, and seaports. SA has assisted by shipping diagnostic tests and the NICD providing testing support; the government pledged US$2.5 million (~R40 million). Bundibugyo is not airborne; early detection and isolation plus 21-day contact follow-up can prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカにエボラはまだ確認されていないが、36の病院が待機体制
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）アウトブレイクであり、複数国への国際的拡大とIHR基準の複数該当が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生し史上最大規模となっているエボラ（ブンディブギョウウイルス病）アウトブレイクについて、南アフリカの準備態勢を報じたもの。感染拡大先のウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランス、および記事主体の南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはPHEIC宣言済みで国際的な緊急性が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Počet prípadov eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike presiahol 12-tisíc, nákaze podľahlo už 5904 ľudí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000, with 5,904 people having died from the infection.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases (12,021) and 5,904 deaths, marking it the second-largest and deadliest outbreak in history. First detected in May in Ituri province, it has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. The surge is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, and overwhelmed health services fuel transmission, with only about 15% of new infections linked to known contacts, indicating substantial untracked spread. The outbreak is compared with the 2014–2016 epidemic, which recorded over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. Reuters satellite analysis suggests the death toll may be undercounted in the two most affected areas, signaling persistent, unchecked transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1万2千人を超え、死者はすでに5904人に達した
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行であり、死亡者数・感染者数が急増、ワクチン未承認株による制御困難な状況が続いているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で、史上2番目の規模・致死率。紛争や医療崩壊により追跡不能な感染が多く、死者数も過小評価の可能性がある。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Śmiertelna Ebola już w Europie! Pilne ewakuacje ze strefy zarazy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola already in Europe! Urgent evacuations from the outbreak zone.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease from the Democratic Republic of Congo has escalated into a cross-continental crisis: as of 26 November 2026, over 11,700 confirmed cases and 5,779 deaths (roughly 50% case fatality). The ongoing outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which vaccines effective against the Zaire lineage show incomplete protection. Evacuations to Western Europe have begun, with patients treated under strict biocontainment in specialist centers in the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Germany, and the Netherlands; MSF staff are among the evacuees. In London, a dedicated unit at Royal Free Hospital; in Geneva and Zurich, university hospitals. Care relies on hermetically sealed transport capsules and negative-pressure facilities; risk to European communities remains very low. Africa CDC notes that 89% of new patients are not identified via contact tracing, signaling sustained transmission in crowded cities and refugee camps; sporadic introductions have reached Kenya and Nigeria. Trials of new protective measures are underway.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的なエボラ、すでに欧州へ！感染地域からの緊急避難

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Mira Estrela realiza mutirão de combate à dengue entre os dias 7 e 11 de dezembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mira Estrela City Hall conducts an anti-dengue campaign from December 7 to 11.

Organizers urge the public to welcome inspectors and cooperate with inspections, paying particular attention to backyards, plant pots, gutters, tires, and any containers that can collect standing water. The initiative emphasizes community participation and environmental management to reduce transmission risk in the municipality of Mira Estrela.

article.articleHeadline: Masuk Musim Hujan Waspada Leptospirosis: Pengertian dan Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the Rainy Season Begins, Beware of Leptospirosis: Definition and Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis poses an elevated health risk as the rainy season starts in flood-prone regions of Indonesia. The disease is caused by Leptospira bacteria shed in the urine of rats and transmitted when people contact water, mud, or sewage contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially through broken skin or mucous membranes. Transmission is linked to floodwaters, stagnant water, and areas affected by flooding. The article notes common warning signs: sudden fever, generalized weakness, red eyes, and yellowing of the skin or certain body parts. Prevention focuses on awareness and protective measures during cleanup after floods or while in standing water, including minimizing exposure and wearing protective gear. The report provides no case counts or laboratory-confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季到来、レプトスピラ症に注意：定義と症状について

article.articleHeadline: Бројот на случаи на ебола во Конго надмина 12.000: Повеќе од 5.900 луѓе починаа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in Congo surpassed 12,000: More than 5,900 people died.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo reports 12,021 Ebola infections and 5,904 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The outbreak began mid-May in Ituri province, northeast, and has expanded to eight of 26 provinces. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. Delayed detection, armed conflict, and an overwhelmed health system have accelerated spread versus prior outbreaks. Africa CDC notes only 15% of new cases involve known contacts, implying many transmission chains remain unidentified. This outbreak is the second-largest and deadliest on record after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). Satellite analysis cited by Reuters suggests official death tolls in the two hardest-hit areas may be significantly underestimated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱症例数が12,000人を超える：5,900人以上が死亡

triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による史上2番目に大きい規模のアウトブレイク。ワクチン・治療法未承認、武力紛争下での対応困難、衛星分析による死者数過小評価の可能性も指摘されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria da Saúde alerta que El Niño pode agravar e elevar casos de doenças no Ceará; veja quais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Health Secretariat warns that El Niño could worsen and increase disease cases in Ceará; see which ones.
article.articleSummary: El Niño could worsen Ceará's epidemiological scenario, triggering drought, water scarcity, and higher risk for arboviruses (dengue, Zika, chikungunya), acute diarrhoeal diseases (ADD), including fly-borne gastroenteritis, leptospirosis, incidents with venomous animals, respiratory illnesses and flu-like syndromes, dehydration, heat exhaustion and heatstroke, and the decompensation of chronic non‑transmissible diseases such as cardiopathies and diabetes, along with psychological distress. The State Health Secretariat’s Plan for Preparation and Response to Drought, Dry Spell and Water Scarcity linked to El Niño, published September and valid through July 2027, outlines actions and disease risk guidance. About 65 municipalities are under emergency water supply conditions. Regions like the Fortaleza Metropolitan Area and the Sertão Central have not yet seen arboviruses surges but remain areas of concern due to susceptible populations and water storage needs. Aedes aegypti breeding risk rises with restricted water; ovitraps are largely negative. Emphasis on risk communication and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 州保健局、エルニーニョがセアラ州の疾病増悪・増加を招く恐れがあると警告；対象疾患一覧
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例急増や異常事態の報告ではなく、エルニーニョによる将来的な疾病リスクに関する予防的・一般的な注意喚起であるため、現時点でピックアップ基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は将来的なリスク予測と既存の予防計画の紹介であり、現時点で具体的な症例数増加や異常発生は報告されていない。ブラジル・セアラ州のローカルな気候関連公衆衛生対策の話題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in der DR Kongo: Wie Krieg die Ausbreitung von Seuchen befeuert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: How war fuels the spread of epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu, is being driven by violence that disrupts control efforts. In Ituri, WHO and Ebola responders sheltered in a hospital in Akwe as fighting forced evacuation; by Nov 25 teams were moved to Bunia for safety. Attacks on health facilities and staff hinder case finding, contact tracing, and treatment. As of mid‑November 2026, WHO records 11,613 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,678 deaths in the DRC (case fatality ~48.9%), with Ituri and North Kivu hardest hit. A Cantine-Aloya assault in North Kivu on Nov 5 killed 66 civilians, including 3 health workers, and disrupted over 1,000 contact-tracing links. The WHO counted about 100 attacks on health workers/facilities in 2026, leaving tracing at roughly 81% of contacts reached (vs a 95% target). Violence worsens gaps in security, access, and funding, fueling transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：戦争が感染症の拡大をいかに助長しているか
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,613例・致死率約49%という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、武力紛争により接触者追跡や医療アクセスが著しく阻害されているため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 武力紛争により接触者追跡率が目標95%に対し約81%にとどまっており、感染拡大制御の実効性低下が懸念される。WHOおよび対応チームへの攻撃も報告されており、国際支援のニーズが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo reaches 12,000 cases as violence forces...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed infections as of Nov. 26, 2026, with 12,021 cases and roughly 6,010 deaths, according to Congo’s Ministry of Health. It is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. Fighting between the army and Convention for the Popular Revolution rebels resumed in Iga-Barrière, a mining town about 25 kilometers north of Bunia in Ituri province, disrupting containment efforts, displacing residents, and hindering surveillance and staffing at treatment centers. Bunia remains a major response hub, while insecurity limits access to exposed communities. WHO Ebola incident manager Dr. Catherine Smallwood noted that violence is restricting teams’ ability to reach affected areas. Burials were reported in Beni, North Kivu province, underscoring the ongoing human toll of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の発生が暴力により対応者が避難を強いられる中、12,000症例に到達

triage.notes: WHO担当者のコメントや武力紛争による対応阻害が明記されており、既に国際的な注目を集めている進行中の大規模アウトブレイク。継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يفتك بأكثر من 5900 شخص في الكونغو وسط تفشٍ متواصل للعدوي - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills more than 5,900 people in Congo amid an ongoing outbreak of infection - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo strain is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, beginning in mid-May 2026 in Ituri province and spreading to eight of 26 provinces. As of November 2026, the outbreak has reached 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths, making it the second-largest and most deadly Ebola outbreak on record, after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic which sickened more than 28,600 and killed over 11,000. The absence of approved vaccines or therapies for Bundibugy ocomplicates response; containment relies on early case detection, isolation, and meticulous contact tracing. Only about 15% of new cases are linked to known contacts, suggesting widespread undetected transmission chains. Reuters satellite imagery analysis indicates the official death toll may be undercounted in two heavily affected areas, underscoring data gaps in a fragile health landscape.

article.articleHeadline: Molecular Survey Reveals Diverse Gastrointestinal and Blood-Borne Parasites
article.articleSummary: Analysis of 370 yak fecal samples from Hongyuan and Aba Counties and 100 blood samples from Qilingou in Aba Prefecture, Sichuan, SW China, found GI parasites in 28.65% (106/370) of yaks: trematodes 58 (15.68%) and nematodes 56 (15.14%). Molecular typing confirmed Oesophagostomum spp.; trematodes included Calicophoron microbothrioides, Paramphistomum cervi, Ostertagia ostertagi, and Cooperia oncophora. Anthelmintic therapy history linked to reduced GI infection (OR 0.41; 95% CI 0.23–0.71; P=0.001). Blood screening showed 2/100 (2%) by smear; PCR detected Babesia or Theileria in 51 and Neospora caninum in 26. Theileria sequences clustered with T. sinensis; Neospora confirmed. Findings provide baseline parasite diversity to guide targeted control in high-altitude yak herds.

The figures underscore a high case-fatality rate and the severe challenges of outbreak control in insecure settings. The report provides no details on infection sources, laboratory confirmation methods, or any imported or exported cases. Published 2026-11-26.

article.articleHeadline: Ação educativa no Mercado de Jaguaribe reforça combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Educational campaign at Jaguaribe Market reinforces the fight against dengue.
article.articleSummary: On 25 November 2026, João Pessoa's Municipal Health Secretariat held an educational action at Jaguaribe Public Market as part of the National Week for Dengue Mobilization, ahead of Day D on 28 November. A multidisciplinary task force conducted direct outreach with vendors and shoppers, emphasizing waste disposal to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites and outlining dengue symptoms: sudden high fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pains, retro-orbital pain, red rash, and fatigue. In 2026, João Pessoa has 3,562 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases and one death, plus 35 chikungunya confirmations and no Zika, per CIEVS. The guidance notes the mosquito’s faster life cycle in heat (5–7 days) and common household breeding sites. Vaccination remains free for 10-14-year-olds (two doses) at basic health units with parental accompaniment. The campaign continues Friday at Mangabeira Market (9:00–12:00).

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Com 946 casos em 2026, RMJ reforça combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: With 946 cases in 2026, RMJ reinforces the fight against dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in the Região Metropolitana de Jundiaí (RMJ) reach 946 in 2026 across seven municipalities: Jundiaí 544; Várzea Paulista 103; Itupeva 84; Louveira 69; Jarinu 63; Campo Limpo Paulista 52; Cabreúva 31. Despite up to 98% drop vs 2025, local authorities intensify control of Aedes aegypti through inspections, breeding-site elimination, and monitoring. Through November, Jundiaí reports 544 confirmed cases and three deaths, with 8,072 cases and three deaths in the same period last year. The state totals 64,998 dengue cases and 45 deaths in 2026, as the season progresses. Vector-control teams conducted 15,572 visits in 2026, identifying 85 mosquito breeding sites, aiming to reduce transmission amid warm, rainy conditions that favor Aedes aegypti.

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تواجه ثاني أسوأ تفشٍّ لـ"إيبولا" بأكثر من 12 ألف إصابة

article.articleHeadline: Кількість заражень Еболою в Конго перевищила 12 тисяч - спалах триває вже пів року
