triage.notes: 発生地域リストにレバノン（El Aaqabé、Mohafazat Béqaa）が含まれるが、記事主題はDRCのエボラ流行であり無関係なノイズと判断し除外した。致死率は約49%と極めて高く、紛争による保健医療従事者の避難・活動停止が対応を困難にしている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo supera los 12.000 casos en medio de combates
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 12,000 cases amid fighting.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases amid fighting in Ituri province and Bunia. Government data cited by AP show 12,021 confirmed infections, with nearly half of patients dying. Fighting resumed in Iga-Barrière, about 25 km north of Bunia, displacing residents and hindering containment efforts. WHO epidemiologist Catherine Smallwood warned that clashes have prevented teams from reaching some communities, disrupted surveillance of those exposed to the virus, and left treatment centers short-staffed. The outbreak represents the fastest-growing on record, with conflict complicating case finding, contact tracing, and access to care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、戦闘の最中に感染者数が1万2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く12,000例を超える大規模アウトブレイクであり、紛争により封じ込め・接触者追跡が阻害され国際的拡大リスクも高いため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOが紛争により監視・対応活動の困難さを警告しており、史上最速の拡大速度とされる重大なアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Focarul de Ebola este de neoprit. A devenit epidemia cu cea mai rapidă evoluție din istorie și a trecut pragul de 12.000 de cazuri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is unstoppable. It has become the fastest-spreading epidemic in history and has crossed the 12,000-case threshold.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 12,021 confirmed cases with about 6,000 deaths, the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the fastest-spreading on record. The May-declared epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Conflict, impassable roads, and local violence fueled by misinformation hinder containment, overburdening treatment centers and disrupting surveillance. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of the sick or deceased; control relies on rapid isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. Fighting around Iga-Barrière, a mining town about 25 km north of Bunia in Ituri province, has displaced residents. About 12 people, including two WHO staffers, were evacuated to Bunia after being trapped near Akwe amid heavy gunfire. The outbreak risks surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of roughly 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は止められない。史上最速の拡大を見せる流行となり、1万2000例の大台を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行が12,000例・6,000人超の死者に達し、史上最速・最悪規模で拡大中。ワクチン・治療薬不在、紛争による封じ込め困難、国際的拡大リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、紛争地域における治安悪化がWHOスタッフの退避を招くなど対応が極めて困難な状況。西アフリカ2014-2016流行の死者数超過リスクが指摘されており、国際的な注目・支援ニーズが非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: India Lowers Tuberculosis Incidence to 195 Cases per 100,000 People
article.articleSummary: Incidence fell to 195 per 100,000 in 2024 from 237 in 2015, but India remains the largest TB burden, contributing about 25% of cases with 2.6–2.8 million infections annually. Drug-sensitive TB treatment success exceeds 85%, yet incidence remains above the elimination threshold of fewer than one per million. Mycobacterium tuberculosis remains the leading infectious disease killer. Transmission concentrates in densely populated states—Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, West Bengal—and in overcrowded urban settlements, mining regions, tribal and peri-urban corridors; predominantly affects working-age adults 15–54, with higher case numbers in men and underreporting among women, plus persistent pediatric transmission. Undernutrition is the primary determinant; nutritional support during therapy improves survival and completion and reduces incidence among contacts. HIV and diabetes complicate control: 2.54 million people living with HIV in 2023; 2024 TB patients with documented HIV status were 2.62 million with 33,190 co-infected; co-morbid diabetes among 2.44 million tested.

triage.headline_ja: インドが結核罹患率を人口10万人当たり195人に低下
triage.triage_reason: 結核罹患率の長期的な改善を報じる統計・政策的な内容であり、新規性や異常性・急性の公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は依然として慢性的な公衆衛生課題であり継続的な曝露はあるが、本記事は罹患率低下という改善トレンドを報じるもので、突発的なシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie im Osten des Kongo: Zahl der bestätigten Ebolafälle steigt auf über 12.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo: the number of confirmed Ebola cases rises to over 12,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached eight of its 26 provinces, with 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths, making it the second-deadliest outbreak. The current epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there are no licensed vaccines or treatments. It was first officially identified in mid-May in Ituri Province in the northeast and has since expanded. Authorities report only about 15% of new cases come from known contacts, implying many transmission chains remain undetected. The outbreak’s severity is highlighted by its scale, though it remains behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 infections and >11,000 deaths). In Kenya, a court halted construction of a U.S.-funded Ebola quarantine center at Nanyuki, giving a 45-day deadline to restore transparency; nine Ebola cases in Kenya were linked to a single Congo-arrived Kenyan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でのエボラ流行：確定症例数が12,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で12,000人超の感染・5,904人の死亡という大規模流行が継続し、ワクチン・治療薬のないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株であること、ケニアへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアでの症例やNanyukiの検疫施設建設差し止めについて言及があるが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生国はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan court halts work on Ebola quarantine centre for US citizens
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to loom as Kenya’s High Court temporarily halted construction of a quarantine facility for US citizens infected with Ebola at an air force base in Nanyuki. The judge ruled the Health Ministry failed to inform local residents, violating transparency and public-participation requirements, and gave 45 days to disclose planned details. The case highlights debate over management of imported cases after the US said infected citizens would be monitored in Kenya rather than returning home. Protests erupted in Nanyuki. Globally, Congo has reported more than 12,000 Ebola cases and over 5,900 deaths. Kenya has recorded nine Ebola cases, all from a Congo-born traveller; two deaths, with the last patient discharged on 11 November. One US citizen infected was treated at Berlin's Charité hospital.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、米国人向けエボラ隔離施設建設を差し止め
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは1万2千人以上の症例・5900人以上の死亡を記録しており、国際的拡大（ケニア、ドイツ、米国への波及）や渡航・隔離対応を巡る問題も発生しているため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの隔離施設建設を巡る訴訟だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし感染症イベントの発生源であるDRCは対象国に該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi TBC, Dinkes Kabupaten Tangerang Sisir 29 Kecamatan, Target Periksa 12.000 Warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB Detection: Tangerang Regency Health Office Sweeps 29 Districts, Target to Screen 12,000 Residents
article.articleSummary: TB detection efforts in Tangerang Regency, Indonesia, use portable chest X-ray screening across 29 districts to identify undiagnosed cases. The target is to screen 12,000 residents in 2026, with nearly 8,000 examined by mid-November 2026. Led by Health Office head Hendra Tarmizi, the program aims to bring suspected cases to further diagnostic testing and prompt treatment, reducing transmission. Expanding outreach should improve detection and help interrupt transmission chains. The initiative supports the national goal of TB elimination by 2030; those suspected through screening will undergo follow-up examinations and medical management.

triage.headline_ja: 結核検出:タンゲラン県保健局が29地区を巡回、12,000人の住民検査を目標に
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核スクリーニング・検診活動の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 国家結核撲滅計画（2030年目標）に基づく通常のスクリーニング活動であり、新規感染拡大や異常事態の報告ではない。「Hendra」は保健局長の人名であり、Hendraウイルスとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM ghi nhận 50.000 ca mắc sốt xuất huyết mỗi năm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City records 50,000 dengue fever cases per year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is a major infectious burden in Ho Chi Minh City, representing 30-40% of local infectious disease cases and about half of Vietnam’s dengue burden. From 2015–2025, the city recorded 22,679–111,420 dengue cases annually, averaging around 50,000 per year, with 2025 incidence at 472 cases per 100,000 people—higher than both the southern region and national averages. Seasonality is pronounced, typically rising June–November. The city maintains three ongoing surveillance streams—case, vector, and serology surveillance—with an online reporting network linked to 121 hospitals, 17 medical centers, 168 health stations, and 350 clinics; more than 8,000 mosquito-risk sites are monitored. A 2026–2028 initiative, in collaboration with OUCRU, will build an early warning system integrating case and vector data, serology, and climate to forecast 1–12 week outbreaks and test interventions. Pilots cover six localities (Cu Chi, Tan Vinh Loc, Hung Long, Hiep Phuoc, An Hoa Tay, Hiep Binh); by 2028, expansion to ~800,000 residents is planned.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、毎年5万件のデング熱症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は毎年恒常的に発生しているデング熱の疫学統計および既存サーベイランス体制・今後の早期警戒システム構築計画の紹介であり、新規の異常な増加や緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市における毎年のデング熱罹患状況（2015-2025年の統計）と、OUCRUと連携した2026-2028年早期警戒システム構築計画についての通常の疫学報告であり、急性の異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola virus cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 12,021 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,904 deaths, with responders still striving to bring the outbreak under control. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. It began in mid-May in Ituri Province in the northeastern part of the country and has since spread to eight of the 26 provinces. The persistence of transmission across multiple districts underscores the challenge of interrupting chains of infection, despite ongoing public health measures and response activities. These figures reflect laboratory-confirmed infections reported by government sources. The event is described as the second-largest Ebola outbreak in recorded history, highlighting the need for sustained surveillance and community engagement to curb transmission and prevent further fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 過去最大級規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定症例12,021例、死亡5,904例）が8州に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目およびWPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 史上2番目の規模とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。致死率約49%と高く、イトゥリ州から8州に拡大。ブンディブギョ株による稀な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola di Kongo lampaui 12.000 kasus sejak Mei
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo surpasses 12,000 cases since May
article.articleSummary: By 26 November 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases since the May outbreak declaration, with 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health. The response spans eight provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi—making it the largest outbreak in the country amid security-related response disruptions. The WHO notes heavy clashes around a hospital in Ituri that disrupted response efforts; Ebola teams were temporarily relocated from Mongbwalu, and health workers had been trapped in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. In Africa, WHO and Africa CDC launched an updated Bundibugyo virus preparedness and response plan for Nov 2026–May 2027, requiring about $1.576 billion over six months to mount the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、5月以降1万2000人超の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが8州に拡大し、12,021症例・死者5,904人と致死率が極めて高く、紛争による対応妨害も発生しており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確に認められるため。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDCが約15.76億ドル規模の対応計画を発表しており、史上最大規模の流行かつ紛争による対応妨害が重大な懸念要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, l'Ebola ha ucciso 5.904 persone, mai così tante: gli scontri a Bunia fermano le squadre dell'Oms
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, Ebola has killed 5,904 people, never before this many: clashes in Bunia halt WHO teams.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo—centered in Ituri Province and Bunia—has 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths, the deadliest outbreak in the country’s history and among the fastest growing. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or therapy. The outbreak began mid‑May in Ituri and has spread to eight of 26 provinces. Fighting near Bunia has disrupted response efforts, with WHO teams evacuated, contact tracing interrupted, and clinics understaffed. WHO seeks about $1.6 billion for the next six months to bolster diagnosis and care. The article also notes a diplomatic flare with Uganda over regional security dynamics and cross‑border tensions involving armed groups, complicating aid delivery to affected communities such as Iga-Barrière, Akwe, and Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱で5,904人死亡、過去最多規模：ブニアでの戦闘がWHOチームの活動を停止させる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（確定12,021例、死亡5,904例）で、8/26州に拡大し、武力衝突により対応が阻害され、WHOが16億ドルの支援を要請している国際的関心の高い深刻な事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダは外交的緊張・越境リスクの文脈で言及されているが、実際のエボラ症例発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。治療薬・ワクチン未承認（Bundibugyo株）、武力衝突による対応中断が流行拡大の主因とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk ghi nhận thêm 1 trường hợp tử vong do sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak reports another death due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Dak Lak Province, Vietnam reports a dengue fever death in patient T.P.H., born 2001, of Ea Knốp Commune, Ea Kar District. Symptoms began 18 November; admission followed on 20 November. NS1 test was positive; dengue diagnosed on day 3. The patient, overweight with Down syndrome, was transferred to Tây Nguyên Regional General Hospital ICU and later en route to Ho Chi Minh City Tropical Disease Hospital; died at 02:00 on 23 November. PCR at the Tây Nguyên Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology confirmed dengue virus type 2 (DENV-2). Family and 17 nearby households reported no dengue cases in 7 days. Vector surveillance in Hamlet 1 yielded BI 41.1 and DI 0.17 mos/house. Indoor residual spraying was conducted at 60 households (209 people protected). Authorities urge intensified surveillance, rapid detection, outbreak control, community education, larval source reduction, and environmental sanitation to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省、デング熱による死亡者をさらに1名確認
triage.triage_reason: 単発のデング熱死亡例であり、地域的な大規模流行の兆候は見られないが、デング熱は毎年流行する風土病であり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡例は基礎疾患（ダウン症候群、肥満）を有する患者であり重症化リスク因子あり。周辺世帯での追加症例は確認されておらず、ベクター指数（BI 41.1）も踏まえ当局が対策を実施中。デング熱はベトナムにおいて季節性の常在疾患であり単発事例としては通常対応範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: UA celebra el fin de las restricciones de viaje de Catar a Uganda por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UA celebrates the end of travel restrictions from Qatar to Uganda due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Qatar lifted travel restrictions on Uganda and resumed issuing all visa types due to the Ebola outbreak, a move welcomed by Africa Union’s Africa CDC as a significant diplomatic and public‑health milestone. The agency highlighted Uganda’s containment of the Bundibugyo strain and urged other countries with similar limits to reassess based on current data. Ugandan Foreign Minister Adonia Ayebare thanked Qatar for the gesture. The Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15; the WHO declared the Uganda outbreak over on August 26 after 20 confirmed infections, including 15 imported from DRC, with 2 deaths. Congo’s outbreak has tallied 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths per the DRC’s National Institute of Public Health. The decision underscores the role of science, evidence, and diplomacy in responding to public health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合（AU）、エボラ流行に伴うカタールからウガンダへの渡航制限終了を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死亡者数が非常に多く重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさの観点で懸念があり、外交・公衆衛生両面での社会的関心も高いためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの流行終息とカタールの渡航制限解除という外交的ニュースだが、DRCでの流行（12,021例、5,904死亡）は継続中であり深刻。ウガンダ(226074)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El segon pitjor brot d'Èbola de la història ja supera els 12.000 casos confirmats
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The second-worst Ebola outbreak in history already surpasses 12,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with over 5,900 deaths (case fatality rate 49.1%), making it the second-deadliest outbreak globally. It remains far from the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (~11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases). The World Health Organization warns two-thirds of deaths occur outside medical centers due to late detection and weak contact tracing. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, but WHO declared on August 26 the end of the outbreak there, with 20 cases and 2 deaths. Related cases have been detected in Kenya, Nigeria, and France. In the DRC, vaccination with the Ervebo vaccine shows positive signals; the WHO is testing two vaccines in Phase 1, though development could take months.

triage.headline_ja: 史上2番目に深刻なエボラ出血熱の流行、確定症例が1万2000例を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が確定症例12,000例・死亡5,900例（致死率49.1%）に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの関連症例拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 発生地域にFrance, Angola, Kenya, Uganda, Nigeriaが含まれるが、記事主題はDRCでの流行であり、これらは関連症例の検出地として言及されているのみ。ウガンダは8月26日に終息宣言済み。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : un pilote sud-africain aux mains des rebelles, Ebola dépasse 12 000 cas et l'Ouganda rappelé à l'ordre - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: A South African pilot in rebel hands, Ebola surpasses 12,000 cases, and Uganda reprimanded - Cameroun24.net News Updates
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak surpasses 12,021 laboratory-confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths (case fatality 49.1%). Ituri remains the epicenter with 67.7% of total cases and 39.4% of new cases; the Bundibugyo strain is implicated, with no WHO-approved vaccine or specific treatment available. Regional spread noted, with Kenya reporting its first case on 6 October and Nigeria detecting a case on 20 October. In security-diplomatic developments, a Congolese Air Force Cessna 208 cargo aircraft disappeared on 22 November 2026 en route from Beni (North Kivu) to Kalemie (Tanganyika). FRN rebels claim to have shot down the plane near Minembwe, South Kivu, and say two survivors—a South African pilot and a Ugandan national—were recovered, but independent confirmation is pending. Kinshasa summoned the Ugandan ambassador after posts by Muhoozi Kainerugaba, highlighting tense regional dynamics; Pretoria is seeking to verify the pilot’s nationality.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：反政府勢力に拘束された南アフリカ人パイロット、エボラは1万2000例を超え、ウガンダに注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は1万2000例超・致死率49.1%に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当、社会的・政治的関心の高まりが見られるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大、ウガンダとの外交的緊張、墜落事故を含む複合的内容だが、エボラ流行の主体はDRC。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết diễn biến phức tạp, Hà Tĩnh tập trung xử lý 2 ổ dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever progresses with a complex course; Ha Tinh Province focuses on addressing two outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: From the start of 2026 through 26 November 2026, Ha Tinh Province reported 731 dengue fever cases with no deaths. Two outbreaks remain active: Văn Miếu – Trung Thượng village, Kỳ Hoa commune (113 cases) and Vĩnh Lộc hamlet, Cẩm Trung commune (91 cases). The other three outbreaks—Hoành Sơn Ward (22), Vũng Áng Ward (114), and Tân Đức hamlet (39)—have been controlled. CDC Ha Tinh is coordinating with authorities to zone areas, clean the environment, and spray insecticides. In Kỳ Hoa, chemicals and environmental cleaning were deployed; 200 patient households and neighbors were sprayed. In Cẩm Trung, 899 households across Vĩnh Lộc, Bắc Lộc, and Trung Lộc were sprayed. Ongoing surveillance, early detection, and treatment at primary care, with public awareness campaigns, accompany these efforts. Advice: maintain hygiene, eliminate water containers, cover storage, seek medical care for fever; do not self-medicate. Dengue can cause shock and multi-organ failure if untreated.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行が複雑化、ハティン省は2つの感染源への対応に集中
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なデング熱の季節的流行であり、死亡例なし・既に制御活動が進行中だが、症例数が多く監視継続が必要。
triage.notes: ベトナム・ハティン省における季節性デング熱流行で、地方CDCが対応中。死亡例なし、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong suspends poultry products import from areas in S. Korea
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Center for Food Safety (CFS) suspended imports of poultry meat and products from several areas in South Korea due to avian influenza outbreaks. Affected areas include Jincheon-gun in Chungcheongbuk-do and parts of Jeonnam-Gwangju, Gyeonggi-do, Gyeongsangbuk-do, and Incheon. The CFS of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’s Food and Environmental Hygiene Department ordered an immediate halt on imports of poultry meat and products, including poultry eggs, to protect public health in Hong Kong. The CFS has contacted Korean authorities and will closely monitor information from the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) and other relevant authorities regarding the outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 香港、韓国の一部地域からの家禽製品輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの発生地は韓国であり対象国リストに含まれず、香港は貿易停止措置を講じた当事国に過ぎないため、対象国に関する直接的なシグナルとはならない。
triage.notes: 発生地域は韓国（対象国外）。香港は輸入停止措置のみを行った国であり、実際の鳥インフルエンザ発生地ではないため、香港・マカオルールに基づくChina算入は適用しない。人への感染事例についての記載はなく、家禽における動物衛生・貿易関連の報道。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : le personnel médical contre Ebola menacé par les combats
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Medical staff fighting Ebola threatened by clashes.
article.articleSummary: Security and diplomatic tensions have intensified in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as fighting resumes between the Congolese army and CRP fighters. The renewed clashes threaten the Ebola outbreak response, endangering medical staff and raising concerns about outbreak control in a region already grappling with the epidemic. The World Health Organization reports 5,575 Ebola-related deaths to date. Aurélie Bazzara-Kibangula, France 24 correspondent in Kinshasa, provides details from the capital on the evolving situation. The report highlights the direct risk to healthcare workers involved in the Ebola response and the potential for further transmission amid ongoing violence. Ituri's eastern frontier.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ対応の医療従事者が戦闘により脅威にさらされる
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中で、武力衝突により医療従事者の安全と感染拡大防止活動が脅かされており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州での武力衝突がエボラ対応活動（医療従事者の安全、感染者追跡等）を直接的に妨げており、感染拡大リスクが高まっている。WHO報告の死者数5,575人は累積値と見られ、出典確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo regista 12.021 casos de Ébola confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 12,021 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: 12,021 confirmed Ebola cases reported in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), per government data, as fighting between the national army and CRP rebels hinders containment. Declared in May, the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. It is the deadliest Ebola epidemic in DR Congo’s history, with nearly half of confirmed cases resulting in death and approaching the West Africa 2014–2016 toll (~11,000). Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals. Ongoing hostilities disrupt access to affected communities and leave treatment centers under-staffed. Bunia, the Ituri province capital, serves as a response hub; Iga-Barrière, a mining town about 25 km north of Bunia, has seen renewed clashes and displacement. WHO notes around a dozen people, including two WHO staff, were transferred to Bunia after three days trapped in Akwe amid intense gunfire.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例12,021件を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模（死亡率約50%）のエボラ流行が、承認済みワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株により拡大しており、武力紛争により封じ込めが阻害されている重大事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事内ではDRC東部（イトゥリ州・ブニア等）での流行のみが主題であり、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。死者数約半数・12,021症例確認という規模はPHEIC級の重大性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Court Stops Work On US-Backed Ebola Facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya High Court halted further construction and operation of the US‑backed 50‑bed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base near Nanyuki, after ruling the government violated constitutional requirements by failing to disclose the US agreement and exclude local residents from scrutiny. Justice Patricia Nyaundi ordered disclosure of the agreement plus public health, environmental, biosafety and security assessments, regulatory approvals and operational protocols within 45 days, and barred any further work until compliance is certified. Protests had warned the project could expose the community to risk. Seven American aid workers who assisted the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo were quarantined at the facility in July. Kenya reported an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case in October from a traveler arriving from DRC via Uganda, with two deaths and other patients recovering; no new cases since Oct 19, and a 42‑day countdown toward outbreak end began on Nov 11. The court stressed that public health urgency does not exempt transparency and public participation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、米国支援のエボラ施設建設を差し止め
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はケニアにおける施設建設差し止めという法的・行政措置であり、新規の感染症発生や症例急増等の疫学的シグナルではない。関連するエボラ輸入症例（10月報告）も既に新規発生なく収束に向かっている。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの施設建設を巡る司法判断が主題。言及されているDRCのエボラ流行は背景情報であり、本記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Crude Lemongrass Oil Outperforms Commercial Formulations Against Aedes
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-extracted crude essential oil from Cymbopogon citratus (lemongrass) shows markedly higher larvicidal potency and longer-lasting adult irritancy against Aedes aegypti than a commercially prepared lemongrass oil. In The Journal of Basic and Applied Zoology, the crude oil achieved a median lethal concentration (LC50) of 10.485 micrograms per milliliter against early fourth-instar larvae after 24 h, more than fourfold more effective than the commercial oil (LC50 43.504 micrograms per milliliter). The crude oil, produced by lab-scale steam distillation from lemongrass leaves collected at Dyal Singh College, New Delhi, India, displayed more chromatographic spots (seven vs fewer) and shared core terpenoid fractions such as citral, but retained additional metabolites due to minimal post-extraction processing. Adult excito-repellency tests confirmed sustained irritancy. The findings, relevant to dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever virus transmission control, underscore how processing and chemical richness influence botanical vector management, using a laboratory Ae. aegypti strain reared from eggs.

triage.headline_ja: 粗製レモングラスオイル、市販製剤よりネッタイシマカに対する効果が高いことが判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はレモングラス精油の蚊幼虫駆除効果に関する実験室研究であり、感染症の発生・流行報告ではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究室における蚊媒介対策（植物由来殺虫剤）の基礎研究報告であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。発生地域として示されたNew Delhi/Indiaは研究実施場所（レモングラス採取地）であり、疾病の発生地ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola en el Congo Democrático entra en meseta persistente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo enters a persistent plateau
article.articleSummary: On 26 November 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached a persistent plateau, with 11,793 confirmed cases and 5,779 deaths (case fatality ≈49%). The outbreak has surpassed 11,700 cases, per WHO, with an unprecedented trajectory not yet larger than West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. There is concern about cross-border spread to France, Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda. The Conversation notes experimental vaccines are insufficient against a crisis driven by war, hunger, population movement, and degraded health systems, with slow clinical progression delaying diagnosis. If transmission continues at the current pace for another year, it could become the largest Ebola disaster to date. Rapid identification and isolation of every case and close contacts through integrated surveillance are urged, while stigma and fear of hospital care fuel home care and unsafe burials. About 89% of infections are detected only when patients die or have exposed many around them.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、持続的な高止まり状態に突入
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が11,793症例・5,779人死亡（致死率約49%）に達し、国境を越えた拡大懸念や医療体制の脆弱性が指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の流行拡大が主題。フランス・ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの越境拡大は『懸念』段階であり実際の発生ではないため、対象国リストに該当するDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。なお上記4か国は対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola no Congo supera 12 mil casos e deixa quase 6 mil mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 12,000 cases and leaves nearly 6,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds 12,000 confirmed cases and about 6,000 deaths as of November 26, 2026. The fastest-spreading outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which no vaccine or approved treatment exists. The Ministry of Health reports 12,021 confirmed infections, with roughly half resulting in death, making it the deadliest of the DRC’s 17 outbreaks and potentially surpassing the 2014-2016 West Africa toll. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of living or deceased patients; it is not airborne. Core symptoms include high fever, headache, muscle pains, weakness, diarrhea, vomiting, and, in severe cases, hemorrhage and organ failure. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, notably Bunia. Fighting between the army and the CRP rebels resumed in Iga-Barrière, a mining town about 25 km north of Bunia, disrupting containment and driving displacement, complicating surveillance and care; WHO notes access disruptions to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、感染者1万2000人・死者6000人近くに達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクで過去最多規模、ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ武力紛争により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる最速拡大・最も致死的なアウトブレイクで、DRC史上17回目の流行。武力紛争による封じ込め活動の妨害とアクセス制限がWHOにより指摘されている。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の死者数を超える可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية.. 6 آلاف وفاة بسبب إيبولا وأكثر من 12 ألف إصابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: 6,000 deaths due to Ebola and more than 12,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo driven by the Bundibugyo strain remains out of control. Government data show 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths across eight of 26 provinces, after the mid‑May start in Ituri’s northeast and subsequent spread. There are no approved drugs or vaccines for Bundibugyo; delays in detection, armed conflict, and exhausted health services have accelerated transmission. Only about 15% of new cases are linked to known contacts, per Africa CDC data cited in November. A Reuters satellite analysis suggests official death tolls undercount fatalities in Bunia and Mongwalu, with excess deaths in Bunia exceeding 1,000 by early November. In response, Gavi plans to purchase up to 1.5 million doses of an Oxford/SII experimental vaccine targeting Bundibugyo (not yet approved); trials of Ervebo (Zaire) and a Moderna candidate for cross-protection are also being explored.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱により6,000人死亡、感染者1万2,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（Bundibugyo株）がDRC8州に拡大し、1万2千人超の感染・6千人近い死亡が報告され、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく制御不能な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、武装紛争により医療体制が疲弊している。Reuters衛星分析では公式死者数が過小評価されている可能性が指摘されており、実際の被害はさらに深刻な可能性がある。Gaviによるワクチン調達計画あり。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Passes 11,500 Cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak, first detected in May 2026, continues across Ituri and Nord-Kivu with no approved vaccine or treatment. By 16 November, ECDC tallies 11,504 confirmed cases and 5,630 deaths, making it the largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo to date. Ituri reports 7,911 cases and 3,738 deaths across 28 of 36 health zones; Nord-Kivu has 2,925 cases and 1,623 deaths. About 68 of 178 health zones are affected; 1,743 patients are in hospital isolation; 3,142 recovered; 81.6% of identified contacts remain under follow-up. UNICEF notes 2,959 infected children (28% of total) and 1,737 child deaths (35% of all deaths), with 72% of under-five infections fatal. Nine cases in Kenya (two deaths) and one Nigerian case linked to Uganda are reported. US CDC issues Level 4 travel warning for Ituri and Nord-Kivu; travelers face 21-day quarantines and enhanced screening.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数が11,500件を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが11,504症例・5,630死亡に達し、史上最大規模。国境を越えてケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大、米国の渡航警告発令など国際的拡大・渡航制限が確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点、致死率の高さ（特に5歳未満児で72%）も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Machine Learning Models Predict Relative COVID-19 Wave Sizes Using Genomic
article.articleSummary: Global modeling study shows machine learning can forecast the relative peak size of emerging SARS-CoV-2 waves using early growth data. Analyzing 43 countries, researchers built random-forest regression models to determine whether a new variant would produce a larger or smaller weekly peak than the preceding dominant variant. Focusing on Delta→Omicron BA.1 and BA.1→BA.2 transitions, combining viral genomic metrics with demographic, mobility, policy, and seroprevalence indicators, the approach correctly identified wave directionality in up to 91% of jurisdictions. Data sources include JHU CSSE, WHO, Oxford COVID-19 Government Response Tracker, SeroTracker, Google Mobility, Our World in Data, and GISAID sequences filtered by Nextclade against Wuhan-Hu-1. Inclusion required at least 10 sequences per week (June 2021–June 2022). Time zero marks when a variant reaches 10% weekly sequences, with a five-week observation window, and leave-one-country-out cross-validation using ensembles of up to 100k trees.

triage.headline_ja: 機械学習モデルがゲノムサーベイランスを用いてCOVID-19の相対的な流行波規模を予測
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去データ（2021年6月〜2022年6月）を用いた機械学習予測モデルに関する学術研究であり、新規の感染症発生イベントを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の変異株（Delta→Omicron BA.1、BA.1→BA.2）の流行データを用いた研究手法の紹介であり、特定国での新規発生事例を報じるものではないため対象国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde: radar digital para detecção de surtos já existe no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: Digital Radar for Outbreak Detection Already Exists in Brazil
article.articleSummary: ÆSOP (Digital Surtos Radar) is Brazil’s national early alert system for outbreaks, developed by Fiocruz, UFRJ and the Health Ministry. It combines about 7 million weekly SUS attendances with over-the-counter drug sales data from pharmacies to monitor all 5,571 municipalities (188 million people). It serves as an early warning for respiratory illnesses and arboviruses such as dengue and chikungunya, signaling increases one to four weeks before they reach hospitals. In Amazonas during the 2024 Parintins festival (≈130,000 visitors), alerts appeared three weeks prior, enabling local action. In dengue, primary care alerts anticipated about 80% of outbreaks in medium/large municipalities. The system also helps identify likely pathogens and spread patterns. Implemented since 2022, it is used by 24 states, with nationwide expansion and Rockefeller Foundation support, and provides dashboards to health authorities without replacing frontline work.

triage.headline_ja: 健康:ブラジルにはすでにアウトブレイク検知のためのデジタルレーダーが存在する
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイク事例の報告ではなく、ブラジルの疾病早期警戒システム（ÆSOP）を紹介する一般的な保健政策・技術記事であり、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイク事例ではなく、デング熱・チクングニア熱等を監視する早期警戒システムの紹介記事であるため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde aponta bactéria em água de 68 cidades de SP; Sabesp nega contaminação atual - Acontece Botucatu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health identifies bacteria in the water of 68 cities in São Paulo; Sabesp denies current contamination - Acontece Botucatu.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli was identified in 137 water samples from 68 municipalities in São Paulo state between January and September 2026, according to the Ministry of Health via the Sisagua water quality surveillance system and reported by CNN Brasil. The finding prompted public discussion after social media posts suggested widespread contamination. Sabesp (São Paulo State Water Utility) rejects generalized contamination claims, noting that subsequent sampling in the cited locations yielded negative results and that there is no evidence of current contamination; it alleges misinformation and says it will pursue accountability for false disclosures. E. coli signals fecal contamination and requires local sanitary investigation, but a single positive sample does not prove system-wide failure. The complete list of municipalities was not released; Botucatu and nearby towns cannot be confirmed due to data gaps. Health authorities emphasize ongoing surveillance and transparent reporting.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がサンパウロ州68都市の水道水に細菌を検出；サベスプ社は現在の汚染を否定
triage.triage_reason: 大腸菌の検出自体は水質サーベイランスの結果であり、人への感染事例や健康被害は報告されていないが、水道当局と保健省の見解が食い違い情報が錯綜しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は水質サーベイランスデータの解釈を巡る情報と水道事業者の反論が中心であり、実際の感染症患者数や臨床的な影響については言及がない。サベスプ社は再検査で陰性だったとし、現在の汚染は否定している。全市町村リストが未公開のため詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: HIV/AIDS Disebut Seperti Gunung Es, DPRD Balikpapan Khawatir Banyak Kasus Belum Terdeteksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV/AIDS Referred to as an Iceberg, Balikpapan City DPRD Worried That Many Cases Have Not Yet Been Detected.
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS in Balikpapan City is described as an iceberg by the local DPRD, with documented cases possibly undercounting the true number of infections. Andi Arif Agung (A3), head of the DPRD’s Regional Regulation Formation Body, warns that current tallies may reflect only a fraction of those living with HIV/AIDS, likening the situation to an iceberg whose bulk lies beneath the surface. A recent Dinkes Balikpapan briefing cited worrying trends amid rapid city growth and high population mobility, complicating surveillance and containment. The DPRD advocates stronger prevention, data collection, education, and protection for people living with HIV/AIDS (ODHIV). The issue has prompted a draft regional regulation on HIV/AIDS prevention, now in Propemperda 2027, though experts emphasize that regulatory measures must be accompanied by sustained public health action.

triage.headline_ja: HIV/AIDSは「氷山の一角」、バリクパパン市議会は未検出症例の多さを懸念
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行性疾患（HIV/AIDS）に関する行政・議会レベルの懸念表明であり、新規性・急性の公衆衛生リスクや国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: HIV/AIDSは慢性的な流行性疾患であり、急性の感染症危機シグナルではない。地方議会による監視体制強化・条例制定の動きが中心で、国際的な公衆衛生緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Reports More Than 12,000 Confirmed Ebola Infections
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 12,000 confirmed Ebola infections as of November 26, 2026, according to government figures. Having faced multiple Ebola outbreaks, the country is intensifying epidemiological surveillance and measures to curb transmission. Ebola is a severe viral disease with potential for rapid clinical deterioration and high mortality in some outbreaks, underscoring its ongoing public health significance. The update signals continued outbreak response activities within the DRC as authorities work to curb spread amid a substantial case burden at late November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定感染者12,000人超を報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラが12,000例を超える大規模流行となっており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 12,000例超という大規模な症例数は既存の大規模流行の継続を示唆する。詳細な地域分布や致死率、対応状況の続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich im Kongo weiter aus - über 12.000 Infektionen gemeldet - Pester Lloyd
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in the Congo - over 12,000 infections reported - Pester Lloyd
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has surged to 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths per Kinshasa, with counts validated by WHO and the African CDC. The epidemic began in May in Ituri province and now spans eight of 26 provinces. No approved antiviral or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo virus. Control efforts like contact tracing and quarantine zones are hindered by ongoing armed conflict, with impassable roads and attacks on health workers; healthcare facilities are under-equipped and understaffed, limiting hospital access for many patients. The outbreak is the second-largest by deaths since records began, surpassed only by West Africa 2014–2016. Europe’s immediate risk of importation remains low, including for Hungary and Austria, but the humanitarian need is high, prompting calls for more protective gear, laboratory capacity, and personnel to sustain containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱がさらに拡大 - 感染者1万2000人以上を報告 - Pester Lloyd
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認感染者12,021人、死者5,904人に達し史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行となっており、武力紛争により封じ込めが困難で国際支援が求められている。
triage.notes: オーストリア・ハンガリーは欧州への輸入リスクが低いとされる文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため除外。原因ウイルスはブンディブギョ型でワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が未承認。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola cases cross 12,000 while clashes hinder containment
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo surpasses 12,000 confirmed cases (12,021) with about half dead, making it the fastest-growing and deadliest of Congo’s 17 outbreaks and on track to exceed the 11,000 deaths of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Declared in May, the Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of the sick or deceased. Containment relies on rapid isolation, contact monitoring, and safe burials. Clashes between army forces and the Convention pour la revolution populaire (CRP) rebels in Iga-Barriere, ~25 km north of Bunia in Ituri province, hinder response and drive displacement toward Bunia. About a dozen people, including two WHO personnel and Congolese health officials, were evacuated to Bunia after three days trapped in a hospital in Akwe amid crossfire. The CRP is one of over 100 armed groups; its founder, Thomas Lubanga, was ICC-convicted in 2012.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が12,000人を超える中、衝突が封じ込めを妨げる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱が12,000例を超え致死率約50%に達し、武力衝突により対応が阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な懸念も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州、Bunia周辺）での発生のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生には言及がないため除外した。武力衝突（CRP反乱軍）により対応要員の避難が発生するなど、人道的・治安的要因が封じ込めを一層困難にしている点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: Congo confirms 12,000 cases as Ebola outbreak worsens due to conflict
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ituri province around Bunia reports 12,021 confirmed Ebola cases—the fastest-growing and deadliest outbreak in Congo's history—with nearly half of infections resulting in death. Bundibugyo virus, a rare Orthoebolavirus, causes severe viral hemorrhagic fever and has no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO declared May 2026 PHEIC; emergency status ongoing into November 2026. Fighting between the army and CRP rebel group near Bunia (about 25 km north) disrupts response, leaving treatment centers understaffed and hindering exposure monitoring. About a dozen people, including two WHO personnel, were evacuated from Akwe after days trapped in crossfire. Transmission via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; rapid isolation, exposure monitoring, and safe burials are needed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、紛争により悪化するエボラ流行で12,000例を確認
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した致死率の高いエボラ大規模流行であり、紛争により対応が妨げられ国際的拡大・支援の必要性が高いため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月にPHEICを宣言済み。致死率約50%、12,000例超の確認例、紛争による対応阻害、WHO職員の退避事案あり。続報でPHEIC継続状況・国際的な封じ込め支援状況を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola deja casi 6.000 muertos en el peor brote de la historia de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves nearly 6,000 dead in the worst outbreak in the history of the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths, the worst in the country's history and the second-deadliest globally. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is responsible; the outbreak began May 15 in Ituri province (northeast) and has spread to eight of 26 provinces. Africa CDC says only about 15% of new infections are linked to previously identified cases, hindering contact tracing. The World Health Organization warns that intensified fighting between government forces and armed groups in eastern DRC is hampering containment, with clashes near an Ituri hospital forcing health workers to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. The authorities stress protecting health facilities and establishing safe evacuation corridors for teams.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRC史上最悪の流行で死者数ほぼ6,000人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が史上最悪規模（12,021例、死者5,904人）に拡大し、武力紛争により封じ込め対応が妨げられているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 武力紛争による接触者追跡・医療従事者の安全確保の困難さが封じ込めの大きな障害となっている。WHO・Africa CDCが積極的に関与しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Los antibióticos pierden terreno frente a la fiebre tifoidea: la infección de esta bacteria ya provoca más de 100.000 muertes al año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antibiotics lose ground to typhoid fever: the infection caused by this bacterium already causes more than 100,000 deaths per year.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella Typhi typhoid fever is increasingly resistant to antibiotics, with more than 11 million infections and over 100,000 deaths annually. A global genomic study of 7,658 samples from over 70 countries (The Lancet Microbe) shows resistance genes originate mainly in South Asia and spread internationally, with 197 introductions and 59 intercontinental events. Roughly 70% of cases occur in South Asia, including India, Nepal, Bangladesh, and Pakistan. Fluoroquinolone resistance arose independently at least 94 times in the last three decades, with 437 samples carrying triple mutations, 92% in a sublineage centered in India/Nepal. A highly resistant XDR Salmonella Typhi strain emerged in Pakistan in 2016 and became dominant within three years. Azithromycin resistance was found in 54 samples across eight genotypes, first documented in Bangladesh around 2013, later in India, Pakistan, Nepal, and Singapore. Travel spreads resistant strains to Europe, Africa, and the Americas. WHO advocates vaccination and strengthened surveillance as essential tools to curb this evolving threat.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質が腸チフスに対抗できなくなりつつある：この細菌による感染症はすでに年間10万人以上の死者を出している
triage.triage_reason: 腸チフス菌（Salmonella Typhi）の薬剤耐性（フルオロキノロン耐性、アジスロマイシン耐性、XDR株）が南アジアを起点に国際的に拡大しているとするLancet Microbe誌の大規模ゲノム研究であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際拡散の双方が確認されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は特定地域の急性アウトブレイクではなく、70か国以上7,658検体を対象とした薬剤耐性腸チフスの国際ゲノム疫学研究の報告。南アジア（インド・ネパール・パキスタン・バングラデシュ）が主要発生地域とされるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはインドのみ。パキスタン・ネパール・バングラデシュ・シンガポールは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: transmissor da dengue em Ewbank da Câmara - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Vector in Ewbank da Câmara - Jornal Panorama
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, November 28, 2026, Ewbank da Câmara, Brazil, will host a Bota-Fora campaign to eliminate dengue mosquito breeding sites. Spearheaded by the Municipal Health Department in partnership with the city hall, the effort targets Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector that also transmits Zika and chikungunya. A collection truck will visit Colônia de São Firmino in the morning and then traverse Ewbank da Câmara in the afternoon to collect items that can accumulate water, such as containers and old furniture. Residents are urged to separate and place items at curbside for disposal, helping keep yards, lots, and public spaces free of standing water. The campaign underlines community participation and ongoing elimination of potential mosquito habitats, particularly during hot, rainy periods that facilitate water stagnation.

triage.headline_ja: Ewbank da Câmaraにおけるデング熱媒介蚊対策 - Jornal Panorama
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング予防キャンペーン（ボウフラ駆除・ゴミ回収）の告知であり、疾病の発生や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発活動の告知であり、具体的な感染者数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases surpass 12,000 as fighting disrupts response in east
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed infections with at least 5,904 deaths as of 2026-11-26. Declared mid-May in Ituri province, the outbreak has spread to eight of DRC’s 26 provinces, complicating control amid escalating violence in the region. Ongoing clashes between the Congolese army and the CRP, led by Thomas Lubanga, have displaced civilians and forced evacuation of health workers and humanitarian staff. About a dozen personnel, including two WHO staff, were evacuated from a hospital in Akwe after days trapped in crossfire; a humanitarian worker came under gunfire near Bunia. UN peacekeepers later escorted teams to safety. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments, hindering prevention and early intervention in a strained health infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の感染者数が12,000人を超える 東部での戦闘が対応を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が8州に拡大し12,000人超の感染・約5,900人の死亡を記録、紛争により対応が妨げられワクチン・治療薬もないためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱はワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、紛争地帯での対応が困難なため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba os sintomas de Covid-19, grupos de risco e atual tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Learn the symptoms of COVID-19, at-risk groups, and current treatment.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains circulating in 2026 in Brazil, with cases rising toward year-end amid new SARS-CoV-2 variants. Symptoms resemble influenza but can cause severe illness and long COVID. Common signs include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, and fatigue; gastrointestinal symptoms and loss of smell or taste may occur. About 15% of cases are severe and 5% critical, risking respiratory failure, thrombosis or neurological sequelae. At-risk groups include people over 60 and those with diabetes, hypertension, heart or lung disease, obesity, kidney disease, dementia, cancer, immunosuppression (including HIV), smokers, and the unvaccinated; pregnancy risk is higher for women over 35 with obesity or chronic conditions. SIM-P in children and SIM-A in adults are noted. Incubation is 1–10 days (average 3–4); transmission occurs via direct contact, droplets within 1 meter, and aerosols. Vaccination remains free via SUS with age/condition-based schedules; masks are mandatory in health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の症状、リスク群、現在の治療法について知る
triage.triage_reason: 一般向けの健康教育記事であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19の症状・リスク群・治療法に関する一般的な医療情報提供記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常増加を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев заражения Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 12 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths, with eight provinces affected, including Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak, first recorded in May in a single province, has expanded amid armed conflict and community resistance to control measures. In Ituri, by May 15 there were 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths. No approved treatments or vaccines exist for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant responsible for this outbreak. Historically, Ebola is a hemorrhagic fever first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River; past outbreaks in West Africa (2013-2016) caused about 30,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths. The health ministry has confirmed the current totals, underscoring ongoing transmission risk and complex response dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱感染確認例数が1万2千人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）の大規模流行が確認され、12,021例・5,904死亡、8州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が約49%と非常に高く、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス変異株による流行。武力紛争や地域住民の対策抵抗により制御が困難化しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが、記事主題では言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Catat 5.702 Kasus Suspek Leptospirosis, Terbanyak di Jawa Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health records 5,702 suspected leptospirosis cases, the highest in Central Java.
article.articleSummary: As of week 46 in 2026, Indonesia's Ministry of Health records 5,702 suspected leptospirosis cases nationwide, with Central Java the highest at 2,559 cases, followed by DI Yogyakarta (1,040). Other totals include West Java (723), East Java (713), Banten (153), and DKI Jakarta (114). The data reflect seasonal risk as the rainy season intensifies, with leptospirosis suspected cases rising in recent years during monsoon periods. A trend graph for 2024–2026 shows weekly spikes approaching 300 cases at the monsoon’s peak before gradual decline. Authorities urge preventive measures: avoid direct contact with floodwater, and when cleaning post-flood environments use protective footwear and gloves to reduce exposure to the bacteria causing leptospirosis.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、レプトスピラ症疑い症例5,702件を記録、中部ジャワが最多
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のレプトスピラ症流行で症例数は多いが、インドネシア保健省による既知の季節パターンであり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。雨季の継続的な曝露があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 毎年雨季に発生する季節性疾患で、保健省が定期的にモニタリング・注意喚起を実施している。重症度や死亡者数についての情報は本記事にはなし。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança no Rio e testes positivos já representam quase 35% dos exames na rede pública
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 advances in Rio de Janeiro, and positive tests now account for nearly 35% of tests in the public health system.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro State, Brazil, reports rising COVID-19 activity. In the week of November 15–21, the public health system recorded 2,424 new cases and a test positivity rate of 34.3%, up from 25.9% the previous week. Since January, total confirmed cases reach 18,060. Genomic analysis shows Omicron as the predominant circulating lineage among identified samples. The state health department (SES-RJ) released the figures to g1 but did not provide data on hospitalizations, deaths, or municipal distribution. Vaccination remains a central control measure: through 2026, 721,950 vaccine doses have been administered in the state, with ongoing efforts to monitor coverage and epidemiology as cases continue to emerge. The report emphasizes vaccination to reduce severe disease risk amid ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでCOVID-19が拡大、公立医療機関の検査陽性率が約35%に達する
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の感染者数・陽性率上昇が報告されているが、重症度（入院・死亡）データは未公表であり、病原体自体も既知のオミクロン株であるため新規性は低い。地域の流行動向として注視が必要。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の病原体であり、オミクロン株による季節的な感染増加とみられる。入院・死亡データが未公表のため重症度評価は困難。ワクチン接種を含む通常の公衆衛生対応が進行中であり、現時点で国際的な懸念材料とはなっていない。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլա վիրուսով վարակման դեպքերի թիվը գերազանցել է 12 հազարը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of Ebola virus infection cases has surpassed 12 thousand.
article.articleSummary: 12,021 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 5,904 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of November 26, 2026, per Reuters citing government data. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, declared mid-May in Ituri province (northeastern DRC) and subsequently spreading to eight of the country’s 26 provinces, with cases reported across dozens of health zones. It represents the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Healthcare delivery is impeded by armed conflict, security concerns, and overloaded facilities; only about 15% of new infections are linked to known exposure chains, hindering contact tracing. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo. On November 18, 2026, the World Health Organization maintained the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルス感染者数が1万2千人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラが8州に拡大し、WHOがPHEIC認定を継続している大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年11月18日時点でPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を維持。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による史上2番目に大きい流行。武力紛争により接触者追跡が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: மாடுகளுக்கு பரவும் பெரியம்மை நோயை தடுப்பது எப்படி?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to prevent the spread of mad cow disease among cattle?
article.articleSummary: Mad cow disease in cattle is caused by a skin-destroying virus, with a 4–14 day incubation. Infected animals show high fever, fatigue, lameness, swelling of forelegs and hind legs (3–5 cm lumps on the head, neck, reproductive region, and limbs), and central ulcers where the skin crusts and sloughs. Treatment involves isolating affected cows and, under veterinary guidance, addressing fever, lameness, and skin wounds. On day 1, administer a mixture of 10 g each of betel leaves, pepper, rock salt, and jaggery every 3 hours; from day 2 for 14 days, three times daily. A paste made from neem leaves, kuppaimani leaves, holy basil, maruthani leaves, turmeric powder (20 g) and garlic (10 cloves), boiled in coconut or neem oil, can be applied to ulcers. Infected cattle should be separated and not grazed. Insects may spread disease; follow veterinary advice. Calves under 6 months should be vaccinated, and vaccination should precede moving cattle by 4 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 牛に広がる痘瘡様疾患（記事ではBSEと分類されているが症状はランピースキン病に類似）の予防法について
triage.triage_reason: 動物（牛）のみに影響する皮膚疾患に関する伝統的治療・予防法の紹介記事であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す記述がなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 疾患名はBSE（牛海綿状脳症）と分類されているが、記事中の症状（皮膚の隆起・潰瘍、発熱、跛行）はランピースキン病（LSD）に酷似しており、Bluedotの疾患分類誤りの可能性が高い。内容は家畜の民間療法・予防に関するもので、ヒトへの健康影響や公衆衛生上の懸念は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia e Ebolës në Kongo kalon 12.000 raste, luftimet pengojnë ekipet e reagimit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Congo exceeds 12,000 cases, fighting hampers response teams.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Ebola epidemic in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 laboratory-confirmed cases (12,021 confirmed), with about half of infections resulting in death. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is the fastest-growing in history, approaching the toll of West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (roughly 11,000 deaths). The epicenter is Ituri province around Bunia, with renewed fighting near Iga-Barrière between the Congo army and Convention pour la Révolution Populaire rebels, fueling displacement and hampering response efforts. WHO reports that clashes hinder access to communities, disrupt monitoring of exposed individuals, and leave treatment centers under-staffed. About a dozen people, including two WHO staff and Congolese health officials, were evacuated after three days trapped in a hospital amid crossfire.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数1万2000人を超える 戦闘が対応チームを妨害
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行が急速に拡大し、武力衝突により対応活動が阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事主題はDRCのイツリ州のみであり、Angolaでの発生は言及なしのため除外した。武力紛争により感染者追跡・治療が困難化しており、致死率の高さと史上最速の拡大ペースが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk ghi nhận thêm 1 trường hợp tử vong do sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak records another death due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: On 26 November 2026, the Dak Lak Center for Disease Control reported another death from dengue fever in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam. The fatality occurred in Ea Knốp commune, bringing the province’s dengue-related fatalities for 2026 to four. The report provides no further details on the number of dengue cases or laboratory confirmation. This update indicates ongoing dengue activity in Dak Lak during 2026. The notice is timestamped 19:08 on 26 November 2026. The information comes from local health authorities, underscoring the continued impact of dengue fever in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でデング熱による死亡者がさらに1名確認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムにおいて毎年発生する風土病であり、今回の死亡報告は既存の流行状況の継続を示す定例的な更新情報に留まる。重症度・伝播性の面で注視は必要だが、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節的に流行する風土病であり、2026年の累計死亡者数が4名となったことが報告されているが、感染者数や検査確定情報は不明。継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : " le plus grand problème qui cause les décès ici au CTE de Kisangani, c'est le retard d'admission ", Dr Tshimanga, médecin directeur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: "The biggest problem causing deaths here at the Kisangani Ebola Treatment Center is the delay in admission," Dr. Tshimanga, Medical Director.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Ebola remains active in Tshopo Province, DRC, with Kisangani's Ebola Treatment Center recording rising deaths linked to delayed admission and comorbidities. The CTE medical director warned that most recent fatalities result from patients arriving late; earlier presentation markedly improves survival, whereas some patients delay seeking care due to traditional medicine use. Dr. Richard Tshibambe noted that fatalities also involve co-morbid conditions such as hypertension and tuberculosis. He urged residents to seek care while the outbreak remains in the dry phase, since transitioning to the wet phase complicates recovery. Since 28 June 2026, the province has recorded more than 109 Ebola cases, with about half of patients dying in the affected health zones. Makiso health zone, in central Kisangani, remains the hardest hit with 33 confirmed cases. Deaths at the CTE have increased, including a family that lost six members in two weeks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：「キサンガニのエボラ治療センターで死亡が増加する最大の問題は入院の遅れ」―チシマンガ医師（医療部長）
triage.triage_reason: DRCコンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、致死率が高く（約半数が死亡）、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクや医療体制の課題も認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年6月28日以降、Tshopo州で109例以上のエボラ症例が確認され、致死率は約50%と高い。既存のエボラ流行の継続報道であり「異常/予想外」ではないが、重症度・感染拡大リスクが高くPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn chặn nguy cơ bùng phát các ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing the Risk of New Dengue Fever Outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang faces a dengue fever surge. Since September 2026, weekly dengue cases have exceeded 1,000; year-to-date through November, Da Nang reported 12,500 cases, up 3.7-fold vs 2015, with small outbreaks up fivefold. In week 47 (Nov 16–22), 2,219 cases were recorded, outpacing the five-year curve. Pediatric services show sharp increases: Da Nang Hospital for Obstetrics and Pediatrics reports 50–100 outpatient dengue visits daily; about 30% of admitted children are severe with hemorrhage and organ injury. Da Nang General Hospital records 260 dengue admissions, double the prior period. The dangerous phase occurs days 3–7 after fever onset, with risk of plasma leakage, bleeding, and shock. High-burden wards include Ngũ Hành Sơn, An Khê, Điện Bàn Đông, Sơn Trà. Surveillance expands at 554 points with 85 hotspots; 83 of 93 communes are under monitoring, but shortages of chemicals and equipment hinder control; five rapid and five mobile teams operate.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなデング熱流行拡大のリスクを防止
triage.triage_reason: ダナンで例年比3.7倍のデング熱症例増加、重症化率30%、入院倍増と公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な増加が確認され、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はベクター媒介感染症で国際的な直接拡散リスクは低いが、季節性の急増と医療資源（薬品・機材）不足が重症化・管理困難を示唆。続報でのサーベイランス状況・政府対応の推移に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 12 000 cas et 1,576 milliard de dollars nécessaires pour la riposte continentale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 12,000 cases and $1.576 billion needed for the continental response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths as of November 26, 2026 (Reuters). Africa CDC and the World Health Organization published a new continental plan for November 2026–May 2027, estimating funding needs of $1.576 billion to guide the continent’s Ebola response, spanning countries and partners, not just the DRC. The plan aims to better coordinate efforts and track fund use across the response. Médecins sans Frontières warns that funds on paper are not translating into care: ambulances are idle for lack of fuel, health workers remain unpaid, and epidemiological surveillance teams are absent in zones needing intervention. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, and the plan seeks to ensure field operations translate into real interventions across the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：症例数12,000件超、大陸規模の対応に15億7,600万ドルが必要
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で12,021例・5,904死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、WHO・Africa CDCが大陸規模の資金計画を発表するなど国際的な対応が必要とされているため。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%と非常に高く、医療現場では資金不足による救急車運行停止・医療従事者未払い・サーベイランス体制の欠如がMSFにより指摘されている。大陸規模の資金計画（2026年11月～2027年5月、15.76億ドル）が公表されたが実行面での課題が残る。

article.articleHeadline: Fighting forces Ebola teams to evacuate in eastern DR Congo -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, shows 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths. Renewed fighting in eastern DR Congo forced evacuation of Ebola response teams from Akwe hospital in Ituri province, hampering containment. About a dozen people, including two WHO staff, were evacuated to Bunia, with UN peacekeepers moving 10 health workers; WHO shifted teams from Mongbwalu to Bunia as road access deteriorated. In North Kivu, clashes displaced more than 20,000 people and health workers lost track of some contacts of Ebola patients. The Congolese army is repelling the CRP rebel advance around Bunia; the CRP is led by Thomas Lubanga. Bunia is a key Ituri response hub. The outbreak began on May 15 and has been declared a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部、戦闘によりエボラ対応チームが避難を余儀なくされる
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行（確定12,021例、死亡5,904例）において、武力紛争により対応チームの避難・接触者追跡の喪失が生じており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い事案。
triage.notes: 本件は既にWHOによりPHEIC宣言済みの進行中の大規模エボラ流行であり、武装勢力（CRP、トーマス・ルバンガ指揮）との戦闘により対応能力が著しく損なわれている。北キブ州で2万人超が避難民となり、接触者追跡が困難になっている点は流行拡大リスクを高める重大な要素。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola no Congo supera 12 mil casos e deixa quase 6 mil mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 12,000 cases and leaves nearly 6,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases (12,021) with nearly 6,000 deaths. Declared in May, the outbreak marks the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic in history and is the deadliest among the country’s 17 outbreaks, on track to exceed the West Africa 2014–2016 death toll. The Bundibugyo species currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. Response efforts are hindered by ongoing armed conflict between the army and the CRP rebels in Ituri Province, including Iga-Barrière near Bunia, prompting new displacement toward urban centers. WHO notes that hostilities have blocked access to some communities, hampering monitoring of exposed individuals and staffing of treatment centers. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected or deceased people; it is not airborne. Bundibugyo was first identified in 2007 in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が1万2000人超の感染者数となり、死者は約6000人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョ種)の大規模流行で、史上最速の拡大ペースかつ紛争により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダに言及しているが、これは2007年の原株発見地としての歴史的記述であり、現在の流行発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点、武力紛争による対応阻害が懸念される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Readily Diagnostics Builds Rapid Infection Test
article.articleSummary: Readily Diagnostics presents a rapid, multiplex molecular test platform built on padlock probes and rolling circle amplification to bridge the gap for half the world lacking basic diagnostics. The test yields visually readable results in about 25 minutes from a single kit, using gold nanoparticle-driven agglutination for a naked-eye readout. It covers nasal swabs for respiratory disease and urine or swabs for STIs. Two projects: Virca Air detects SARS CoV-two, Influenza A and B, and RSV for respiratory care, with elderly populations in mind; STI project detects Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, Trichomonas and gonorrhea AST, targeting LMICs in Africa and Asia, with home-based testing in Western markets. Gates Foundation backs STI project; collaborations in Kenya, Rwanda, Thailand; KOLs in Sweden and the US. The technology multiplexes up to 1000 padlock probes and is protected by four patents, aiming to connect central labs with point-of-care diagnostics and improve global access.

triage.headline_ja: Readily Diagnostics社、迅速感染症検査を開発
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクに関する報告ではなく、診断技術企業のプロダクト紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事は診断技術企業（Readily Diagnostics）の新製品発表に関するもので、疾患アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ケニア・ルワンダ・タイは臨床協力先として言及されているが、現地での感染症発生を報じるものではないため対象国リストに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia registra 19 casos de mpox em 2026; Salvador concentra maioria - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia reports 19 mpox cases in 2026; Salvador accounts for the majority.
article.articleSummary: Bahia reports 19 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with Salvador accounting for the majority (12), per Sesab as of November 24. Other cases are in interior municipalities: two in São Sebastião do Passé; one each in Feira de Santana, São Francisco do Conde, and Vitória da Conquista. Two patients reside outside Bahia; residence may not reflect where infection occurred. Mpox (monkeypox), caused by MPXV, spreads mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, secretions, or bodily fluids of infected people, plus contact with contaminated objects and prolonged close contact with respiratory secretions. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal lesions that may appear on the mouth, genitals, and anus. Authorities urge medical evaluation for suspected cases and to avoid close contact until assessed.

triage.headline_ja: バイーア州、2026年に19件のmpox症例を報告；サルバドールが大半を占める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイーア州でmpox症例が報告されているが、重症例や死亡、急増の情報はなく、現時点では散発的な国内発生に留まるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 既知の風土病化しているmpoxの国内発生報告であり、既存の対応能力内と推測されるが、症例数推移や重症度情報が不足しているため続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan Court Blocks Work on US-Backed Ebola Quarantine Site
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court blocked further construction or operation of a United States–backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base, ruling that the government failed to consult the public and ordering disclosure of the terms of the US arrangement within 45 days. Justice Patricia Nyaundi barred work from resuming unless the court certifies compliance with the disclosure order, citing breaches of public participation and access to information. The May temporary injunction followed protests in Laikipia. The case, brought by Katiba Institute and the Law Society of Kenya, concerns the Laikipia facility and not Kenya’s broader Ebola response. The outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 12,000 confirmed Ebola cases reported there. The facility was described as intended for Americans exposed to Ebola abroad.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの裁判所、米国支援のエボラ隔離施設建設を差し止め
triage.triage_reason: 記事はケニアの法廷闘争が主題だが、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で12,000例超という前例のない規模のエボラ感染が報告されており、事実確認のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文はケニアの隔離施設建設を巡る裁判が中心だが、DRCで12,000例超のエボラ確定例という記述は過去のDRC国内アウトブレイク規模（通常数百例以下）と比較して極めて異常であり、数値の正確性・最新のアウトブレイク状況の確認が必要。ケニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Phế cầu khuẩn: Mối nguy thầm lặng ẩn sau những tiếp xúc thường ngày
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcus pneumoniae: The silent danger lurking behind everyday interactions.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus pneumoniae (pneumococcus) is highlighted as a silent threat in a 15-panel visual project by Pfizer Vietnam and the Vietnamese Preventive Medicine Association to raise awareness in Vietnam. The bacterium commonly colonizes the throat in 5–90% of healthy people and spreads via respiratory droplets or contaminated surfaces in everyday interactions such as hugs or conversations. Globally, pneumococcal diseases cause about 1.6 million deaths annually, including pneumonia, meningitis, and bacteremia; the WHO lists S. pneumoniae on the 2024 Bacterial Priority Pathogens List in the medium-priority group. High-risk groups include the elderly, children under five, and those with chronic diseases (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, COPD). In older adults with comorbidity, infection can raise short-term risks of myocardial infarction (~6x) and stroke (~12x). Economic burden is substantial: in Vietnam, adult CAP costs average about $795 per case with ~11 days hospitalization. Prevention emphasizes nutrition, hygiene, and handwashing; high-risk groups should consult healthcare providers for tailored prevention. The project is independently reviewed by the Vietnamese Society of Preventive Medicine.

triage.headline_ja: 肺炎球菌：日常の接触に潜む静かな脅威
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、Pfizerベトナムによる肺炎球菌感染症の一般的な啓発キャンペーン記事であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、Pfizerベトナムとベトナム予防医学会による肺炎球菌感染症の一般啓発プロジェクトの紹介記事であり、疫学的シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose avança no RS e preocupa: saiba reconhecer os sinais em pessoas e gatos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis advances in Rio Grande do Sul and raises concerns: learn to recognize the signs in people and cats.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, reports 1,465 confirmed human sporotrichosis cases in 2026 through November, with 1,051 cases under investigation, signaling a notable outbreak often called the 'cat disease.' Sporotrichosis is caused by Sporothrix fungi found in soil and decaying vegetation; transmission occurs via skin breaches from scratches, bites, or contact with contaminated material, and is not transmitted person-to-person. The predominant lymphocutaneous form presents as a small skin nodule or non-healing wound, followed by new nodules along lymphatic channels; less commonly, pulmonary, bone, or joint involvement may occur. Incubation ranges from one week to six months. Diagnosis relies on lesion examination and culture. Treatment uses antifungals (itraconazole; amphotericin B in specific cases), usually for months and sometimes up to a year, with ongoing SUS provision. In cats, lesions on the nose, ears, and paws, with nasal discharge; owners should seek veterinary care and avoid touching lesions.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州でスポロトリコーシスが拡大し懸念高まる：人と猫の兆候の見分け方
triage.triage_reason: 人-人感染はないが、環境曝露の継続と社会的関心の高まり（『懸念』と明記）が確認され、WPROスクリーニング基準の『長期曝露』に該当するためフルRRAへの移行を推奨。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスは土壌・植物由来の真菌症で人-人感染はなく、主にブラジル南部の猫由来感染症として知られる。大量の症例数（確認1465例、調査中1051例）が報告されているが、重症度は限定的で国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域内公衆衛生対応（SUSによる治療継続）が進行中であり、続報の推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola franchit la barre des 12 000 cas confirmés et dépasse les 5 900 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases and 5,900 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths across eight provinces: Ituri; Nord-Kivu; Sud-Kivu; Haut-Uélé; Bas-Uélé; Tshopo; Nord-Ubangi; Sud-Ubangi. As of 24 November 2026, 66 new cases and 37 deaths were reported. Ituri remains the epicenter with 8,140 cases and 3,843 deaths, about 67.7% of cumulative infections. There are 1,092 people hospitalized or in isolation; 3,332 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 85.1%. The outbreak, declared in May, is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Ongoing conflict, road degradation, and violence hinder response activities. MONUSCO installed a mobile operations base in Djugu (Akwe, Damas, Mbidjo) on 22 November to protect civilians and facilitate access; on 24 November ten health workers, including a physician and nurses from Akwe, were evacuated. WHO Africa warns insecurity complicates case detection, tracing, and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行が確認症例12,000例、死者5,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が8州に拡大し12,000例・死者5,900人超、紛争地域での対応困難が継続しているため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ワクチンや承認された治療法が存在しないBundibugyoウイルスによる流行であり、紛争・治安悪化により対応活動（症例探知・接触者追跡・患者ケア）が阻害されている。MONUSCOによる保護活動や医療従事者の避難も発生しており、既にフルRRA相当の深刻な継続的流行である。
