article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc cúm A gia tăng, cha mẹ cần cảnh giác với những dấu hiệu nguy hiểm này
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising cases of influenza A among children; parents should be vigilant for these dangerous signs.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is an acute respiratory infection caused by influenza A viruses (H1N1, H3N2) that spreads mainly via respiratory droplets. It can affect all ages, with children under five at higher risk. Admissions for influenza A have risen recently at the Cam Khe Regional Medical Center Pediatric Department. Common symptoms in children include fever (often high), cough, sore throat, runny nose or congestion, headache, myalgia, and fatigue; nausea or diarrhea may occur. Transmission is via droplets and contact, with higher spread in crowded, poorly ventilated settings such as schools and daycares. Dangerous signs include persistent high fever, seizures, rapid or labored breathing, chest or limb pain, pallor or lethargy, and poor feeding. Complications can include bronchitis, pneumonia, otitis media, and encephalitis. Prevention: annual vaccination, hand hygiene, masks, covering coughs, a clean environment, adequate rest and fluids, and seeking care when needed.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型罹患児童が増加、保護者はこれらの危険な兆候に注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの一般的な啓発記事であり、地域医療センターでの患者増加は報告されているが、異常性や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAに関する一般的な保護者向け啓発・注意喚起記事で、特定地域（Cam Khe地域医療センター）での患者増加に言及しているが、疫学的な異常性や重症度の急増、集団発生のエビデンスは示されていない。対象国リストの中では唯一Vietnamが発生地域として挙がっているが、記事内容は日常的な季節性感染症の注意喚起にとどまるためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 简易四针法是什么？无血清工艺有何特点？狂犬病领域新科普
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the simple four-needle method? What are the characteristics of the serum-free process? A new science popularization in the field of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies is a nearly 100% fatal CNS zoonosis but preventable with timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) in China: wound cleaning, vaccination, and passive immunisation when indicated. Exposures are I-III; I: licking on intact skin; II: minor bites/scratches; III: penetrating wounds, mucosal contamination, or bat contact (facial injuries or immunocompromise may be treated as III). Vaccination regimens in China: 5-dose (0,3,7,14,28); 2-1-1 (day 0 two injections, days 7 and 21); and the newly approved simple four-dose method (0,3,7, plus a fourth dose between days 14–28; total completion as short as 14 days if fourth dose on day 14). Phase III data show 100% seroconversion at days 14/28/42 and 3 months; safety similar. No-serum production: Sinovac’s Rabies Vaccine uses a serum-free, animal-component-free Vero cell culture (Vero-SF-ACF) and the rPV-2061 virus, via fixed-bed perfusion, yielding higher purity and potential production gains. Choose vaccines considering regimen convenience and disclosed production details.

triage.headline_ja: 簡易四針法とは何か？無血清プロセスの特徴は？狂犬病分野の新しい科学普及
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病ワクチンの接種スケジュールや製造技術に関する科学普及・解説記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規感染事例の報告ではなく、ワクチン接種法（簡易四針法）と無血清ワクチン製造技術に関する啓発記事。具体的な発生状況・症例数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode aumentar casos de doenças no Ceará em 2027; entenda quais são os riscos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could increase disease cases in Ceará in 2027; understand the risks.
article.articleSummary: El Niño could raise health risks in Ceará in 2027 due to drought, water scarcity, and higher temperatures, according to planning by the Ceará Health Secretariat (Sesa) published in 2026 (as of 2026-11-26) guiding actions through July 2027. The State Plan for Preparation and Response to Impacts of Drought, Dry Spell and Water Scarcity associated with El Niño identifies dengue, Zika, and chikungunya (Aedes aegypti) as key arboviruses potentially intensified by irregular water supplies that trigger household storage. Acute diarrheal diseases, leptospirosis, and respiratory infections are highlighted, along with dehydration, heat exhaustion, and heat stroke. Vulnerable groups include the elderly, children, and people with chronic diseases (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, other non-communicable diseases). Accidents with venomous animals and mental-health impacts are also noted. Prevention emphasizes sealing water tanks, eliminating standing water, and maintaining hygiene; the plan stresses surveillance and environmental monitoring, not an assured rise in all conditions.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョが2027年にセアラ州での疾病症例を増加させる可能性；考えられるリスクを解説
triage.triage_reason: 将来のリスクに関する予防的な行政計画の報道であり、実際の症例急増や異常な流行は報告されていないため、現時点でのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・セアラ州政府による2027年に向けた予防計画の紹介であり、実際の感染症発生状況の報告ではない。デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱・レプトスピラ症は季節性・気候要因によるリスクとして言及されているのみで、具体的な症例数や異常増加は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진 1만2천명 넘어...보름 만에 1천명 또 증가
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000, with another 1,000 increase in just over two weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 cases, with 12,021 cumulative infections reported by INSP as of Nov 24, 2026. Since Nov 9, new cases rose by about 1,000 over the following two weeks. Deaths total 5,904 (case fatality 49.1%), with 3,332 recoveries and 1,092 currently in treatment. The outbreak is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine or therapy exists; the Ervebo vaccine (Zaire ebolavirus) has been deployed since Aug 26 for outbreak-area residents and healthcare workers, with some reported protective effect in animal studies. Ongoing fighting in Ituri and North Kivu complicates containment; clashes near Bunia and related evacuations of WHO staff are noted. In Kenya, a court halted further construction of a US-backed Ebola isolation facility at a central Kenya US Air Force Base, ordering disclosure of the agreement terms. Kenya reported nine confirmed cases and two deaths linked to travel from DRC via Uganda; no new cases since Nov 19, with the last discharge on Nov 11, triggering a 42-day countdown to declaring outbreak over.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確認症例が1万2千人を超過…2週間余りで1千人増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）流行が12,000例・致死率49.1%に達し、紛争地域での対応困難とケニアへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株であり、Ituri州での武力衝突がWHO職員の避難を招くなど対応を複雑化させている点に特に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Εκρηκτική η εξάπλωση δάγκειου πυρετού παγκοσμίως - Τα κρούσματα αυξήθηκαν κατά 34 φορές σε τρεις δεκαετίες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Explosive global spread of dengue fever — cases increased 34-fold over three decades.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, a viral disease transmitted by mosquitoes, is spreading rapidly. A new analysis using mathematical models estimates confirmed cases rose 34-fold over 34 years, from 430,000 in 1990 to 14.7 million in 2025. Symptoms include high fever, headache, vomiting, muscle and joint pains, and an itchy rash; a small minority develop hemorrhagic fever with low blood pressure. In Greece, dengue was once endemic but eradicated after the 1927–28 epidemic; reintroduction is anticipated with climate change. The principal vector, Aedes aegypti, is established in Cyprus and may move north; Greece also hosts Aedes albopictus. Europe recorded 71 cases in 2022 (France 65, Spain 6). WHO notes dengue circulates on all continents except Antarctica, threatening about half the world’s population. Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduced transmission in Brazil by 68% (2020–2024) and eliminated cases in Colombian cities; devices releasing repellents showed a 34% reduction in Peru but no significant effect in Puerto Rico.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的なデング熱の爆発的拡大 — 過去30年で症例数が34倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: 過去30年間のデング熱症例数の増加に関する統計・科学的分析記事であり、特定国における急性アウトブレイクや新規異常事象を報告するものではないため、即時のシグナルトリアージ対象としない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界的なデング熱流行のトレンド分析（1990年〜2025年の34倍増加）を扱う総説的内容。ブラジルはWolbachia感染蚊による防除効果（2020-2024年に68%減少）の具体例として言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。ペルー・コロンビア・プエルトリコ等は対象国リスト外のため除外。特定の急性アウトブレイクイベントではなく、長期的傾向報告のためDISMISS判定。

article.articleHeadline: Aktivasi SIZE deteksi wabah penyakit di 32 daerah Nusa Tenggara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Activation of SIZE for disease outbreak detection in 32 districts of Nusa Tenggara.
article.articleSummary: On 26 November 2026, the Indonesian government activated the Zoonosis and Emerging Infectious Diseases Information System (SIZE) for the Nusa Tenggara region, spanning 32 districts. SIZE is a digital, data-driven platform designed to boost early vigilance, accelerate information exchange, and enable a coordinated, integrated response to infectious disease threats in both animals and humans. The deployment strengthens disease surveillance, improves timeliness of alerts, and facilitates interagency collaboration across West and East Nusa Tenggara. By centralizing zoonotic and emerging pathogen data, SIZE supports rapid detection, reporting, and response to potential outbreaks, providing a common framework for monitoring, risk assessment, and decision-making in public health and veterinary contexts.

triage.headline_ja: ヌサトゥンガラ地域32地区で疾病流行検知のためSIZEを稼働
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な疾病の発生ではなく、サーベイランスシステム（SIZE）の導入・稼働に関する行政的な報告であり、健康事象そのものの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染症の発生を報じるものではなく、監視システム導入のニュースのため、感染症イベントとしては対象外。インドネシア国内の話題だが、対象国リストに含まれるIndonesiaでも疾病そのものの報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: New Blood Protein Test Could Help Doctors Track COVID-19, Flu Recovery And Other Viral Infections: Lancet
article.articleSummary: Beijing outpatient clinic study enrolled 201 adults with respiratory viral infections from December 2023 to March 2024; 59 influenza A, 43 influenza B, 78 SARS-CoV-2, 21 other viruses. Blood myxovirus resistance protein A (MxA) levels, measured by fluorescence-based assay, were high at symptom onset (median 116 ng/mL), peaking around day 2 and decreasing to below 50 ng/mL by day 10. MxA dynamics correlated with viral reads via sequencing and with systemic/respiratory symptom scores, strongest early in infection. Virus-specific patterns: MxA declined faster with SARS-CoV-2 than influenza; among influenza B, declines were faster with baloxavir than oseltamivir. Not a stand-alone recovery test; MxA declined more slowly than viral load, and a low value does not confirm non-infectiousness. An exploratory finding: higher baseline MxA associated with in-hospital mortality in 48 hospitalized patients with lower respiratory infections and fever. Limitations: single hospital, limited follow-up, excluded immunosuppressed; requires larger validation.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい血液タンパク質検査がCOVID-19・インフルエンザの回復やその他のウイルス感染の追跡に役立つ可能性：Lancet誌
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断バイオマーカー研究に関する学術報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 北京の臨床研究を基にしたMxAタンパク質によるウイルス感染回復追跡に関する医学研究記事であり、感染症の発生・流行に関する情報ではないため、対象国としての発生地域検証も該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: ಮತ್ತೆ ವಕ್ಕರಿಸಿದ 'ಮಹಾಮಾರಿ': 12 ಸಾವಿರ ಮಂದಿಗೆ ಸೋಂಕು, ಸಮರೋಪಾದಿ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ! ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಮಾರಕ ಎಂದ ತಜ್ಞರು
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another ravaging 'pandemic': 12,000 people infected, a military-style operation! Experts say it's the deadliest.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo-strain Ebola virus first detected in May in the Bundibugyo region has infected roughly 12,000 people, with experts deeming it the deadliest Ebola outbreak to date. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. Health workers face intensified containment challenges due to security and access issues: clashes between the army and insurgents, damaged road networks, local misperceptions, and deep distrust in the health system. The response is described as a military-style operation, highlighting severe operational hurdles to containment. The article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. Published on 2026-11-26, the outbreak remains ongoing as authorities strive to scale up response amid security and access constraints.

triage.headline_ja: 再来する『大流行』：1万2000人が感染、軍事的規模の対応作戦！専門家は『史上最も致死的』と指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ株エボラが約1万2000人に感染し、承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しない史上最悪規模の流行とされ、治安悪化によって封じ込めが著しく困難になっているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の見出し・URLはコンゴ（DRC）での発生と明記している一方、サマリー中の『ブンディブギョ地域』はウガンダの地名であり地理的記述に矛盾がある。発生地域データにはウガンダも含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外し、記事の主題であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。続報でラボ確認情報・感染経路・国境を越えた拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alertan que el dengue se expande a una "velocidad alarmante": las causas de la suba histórica de casos en el mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They warn that dengue is spreading at an alarming rate: the causes of the historic rise in cases worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases worldwide rose from about 430,000 in 1990 to 14.7 million in 2024, a 34‑fold increase. Presented November 22 at the ASTMH meeting in National Harbor, Maryland, the analysis attributes the surge to urban expansion and warming that broaden Aedes aegypti’s range and human exposure. The study compiles national health records and uses modeling to fill gaps; it is a preprint, not peer‑reviewed. Vaccination may reduce impact, depending on age, prior infections, and policy, but should be paired with surveillance and vector control. In Brazil, a randomized trial (Jan 2021–May 2022) released about 32 million Wolbachia‑infected mosquitoes; children in intervention areas had 68% fewer dengue infections than controls—the first Americas‑based randomized evidence of this approach. Spatial repellents in Peru (2016–2019) reduced dengue risk by ~34%, while results in Puerto Rico showed no measurable effect. Experts emphasize Wolbachia’s potential alongside vaccination and vector control.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が『驚異的な速さ』で拡大していると警告：世界的な患者数の歴史的急増の原因
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はASTMH学会で発表されたプレプリント研究に基づく世界的なデング熱増加傾向の解説記事であり、特定の国における新規アウトブレイクや緊急対応を要する事象ではないため、現時点でのシグナルとしての取り扱いは不要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は査読前のプレプリント研究に基づく世界的なデング熱増加トレンドの分析であり、具体的な国別アウトブレイクの速報ではない。ブラジルについてはWolbachia感染蚊を用いた無作為化試験（2021-2022年）の結果が具体的に言及されているため地域として記載したが、現行の発生急増を示す内容ではない。ペルー・プエルトリコ・米国（メリーランド）は会議開催地または研究対象地域であり対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ASF confirmed in Colase as Samboan widens checks
article.articleSummary: ASF confirmed in Colase, Samboan, southern Cebu, after the Department of Agriculture 7 laboratory confirmed ASF in two Colase samples; infection source under investigation, with hogs alleged smuggled from Negros Island. Containment in Samboan is in its second week; surveillance expanded to 14 of 15 barangays. About 10 barangays tested negative; the first 41 samples were negative, with 57 pending as of Nov. 25, 2026. Samboan’s hog population exceeds 5,000; Colase’s current count unavailable. In Ginatilan, ASF was confirmed Sept 20 in Cagsing and Calabawan and contained by Oct 20 after 14 days of surveillance; 60 samples from 12 other barangays were negative, with border controls implemented. Executive Order 55 (Oct 26) requires external hogs to be slaughtered at NSI-accredited facilities, with permits, veterinary health certificates, and negative ASF tests; proposed weekly cap of 1,500 hogs from Negros Oriental; Cebu faces a ~1,000-head shortfall ahead of holidays/Sinulog.

triage.headline_ja: サンボアンでの検査拡大の中、コラセでASF（アフリカ豚熱）感染確認
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は家畜（豚）のみに影響する動物疾病でヒトへの感染性はないが、フィリピン・セブ州南部で拡大が続き、食料供給・経済への影響と行政対応が継続しているため、動向注視の対象とする。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。ただし養豚業・食料供給への経済的影響があり、地方自治体による検疫・移動制限（Executive Order 55等）が継続中。ヒト健康影響の観点からはDISMISS相当だが、食料安全保障・経済動向の観点からWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de mpox foge de hospital de Divinópolis e é localizado horas depois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected mpox escapes from Divinópolis hospital and is located hours later.
article.articleSummary: November 25, 2026: A patient with suspected mpox escaped from Hospital Universitário de Divinópolis in Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The individual presented clinical features compatible with mpox, but laboratory confirmation was pending; authorities located him hours later in the Niterói neighborhood after a joint effort by the Municipal Social Development Secretariat, the Military Police, and Samu. Mpox is caused by the mpox virus and is transmitted mainly by direct contact with lesions or contaminated objects, with possible airborne spread in prolonged close contact. The incubation ranges from 3 to 16 days, up to 21; symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, body pains, chills, and weakness. Diagnosis is via laboratory testing; treatment is supportive. Vaccination exists for adults over 18 before exposure (lab workers, immunocompromised, people with HIV/AIDS, transplant or oncology patients, and PrEP program staff) and after medium- or high-risk exposure.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox疑いの患者がディヴィノポリスの病院から逃走、数時間後に発見される
triage.triage_reason: 単発の疑い症例で検査確定前であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の根拠は乏しいが、Mpoxという流行性のある疾患であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 検査確定前の疑い症例の単発事例であり、病院からの逃走という社会的エピソードが主題。感染拡大の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заражения Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 12 тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo exceeded 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 12,000 confirmed cases and about 5,900 deaths since spring. It is the deadliest of 17 regional outbreaks and could surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (≈11,000 deaths). The crisis is aggravated by ongoing armed clashes between government forces and multiple groups, with frequent attacks on health facilities. Last week, WHO staff and clinicians barricaded themselves in a hospital in Ituri Province amid crossfire. The UN Secretary-General notes more than 87 armed attacks on health facilities in the DRC since January, hindering detection and patient care across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1万2千人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ流行が1万2千例・約5900人死亡に達し、武力衝突により医療対応が阻害されるなど公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリーではDRCの流行のみが主題であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Високиот суд во Кенија: Владата го прекрши Уставот со изградбата на американски карантин за ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Kenyan High Court: The government violated the Constitution by building an American Ebola quarantine facility.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court ruled that the government violated the Constitution by permitting a US-backed Ebola quarantine facility at a Laikipia military base, built without public participation. The court ordered the government within 45 days to publish all contracts with the United States and halt further construction and operation of the 50-bed facility. Protests erupted as residents feared virus exposure and strain on an already weak health system. The Kenyan Law Society and the Katiba Institute argued the health system is under-equipped to handle an outbreak. US officials said Americans exposed abroad would be routed to the facility, and $13.5 million was earmarked to support Kenya’s Ebola preparedness. Residents noted military aircraft; a US humanitarian organization reported quarantining staff who previously worked in Congo. Kenya reported its first Ebola case in October, nine cases by 26 November 2026, all linked to the initial case, with origin tracing to Congo via Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所：政府は米国支援のエボラ検疫施設建設で憲法に違反したと判断
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ症例が確認され、9例に拡大（起源はコンゴ経由ウガンダ）。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、越境拡大の可能性があり、政治的・社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける米国支援の検疫施設建設を巡る違憲判決および住民の抗議活動。エボラの起源はコンゴ経由ウガンダとされるが、対象国リストにケニア・ウガンダは含まれず、DRCは発生地域として記載されているものの記事本文では『起源』としての言及に留まり、DRC国内での発生事例としては確認できないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Суд у Кенији забранио рад америчког центра за карантин оболелих од еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Kenyan court banned the operation of an American Ebola quarantine center.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court halted operation of a US-backed Ebola quarantine centre near Nanyuki, central Kenya, on 26 November 2026. The 50-bed facility, built at Lakipiya military base to quarantine people exposed to Ebola, was ordered closed until the government publishes within 45 days all agreements with the United States and related health, environmental, and security assessments. The court ruled the government violated the constitution by allowing construction without public participation and transparency. Protests by locals fearful of exposure accompanied the case. Officials had planned to relocate exposed nationals there, with the US government allocating about $13.5 million to help Kenya prepare for an Ebola outbreak. In July, seven American humanitarian workers quarantined there after working in DRC; they were asymptomatic. Kenya reported its first Ebola case in early October; nine total cases, two deaths, seven recoveries; no new infections since 20 October; all linked to the initial case.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの裁判所が米国支援のエボラ検疫センターの運営を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラ検疫施設運営をめぐる訴訟であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（DRC等）での具体的な感染拡大・発生状況の記述がないため、モニタリング対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: ケニアでのエボラ発生（9例、死亡2例、10月20日以降新規感染なし）と米国支援の検疫施設に関する訴訟が主題。ケニアおよび米国は対象国リストに含まれず、DRCへの言及は曝露歴の背景情報のみで発生状況の具体的記述はないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Альянс вакцин Gavi уклав угоду на до 1,5 млн доз вакцини від Еболи -- Health Policy Watch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance signed a deal for up to 1.5 million doses of an Ebola vaccine — Health Policy Watch.
article.articleSummary: ChAdOx1 BDBV, Ebola vaccine candidate from Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India, could deliver up to 1.5 million doses to affected populations in the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, pending successful Phase II/III trials and regulatory approvals. Gavi, the Serum Institute of India, and Serum Life Sciences signed a provisional purchase agreement this week. The WHO has approved ChAdOx1 BDBV for trials during the current outbreak and also endorsed testing Moderna’s mRNA-1469. The trial design employs ring vaccination, targeting contacts of confirmed cases, with results expected in early 2027. Since the outbreak began, over 12,000 people have been infected and more than 5,900 have died. Funding comes from Gavi’s First Responders Fund, supported by the US, Japan, Italy, Germany, Norway, and France. The Serum Institute has produced substance for over 500,000 doses to speed access.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン同盟Gavi、エボラワクチン最大150万回分の調達契約を締結 — Health Policy Watch
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行は感染者1.2万人超、死者5900人超と極めて深刻で、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン調達契約が主題だが、背景にあるDRCのエボラ流行自体が大規模（感染1.2万人超、死亡5900人超）であり既に国際支援（Gavi First Responders Fund、米・日・伊・独・ノルウェー・仏の資金提供）が動いている。他国（米・伊・日・仏・独・ノルウェー・インド）はワクチン開発・資金提供国であり発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Les cas d'Ebola dépassent les 12 000 alors que les intervenants peinent à contenir l'épidémie | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola cases exceed 12,000 as responders struggle to contain the outbreak | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths as of November 26, 2026. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain and was declared mid-May in Ituri province in the northeast, now extending to eight of the DRC's 26 provinces. No approved treatment or vaccine exists for this strain. The current outbreak is the second-largest and second-deadliest on record, behind West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic that infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000. Factors fueling transmission include late case detection, ongoing armed conflict, and strained health systems. Only about 15% of new cases arise from contacts already identified by health authorities, according to Africa CDC data released earlier this month.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例数が12,000人を超え、対応者らは流行の抑制に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例12,021人・死者5,904人に達し、治療法・ワクチンが存在しない稀な株による大規模流行が8州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外。Ituriは州でありDRCに包含。致死率約49%、接触者追跡率が低く(新規症例の約15%のみ既知接触者由来)、武力紛争により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Captive Wild Boars in Brazil Harbor Highly Multidrug-Resistant Escherichia
article.articleSummary: In Goiás State, Brazil, captive European wild boars (Sus scrofa scrofa) on two licensed farms showed a 56.0% carriage of Escherichia coli and 1.0% carriage of Salmonella enterica. From 100 rectal swabs of clinically healthy boars collected Sept 2014–Feb 2017, 98.2% of E. coli isolates were resistant to four or more antimicrobial classes, with every isolate having a multiple antimicrobial resistance index >0.2. A single Salmonella enterica isolate, serotype O:6,8, was resistant to ampicillin, amoxicillin, and sulfonamides but susceptible to third-generation cephalosporins, and showed no targeted virulence or resistance genes molecularly. Antimicrobial susceptibility used disk diffusion per CLSI M100 guidelines across nine antibiotics; MDR defined as resistance to three or more classes. The study highlights invasive wild boar expansion in Brazilian biomes and their role as wildlife reservoirs for zoonoses (e.g., Leptospira, Toxoplasma, Brucella, Mycobacterium tuberculosis, hepatitis E), raising concerns about bidirectional pathogen exchange at the human–livestock–wildlife interface amid increasing hybridization with domestic swine.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの飼育野生イノシシに高度多剤耐性大腸菌を保有
triage.triage_reason: 動物（野生イノシシ）における薬剤耐性菌保有の学術研究報告であり、ヒトへの感染事例や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2014-2017年に収集された検体に基づく学術研究の報告であり、ヒト感染事例は確認されていない。多剤耐性大腸菌の野生動物保有という知見自体は公衆衛生上の潜在的関心事だが、即時のシグナルとはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Nordeste e Venda Nova concentram quase 45% dos casos de dengue em BH; veja os dados da sua regional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nordeste and Venda Nova account for almost 45% of dengue cases in Belo Horizonte; see the data for your region.
article.articleSummary: Belo Horizonte reported 1,982 dengue cases in 2026 through November 19, according to the city's Dengue Balance and Other Arboviruses. The Nordeste region registered the highest number of confirmed cases (485), followed by Venda Nova (399). Together, Nordeste and Venda Nova accounted for 884 diagnoses, 44.6% of the total. The Leste region ranked third with 259 cases, then Oeste with 200, Norte with 172, Noroeste with 169, Barreiro with 132, Centro-Sul with 118, and Pampulha with 44—the lowest among the nine regions. In addition, 1,193 notifications were awaiting laboratory results or epidemiological assessments, while 17,080 were investigated and ruled out. The report highlights ongoing monitoring of dengue and other arboviruses in the city for the 2026 season.

triage.headline_ja: ノルデステ地区とヴェンダ・ノヴァ地区がベロオリゾンテ市のデング熱症例の約45%を占める；地域別データを見る

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 aumentam no Rio de Janeiro e somam 2.424 registros em uma semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in Rio de Janeiro, totaling 2,424 records in one week.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil — The Secretaria de Estado de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro (SES-RJ) reports a surge in COVID-19 activity, with 2,424 new infections recorded across the state during 15–21 November 2026. The state’s positivity rate rose from 25.9% to 34.3% in the same period, signaling increased transmission. Cumulatively for 2026, 18,060 laboratory-confirmed cases have been identified. Laboratory surveillance shows the Omicron variant remains predominant among analyzed samples. To blunt the rising infections, the state has administered 721,950 doses of COVID-19 vaccines so far in 2026. The health secretariat emphasizes immunization continues to play a central role in reducing severe disease and hospitalizations.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでCOVID-19症例が増加、1週間で2,424件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 既知の流行病（COVID-19、Omicron株）の季節的増加であり、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生への新たな影響は認められない。ワクチン接種など通常の対応が継続されている。
triage.notes: 陽性率上昇は見られるが、重症度や医療逼迫に関する情報はなく、既存の季節的流行の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de COVID-19 sobe em MG, mas Governo afirma que situação está sob controle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of COVID-19 cases rises in Minas Gerais, but the government says that the situation is under control.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Minas Gerais, Brazil, but authorities say the situation remains under control. In Belo Horizonte, 13 COVID-19 deaths have been recorded this year, with test positivity up to 7%. The city distributes face masks and urges vaccination, especially for older adults and children aged 6 months to 5 years. Across the state, 85 deaths were reported in 2023. In Contagem, visits for respiratory symptoms increased by 33%, and mask use is again mandatory in health facilities for symptomatic patients. Specialists note that increases are not yet indicative of a large outbreak, while reinforcing vaccination and masking as preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州でCOVID-19症例が増加、政府は「状況は制御下にある」と発表
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な症例増加であり、当局も「制御下にある」と説明。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常のサーベイランス情報に留まる。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）による既存の流行状況の変動であり、専門家も大規模アウトブレイクを示すものではないとコメントしている。

article.articleHeadline: Estado do Rio registra mais de 2,4 mil casos de covid-19 em uma semana | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of Rio de Janeiro records more than 2,400 COVID-19 cases in one week | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains active in Rio de Janeiro state, with 2,424 confirmed cases in the week of 15–21 November 2026—the highest weekly total in 2026—and six deaths. November totals reach 5,473 cases; year-to-date: 19,158 cases and 80 deaths in the state; in the capital, Rio de Janeiro city, 2026 totals are 10,982 cases and 32 deaths. Fiocruz IOC sequencing finds PJ.2.1 as the predominant lineage in Rio (58% of 167 genomes from 17 Oct–6 Nov), with RF.5 (22%) and XFG (11%) also detected. PJ.2.1 was first identified in Canada (May) and reached Brazil by late August, with detections in São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Rio Grande do Sul and Santa Catarina. WHO classifies PJ.2.1 as under monitoring. Vaccination via SUS protects against severe illness; typical symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, and runny nose; at-risk groups should stay up to date with vaccines and maintain hygiene and masking if symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、1週間で2,400件を超えるCOVID-19症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 通常のCOVID-19流行動向報告であり、新規変異株（PJ.2.1）はWHOによりunder monitoring分類にとどまるため、重症度や国際的懸念は限定的だが、変異株の拡大動向として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 新変異株PJ.2.1はカナダ起源でブラジル国内複数州に拡大しているが、WHOはunder monitoring分類であり重症度上昇の報告はなし。季節性の通常報告に近い内容。

article.articleHeadline: Omar Neyra advierte que epidemia de dengue está "fuera de control" y cuestiona respuesta sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Omar Neyra Warns That the Dengue Epidemic Is 'Out of Control' and Questions the Health Response.
article.articleSummary: Peru faces an unprecedented dengue epidemic, with 124,000 cases and 177 deaths (some under investigation), according to Neyra. He says the spike is driven by higher temperatures and rainfall, plus diagnostic delays and limited first-level testing that push patients into hospitals with advanced disease. Neyra criticizes the government’s emphasis on expanding ICU beds and partnerships rather than preventing transmission or enabling diagnosis, warning that waiting for severe illness is ineffective. He calls for sustained vector-control campaigns, fumigation, removal of standing water, and strong community participation, plus broader access to repellents. Vaccination coverage for the second dose is about 5–6%, and vaccine availability is constrained; Brazil’s suspension could hinder access to the Japanese dengue vaccine used in Peru. Serotype 3 is rising, and vaccine efficacy against this serotype should be evaluated. He proposes Minsa-led regional health management before December–January transitions to avoid care gaps. A dengue-related fetal death in Chimbote was reported; the newborn remains hospitalized.

triage.headline_ja: オマール・ネイラ氏、デング熱流行は「制御不能」と警告し、保健当局の対応に疑問を呈する
triage.triage_reason: ペルーにおけるデング熱流行に関する記事であり、ブラジルはワクチン供給文脈での言及のみで発生国ではない。対象国リストに該当する発生国がないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はペルー（対象国外）のデング熱流行に関する内容。ブラジルは日本製デングワクチンの供給停止に関連して言及されているのみで、ブラジル国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Allerte alimentari in aumento: più segnalazioni in Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food allergies on the rise: more reports in Italy.
article.articleSummary: RASFF 2025 shows rising food alerts; total notifications 5,206, down slightly from 2024. Border rejections 1,401 (-16.1%), alerts 1,415 (+10.4%), about 27.2% of notices. Microbiological contamination remains the main alert driver, including Salmonella, Listeria monocytogenes, and Escherichia coli; pesticide residues (16%) and mycotoxins (14%). Pesticides like chlorpyrifos and chlorpyrifos-methyl are frequently detected. Top food groups: fruits and vegetables (1,033), dried fruits and seeds (649), dietary supplements (409); confectionery notices rose. Italy sent 485 notifications to RASFF, with 226 for products of Italian origin. Most notices concern Turkish origin products (477), followed by China (327) and the Netherlands (323). Nationally: 349 alerts (+~15%), with about 85% serious or potentially serious. Notable outbreaks: Calabria and Sardinia botulism clusters in summer 2025; Listeria monocytogenes ST451 cluster (48 cases, 3 deaths) linked to salumi/sausages but no single source proven. Regions with most national notifications: Lazio, Lombardy, Veneto; main origins: Veneto, Emilia-Romagna, Lombardy. Calls for stronger supplier controls.

triage.headline_ja: 食品アレルギー（食品安全警告）増加：イタリアでの報告件数が増加
triage.triage_reason: イタリア国内のRASFF（食品・飼料に関する早期警告システム）年次報告であり、対象国における感染症アウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。中国等は食品原産地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアのRASFF2025年次報告書に関する統計的サマリーであり、ボツリヌス症（カラブリア・サルデーニャ）やリステリア菌クラスター（ST451、48例・3死亡）はイタリア国内の事案。中国・トルコ・オランダは食品原産国として言及されているのみで、対象国リストに該当する実際の発生国はない。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया से लड़ने के लिए AI और ड्रोन तकनीक ला रहा ICMR-NIMR, छतों व टंकियों में छिपे प्रजनन स्थलों की होगी सटीक पहचान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ICMR-NIMR to bring AI and drone technology to fight malaria, with precise identification of breeding sites hidden on rooftops and in water tanks.
article.articleSummary: ICMR-NIMR is developing a semi-automated drone-based system, powered by AI, to map malaria mosquito breeding sites in dense urban India. The technology targets breeding habitats concealed on rooftops and inside water storage tanks, enabling precise, data-driven vector-control interventions in metropolitan settings. By identifying breeding hotspots via drone imagery and AI analysis, the initiative aims to guide timely larval source management and curb urban malaria transmission. This approach marks India’s push toward advanced surveillance and targeted control in crowded cities, where traditional surveys struggle to detect hidden breeding grounds in rooftops and water containers.

triage.headline_ja: ICMR-NIMR、マラリア対策のためAIとドローン技術を導入へ―屋上や貯水槽に隠れた繁殖地を正確に特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア流行の発生報告ではなく、研究機関による蚊の繁殖地検出技術（AI・ドローン）の開発に関する技術紹介であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規感染症発生ではなく、既存のマラリア媒介蚊対策技術（AI・ドローンによる繁殖地検出）の開発ニュース。疫学的な異常事態の報告ではない。発生地域にLouisiana/United Statesが含まれるが、記事内容と無関係なため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Varginha realiza Dia D contra a Dengue e Novembro Azul neste sábado (28)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Varginha hosts Day D against Dengue and Blue November this Saturday (the 28th).
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, 28 November 2026, Varginha hosts Dengue Control Day from 8:00 to 12:00 at Praça dos Estudantes (Avenida Manoel Vida, Imaculada Conceição, near Unifenas). Organized by SEMUS, activities focus on preventing Aedes aegypti breeding, with educational talks, vector-control demonstrations, and guidance to eliminate water-collecting containers; entertainment includes inflatables, a trampoline, popcorn, and Dança Retrô. Iran Oliveira (Environmental Surveillance) notes the event fosters community engagement with the work of the teams. Also from 8:00 to 12:00, the Municipal Center of Physiotherapy at SEMEL (São Geraldo) hosts November Blue, offering free blood pressure and glucose checks, vaccination, medical and physiotherapy guidance, physiotherapy services, and dental care by appointment. HPV vaccination for 9–14-year-olds is temporarily extended to 15–19-year-olds through December 2026, per Health Secretary Heron Ataíde Martins and Physiotherapy Coordinator Patrick Baroni.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァルジーニャ市、28日（土）にデング熱対策「Dia D」と「ブルーノベンバー」を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の感染拡大や症例報告ではなく、自治体による蚊媒介対策の啓発イベントと健康診断イベントの告知であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発・地域イベントの告知であり、具体的な感染者数や流行状況の報告ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Amambai é o primeiro município de Mato Grosso do Sul a receber técnica com mosquitos machos estéreis para combater o Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amambai is the first municipality in Mato Grosso do Sul to receive the technique using sterile male mosquitoes to combat Aedes aegypti
article.articleSummary: Amambai, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, becomes the state’s first municipality and the country’s third to adopt Sterile Insect Technique (SIT) against Aedes aegypti, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector. The program releases sterilized male mosquitoes to mate with wild females, reducing reproduction and gradually lowering the vector population. Initiated November 23–28, 2026, activities include training for Indigenous Health Agents (AIS) and Indigenous Sanitation Agents (AISAN), entomological traps, theoretical and practical release management, a test release, and community engagement to explain the technology and prevention. The formal launch is set for November 28 (Dia D National Day for Dengue, Zika, and chikungunya) at Escola Municipal Guarani Kaiowá in Aldeia Amambai. Despite new tools, eliminating water-holding containers remains essential; community participation is vital to sustain control of arboviruses.
