article.articleHeadline: 中疾控发布提示：全国流感处于中流行水平，检测阳性率上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC issues a reminder: nationwide influenza is at a moderate level of circulation, and the test positivity rate is rising.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in China is at a moderate nationwide level for the period November 16-22, 2026, with rising influenza positivity in northern and southern provinces, according to China CDC surveillance released November 26, 2026. Among positive samples, influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 accounts for 65.0%, A(H3N2) 9.7%, and B/Victoria lineage 25.3%. The 5-14-year-old group shows higher positivity than other ages. The report notes that most regions have entered the peak season of acute respiratory infections. Public health recommendations include timely vaccination and multi-disease prevention, good hygiene, covering coughs/sneezes with tissue, cloth, or elbow, hand hygiene, avoiding touching eyes/nose/mouth with unclean hands, and wearing masks in crowded settings. Source: CCTV News.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病対策センターが発表：全国のインフルエンザは中程度の流行水準、検査陽性率が上昇
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、異常な拡大や重症化、渡航制限等の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告。中程度の流行レベルで、A(H1N1)pdm09が優勢。特段の異常所見や重症化報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng bệnh sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive dengue fever prevention
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases rise in Vietnam with over 170,000 infections and 21 deaths in the first 10 months of 2026, up 1.3-fold from the same period in 2025. The outbreak affects all ages, though children and adolescents remain a priority, with adults at risk as well. Symptoms include sudden high fever, severe headache, muscle pains, nausea, and rash; progression can lead to dengue shock syndrome, severe bleeding, or organ failure if not managed promptly. Public health efforts focus on household and community mosquito control: eliminating standing water, covering containers, cleaning environments, and reducing larval sources. In addition, vaccination is available for eligible individuals: a dengue vaccine for those aged 4 and older, given in two doses 3 months apart, with eligibility based on age, prior infection history, immunity, and contraindications. Vaccination lowers risk but does not replace vector control or ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の予防に積極的に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性のデング熱症例が前年比1.3倍に増加し死者も出ているが、デング熱は同国の風土病であり、通常の予防啓発記事であるため新規性・国際的拡大懸念は低い。継続的な発生動向の監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、本記事は予防啓発・ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する通常の公衆衛生情報。症例数増加（170,000件超、死亡21人）は注視すべきだが、国際的な異常事態としてのシグナルは弱い。

article.articleHeadline: Da Nang dengue cases surge by 2,000 in just one week
article.articleSummary: Da Nang City, central Vietnam, reported 2,219 dengue fever cases in the week ending 2026-11-26, up from 1,925 the prior week—the first week this year above 2,000. Year-to-date cases reach 12,555, about 3.7 times higher than 3,384 in the same period last year. Wards with high numbers include Ngu Hanh Son, An Khe, and Son Tra. Hospitals have added beds as Da Nang Hospital for Women and Children and the Department of Tropical Medicine report strained capacity. Dengue typically starts with high fever, headache, body aches, and eye pain; the dangerous 3rd–7th day requires close monitoring, with warning signs needing immediate hospitalization: severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, reduced urination, cold hands and feet. Authorities urge prevention: eliminate stagnant water, use nets and repellents. Officials say the outbreak remains under control, with three inspection teams, enhanced surveillance, and tightened triage and responses.

triage.headline_ja: ダナンのデング熱症例、わずか1週間で2,000件急増
triage.triage_reason: ダナン市でデング熱症例が前年比3.7倍に急増し病院病床が逼迫するなど、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、社会的・行政的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナム中部で季節性に流行する既知の疾患だが、今年は前年比3.7倍という異常な増加と病院逼迫が報告されており、当局は「制御下」としているものの推移の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São Bento do Sul realiza pulverização de inseticida para combater o mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Bento do Sul carries out insecticide spraying to combat the dengue-carrying mosquito.
article.articleSummary: São Bento do Sul, Santa Catarina, Brazil, is spraying insecticide to curb Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever. The campaign uses the BRI-Aedes technique to create a residual chemical barrier at selected sites as part of the Dengue Control Day, targeting environments with high human traffic such as schools, health units, public buildings, churches, community centers, the bus station, and recyclable workers’ residences. In November, 23 mosquito foci were identified in the municipality, led by Serra Alta (4) and Colonial and Mato Preto (3 each). No dengue cases have been confirmed in 2026. With summer approaching, the Health Secretariat urges preventive actions and weekly home inspections (about 10 minutes) to eliminate standing water in tanks, gutters, plant pots, bottles, tires, animal waterers, tarps, pools, and drains. Most foci are indoors, so resident participation is essential; reports can be made anonymously to Endemias at (47) 9.9194-8790 or the Municipal Ombudsman at (47) 3631-6004.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ベント・ド・スル市、デング熱媒介蚊対策で殺虫剤散布を実施
triage.triage_reason: 2026年にデング熱の確定症例はなく、予防的な蚊対策（殺虫剤散布）に関する日常的な自治体活動であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な蚊駆除活動（殺虫剤散布キャンペーン）に関する報道であり、確定症例もなく感染症の発生イベントではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、イベントの実質的な発生（症例確認）がないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu confirma o segundo caso de Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu confirms the second case of Mpox.
article.articleSummary: Botucatu, Brazil, confirms its second mpox (monkeypox) case. The two confirmed patients are White; both infections occurred in November. The first case is a man aged 40–44, the second a woman aged 30–34. Botucatu is also investigating two additional suspected cases, with one notification discarded after evaluation. Both confirmed patients presented with skin lesions, fever, and lymphadenopathy, with lesions on multiple sites including genital/genital area, trunk, face, palms, mouth, feet, and anus. Mpox is a viral illness causing fever, body aches, swollen lymph nodes, and skin or mucosal lesions. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with lesions, secretions, contaminated objects, or close physical contact with infected individuals. With November confirmed cases, Botucatu records two mpox cases, two under investigation, and one discarded notification.

triage.headline_ja: ボツカツがMpoxの2例目の感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の小規模な局地的Mpox症例（確定2例、疑い2例）であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の影響は認められないが、人-人感染の可能性があるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 症例は軽症〜中等度の皮膚病変・発熱等で、重症化や死亡の報告なし。地域保健当局による通常の疫学調査範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis-MG decreta situação de emergência devido a casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis-MG declares a state of emergency due to cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, declared public health emergency over a human scabies outbreak concentrated in schools. Mayor Janete Aparecida signed a 60-day decree on 25 November, extendable. Measures include suspending a class if three confirmed cases occur on the same day; diagnosed students are excused for 48 hours after starting treatment; symptomatic students awaiting evaluation must not attend classes or use school transport until health guidance; intensified cleaning of schools and transport after each shift; fixed seating during the outbreak; report two or more confirmed cases with possible epidemiological links to Health Surveillance. Suspensions must be paired with a plan to recover activities. The mayor said there is no reason to suspend yet; families with cases will be followed by teams. Parents should monitor for nocturnal itching and skin lesions and seek care at the Basic Health Unit. Scabies is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei and diagnosed clinically; treatment is topical agents.

triage.headline_ja: ジヴィノポリス市（ミナスジェライス州）、ヒト疥癬の症例により緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 学校を中心とした疥癬の集団発生で地方自治体が緊急事態を宣言したが、疥癬自体は重症度が低く国際的拡大リスクも乏しいため、IHR基準には該当しないが地域的対応として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Scabies）はヒト-ヒト接触で学校等の集団生活環境で広がりやすいが、重症度は低く国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とはならない。地方自治体レベルでの対応（60日間の緊急事態宣言、学級閉鎖基準等）が取られており、今後の拡大状況を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в Конго надхвърли 12 000 случая, медици се евакуират заради боеве
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 12,000 cases, medics are being evacuated due to fighting.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases (12,021), with about half infected dying, making it the fastest-growing and most lethal Ebola epidemic in the country’s history. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with no approved vaccine or treatment. Responders face armed conflict, poor roads, and community violence, undermining outbreak control. In Ituri province, Bunia—the outbreak hub—has seen renewed fighting near the mining town of Iga-Barier, about 25 km north of Bunia, triggering new displacements. Clashes between the army and the rebel CRP group have hindered access, contact tracing, and hospital staffing. About a dozen people, including two WHO staff and Congolese health workers, were evacuated to Bunia after three days blocked in a hospital near Ake, northeast of Bunia. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; control requires isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. 26 Nov 2026

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が1万2000件を超え、戦闘のため医療従事者が避難
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ流行が12,000例を超え致死率約50％に達し、史上最速・最も致死的な流行となっている上、武力紛争により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 武力紛争（軍と反政府CRPグループの衝突）により接触者追跡・病院スタッフ配置・アクセスが阻害されており、WHO職員を含む医療従事者の避難が発生。ブンディブギョウイルスによる流行でワクチン・治療薬未承認。フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Minsa prevé incremento de casos de dengue en Perú en las siguientes semanas por el fenómeno 'El Niño'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MINSA expects an increase in dengue cases in Peru in the coming weeks due to the El Niño phenomenon.
article.articleSummary: Peru reports 126,986 dengue cases in 2026, with 87,563 confirmed and the remainder probable, and 124 deaths, per MINSA and the National Center for Epidemiology. El Niño-driven higher temperatures are expected to sustain transmission in coming weeks, prompting expansion of health-system capacity regionally. ICU occupancy is about 84%; funds are being dispatched to install more clinical surveillance units (UVICLIN) and fever clinics and to optimize bed distribution. Current totals are roughly half of 2023’s 250,000 and well below 2024’s 275,000 (254 deaths). Casma reports fumigation of over 90% of homes, while Santa regions reach 40–45%; La Libertad shows better vaccination uptake among 10–20-year-olds. Symptoms include fever and malaise; severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or bleeding require urgent care at a hospital or UVICLIN. Automedication remains a risk, with 30–40% first seeking treatment at a pharmacy.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ現象の影響でペルーのデング熱症例が今後数週間で増加する見込みとMINSAが発表
triage.triage_reason: ペルーで12万人超のデング熱症例と124人の死亡が報告され、ICU占有率も84%に達するなど重症度・医療負荷が高く、政府（MINSA）が対応体制強化に動いていることから、社会的・行政的関心が認められるためフルRRAへの移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 記事はペルーにおけるデング熱の季節的増加を扱っており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）にペルーは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。発生地域データにPhilippinesが含まれているが、記事本文には一切言及がないためBluedotの地域付与誤りと判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya High Court Rules Government Violated Constitution Over US-Backed Ebola Quarantine Facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court ruled the government breached the constitution by approving a United States–backed 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia airbase near Nanyuki without disclosing the bilateral agreement or holding public consultation, and ordered an immediate halt until disclosure and consultation occur. Judge Patricia Nyaundi highlighted lack of transparency and public participation. The facility has provoked protests and violence; June demonstrations left at least one dead after police fired on protesters, and later protests in Nanyuki left two more dead and one wounded. Seven American aid workers were quarantined there in July. Kenya's first imported Bundibugyo Ebola case arrived in October from the DRC via Uganda; by mid‑November the country reported two deaths and seven other cases, all recovered, with no new cases since Oct 19. WHO declared an international public health emergency on May 17. Health Minister Aden Duale had ordered a halt; no government comment on the ruling yet.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所、米国支援のエボラ検疫施設を巡り政府の違憲行為を認定
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源としウガンダ経由でケニアに輸入されたエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)症例があり、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言するなど国際的拡大・深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認されるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける検疫施設設置を巡る違憲判決・社会的抗議だが、背景にあるエボラ流行はDRCを起源としウガンダ経由でケニアに波及した事例であり、国際的拡大とWHOのPHEIC宣言を伴う公衆衛生上の重大事案として評価した。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Lagos unveils disease surveillance system as 1.8 million cattle enter state annually
article.articleSummary: Lagos State unveiled the Lagos State Bioshield, a digital biosecurity framework to detect and contain emerging disease threats, amid 1.8 million cattle entering Lagos annually. With Lagos hosting about 70% of Nigeria’s international air traffic and a population of 30.1 million, authorities stress cross-sector surveillance across human, animal and environment health. The BioShield combines artificial intelligence, telemedicine and digital health surveillance in two layers: screening entrants and monitoring arrivals who develop symptoms. Health Radar uses WhatsApp, SMS and email to conduct 21-day daily health checks, linking symptomatic travellers to telemedicine, labs and referrals. Pilot at CANEX WKND covered ~19,000 delegates, including 2,298 international visitors; 2,454 telemedicine consultations; 241 clinical referrals; 219 flagged. Plans for BioShield 3.0 and Africa-wide alliance with Lagos, Cairo, Kinshasa, Johannesburg, Nairobi to harmonize preparedness. Threats include Lassa fever, dengue, yellow fever, Marburg, Ebola, and unknown pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴス州、年間180万頭の牛が流入する中で疾病サーベイランスシステムを発表
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生事例ではなく、ナイジェリア・ラゴス州における予防的バイオセキュリティ監視システム導入の発表記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ナイジェリア・ラゴス州が新設したデジタル・バイオセキュリティ監視体制（Lagos State Bioshield）の紹介記事。対象国リストにナイジェリアは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。言及されているラッサ熱・デング熱・黄熱・マールブルグ病・エボラ出血熱はいずれも将来の脅威として一般的に挙げられているのみで、具体的な発生事例の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Large Bronchial Cast Removed from Infant with Parainfluenza Virus Pneumonia
article.articleSummary: Massive plastic bronchitis temporally linked to human parainfluenza virus type 3 (HPIV-3) pneumonia in an 11-month-old infant in Shanghai, China. Case from Shanghai Children's Hospital and Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital describes bilateral pulmonary infiltrates on chest radiography with left-lower-lobe consolidation on CT. Flexible bronchoscopy removed a single branching cast about 45 mm long obstructing the left main bronchus to the left lower lobe, following saline lavage. Pathology and molecular analyses of the cast and bronchoalveolar lavage identified HPIV-3 (65,790 t-NGS reads) with co-detection of Streptococcus mitis and Klebsiella pneumoniae; histology showed inflammatory infiltrates with PAS-positive material, consistent with Type I inflammatory plastic bronchitis. Treatment included amoxicillin-clavulanate, systemic methylprednisolone, and nebulized budesonide with ipratropium and salbutamol, with complete clinical recovery and radiographic resolution within one week. The report underscores prompt bronchoscopy for cast removal in HPIV-3–associated cases.

triage.headline_ja: パラインフルエンザウイルス肺炎の乳児から摘出された大規模な気管支鋳型
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やヒト-ヒト感染拡大の懸念は示されておらず、社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一の臨床症例報告（乳児のプラスチック気管支炎）であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vacaciones de verano: Salud insta en completar vacunación contra sarampión para evitar nuevos brotes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer vacations: Health urges completing measles vaccination to prevent new outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination urged as Paraguay faces summer travel and potential reintroduction. With holidays and increased international movement, authorities urge completing the routine immunization schedule before travel to protect children from measles. Paraguay remains measles-free but warns that imported cases can ignite outbreaks; high vaccination coverage is essential to maintain status. The plan notes first measles dose at age one and a second around 18 months; current figures show 66,000 first doses in one-year-olds (about 90% coverage) and 53,000 second doses. A recent outbreak in October produced 50 confirmed cases and was contained in about ten weeks. In the Americas, over 58,000 measles cases have been reported, with Canada ~1,128; United States >5,000; Guatemala >34,000; Peru >2,900. The Paraguay outbreak originated from a Bolivian family entering via Bella Vista (Amambay) after traveling through Corumbá, Brazil; transmission highest during rash onset. Vaccination against yellow fever and dengue is also emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季休暇:麻疹の新たな流行を防ぐため、保健省がワクチン接種完了を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はパラグアイの麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関するものであり、対象国（ブラジル等）は感染経路の経由地として言及されているに過ぎず、イベントの主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパラグアイ国内の麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、パラグアイは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル（コルンバ）はボリビア人家族の経由地として言及されているのみで、ブラジル国内での流行事例ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: מצב חירום עולמי: התפרצות האבולה השנייה בגודלה בהיסטוריה
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global health emergency: the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo endures the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths (about 49% overall mortality). The outbreak began in May in north‑east Congo and has reached eight of 26 provinces. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus responsible has no approved vaccine or specific antiviral. Vaccines and therapeutics are in trials, including an Ervebo vaccine study (approved for a different Ebola strain) initiated in October, and more than 900 patients enrolled in drug trials. Early recognition and supportive care (fluids, electrolyte balance) are crucial for survival, yet control is hampered by late case detection, strained health systems, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict; only ~15% of new cases are identified among known contacts. The WHO still deems it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; cases have been reported in Uganda, France, Kenya, and Nigeria, but sustained spread outside DRC is not observed. Israel reported suspected cases; none were confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な公衆衛生緊急事態：史上2番目の規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目規模のエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）流行が継続し、致死率約49%、複数国への症例報告もありWHOがPHEICと認定しているため、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリア、イスラエルでも症例報告があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないか、確認症例ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC域外での持続的な感染拡大は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Misiones no registra casos y mantiene la vigilancia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Misiones reports no cases and maintains surveillance.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Misiones, Argentina, reports no confirmed Mpox cases and maintains surveillance due to cross-border movement with Paraguay and Brazil. Health authorities have investigated suspected Mpox cases, all of which were ruled out. Misiones can detect Mpox by PCR testing; results are available within 48 hours, with viral characterization sent to the reference laboratory, Instituto Malbrán. Preventive measures start at clinical suspicion, including patient isolation and evaluation of contacts per protocol. Mpox is caused by an Orthopoxvirus and can present with fever, headache, myalgias, fatigue, and variable skin lesions; typical course is 14–21 days. In Paraguay, the outbreak is linked to clade 1B. In Argentina, 2026 cases have been reported in Buenos Aires City, Buenos Aires Province, Córdoba, and San Juan, but there is no confirmed community transmission yet. Vaccination with MVA-BN is available elsewhere but not in Argentina; regional cooperation continues with Paraguay and Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:ミシオネス州は症例なし、疫学監視を継続
triage.triage_reason: 記事はアルゼンチン・ミシオネス州における症例なし・監視継続を報告する内容であり、対象国（ブラジル等）での発生が主題ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチン（対象国外）の状況を主題としており、ブラジル・パラグアイは国境を越えた監視文脈での言及のみで発生地ではない。そのためverified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: ASF confirmed in Samboan; Province steps up surveillance, containment
article.articleSummary: ASF confirmed in Samboan, Cebu, with samples from Barangay Colase in Nov 2026, affecting pig farms. After two positive blood tests, a response team was deployed to contain the outbreak. Investigators cite two infection sources: hogs smuggled from Negros and shipments from Ginatilan, where ASF was confirmed. Cebu PVO expanded surveillance to 14 barangays; tests from 10 were negative, with results pending for the rest, and quarantine areas may expand if secondary infections arise. About 5,000 hogs in Samboan are at risk. RT-PCR testing is conducted at the Regional Animal Disease Diagnostic Laboratory. ASF had been contained in Ginatilan; Cebu maintains border controls. EO 39 (Jul 7) imposed a 45-day ban on hogs/pork from Negros, later extended and eased by EO 55 (Oct 26) to allow immediate slaughter for lechon in accredited facilities. Twenty-four LGUs recognized for ASF surveillance, enabling Green Zone status for hog sales outside Cebu.

triage.headline_ja: サンボアン(セブ州)でASF確認、州が監視と封じ込めを強化
triage.triage_reason: ASF(アフリカ豚熱)は家畜(豚)の疾患であり人への直接感染は報告されていないため人の公衆衛生への深刻な影響は低いが、養豚業への経済的影響や域内拡大のリスクがあり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾患であり人獣共通感染症ではないため、人の公衆衛生リスクとしては限定的。ただし養豚業・食料安全保障・貿易制限（EO39/EO55）に関連する経済的影響があり、地域拡大状況を継続監視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Penyakit Menular yang Mesti Diwaspadai saat Musim Hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Infectious Diseases to Watch Out for During the Rainy Season
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health flags four priority diseases during the rainy season: acute respiratory infection (ISPA) with 17.6 million cases; acute diarrhea with 3.9 million; suspected dengue fever (DBD) 391,000; and suspected leptospirosis 5,702, as of week 46, 2026. Influenza-like illness reaches 1.4 million with 837,000 suspected typhoid. Preventive measures stress environmental hygiene and flood-related risk mitigation. For ISPA and influenza, use cough etiquette, wear masks when ill or in crowds, limit outdoor activity, and seek care if symptoms worsen. For diarrhea, ensure safe drinking water, properly cooked food, and thorough handwashing. For dengue, eliminate standing water and support 3M Plus mosquito-control efforts; seek care if dengue-like symptoms appear. For leptospirosis, avoid floodwater contact; wear protective boots and gloves when cleaning after floods, and monitor health after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季に注意すべき4つの感染症
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア保健省による雨季恒例の感染症注意喚起であり、季節性で予想される内容。異常性や新規の公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 複数疾患（ISPA、下痢、デング熱、レプトスピラ症、インフルエンザ様疾患、腸チフス疑い）の累計症例数が報告されているが、これは毎年恒例の雨季の公衆衛生啓発であり、特定の異常なアウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis tem 57 alunos com sarna em 10 escolas; suspensão das aulas é descartada - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis has 57 students with scabies in 10 schools; class suspension is ruled out - Portal MPA
article.articleSummary: 57 confirmed scabies cases among students across 10 Divinópolis schools as of November 26, 2026, with 15 cases at Sidney José de Oliveira in the Candidés neighborhood, which suspended classes for disinfection. Officials say transmission occurs through prolonged skin contact and sharing clothing and objects, not due to poor hygiene. A digital surveillance protocol tracks suspected and confirmed cases by classroom; if three confirmed in a class, that class is suspended for one day for full disinfection. Symptomatic students should stay home. Cleaning intensified with bleach; gloves for cleaning and food/hygiene staff. Parents should not bring symptomatic children; isolated on arrival; guardians contacted; if no response, the Council Tutelar and Social Assistance intervene. Treatment is free at the municipal pharmacy; no preventive medication for asymptomatic individuals. A decree formalizes the emergency; procurement remains under normal bidding rules. Pediatric referrals streamlined; generalists freed for adults.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスで児童57人が疥癬に感染、10校で確認；休校措置は見送り
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は低重症度で管理可能な感染症であり、学校レベルでの対応が既に機能しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とはならない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルで既に監視プロトコルと対応策（消毒、治療の無償提供）が確立されており、国際的な懸念事項ではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: No human transmission of bird flu in TN, says Minister Arunraj
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Tamil Nadu reports no human infections from Avian Influenza (H5N1) linked to poultry outbreaks in Cuddalore district, with ongoing active monitoring and resident screening. Mass broiler chicken deaths were reported across Nochikadu, Thammanampettai, Thimmaravuthankuppam, Kullanchavadi, and Kurinjipadi, leading to culling of remaining birds. In Chennai, H5N1 was confirmed at Vandalur Zoo, prompting heightened surveillance and public advisories. Authorities say no human transmission has occurred and the situation is under control. The government is expanding medical capacity: six additional doctors and eight nurses for Vedaranyam Government District Headquarters Hospital, three new dialysis machines, and 108 ambulances, plus a Rs 20 crore mother-and-child health facility opening soon; 1,695 new nursing posts have been announced in the budget with recruitment through district health societies forthcoming.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州で鳥インフルエンザのヒトへの感染なし、アルンラージ大臣が発表
triage.triage_reason: H5N1が家禽および動物園のトラで確認されているが、ヒトへの感染は確認されておらず当局は状況を制御下にあるとしている。ただし継続的な家禽暴露とH5N1の流行可能性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル・ナードゥ州クダロール県の家禽大量死およびチェンナイのヴァンダルー動物園でのH5N1確認を報告。ヒト感染例は確認されていないが、継続的な家禽への曝露リスクとH5N1の流行可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis decreta situação de emergência após casos de sarna humana em escolas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis declares a state of emergency after cases of human scabies in schools.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil declares a public health emergency after human scabies cases in two schools: Escola Municipal Sidney José de Oliveira and AABB in Jardim Candidés. Fifteen confirmed cases; 46 additional notifications under investigation. The emergency decree, signed by Mayor Janete Aparecida (Avante) on Nov 25, 2026, is valid for 60 days and can be extended, establishing a school protocol of class suspensions, removal of diagnosed students, and escalated cleaning. In the Greater Belo Horizonte area, actions include Nov 13 closures in São José da Lapa for sanitation after community cases; Vespasiano suspended in all municipal schools (five municipal and one state school) for four days; Lagoa Santa reported 178 confirmed cases, 75 under investigation (253 notifications), with 12 new cases in the prior 24 hours. Scabies is a mite-driven skin disease with intense nocturnal itch and lesions; transmission is mainly prolonged skin-to-skin contact, less often via shared textiles. Not linked to hygiene; seek medical evaluation and treat close contacts as advised.

triage.headline_ja: ジヴィノーポリス、学校での人疥癬症例発生を受け緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 複数の学校・自治体で疥癬の集団感染が継続し、地方自治体が緊急事態を宣言するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、WPRO基準（持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症の皮膚疾患で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、複数校・複数自治体での集団発生と行政による緊急事態宣言という点から継続監視およびローカルな公衆衛生対応の評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : le nombre de cas confirmés dépasse les 12.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: The number of confirmed cases exceeds 12,000.
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has over 12,021 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 5,904 deaths (case fatality rate 49.1%), across 69 health zones in eight provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu in the east accounting for more than 94% of cases. The outbreak—the 17th in the DRC—remains in an acute phase, with persistent transmission and high mortality, hindered by armed conflict, population displacement, and limited access to care. A joint Africa CDC–WHO continental plan for November 2026 to May 2027 estimates about $1.58 billion in funding needs to bolster the response. The WHO has affirmed that Ebola remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no vaccine or specific treatment is approved.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国/エボラ出血熱：確認症例数が12,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと認定している大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、死亡率約49%、武力紛争下での対応困難、国際的資金支援が必要とされるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEIC継続中と明言されており、Africa CDC-WHOによる大規模資金計画（約15.8億ドル）が進行中。ワクチン・特異的治療法未承認のBundibugyo株による第17次アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
article.articleSummary: 12,021 people in eastern Congo have tested positive for Ebola, with about half dying, according to Congo’s Ministry of Health, as of 2026-11-26. Declared in May, the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus and is the fastest-growing and deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history, with no approved vaccine or treatment. Containment is hindered by fighting between the army and the Convention pour la révolution populaire (CRP) rebels in Iga-Barrière, about 25 km north of Bunia, the Ituri province capital and a key response hub. WHO says security and access constraints hamper case-finding, monitoring, and treatment, leaving some centers understaffed. About a dozen people, including two WHO personnel, were evacuated to Bunia after three days trapped in Akwe amid crossfire. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が12,000例に到達、一部の対応要員が避難
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、ワクチン・治療法未承認のエボラ流行が12,000例に達し、紛争により対応が阻害されるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルスによる史上最速・最も致死的なエボラ流行とされ、武装勢力との戦闘によりWHO職員を含む対応要員が避難する事態となっている。ワクチン・治療法が未承認である点も深刻度を高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Rio registra alta de Covid-19 com 2,4 mil casos em uma semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro records a surge in COVID-19 with 2,400 cases in one week.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state reports a COVID-19 surge, with 2,424 confirmed cases in the week of 15–21 November 2026—the highest weekly total in 2026. Public test positivity rose from 25.9% to 34.3%. For November, 5,473 confirmed cases; since 1 January 2026, 18,060 cases and 80 deaths, including six in November. The state issued an alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) as respiratory viruses circulate, including SARS-CoV-2, metapneumovirus, and Influenza A and B. An IOC/Fiocruz survey with the Municipal Health Secretariat detected predominance of the coronavirus lineage PJ.2.1 in 58% of samples from Rio de Janeiro city. Fiocruz emphasizes vaccination as the main measure to prevent complications, urging updated immunization status—especially for older adults, the immunocompromised, and other priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでCOVID-19が急増、1週間で2,400件の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症の増加であり既知の病原体（COVID-19、メタニューモウイルス、インフルエンザ）だが、陽性率上昇と新系統PJ.2.1の優勢が確認されており、動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: COVID-19新系統PJ.2.1がリオデジャネイロ市のサンプルの58%を占めており、変異株の動向として注視が必要。死亡者数（11月6名含む年間80名）は季節性流行の範囲内とみられるが、SARIアラートが発令されている点は留意すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Authorities step up anti-dengue operations in Luyang residential area
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Luyang, Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, prompted authorities to designate Taman Austral Park as high risk and launch house-to-house inspections in November. UPPM Luyang, led by Simon Chin, with the Kota Kinabalu Health Office and DBKK, carried out joint checks at homes and nearby construction sites. The Health Office conducted fogging and applied larvicides to curb Aedes populations. Inspectors checked for stagnant water and educated residents on Aedes breeding and dengue prevention. Daytime-active Aedes mosquitoes—black-and-white—breed in small water sources such as bottle caps, flowerpot saucers, discarded containers and roof gutters; their eggs resist drying for months and hatch when water returns. Residents were urged to spend 10 minutes weekly removing standing water, cover storage containers, clear drains, dispose of water-collecting refuse, and seek prompt medical care for fever, headaches, pain behind the eyes, muscle aches or rashes. Fogging targets adults; source reduction and ongoing monitoring remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: 当局、ルヤン住宅地でのデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: マレーシア・サバ州における通常の季節性デング熱対策活動であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生事例ではないため、特段の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマレーシア・サバ州コタキナバルのLuyang地区における通常のデング熱対策（フォギング、幼虫駆除、住民啓発）。発生地域にHunan（中国）が含まれているが記事本文に中国への言及はなく、主題はマレーシアであるため除外。マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Fighting in eastern Congo forces Ebola workers to evacuate, disrupts outbreak response
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, escalating fighting in eastern Congo has forced Ebola response workers to abandon affected areas, disrupting efforts to contain the outbreak. The Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has infected more than 11,700 people and killed more than 5,700, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country to date. Health officials and humanitarian workers cited security conditions as the reason for evacuations and pauses in surveillance, case finding, and contact tracing. The report from Kinshasa, FRANCE 24's Emmet Livingstone, underscores how ongoing hostilities can impede outbreak response. No new clinical details or infection source are provided in the brief, but the disruption risks extending transmission in affected eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部での戦闘によりエボラ対応要員が避難、アウトブレイク対応に支障
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪とされるエボラ流行（感染者11,700人超、死者5,700人超）が、紛争による対応要員の避難で監視・接触者追跡が中断しており、国際的な公衆衛生リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はキンシャサからの報告だが、実際の流行地域は東部州。紛争により監視体制が機能不全に陥っており、感染拡大の継続リスクが高い。史上最悪規模のエボラ流行としてフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Varginha registra 229 casos de síndrome gripal por COVID-19 até 25 de novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Varginha records 229 cases of influenza-like illness due to COVID-19 as of November 25.
article.articleSummary: Varginha, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reported 229 COVID-19–associated influenza-like illness (ILI) cases from January 1 to November 25, 2026, down from 362 in the same period in 2025. Severe acute respiratory illness (SARI) due to COVID-19 totaled 4 cases with no related deaths in January–November 2026, versus 9 cases and 1 death in 2025. Total SARI notifications reached 324 in 2026 (323 in 2025), with 26 SARI deaths (down from 30). Minas Gerais state issued an epidemiological alert due to a recent uptick in cases. By November 24, 2026, Varginha had administered 10,681 COVID-19 vaccine doses and urged residents to check vaccination status at UBS clinics. Actions include expanding vaccination, ongoing respiratory surveillance, creation of a Síndromes Gripais/SARI Situation Room, and rapid COVID-19 tests at UBS for symptomatic individuals. Preventive guidance emphasizes vaccination, masking if needed, cough etiquette, hand hygiene, ventilation, and seeking care for fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, malaise; dyspnea requires urgent care.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァルジーニャ市、11月25日までにCOVID-19によるインフルエンザ様疾患229例を記録
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の症例数は前年より減少しており、死亡例もなく、通常の季節性サーベイランス報告の範囲内で異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。州による疫学警報は出されているが、数値は前年比で改善傾向にあり定例の感染症サーベイランス報告の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Macaé confirma sete casos e reforça prevenção | Macaé | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Macaé confirms seven cases and reinforces prevention | Macaé | O Dia
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Mpox in Macaé, Brazil: As of 26 November 2026, seven confirmed mpox cases this year, with three under investigation and three discarded; one hospitalization in September in a private facility; no deaths reported. Vaccination targets are HIV-positive individuals with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm3, with planned later expansion to CD4 <200, PrEP users, and laboratory staff; no broad, population-wide vaccination initially. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with skin/mucosal lesions, contaminated objects, or close contact; respiratory secretions may also play a role. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, chills, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions on the face, hands, mouth, and genital/anal regions, though some cases may lack fever. Health measures emphasize online training, outreach at primary care units, home visits, and guidance on avoiding contact with lesions, sharing of personal items, and prompt care seeking. Avoid self-diagnosis; professional evaluation guides management and infection control."]} }/n

triage.headline_ja: Mpox: マカエ市で7例確認、予防対策を強化 | マカエ | O Dia
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方都市における少数のMpox症例（7例、死亡なし、入院1例）で、既存の流行状況下での通常の公衆衛生対応であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州マカエ市での年間7例のMpox症例報告であり、HIV陽性者を対象とした既存のワクチン接種プログラムの説明が中心。死亡例なし、入院1例のみで重症度は低く、地域的な通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 no RJ: devido ao aumento de casos, Secretaria de Saúde volta a divulgar boletim com panorama dos casos no estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 in Rio de Janeiro: due to the rise in cases, the Health Department resumes publishing the bulletin with an overview of the cases in the state.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Rio de Janeiro State, Brazil: as of 26 November 2026, the SES-RJ resumes Panorama Covid bulletin due to rising cases. Since the start of 2026, 18,060 confirmed COVID-19 cases; 2,424 between 1–21 November; nowcasting estimates 2,614 for 15–21 November. Test positivity in the public network rose from 25.9% to 34.3% over two weeks; however, hospital bed requests remained stable, suggesting milder disease in the circulating sublineage. Adult symptomatic UPA visits rose from 1,652 (1–7 Nov) to 1,981 (15–21 Nov); pediatric visits increased from 859 to 1,048 in the same periods. Omicron remains predominant; MC.10.1.7 detected since August, with PJ.2.1 and RF.5.3 now more common. Vaccination: 721,950 doses administered in 2026 through 24 November; 679,322 in 2025. Target groups include 60+, pregnant, immunocompromised, health workers, comorbidities, and 12+ with disability; aligns with the national calendar. Data via Monitora.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州のCOVID-19：感染増加に伴い、保健局が州内症例概況のブルティンを再開
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の風土病化した疾患であり、入院数は安定し重症度も低いと報告されている。季節的な症例増加に伴うルーチンのサーベイランス公表であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: リオデジャネイロ州保健局が感染者数増加を受けて定期ブルティンを再開したという、既存のサーベイランス体制下でのルーチン報告。入院需要は安定しており、流行株（Omicron系統）も重症化傾向は低いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Смертельный вирус набирает обороты - что грозит Израилю
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus is gaining momentum — what threatens Israel.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has reached 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the second-largest outbreak on record, with transmission in eight of 26 provinces and high mortality among children under five (about 70%). There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; however, the Ervebo vaccine (for another Ebola type) entered trials in October, and experimental therapeutics have enrolled over 900 patients. Ongoing eastern Congo conflict, limited medical resources, and late case detection hinder containment; Reuters satellite analysis suggests actual deaths may exceed official counts. Outside DRC, cases have appeared in Uganda, France, Kenya, and Nigeria, but WHO has not confirmed sustained local transmission beyond Congo. In Israel, several Ebola suspicions emerged; a Congo-returned patient hospitalized there tested negative, and no confirmed cases exist in Israel. WHO assesses low regional spread risk for high-capacity health systems. Israelis returning from Congo should monitor for three weeks and contact the health ministry at *5400 if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスが勢いを増す——イスラエルへの脅威とは
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo型エボラが12,021例・死者5,904人に達し、史上2番目の規模の流行で国際的な波及例（ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリア）も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: フランス・イスラエル・ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアでの症例・疑い例は確認/持続伝播がWHOにより否定されており、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主たる発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança no RJ com 2,4 mil casos em uma semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 advances in Rio de Janeiro with 2,400 cases in one week.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state’s SES-RJ reports a resurgence of COVID-19 activity, with 2,424 confirmed cases between November 15–21 and a public testing positivity rate rising to 34.3% (from 25.9%). Since January, the state has logged 18,060 confirmed cases. The Omicron variant remains predominant among samples analyzed by epidemiological monitoring labs. In 2024, 721,950 vaccine doses were administered across the state, underscoring vaccination as essential to reducing severe disease and easing health system strain. The uptick in November aligns with a broader October–November growth trend observed statewide, continuing to raise concerns about transmission and health system impact.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、1週間で2,400件のCOVID-19新規感染、増加傾向続く
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19はすでに既知の流行病であり、オミクロン株優勢という通常の状況で、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念も認められないため見送り。
triage.notes: 陽性率上昇（25.9%→34.3%）はあるが、季節性の増加であり既知の変異株（オミクロン）によるもので、特段の異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola na RDC ultrapassa 12 mil infecções
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 12,000 infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 12,021 confirmed infections, with nearly half of patients dying, making it one of the deadliest outbreaks in RDC history. The current epidemic is the most severe among the 17 Ebola outbreaks recorded in the DRC and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which killed about 11,000 people. Health authorities report that ongoing violence and armed conflict in the east, restricted access to affected areas, and community resistance impede response teams and efforts to halt transmission. The data are from the DRC Ministry of Health as cited by Notícias ao Minuto. The outbreak underscores the critical challenge of delivering care amid insecurity, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、感染者数が12,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が12,021人の感染者に達し致死率約50%と歴史的に最も深刻な流行となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRC東部での流行についてのみ言及しており、Angolaへの波及は記載されていないため除外した。紛争・治安悪化によりアクセス制限や対応の遅延が生じている点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz: casos graves de Covid-19 seguem aumentando no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz: Severe COVID-19 cases continue to rise in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: InfoGripe, Fiocruz's national surveillance for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome, reports a continued rise in COVID-19 hospitalizations in Brazil for 15–21 November 2026. Increases are mainly in the Center-South states of Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul, as well as Brasília and Bahia. Nonetheless, overall SRAG activity remains low. The exception is Pará and Rio de Janeiro, where SRAG incidence is elevated not only for COVID-19 but also for metapneumovirus and influenza A and B, triggering alert-level monitoring. The report highlights multi-viral SRAG activity in these locations while COVID-19 remains the principal driver of the rising hospitalizations in most of the country.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス:ブラジルで新型コロナウイルスの重症例が引き続き増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19による入院が増加傾向にあるが、全体のSRAG活動は低水準であり、パラ州とリオデジャネイロ州のみ複数ウイルス（メタニューモウイルス、インフルエンザA/B）による警戒レベル監視が開始された段階で、国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報は現時点でない。
triage.notes: 本記事はFiocruz（InfoGripe）による定期的な呼吸器系症候群サーベイランス報告であり、季節性の増加傾向を示すもの。パラ州・リオデジャネイロ州での複数ウイルス同時流行（警戒レベル）の継続状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Covid: casos graves sobem em 8 estados e no DF; variante é monitorada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: severe cases rise in eight states and the Federal District; the variant is being monitored.
article.articleSummary: Eight Brazilian states and the Federal District report rising severe COVID-19 cases, though overall incidence remains low, in the 15–21 November 2026 period. Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul and Bahia show increases in severe COVID-19; Pará records SRAG growth mainly among children up to 14, with limited viral identification. SRAG is a severe complication of respiratory infections; in Rio de Janeiro, the rise is driven by SARS-CoV-2, metapneumovirus and influenza A/B. The PJ.2.1 variant is circulating and under WHO monitoring; detected in Rio, Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina and the DF, with no clear causal link yet. Vaccines remain the main protection against severe disease. Nationally, 180,105 SRAG cases have been reported in 2026, with 95,3k positive and about 7,707 awaiting results; in the four weeks to 21 November, coronavirus 22%, rhinovirus 42.3%, RSV 7.6% of positive SRAG.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19:8州と連邦直轄区で重症例が増加、変異株を監視中
triage.triage_reason: 複数州で重症COVID-19/SRAG症例の増加とWHO監視下の変異株(PJ.2.1)が報告されているが、全体の罹患率は低く因果関係も不明確なため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: WHO監視下の変異株PJ.2.1が複数州で検出されているが、重症化や感染拡大との明確な因果関係は確認されていない。全体の罹患率は低いとされており、国際的な拡大リスクは現時点で低いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Infectious diseases from free-ranging domestic animals threaten Nilgiris wildlife
article.articleSummary: Nilgiris district accounted for five of 12 wildlife deaths since 2005 likely due to infections from feral animals, per Forest Department findings to the Madras High Court. Necropsies identified canine distemper and rabies as causes across species, including leopard with canine distemper, Nilgiri langur rabies, gaur rabies, sloth bear rabies and ehrlichiosis, and golden jackal canine distemper and parvovirus. Deaths had been reported in Kodaikanal, Kalakkad Mundanthurai Tiger Reserve (KMTR), Sivaganga, Theni, Kanniyakumari and Tirunelveli, with Nilgiris highest. In Gudalur, two 2026 deaths—a leopard and a tiger—were attributed to canine distemper. Officials note disease transmission from free-ranging dogs and cattle around Mudumalai Tiger Reserve; vaccination of village dogs and cattle began in Gudalur in 2026. The department plans joint vaccination across KMTR, MTR, Srivilliputhur-Megamalai TR, Sathyamangalam TR, and Anaimalai TR, with 5,766 animals vaccinated in 2026 against canine distemper, rabies, and foot-and-mouth disease. Conservationists caution numbers may undercount wildlife mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 放し飼いの家畜からの感染症がニルギリスの野生動物を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（ヒョウ、トラ、ラングールなど）における狂犬病・ジステンパー等の感染症であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは記事上示されておらず、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 本事案は野生動物保全・獣医学上の問題であり、ヒトの感染症公衆衛生イベントではない。森林局による野生動物のワクチン接種対策が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Vasos de plantas, pneus e tonéis concentram 45% dos focos de dengue no Amazonas - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plant pots, tires and barrels account for 45% of dengue foci in Amazonas - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, almost half of Aedes aegypti breeding foci identified in the interior of Amazonas occur in common home containers. A September–October survey across 51 municipalities found 24% of foci in plant pots, saucers, animal drinking troughs, and bottles; 21% in tonéis/barrels and water storage tanks, totaling 45% of identified breeding sites. Litter accounts for 14% and can include cans and packaging that collect rainwater. The vector transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Most municipalities show low infestation risk (36 of 51), with 12 at alert; Juruá, Japurá, and Guajará are high-risk areas. The Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) provides ongoing support and training to municipalities. Manaus surveys are to be completed in November, with ten more municipalities organizing the study. Public health guidance urges eliminating breeding sites: cover tonéis/barrels, wash or sand plant trays weekly, clean animal waterers, store bottles mouth-down, keep water tanks closed, clean gutters, and discard water-holding waste.

triage.headline_ja: 植木鉢、タイヤ、樽がアマゾナス州のデング熱発生源の45%を占める - アマゾナス | Portal do Holanda
triage.triage_reason: 通常のベクターサーベイランス・予防啓発に関する内容であり、異常な流行拡大や重症化の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の発生源調査と予防啓発が主題であり、デング熱の実際の患者数・重症度データは含まれていない。地方衛生当局(FVS-RCP)による通常業務の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Após fugir de hospital, homem com suspeita de mpox é encontrado em Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After fleeing from the hospital, a man with suspected mpox is found in Minas Gerais
article.articleSummary: A 36-year-old man with suspected mpox, who fled from the University Hospital of Divinópolis in Minas Gerais’ Central-West region, was located in the Niterói neighborhood and returned to the hospital for further care. Laboratory confirmation of mpox has not yet been established, but he continues to exhibit symptoms compatible with the disease and must adhere to preventive measures to prevent possible transmission. Local health teams, in coordination with municipal health services and with support from the Military Police and Samu, located and escorted him back for medical follow-up. The municipality warns that noncompliance with sanitary measures to prevent disease spread could constitute an offense under Article 268 of the Brazilian Penal Code. The case highlights ongoing surveillance and the need for confirmed diagnosis and appropriate isolation until results are available.

triage.headline_ja: 病院を脱走後、mpox感染が疑われる男性がミナスジェライス州で発見される
triage.triage_reason: 単一の疑い症例（確定診断未）で、地域保健当局により速やかに発見・隔離対応がなされており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の疑いレベルであり、検査確定前。地域の保健・警察・救急体制で対応完了済み。続報があれば確定診断の有無と感染経路の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tribunal keniano dictamina que el sitio de cuarentena de ébola violó la constitución.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court rules that the Ebola quarantine site violated the constitution.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court ruled that the government violated the Constitution by permitting a US-backed Ebola quarantine facility (50-bed) to be built without public participation. The court ordered the government to disclose all US agreements within 45 days and barred further construction or operation at the site. The High Court had halted work in May after petitions by the Kenyan Law Society and Katiba Institute, who argued Kenya’s health system was ill-prepared for an Ebola outbreak. U.S. officials had said Americans exposed abroad would be sent to the facility rather than repatriated, with the United States planning about $13.5 million for Ebola preparedness in Kenya. Kenya reported its first Ebola case in October—a Kenyan citizen who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda—with nine total cases, all direct contacts of the first patient. Health Minister Aden Duale says authorities await court guidance on whether Kenyans exposed could be detained at the facility.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所、エボラ検疫施設の建設は憲法違反と判断
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ症例（コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者由来）の国際的拡大と、米国支援による検疫施設建設を巡る法的措置が確認され、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの検疫施設を巡る裁判だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者はDRCからウガンダ経由でケニアに渡航したとされ、発生源としてDRCが明記されているため同国を検証済み地域に含めた。ウガンダ・米国も対象国リストに該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Masu cutar Ebola a Congo sun wuce 12,000 yayin da ake kokarin dakile annobar
article.articleSummary: Adadin masu kamuwa da Ebola a Jamhuriyar Dimokaradiyar Congo ya wuce 12,000, yayin da kusan 5,904 suka rasu. Cutar ta samo asali daga nau’in Bundibugyo ta yaɗu zuwa larduna 8 daga cikin 26 tun ɓullarta a watan Mayu. Likitoci da masu agaji na fuskantar babban ƙalubale wajen dakile annoba saboda rashin rigakafi ko magani da ya dace da wannan nau’in. Haka kuma, rikice-rikicen makamai a Gabashin ƙasar, ƙarancin kayan aiki, da rashin gano waɗanda suka yi mu’amala da masu cutar suna ƙara yaɗuwar annoba. A halin yanzu, wannan ita ce annobar Ebola ta biyu mafi muni da aka taɓa gani a tarihin duniya.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者が12,000人を超える中、流行阻止の取り組みが続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が12,000人感染・5,904人死亡に達し、史上2番目に深刻な流行とされる。複数州への拡大、紛争地域での対応困難、ワクチン・治療薬不足など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中の『Bundibugyo』はエボラウイルスの株名（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）であり、地名としての発生地ではない。発生地域リストに含まれるUgandaはウイルス株に由来する誤認と考えられ、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。致死率は約49%（5,904/12,000）と非常に高く、5月の発生以来8/26州に拡大、紛争地域での医療アクセス困難が流行制御を一層困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll Hits 5,904 In DR Congo As Fighting Disrupts Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 5,904 deaths and 12,021 confirmed infections across eight of 26 provinces as of government data released on Thursday. The Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant, sparked the mid-May outbreak in Ituri Province (northeastern DRC) and has been worsened by insecurity, delayed detection and overstretched health facilities. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo; containment relies on early detection, isolation, infection prevention and supportive care. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, bodily fluids or tissues of infected people or animals and contaminated materials, with symptoms including fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, bleeding. Ongoing fighting in eastern DRC impedes response, endangering health workers. The region’s history includes a 2018–2020 outbreak with over 2,200 deaths. A humanitarian worker reported gunfire near Bunia and UN peacekeepers escorted responders. Keywords: outbreak, vaccination, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数5,904人に到達、戦闘が対応を妨害
triage.triage_reason: DRCで稀なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が拡大（死者5,904人、感染者12,021人）し、紛争により対応が阻害されているため、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクがありフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、東部での武力紛争が対応を妨げている。2018-2020年の大規模流行（死者2,200人超）に続く深刻な事例。

article.articleHeadline: Fighting Forces WHO Ebola Team Out of Congo's Mongbwalu
article.articleSummary: WHO temporarily pulled its Ebola response team from Mongbwalu, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, due to escalating fighting and insecurity; responders evacuated to Bunia on 25 November with a plan to return when safe. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak has surpassed 11,700 cases and about 5,700 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history. There is no approved Bundibugyo-specific vaccine; vaccines used elsewhere target Zaire Ebola. Without vaccines, control hinges on rapid case finding, isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. Ebola is zoonotic, with spillover from wildlife—fruit bats suspected reservoirs—and human-to-human transmission via contact with blood or body fluids. Insecurity in Ituri disrupts outreach, undermining containment and increasing cross-border risk to Uganda and South Sudan. Mongbwalu’s status as a gold-mining town underscores transmission and response challenges in conflict zones.

triage.headline_ja: 戦闘によりWHOのエボラチームがコンゴ・モングバルから撤退
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がすでに11,700例超・死亡5,700人規模に達し史上最悪の流行となっており、治安悪化でWHO対応チームが撤退するなど封じ込めが困難化、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダ・南スーダン）も指摘されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは越境リスクとして言及されているが、実際の発生は現時点でDRC国内（イトゥリ州モングバル）に限定されているため対象国としてはDRCのみを計上。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 voltam a crescer em SP; saiba como se proteger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise again in São Paulo; learn how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Severe Covid-19 cases rise again in Sao Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Parana, Bahia and the Federal District as of 2026, though hospitalizations remain low. Fiocruz's InfoGripe shows SRAG cases from all respiratory viruses decreasing nationwide. About 90% of 2026 sequenced samples are lineage XFG, derived from Omicron, suggesting growth is not due to a new variant. With year-end travel and gatherings, experts urge vaccination and preventive measures. 65+ have the highest mortality risk; SUS guidance: 60+ every six months; immunocompromised 5+ every six months; pregnant once per pregnancy; 6 months-<5 per calendar; others 5+ who never vaccinated may get vaccinated; healthy adults without priority boosters may not have routine boosters. Common symptoms include sore throat, congestion, cough, fever, fatigue, and loss or alteration of smell/taste; testing is important, and antivirals are available if started within five days. Other circulating viruses include rhinovirus, influenza and RSV.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで新型コロナウイルスの重症例が再び増加、予防法を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: 入院は低水準で推移し、新規変異株でもなく既知のオミクロン系統によるもので、季節性の増加と説明されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 既知のXFG系統（オミクロン由来）による季節性増加であり、入院率は低いままとされている。ワクチン接種呼びかけなど通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: התפרצות האבולה בקונגו: אלפי מתים ומצב חירום בריאותי בינלאומי
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: thousands dead and an international health emergency.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached historic scale: 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths, making it the second-largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak to date. Eight of 26 provinces are affected, led by Ituri in the northeast, with significant transmission in North Kivu and Haut-Uélé; as of Nov 8, about 70% of cases were in Ituri. Pediatric fatalities are severe, with roughly 70% of children under five diagnosed dying. The response is hampered by ongoing eastern Congo conflict, with aid workers abducted and communities displaced, limiting contact tracing. Africa CDC data indicate only ~15% of new infections occur among those under surveillance, and satellite imagery suggests official death tolls may be undercounted. The virus, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has no approved vaccine or therapy; Oct trials assess Ervebo for cross-protection, while treatment remains supportive care. On Nov 18, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after imported cases in Uganda, France, Kenya and Nigeria; Israel ruled out a suspected imported case; no confirmed cases in Israel.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行：数千人が死亡し、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、複数国への越境拡大（ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリア）が確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も複数該当するため、フルRRAへ進むべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）が主題であり、WHOがPHEICを宣言。ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの輸入症例やイスラエルでの疑い例（否定済み）が報告されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。紛争による対応困難、死亡率の過小評価の可能性、ワクチン未承認など、極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Com aumento de casos de Covid na Prefeitura, secretário de Saúde enfatiza a necessidade da vacinação. - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With rising COVID-19 cases at City Hall, the Health Secretary emphasizes the need for vaccination. - Canedo Speaks.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 surge in Goiânia linked to outbreaks among municipal workers. In the first half of November, Goiânia recorded 1,522 cases, pushing the state total above 8,000 with over 200 severe cases and about 25 deaths since the start of the year (data through November 3). Health Secretary Luiz Pellizzer urges vaccination as the primary defense, noting outbreaks at IMAS (Institute of Assistance and Health for Goiás Servants) and other agencies. Vaccination is available at more than 60 sites; boosters are annual and vaccines are provided free under the Ministry of Health calendar. Testing is offered in all primary health units with same-day results after medical evaluation. Nationally, 18 states including Goiás report rising cases; Brazil logged ~17,000 new notifications through mid-November and test positivity rose from 1% to 17% in three months. The rise is linked to the transmissible PJ.2.1 variant (not yet more severe). Symptoms: dry cough, fever, headache, congestion, fatigue, body aches. Prevention stresses vaccination, masking for symptoms or in contact with immunocompromised individuals, and good ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所でのCOVID-19感染者増加を受け、保健局長がワクチン接種の必要性を強調 - ファラ・カネド
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ゴイアス州で季節的なCOVID-19症例増加とワクチン接種呼びかけが報じられているが、新規変異株PJ.2.1は重症度増加の証拠はなく、既存の公衆衛生対応で管理可能とされているため、現時点ではフルRRAに進めるほどの深刻性はない。
triage.notes: 季節的増加であり、PJ.2.1変異株は伝播性が高いが重症度は増していないと記事内で明記。18州で増加傾向だが国内対応（ワクチン接種・検査体制）の枠内で管理されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai ghi nhận 8 trường hợp tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai records 8 deaths due to rabies.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Gia Lai province, Vietnam, has recorded eight rabies deaths, with three additional fatalities in the 16–25 November period in western Gia Lai. All three recent cases had not received post-exposure vaccination after dog bites. The latest, H.X.D., born 1982, of Ia Grang, Ia Grai, was bitten about two months earlier while fending off a free-roaming dog; the dog was killed and reportedly eaten. He developed fever and weakness on 21 November and died on 25 November. On 22 November, 11-year-old D.V.N., of Don Hyang, Lo Pang, died after a dog bite he sustained in October 2025; the dog fell ill and died two days after biting; no rabies prophylaxis was given. The third case, 10-year-old A.T., of Kon Sơ Lang, Ia Khươl, was bitten by a stray dog on 30 September; symptoms appeared mid-November and he died 16 November. Public health urges immediate wound washing, medical care for vaccination and immunoglobulin, and improved pet management.

triage.headline_ja: ザーライ省、狂犬病による死亡者8人を記録
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内で狂犬病による死亡が継続発生しているが、ヒト-ヒト感染がなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域の予防体制の課題として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染がなく、曝露後予防(PEP)未実施による死亡例が主因。地域の動物管理・ワクチン接種体制の強化が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : écoles et familles mobilisées pour protéger les élèves contre Ebola à Oicha - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Schools and Families Mobilized to Protect Students from Ebola in Oicha - ACP.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Oïcha, Democratic Republic of the Congo, launches a broad mobilization to protect students from Ebola virus disease (EVD). In a two-hour public session at Saint-Esprit Parish, school officials, teachers, prefects and parents discussed making families and schools central to Ebola awareness and prevention, aiming to overcome resistance to response teams. Dr. Melcki Lukombola, head of the Ebola Treatment Center in Oïcha, urged teachers and parents to become information conduits to bridge gaps between communities and responders. Participants, including students, pressed for stronger school-based health education, timely sharing of guardians’ contact numbers with health facilities, and careful handling of forest foods and wildlife. The event, organized under the IERDC project with support from the humanitarian fund in DRC and CORACON collaboration, with Mercy Corps, International Alert, Concern Worldwide, and Viamo backing, seeks to make families and schools safe spaces for Ebola prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：オイチャでエボラから生徒を守るため学校と家族が動員
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・北キブ州における既存のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの対応活動に関する記事であり、住民の抵抗感や複数国際機関の継続支援が示されており、重大疾患として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規発生報告ではなく、既存のエボラアウトブレイクに対する学校・家族を対象とした予防啓発活動に関する内容。エボラ治療センターの存在から既知のアウトブレイク継続中であることが示唆される。地域住民の対応チームへの抵抗感への言及があり、流行制御上の懸念材料として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : suspension des cérémonies funéraires dans les zones de santé touchées par Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Suspension of Funeral Ceremonies in Health Zones Affected by Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts suspension of funeral ceremonies across all Ebola-affected health zones as of 26 November 2026. Datelined from Beni, the provincial health communiqué, signed by General-Major Evariste Somo Kakule (military governor and Ebola incident manager), orders bans on mourning, wakes, and memorial services, while allowing burials to proceed in a dignified and safe manner with no more than 20 family members. Public health actions around each confirmed case—decontamination, contact identification, and isolation—must be undertaken by the response teams with secure accompaniment of relevant services and community involvement. Authorities urged strict application by provincial Ebola coordination, local leaders, and security agencies. The measures come amid rising transmission risk in Nord-Kivu, which recently added Kibirizi health zone in Rutshuru district as the province's 18th affected area.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ感染確認地域における葬儀の中止措置 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の感染地域が18保健圏に拡大し、葬儀中止など公衆衛生対応が強化されていることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは国境付近の地理的言及のみで、同国内での症例発生は述べられていないため verified_locations から除外した。Kibirizi保健圏（Rutshuru）が新たに18番目の感染地域として追加されたことが継続的な感染拡大を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: des difficultés de prélèvements des échantillons après décès communautaires évoquées à Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: difficulties in collecting samples after community deaths discussed in Isiro - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, in Haut-Uélé province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces ongoing challenges in collecting Ebola virus disease samples after community deaths, highlighted at a provincial response briefing. Delays or family hesitancy to consent jeopardize sampling, with Dr. Jose Lolekoleko urging real-time death reporting to the response coordination and rapid mobilization of surveillance, prevention and infection control (IPC) teams to engage families and stress the importance of sampling; arriving one or two days late makes collection difficult. The meeting covered strategies to bring response teams closer to communities and to secure dignified, safe burials. It also announced deployment of teams to supervise checkpoints and disinfection (PCI) activities in the Watsa health zone to strengthen the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:イジロでコミュニティ内死亡後の検体採取の困難さが議論される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応に関する続報であり、公衆衛生上重大、国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応の進捗・課題に関する報道。コミュニティ内死亡後の検体採取遅延がサーベイランスと感染制御上の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Surto na RDC Ultrapassa 12 Mil Casos Confirmados e Provoca Quase Seis Mil Mortes * Diário Económico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Outbreak in the DRC surpasses 12,000 confirmed cases and causes nearly 6,000 deaths - Diário Económico.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths, making it one of the deadliest outbreaks. The epidemic, declared mid-May in Ituri province, has spread to eight of 26 provinces and is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant. There are no vaccines or treatments specifically approved for this variant, limiting preventive and therapeutic options. Late case detection, armed conflict, and weak health services hinder surveillance and response, accelerating spread. Reuters-based satellite analysis suggests the official death toll may be significantly underestimated in two heavily affected areas. Africa CDC data indicate only about 15% of new cases are identified among known contacts, revealing persistent undetected transmission chains. Effective control hinges on rapid case finding, comprehensive contact tracing, and strengthening health-system capacity, especially in conflict-affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の流行は確認症例1万2千件を超え、死者数は約6千人に達する - Diário Económico
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が1万2千人超の感染、約6千人の死亡という大規模な公衆衛生危機に達しており、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認で、武力紛争下での検出・対応能力の限界により国際的拡大・管理困難のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 致死率が極めて高く（約49%）、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行。武力紛争地域での監視・対応能力の制約により、死者数が過小評価されている可能性がある点にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Montes Claros confirma três casos de Mpox neste ano; município mantém monitoramento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Montes Claros confirms three Mpox cases this year; the municipality maintains monitoring.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) has been confirmed in Montes Claros, Northern Minas Gerais, with three cases this year and nine more under investigation. The municipality maintains epidemiological monitoring and preventive guidance; confirmed patients have traveled to Belo Horizonte and Janaúba and are in isolation, with families under health surveillance. The first Montes Claros case was a 41-year-old man who sought hospital on Nov 9 with fever, chills, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, sore throat, and skin lesions; symptoms began Nov 4 while in the city. Lab confirmation occurred on Nov 16. Authorities emphasize surveillance to identify transmission and provide testing; there is no evidence of sustained local transmission. In 2025, 11 mpox cases were investigated and discarded. Minas Gerais state has 42 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with 172 under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: モンテスクラロス市、今年Mpox症例3件を確認。市は監視を継続
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内での散発的なMpox症例報告だが、持続的な地域内伝播の証拠はなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際拡大のリスクは現時点で限定的。州全体での症例数（42例確認、172例調査中）は注視が必要。
triage.notes: Mpoxは既知の疾患であり国際的に広く報告されているため「異常/予想外」には該当しないと判断。州内で症例数が継続的に増加（2025年11例→2026年42例確認、172例調査中）しており、監視継続が妥当。地域の自治体レベルでの監視体制は機能しているため管理可能性の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Court blocks US-linked Kenyan Ebola quarantine facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court halted construction of a US-backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base near Nanyuki, ruling the plan unconstitutional and breaching parts of the constitution. Justice Patricia Nyaundi issued a prohibition order barring further works to operationalize the 50-bed tented facility until conditions are met, including disclosure of its deal with Washington. The ruling follows June protests over fears the center could spread Ebola from neighboring Congo, epicenter of the latest outbreak—the second-largest on record. Seven American aid workers were quarantined there in July after working in the Democratic Republic of Congo to tackle Ebola. Health ministry and U.S. State Department responses were not immediately available. The court-imposed pause underscores concerns about public health risk and governance in the project.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、米国関連のエボラ検疫施設建設を差し止め
triage.triage_reason: 記事の背景にあるコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行は『史上2番目に大きい』規模とされ、国際的な拡大懸念から米国支援の検疫施設建設に至った経緯があり、IHR基準で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの検疫施設建設を巡る裁判所判断だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。実際のエボラ流行発生地であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。記事本文が空欄のため詳細な疫学情報は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surpass 12,000 in DR Congo as outbreak remains acute
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 5,904 deaths and a case fatality rate of 49.1%. As of the latest situation report, 12,021 cases have been confirmed across 69 health zones in eight provinces. The Africa CDC and WHO plan warns the outbreak remains in an acute phase and requires intensified action; the continental preparedness and response plan (Nov 2026–May 2027) estimates $1.58 billion to support the next phase of response. Ongoing transmission, high mortality, armed conflict, population displacement, and limited access to health care continue to hamper containment. WHO reaffirmed the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) last week, underscoring the need for sustained international support and coordinated measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者数が12,000人を超え、流行は依然深刻な局面に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを再確認した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率約49%、国際的な支援要請もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: WHOは既にPHEICを宣言済みであり、フルリスク評価が必要な継続的大規模アウトブレイクである。

article.articleHeadline: Surtos de sarna humana chegam a 43 municípios de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreaks of human scabies reach 43 municipalities in Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: 43 municipalities in Minas Gerais reported human scabies outbreaks as of 26 November 2026, with 31 of 43 in the South of Minas and Campo das Vertentes. Four cities are in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, four in Centro-Oeste, and others in Vale do Aço, Norte and Central. The list reflects reports received this year and does not necessarily indicate active outbreaks; scabies is not on Brazil’s or Minas Gerais’s compulsory-notification lists, so data aren’t comprehensive. Two or more epidemiologically linked cases should be reported to CIEVS-Minas or the relevant area for monitoring. In Divinópolis, a 60-day public-health emergency was declared on 25 November due to 15 confirmed and 46 suspected cases at the Sidney José de Oliveira Municipal School, with a protocol that could suspend classes if 3+ positives in a day; hygiene measures are reinforced. Transmission is by close contact; symptoms include intense itching; treatment is topical or oral; fabrics must be cleaned; seek care for persistent itching.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州で疥癬の流行が43自治体に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威度が低く、ヒト-ヒト感染で局所的な集団発生に留まるが、学校での集団感染と公衆衛生緊急事態宣言があり、続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 疥癬はブラジルおよびミナスジェライス州の届出義務疾患ではなく、データは網羅的でない。学校での集団感染により60日間の公衆衛生緊急事態が宣言されているが、重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Repubblica Democratica del Congo La violenza frena la lotta all'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Violence slows the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Violence in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo undermines the Ebola response as the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak persists for six months in Ituri, with 12,000 confirmed cases and nearly 6,000 deaths. The Ituri epicenter accounts for more than two-thirds of cases; clashes in Djugu have driven about 30,000 people to flee in the past week, hampering humanitarian and health operations. UNICEF surveys indicate around 60% of women and girls aged 15+ report increased violence since the outbreak began, increasing infection risk through caregiving, clinic visits, and funeral preparations. The virus has spread to Haut-Uele, Nord Kivu, Sud Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, Sud-Ubangi, and Nord-Ubangi. Attacks on personnel and facilities total at least 170, with more than 60 against humanitarian groups. After a brief ceasefire, fighting near Bunia’s Iga-Barrière disrupts case finding, monitoring, and patient transport; WHO cites security constraints hindering supplies and safe burials. A continental Bundibugyo plan aims for implementation by May 2027.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:暴力がエボラとの闘いを停滞させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)のアウトブレイクが6ヶ月継続し12,000例・約6,000死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、複数州への拡大・暴力による対応阻害など国際的拡大・管理困難性も高い。
triage.notes: 複数州(Ituri, Haut-Uele, Nord Kivu, Sud Kivu, Bas-Uele, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi)に拡大中。武力紛争により対応・医療従事者へのアクセスが著しく阻害されている。
