article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo: Ebola-Ausbruch erreicht neuen Höchststand
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola outbreak reaches a new peak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, has 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths (49.1% CFR) through Nov 24 (INSP), spanning 69 health zones in eight provinces. On Nov 18, WHO deemed it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; two-thirds of deaths occurred outside treatment centers, indicating late detection and inadequate contact tracing. Africa CDC warns displacement in the east risks a continental outbreak. Fueled by Bundibugyo, this is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak; no specific therapy exists. Two vaccines are in Phase 1 trials; development will take months. Since August, Ervebo has been used at scale in DRC with promising results against Bundibugyo. Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported from DRC, 2 deaths), alongside Kenya (9), Nigeria (1) and France (1); four evacuees left for the Netherlands, United Kingdom and Germany.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ：エボラ出血熱の流行が新たなピークに達する
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言し、致死率49.1%、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主発生国はDRC。ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、オランダ、英国、ドイツへの波及があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みで、史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 2,4 mil casos de covid-19 são registrados em uma semana no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,400 COVID-19 cases are recorded in a week in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro State recorded 2,424 confirmed COVID-19 cases from 15–21 November 2026, the highest weekly total in 2026, with public-network test positivity rising from 25.9% to 34.3%. November totals reach 5,473 cases and six deaths in the period, while deaths remain low in recent weeks. Year-to-date: 19,158 cases, 626 hospitalizations, and 80 deaths in the state; in the capital, 10,982 cases and 32 deaths in 2026. By 25 November, 742,634 vaccine doses had been administered in the state in 2026 (674,168 in 2025). New SARS-CoV-2 lineages in Rio: PJ.2.1 predominates (58% of 167 genomes) with RF.5 (22%) and XFG (11%). PJ.2.1, first identified in Canada in May, arrived in Brazil by August and is under WHO monitoring. Symptoms mimic flu/cold; vaccination and public health measures remain advised; vaccines protect against severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロで1週間に2,400件超のCOVID-19症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例数が増加し新系統PJ.2.1がWHO監視下にあるが、重症度や死亡数は低く、通常の季節的サーベイランス報告の域を出ないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 新系統PJ.2.1はカナダで最初に検出されブラジルに到達、WHOの監視対象であるため今後の系統動向を注視する必要がある。死亡数・重症化率は低水準で推移。

article.articleHeadline: US Ebola quarantine facility ordered to halt work amid deadly outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court halted construction of a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base after ruling the government violated the Constitution by failing to consult the public or disclose U.S. deal details. The 50-bed center was meant to isolate Americans exposed to Ebola abroad rather than repatriate them, backed by a $13.5 million U.S. Ebola-preparedness commitment. Protests earlier this year in Laikipia led to two deaths. Justice Patricia Nyaundi ordered 45 days to disclose all agreements and biosafety and security assessments. Kenya has nine Ebola cases and two deaths as of November 23, with a possible Ebola-free status by December 23 if no new cases emerge. The U.S. State Department maintains a Level 3 travel warning; the CDC urges precautions. In the DRC, there are 11,986 cases and 5,871 deaths (as of Nov 23) amid violence and attacks on health facilities; WHO reports heavy fighting near the outbreak area.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、致死的アウトブレイクの最中にエボラ検疫施設の建設停止を命じられる
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行は症例数11,986・死亡5,871と極めて深刻で、紛争による医療アクセス制限や国際的な渡航制限（米国Level3警告）も伴い、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国バック支援によるケニア国内のエボラ検疫施設建設を巡る訴訟だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの進行中アウトブレイクに関する実質的データ（症例数・死亡数・治安情勢）が含まれるためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases reach 12,000 in Congo as second-largest outbreak on record grows
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola confirmed cases exceed 12,000 (12,021) with 5,904 deaths as the Bundibugyo strain outbreak began in mid-May in Ituri and has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. This is the second-largest and deadliest outbreak on record behind the 2014–16 West Africa epidemic, though it is spreading much faster. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this strain, complicating response efforts. Delayed detection, armed conflict, and strained health services, compounded by mistrust and misinformation, hinder containment. About 15% of new cases come from known contacts, suggesting many transmission chains are missed. The outbreak has spilled into five countries, but active cases remain in DRC; Uganda reports 21 cases and 3 deaths, Kenya 9 cases and 2 deaths, while Nigeria and France have imported cases with no ongoing transmission. Satellite imagery suggests the official death toll may be undercounted in hardest-hit areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の症例が12,000人に到達、史上2番目に大きい流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が12,000例・5,904死亡と史上2番目の規模に拡大し、複数国への国際的拡大とワクチン・治療薬不在という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスへの症例拡散が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リスト外（ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれるIDと一致しないため除外）。主な流行地はDRCであり、同国のみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Técnica de combate à dengue reduz número de contaminações no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Technique for combating dengue reduces the number of infections in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control in Brazil via Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes has yielded substantial declines. Launched in 2023, the Wolbachia method reduces transmission of dengue and other arboviruses such as Zika and Chikungunya. In the first cities adopting the approach, Fiocruz reports dramatic dengue declines: in Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, cases fell by 89% over the last three years; in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, by 68.5%. In Paraná, releases began last July, with Curitiba and additional municipalities—Cascavel, Londrina, Cambé, Maringá, Foz do Iguaçu, and Ponta Grossa—now applying the technique. Fiocruz researcher Luciano Moreira says expansion to more Paraná cities is planned for 2027. The latest Epidemiological Bulletin released on the 10th by the Paraná State Health Secretariat reports 6,380 dengue cases and six deaths in the state to date. The approach relies on releasing Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes to curb viral replication.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策技術がブラジルでの感染者数を減少させる
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・ベクター対策技術の成功事例を報じる内容であり、デング熱の流行拡大や新規異常事態を示すものではない。むしろ感染減少を示す好材料のニュースである。
triage.notes: 記事はWolbachia法によるデング熱対策の成功を報じるポジティブなニュースであり、州の疫学速報としてパラナ州で6,380例・死亡6例の報告はあるが、これは対策の文脈での統計であり新規の公衆衛生緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DRC: Health workers on the front line face infection risks
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) linked to the Bundibugyo strain has claimed over 5,300 lives in six months, making it the largest and deadliest epidemic in the country's history. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) has deployed more than 2,900 health workers across the DRC to confront the outbreak, with frontline staff in Ituri and North Kivu repeatedly exposed to the virus despite protective gear. In Mongbwalu, Ituri, nurse Alice Alyerunga described about 100 deaths at her treatment center in the opening weeks, with no patient survival. In Bunia, physician Sylvain Radjabu Lubangi contracted Ebola but recovered after fear of death. Ambulance drivers and burial teams face acute danger from handling severely ill patients and corpses. Armed insecurity and community mistrust—misinformation, threats to responders, and an arson attack on a Mongbwalu tent—hamper response. MSF emphasizes staff safeguarding to secure access and trust for early case detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：最前線の医療従事者が感染リスクに直面
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・最多死者数（6ヶ月で5,300人超）のエボラ流行が継続中であり、医療従事者の感染や治安悪化・住民の不信感が対応を阻害しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行がイトゥリ州・北キブ州で継続中。MSFが2,900人以上の医療従事者を投入しているが、武装勢力による治安悪化と住民の不信（デマ、放火など）が対応を阻害している。国際的拡大リスクについては明記されていないが、大規模流行かつ医療従事者感染が続いている点からリスクありと判断。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo superó los 12.000 casos de ébola y registra casi 6.000 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 Ebola cases and has recorded nearly 6,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths (case fatality rate 49.1%), with the outbreak declared on May 15 and extending across 69 health zones in eight provinces, including Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, and Ubangi South/North. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second deadliest globally. Health facilities face rising demand under ongoing conflict and population displacement, which hinder surveillance, contact tracing, and timely care. The World Health Organization maintains the Public Health Emergency of International Concern as of November 18. African CDC warns that insecurity and displacement could drive regional spread, highlighting the need for strengthened surveillance and response to prevent a continental outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が12,000例を超え、死者数は約6,000人に達する
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを維持しているエボラ大規模流行であり、致死率約49%、紛争・住民避難により対応が困難で地域拡大のリスクがAfrican CDCにより指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を2026年11月18日時点で維持中。African CDCは紛争・住民避難による地域拡大リスクを警告しており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Food poisoning in Bhiwandi: 120 still in hospital, action against 54 food stalls
article.articleSummary: Shawarma-related food poisoning in Bhiwandi, Thane district, Maharashtra, has left 120 people hospitalized at IGM Hospital as of 26 November 2026, with 22 discharged and 10 new admissions reported today; all patients are stable. The illnesses followed consumption of shawarma at a street stall in the Vanzarpatti Naka area on Monday night. In response, the Bhiwandi Nizampur City Municipal Corporation on Wednesday actioned 54 vendors for illegal operation and noncompliance with FDA rules, including 15 shawarma stalls, 21 Chinese food stalls, and 18 other stalls. The investigation notes that the outbreak stemmed from shawarma consumption at street stalls; no laboratory confirmation details are provided. There are no fatalities reported. Authorities say hospitalization is ongoing and regulatory enforcement will be used to improve food safety.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディで食中毒発生：120人がなお入院、54の屋台を摘発
triage.triage_reason: 食品由来の集団食中毒事例であり死亡者はないが、入院患者数が多く継続中であるため経過観察が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: シャワルマ屋台を原因とする食中毒で、病原体や検査確定情報は不明。感染症（病原体由来）の可能性もあるが、現時点では食品衛生事案として対応されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Surpasses 12,000 Cases and 5,900 Deaths as Rebel Fighting Disrupts Emergency Response - [your]NEWS
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reached 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths (case-fatality ~49%) as of Nov 26, 2026, making it the deadliest yet and second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. Declared in May, the outbreak has spread from northeastern Ituri to eight of Congo’s 26 provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi and North Ubangi. It is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus species, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids, causing severe illness, internal bleeding and death. Renewed fighting near Bunia, with Iga-Barrière about 15 miles north, disrupts evacuations and access; about a dozen responders, including two WHO staff, were evacuated to Bunia. Roughly 15% of new cases are among non-contacts, suggesting transmission outside known chains; WHO maintains the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが12,000症例・5,900人死亡を超える、反政府勢力の戦闘が緊急対応を妨害
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が8州に拡大し、武力紛争により対応が阻害され、WHOがPHEICを維持していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行のみを主題としており、発生地域に含まれるAngolaは記事本文で言及されていないため除外。非接触者からの感染が15%あり、既知の感染連鎖外での伝播の可能性が示唆される点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Medical officers in Tuensang trained on Ebola detection, res
article.articleSummary: One-day capacity-building training on Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) preparedness and response was conducted for medical officers and the district joint outbreak response team in Tuensang, organized by the District Surveillance Unit (DSU) and Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) under the CMO, Tuensang, at District Hospital Tuensang. The program covered Ebola case definition, actions at points of contact for suspected cases, and infection prevention and control (IPC) to safeguard healthcare workers, patients, and attendants. Microbiologist Dr. Mohan Sharma discussed zoonotic epidemiology, antibody detection, clinical specimen collection, prerequisites for collection, specimen transport, and the triple packing system. District Data Manager Langthsapila Sangtam emphasized real-time reporting via the IDSP portal. A practical session on proper PPE donning and doffing was conducted by Dr. Sharma and Dekhingridi Sangtam, BSL-2 Technician at the Integrated Molecular Diagnostics and Research Laboratory, District Hospital Tuensang.

triage.headline_ja: トゥエンサンの医療担当官がエボラ検知・対応について研修を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ発生事例ではなく、医療従事者向けの検知・対応に関する予防的訓練に関する記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの実際の発生・症例報告ではなく、インド・ナガランド州トゥエンサンでの準備訓練（キャパシティビルディング）に関する内容。対象国リストにインドは含まれるが、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Au Kenya, la justice suspend la construction d'un centre de quarantaine et de traitement d'Ebola - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, the courts suspend the construction of an Ebola quarantine and treatment center - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: On 26 November 2026, Kenya’s High Court suspended immediately the construction of an Ebola quarantine and treatment center at Laikipia Air Base, following a challenge by Katiba Institute. The court ruled that the government’s bilateral setup with the United States failed to meet constitutional obligations on transparency, citizen participation, and access to information, delaying the project designed to isolate potentially exposed Americans amid an active Ebola concern linked to the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo’s eastern outbreak. Justice Patricia Mande Nyaundi emphasized that health emergencies do not suspend constitutional duties, granting 45 days to the Ministry of Health to declassify and publish all bilateral agreements, environmental impact studies, and operational protocols. Restart of construction remains contingent on court compliance checks. A prior conservatory order was issued May 28. The ruling underscores judicial sovereignty over security/biomedical partnerships and accountability to local communities, without questioning the broader US partnership.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで、裁判所がエボラ検疫・治療センターの建設を差し止め - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はケニアにおける施設建設を巡る司法判断であり、DRC東部のエボラ流行への言及はあるものの、発生状況に関する新規情報は乏しく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの米国との二国間協定に基づく隔離施設建設を巡る司法審査が主題であり、DRC東部のエボラ流行は背景情報として言及されているのみ。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでのアウトブレイクの詳細な状況（症例数・死亡数等）は本記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: casos graves aumentam e variante monitorada pela OMS circula em 8 estados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: severe cases on the rise and the WHO-monitored variant circulating in eight states.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 severe cases are rising in Brazil as the SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 circulates across eight states and the Federal District, per Fiocruz InfoGripe (15–21 November). Rio de Janeiro reports SRAG alert levels linked to COVID-19 and other respiratory viruses (metapneumovirus, influenza A/B). The uptick in SRAG spans Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Bahia, and the Federal District; Pará is also at an alert level for severe respiratory disease, but the etiologic virus is not yet identified due to limited lab data. The PJ.2.1 lineage was first detected in May this year in Canada and is predominant in Rio de Janeiro’s capital (58% of sequenced genomes). It has been detected in the Federal District and eight states: RJ, ES, SP, MT, MG, PR, RS, SC. The WHO classifies PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring with low global health risk. Preliminary data do not show reduced vaccine protection; vaccines remain the main protection, with free vaccination through the SUS.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：重症例が増加、WHOが監視する変異株が8州で流行
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でCOVID-19重症例（SRAG）が増加し、WHOが監視する新変異株PJ.2.1が8州と連邦直轄区に拡大していると報道されており、メディアの関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: WHOはPJ.2.1を『監視下の変異株』とし、現時点ではグローバルなリスクは低いと分類。ワクチン効果の低下も確認されていないが、複数州でのSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）増加が報告されており、続報の確認が必要。カナダでの初検出情報はブラジル国内流行の文脈であり、Canadaはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bhiwandi Shawarma Scare: 120 Fall Ill, Four Serious Patients Shifted To Thane Hospital
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning linked to chicken shawarma from AK Shawarma near Vanjarpatti Naka in Bhiwandi has sickened 120 people as of 26 November 2026, with 111 still undergoing treatment and four hospitalized at Thane District Hospital. Affected individuals include 59 men, 35 women, and 25 children; common symptoms are vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, and fever. An FIR has been filed against the shop operator, who remains absconding, and police are examining ingredients and storage practices. The shawarma was sold at Rs 10–50. This marks the second major shawarma-linked outbreak in Bhiwandi, following a June incident that infected 107 people. In response, BNCMC launched a citywide crackdown on unauthorized stalls, with the FDA increasing inspections. Authorities emphasize ongoing investigations and call for regular food safety monitoring; no laboratory confirmation of the causative agent is reported.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディのシャワルマ食中毒騒動：120人が体調不良、4人の重症患者がターネー病院へ搬送
triage.triage_reason: 単一店舗の食中毒疑い事例であり、死者なし・人獣共通感染症でもなく、地域当局（BNCMC/FDA）が対応中で国際的拡大リスクは認められないため見送り。
triage.notes: 食中毒（シャワルマ由来の疑い）事例で、病原体のラボ確認は未報告。同地域で6月にも同様の事例があり、感染症（ヒト-ヒト感染）ではなく食品安全上の問題として地域当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox en las Américas, comercio marítimo, Haití, conflicto y ébola...Las noticias del jueves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox in the Americas, maritime trade, Haiti, conflict and Ebola... Thursday's news.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases rise in the Americas: 3,269 confirmed and 4 deaths from January–November, with Brazil reporting 1,325 cases and the Ib variant detected; transmission is by close contact; symptoms include rash, fever, and myalgias. PAHO/WHO urge vigilance and vaccination for high-risk groups. Global maritime trade stalls in 2026 due to conflicts in the Middle East, Black Sea security risks, and Panama Canal drought, pushing up transport costs and food and energy prices; UNCTAD projects a 3.2% recovery in 2027 and calls for international cooperation and navigational freedom. In Haiti, only 24.5% of health facilities function fully; 4.9 million people need health assistance in 2026; La Paz University Hospital has treated over 19,500 emergencies, including 291 gunshot injuries. In DR Congo’s Ituri, MONUSCO tightens protection during an Ebola outbreak, with thousands displaced; 10 health workers evacuated, and 380 civilians returned to a camp housing ~70,000.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ大陸でのMpox、海上貿易、ハイチ、紛争とエボラ…木曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: アメリカ大陸でMpox Clade Ib変異株が検出され複数国に拡大、DRC Iturではエボラ流行が継続中で保健従事者の避難や大規模な住民移動が発生しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心（PAHO/WHO声明）も確認できるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は複数トピック（Mpox、海上貿易、ハイチ人道危機、DRCエボラ）を扱う総合ニュースのため、Mpox（ブラジル中心にIb変異株検出）とエボラ（DRC Ituri）の2つの感染症イベントが対象国に該当。カナリア諸島・スペイン・パナマ・ハイチは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgını: Vaka sayısı 12 bini, can kaybı 5 bin 900'ü aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: case count exceeds 12,000; death toll exceeds 5,900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with confirmed cases surpassing 12,000 and deaths exceeding 5,900. Health authorities report the country-wide situation spans eight provinces, including Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Ituri province recorded 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, after which the outbreak was declared on May 15. Officials note that the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, identified in May, currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. The ongoing conflict and public backlash against the response impede containment as responders struggle to reach affected communities. The disease is named after the Ebola River, near where the outbreak began in a village in the DRC. These data reflect updates from the Ministry of Health as of 2026-11-26.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行：症例数12,000件、死者数5,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8州に拡大し、症例12,000件・死者5,900人超、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株であり、紛争により対応が困難な状況であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%と高く、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株であることが特に懸念される。紛争により対応要員のアクセスが制限されており、国際的な支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentan los casos de mpox en las Américas y llaman a reforzar la vacunación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases are rising in the Americas, and calls to bolster vaccination
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases rise across the Americas, triggering an OPS epidemiological alert amid increasing detection of clade Ib variant. From January through November 2026, 13 countries reported 3,269 confirmed cases and 4 deaths, with Brazil accounting for 1,325 cases and 1 death. Since 2022 the region has logged over 76,000 cases and 202 deaths in 31 countries/territories. The outbreak continues to affect disproportionately men who have sex with men and people living with HIV; among 114 mpox deaths with known HIV status, 97% were HIV-positive. OPS urges stronger surveillance, lab capacity, and prevention, including vaccination for high-risk groups before travel to areas with active transmission; vaccination should complement other measures. Transmission occurs via close physical contact and contaminated materials; symptoms include skin rashes. Seek testing if exposed. The WHO declared mpox a PHEIC in August 2024 and lifted it on September 5, 2025; the virus continues circulating with new variants.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ大陸でMpox症例が増加、ワクチン接種強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際拡大の3項目に該当し、PAHO（OPS）が地域的疫学警報を発出するなど社会的・行政的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはCanary Islands/Spainが含まれるが、記事はアメリカ大陸（特にブラジルが最多症例国）を主題としており、対象国リストに該当するのはBrazilのみ。clade Ib変異株の検出増加とHIV陽性者への不均衡な影響が特記される。

article.articleHeadline: Study Identifies Multidrug-Resistant MRSA in Retail Fish Imported into
article.articleSummary: MRSA (methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus) identified in unprocessed retail fish imported into Germany from non-European countries. Across two sampling phases (2019–2025), 123 mecA-positive MRSA isolates were confirmed from 483 samples, primarily tropical aquaculture fish such as pangasius and tilapia. 94.3% of isolates showed resistance to at least three antimicrobial classes. Genomic typing revealed 18 sequence types, 23 spa-types, and six SCCmec architectures; dominant lineage ST188-t189-IVa comprised 41.5% (51 isolates), with ST188 overall 59.3%, ST1232 9.8%, ST1 7.3%, ST45 6.5%, and five novel STs. Most carried IVa or V cassettes, typical of community-associated lineages. 2019 Zoonoses Monitoring: 419 samples; 29.1% positive, with 81% from Vietnam. Follow-up (2024–2025) in Berlin: 64 frozen samples, 21.9% MRSA positive, all tropical-origin fish from Vietnam, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka; temperate species negative. Implication: global seafood trade as a vehicle for resistant, virulent MRSA.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツに輸入された小売用魚から多剤耐性MRSAを検出した研究
triage.triage_reason: これはドイツで実施された食品由来MRSAの研究・サーベイランス報告であり、ヒトの感染症例やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究報告であり、輸入魚（ベトナム・インド・パキスタン・スリランカ産が中心）からの多剤耐性MRSA検出に関する科学的知見を示すもの。ヒト感染例やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、食品安全・AMRサーベイランスの観点からの情報として注視対象にとどまる。パキスタン・スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ドイツも対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue avança em Santa Catarina e acende alerta para 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue advances in Santa Catarina and raises an alert for 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue is advancing in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with 727 probable cases recorded in the first three weeks of November 2026, up from 331 in the same period in 2025. The 120% rise, equal to 396 additional cases, has prompted the epidemiological surveillance Directorate (DIVE) and the State Health Secretariat to warn for a potentially more intense dengue season. Officials link the surge to warm conditions, rainfall, and El Niño, which may boost Aedes aegypti proliferation. Prevention centers on household actions: allocate at least 10 minutes per week to eliminate standing water and remove debris that can serve as mosquito breeding sites. Advice targets yards, gutters, pots, water tanks, drains, and any container capable of collecting water. The message stresses the dengue fight starts at home and requires broad community participation.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でデング熱が拡大、2026年に向け警戒感高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州で季節性のデング熱症例数が前年比120%増加し保健当局が警戒を発しているが、重症度や国際的拡大・渡航制限等の情報はなく、地域の風土病的な季節変動の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年季節的に流行する風土病であり、今回の増加はエルニーニョによる気候要因が主因とされる。重症例・死亡者数などの情報がなく、全国的な拡大や国際的懸念を示す記述もないため、フルリスク評価の優先度は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Wirkstoff gegen Durchfall hilft bei Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diarrhea drug helps with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; no vaccine is currently available. A Lancet study indicates that the anti-diarrheal drug loperamide, given to Ebola patients, is associated with significantly lower mortality by mitigating severe fluid loss from diarrhea. The medicine costs only a few cents per tablet and does not require refrigeration, potentially enabling large‑scale use by aid groups. Authors urge the World Health Organization to include loperamide in Ebola treatment guidelines, allowing organizations such as Doctors Without Borders to stock and distribute it widely. The analysis uses patient data from 20 Ebola treatment centers across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone; while different virus strains were present there, experts believe loperamide could also help with the current Congo strain, though dosing remains to be optimized.

triage.headline_ja: 下痢治療薬がエボラ出血熱に効果
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロペラミドの治療効果に関する研究発表が主題であり、新たな発生や症例急増などのアウトブレイク情報を報告するものではない。DRCでの流行は既知の継続事案として言及されているのみ。
triage.notes: ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネのデータは2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行時の過去データであり、現在進行中の発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCは現在継続中の流行として言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak tops 12,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths (overall case fatality 49.1%) since the outbreak began. As of 24 November, 66 new confirmed cases were reported across Ituri (26), North Kivu (31), Tshopo (2), and Haut-Uélé (7), down 4.3% from the previous day. There were 18 community deaths (Ituri 6, North Kivu 11, Haut-Uélé 1) and 19 confirmed deaths in Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs) (Ituri 5, North Kivu 10, Haut-Uélé 4), bringing total confirmed deaths in this period to 37. Affected health zones total 69 of 178 (38.8%) across eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, South Kivu, Bas-Uélé, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi. Ituri remains the epicenter with roughly 8,100–8,140 cases and ~3,800+ deaths; Nord-Kivu (~3,150–3,180 cases) hosts major hotspots such as Beni and Katwa, with ongoing insecurity hindering response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、累計症例数が12,000例を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の累計12,021症例・5,904死亡（致死率49.1%）に達しており、複数州・多数の保健ゾーンに拡大、治安悪化で対応が困難なことからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%、8州69保健ゾーンに拡大中。治安悪化（Nord-Kivu等）が対応を妨げており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続・悪化を示す。国際的な封じ込め支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Oropouche Virus Surveillance Highlights Expanding Urban Outbreaks and
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus has escalated into an urgent public health concern after a late-2023 epidemiological shift. First identified in Trinidad (1955), it historically caused outbreaks in forested Amazonian Brazil and neighboring nations. In 2024, >11,600 laboratory-confirmed infections were recorded across the Americas; by 30 April 2025, 11,634 confirmed human cases and two deaths across ten countries and one territory (Brazil, Bolivia, Peru, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Guyana, Panama, among others). Brazil reported 3,678 cases Jan–Apr 2025; female predominance 51.8%. Travel-associated imported cases occurred in Canada, the United States, and several European countries. Underdiagnosis likely underestimates true incidence due to rural diagnostics and overlap with dengue, chikungunya, Zika. Urban transmission is driven by Culicoides paraensis; sylvatic cycle incompletely characterized. The segmented genome (S, M, L) enables reassortment (Perdões, Madre de Dios, Iquitos), challenging immunity and vaccines. Infection begins after midges bite, with replication in macrophages, endothelial, and epithelial cells.

triage.headline_ja: オロプーシュウイルスのサーベイランス、拡大する都市型アウトブレイクと診断上の課題を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: 2024年以降、オロプーシュウイルスが複数国（ブラジルを含む10カ国以上）で拡大し、都市部への感染サイクル変化や遺伝子再集合株の出現など異常な疫学動態が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大」の2項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は科学誌(scienmag)によるレビュー的内容で、ブラジルを含む複数国（ボリビア、ペルー、コロンビア、キューバ、エクアドル、ガイアナ、パナマ等）にまたがる感染拡大を報告しているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。渡航関連の輸入例が米加欧でも報告されているが、これらは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dia 'D' de combate à dengue vai a cinco bairros de Limeira neste sábado (28) | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day in the fight against dengue will visit five Limeira neighborhoods this Saturday (28) | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: On November 28, 2026, Limeira, São Paulo, will hold a D-Day for Dengue Control in Campo Verde I & II, Parque Pompeu, Residencial Marajoara, and Jardim Gustavo Peccinini. From 7:30 to 12:00, about 80 professionals—including vector-control agents, endemic-control teams, and community health workers—will reinforce Aedes aegypti control and educate residents on identifying and eliminating breeding sites for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Residents are urged to spend 10 minutes weekly inspecting yards, plant pots, water tanks, and other containers for standing water. Dengue vaccination remains available for adolescents 10–14 at all municipal vaccination sites; bring photo ID and a vaccination card, and minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. Dengue symptoms include sudden high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle and joint pains, extreme fatigue, red spots on the skin (with or without itching), nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラ市内5地区でデング対策「Dデー」実施、今週土曜(28日)に
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング熱予防啓発・媒介蚊対策活動の告知であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体の定例的な蚊媒介感染症予防キャンペーンの告知であり、症例数や流行状況についての具体的データは含まれていない。ブラジル(São Paulo州)で発生しているが、通常の予防活動であるため対象国リストに該当する発生国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Montes Claros confirma três casos de Mpox e mantém monitoramento epidemiológico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Montes Claros confirms three cases of Mpox and maintains epidemiological surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Montes Claros has three laboratory-confirmed Monkeypox (Mpox) cases and nine more under investigation, with notifications up to Wednesday, November 25. The illness is transmitted mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, secretions, and contaminated materials. Municipal Health Secretariat guidance emphasizes avoiding contact with suspected lesions, not sharing personal items such as towels and clothing, and frequent hand hygiene to prevent transmission. Individuals with signs or symptoms should seek evaluation at their designated Family Health Unit (USF). Early case identification and advised precautions help reduce transmission risk. In 2025, eleven Mpox cases notified in Montes Claros were investigated and discarded. The situation remains under active surveillance by the city's epidemiological surveillance team.

triage.headline_ja: モンテス・クラロス市、Mpox3例を確認し疫学的監視を継続
triage.triage_reason: Mpox既知疾患の局地的な少数例報告であり、現時点で重大な公衆衛生インパクトや急速拡大の兆候は見られないが、9例が調査中であり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 地元自治体レベルでの監視対応であり、症例数は少なく既知疾患のため現時点ではDISMISS寄りだが、調査中の9例の帰趨を確認するためWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Fresh bird flu outbreak confirmed in Cuddalore district; culling of chickens begins
article.articleSummary: Fresh bird flu outbreak confirmed in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, with culling of more than 25,000 chickens at a Nochikkadu poultry farm after over 1,000 birds were found dead. Tissue and blood samples from the dead birds were sent to the central laboratory in Bhopal, and tests returned positive for avian influenza. Special teams are culling and safely disposing of infected poultry by burying them in deep pits. Farms are prohibited from restocking for 90 days and are under monitoring by joint revenue-local administration committees, with intensified inspections by animal husbandry officials to prevent human transmission. Recurrent outbreaks have affected parts of Cuddalore in the past month, including Krishnankuppam, Naduthittu, and Thyagavalli, destroying more than 100,000 birds across multiple farms as of 26 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: クダロール県で新たな鳥インフルエンザの発生を確認、鶏の殺処分開始
triage.triage_reason: 家きんでの鳥インフルエンザ再発事例であり、ヒト感染の報告はないが、反復発生と大規模な被害が続いているため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽における動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。ただしクダロール県で過去1か月に反復して発生しており、10万羽以上の家禽が被害を受けていることから、ヒトーヒト感染の可能性や公衆衛生リスクの拡大について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria 'devoradora de carne' mata nos EUA; há risco nas praias brasileiras?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flesh-eating bacteria kill in the U.S.; is there a risk on Brazilian beaches?
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus, the flesh-eating bacteria, caused seven deaths in Florida this year, with 36 cases reported through November 24, 2026. The organism naturally inhabits coastal and brackish waters and thrives in higher temperatures; severe infections destroy skin tissue and may require amputation. Transmission mainly occurs via raw or undercooked oysters and shellfish, but wounds exposed to seawater can also become infected, causing pain, redness, swelling and blisters. Ingestion may cause diarrhea, abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting. High-risk groups include chronic liver disease, diabetes and immunocompromised individuals; CDC estimates about 20% mortality, with some cases advancing within 1–2 days. Prevention: avoid raw shellfish; avoid entering the sea with open wounds; wear protective footwear; promptly clean wounds. In Brazil, a 2025 study in Laguna, Santa Catarina found Vibrio species in oysters and mussels; V. vulnificus appeared in three samples in summer. No recent Brazilian alerts, but guidance applies for at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 「肉食バクテリア」が米国で死亡例、ブラジルのビーチにもリスクはあるか？
triage.triage_reason: 主な発生は米国フロリダ州でのVibrio vulnificus感染であり、ブラジルでは2025年の研究で病原体が検出されたのみで実際の感染事例・警報は報告されていないため、ブラジルに関しては経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国フロリダ州での死亡例であり、ブラジルについては2025年の研究で病原体の存在が確認されたのみで、実際の感染事例報告はない。Vibrio vulnificusは海水温上昇に伴い世界的に懸念される病原体だが、本記事はブラジルでの実際の発生を示すものではなく、注意喚起的な内容である。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D: Sesau promove mobilização contra a dengue nesta sexta-feira | Roraima em Foco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day: Sesau promotes mobilization against dengue this Friday | Roraima in Focus
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention mobilization in Roraima: Boa Vista’s Sesau, in partnership with the city, hosts a D-Day mobilization on Friday, November 27, 2026, from 08:00 to 12:00 at Praça do Centro Cívico (opposite the Legislative Assembly). The event distributes informational materials and guidance on preventing and controlling Aedes aegypti, underscoring that over 70% of breeding sites are domestic. Authorities highlight climate changes and irregular water supply as challenges, noting 889 probable dengue cases across 15 municipalities in 2026. In addition to Boa Vista, activities run through Saturday, November 28, including schools, health units, home visits, and clean-up campaigns. A mechanical vector-control drive is planned in high-notification neighborhoods (08:00–14:00). Other towns involved include Alto Alegre, Pacaraima, Bonfim, Cantá, Caroebe (Caroebe Agroshow 2026), Mucajaí, Normandia, and São João da Baliza.

triage.headline_ja: Dデー：Sesauが金曜日にデング熱対策の啓発活動を実施 | Roraima em Foco
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発活動の報道であり、異常な増加や重症例の急増を示す情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 2026年にロライマ州で889件の疑いデング熱症例が15自治体で発生しているが、これは季節的な通常対応としての予防キャンペーンの報道であり、緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Śmiertelny wirus zbiera tragiczne żniwo. Tysiące zmarłych! "Epidemia wymknęła się spod kontroli"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus takes a tragic toll. Thousands dead! 'The epidemic has spiraled out of control.'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. The cluster began mid-May in Ituri province (northeast DRC) and has spread to eight of 26 provinces. The causative virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. Delays in outbreak detection, isolation, and contact tracing—exacerbated by ongoing eastern DRC conflict—have allowed rapid spread, with medical teams sometimes unable to reach patients, including a three-day evacuation delay at Akwe hospital. Africa CDC warns only about 15% of new cases are linked to known contacts, suggesting under-detection and a true burden possibly 2–4 times higher than official figures. Satellite-based investigations in Bunia indicate excess mortality >50% above official counts, reflecting many deaths outside healthcare facilities. Ebola transmission occurs via contact with blood, saliva, or other fluids, with a 2–21 day incubation and initial flu-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的ウイルスが悲劇的な犠牲者数を記録。数千人が死亡！『感染拡大は制御不能に陥った』
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）流行が史上2番目の規模（感染1万2千超、死亡5900超）に達し、紛争下での検出・隔離遅延によりIHR基準複数該当・WPRO基準も広く該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はポーランドのタブロイド紙だが内容はAfrica CDCの警告や衛星調査に基づく深刻な実態を反映。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文での言及がないため除外。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事に明記なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Volta Redonda promove dia D contra a Dengue neste sábado (28) | Volta Redonda | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Volta Redonda promotes D-Day against dengue this Saturday (28) | Volta Redonda | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Volta Redonda launches a D-Day against dengue on Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 8:00 a.m., concentrating efforts in the Sessenta neighborhood. The initiative, led by the Municipal Health Department with Environmental Surveillance teams, will conduct door-to-door visits to identify Aedes aegypti breeding sites and educate residents on eliminating water-collecting containers. Activities include distributing informational materials and installing an educational tent for preventive guidance. Officials note that about 80% of mosquito breeding sites are inside or around homes, underscoring the need for routine inspections, particularly during warm, rainy periods that facilitate water accumulation. Key recommendations: avoid standing water in bottles, vases, tires, and other receptacles; keep water tanks sealed; clean gutters; discard items that collect water; and perform weekly home checks. Aedes aegypti also transmits Zika and chikungunya; community participation is essential for sustained control.

triage.headline_ja: ヴォルタ・レドンダ、今週土曜日（28日）にデング熱対策「D-Day」を実施
triage.triage_reason: 地域の日常的な蚊対策啓発活動の告知であり、新規症例や異常な流行拡大の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による予防啓発キャンペーンの告知であり、具体的な感染者数や流行状況は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana: 43 cidades de Minas Gerais registraram surtos da doença; veja lista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies: 43 cities in Minas Gerais recorded outbreaks of the disease; see the list.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, Minas Gerais state in Brazil reports human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) outbreaks in 43 municipalities, with no disclosed case counts since scabies is not on the national or state notifiable list. Municipalities are to notify two or more epidemiologically linked cases via CIEVS-Minas or the responsible technical area; after notification, monitoring focuses on severity, transmissibility, and magnitude. Notable cities affected include Belo Horizonte, Ipatinga, Poços de Caldas, Ouro Preto, Lagoa Santa, Lavras, Varginha, and São João Del Rei, among others. Diagnosis is largely clinical, based on lesion appearance and symptom history, with many districts lacking a standardized case definition. Treatment comprises antiseptic lotions or creams and medications. Scabies spreads rapidly as scratching facilitates mite transmission; outbreaks are likely in crowded settings such as schools, elderly homes, daycares, and prisons.

triage.headline_ja: ヒト疥癬：ミナスジェライス州の43都市で疾病の集団発生を記録、リストを見る
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低い疾患だが、多数の自治体で集団発生が報告され、届出義務がなく症例数不明のため情報不足の観点から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は届出義務疾患でないため正確な症例数が不明。学校・高齢者施設・刑務所等の集団施設での流行可能性が指摘されているが、重症度や国際的影響は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 患者爆料院內染疫 突發心血管疾病恐猝死 | 中國心血管疾病 | 新冠感染 | 風濕性心臟病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient reveals hospital-acquired infection; sudden cardiovascular event could lead to sudden death | Cardiovascular Diseases in China | COVID-19 Infection | Rheumatic Heart Disease
article.articleSummary: China’s cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause of death for urban and rural residents, with higher rural mortality and men at greater risk, per the 2025 China Cardiovascular Health and Disease Report. The article notes a rapid rise in COVID-19–related cardiovascular disease and rheumatic heart disease. Hospitalized patients infected during care may experience acute cardiovascular events and potential sudden death. In Tianjin, a diabetic patient developed mitral valve deformity with stenosis during admission, signaling imminent risk. In Jiangsu, a patient suffered brain infarction amid fever and immune compromise; pericardial infection noted. Rheumatic heart disease patients in Zhejiang and Henan report multiple valve surgeries (mitral, aortic, tricuspid), atrial fibrillation, and reduced exercise capacity; some use domestic drugs with severe side effects, prompting pacemaker implantation. Immune-driven damage from inflammation and associated thrombosis underlie worsening valve dysfunction and rapid deterioration.

triage.headline_ja: 患者が病院内感染を告発、突発性心血管疾患で死亡の恐れ｜中国の心血管疾患｜新型コロナ感染｜リウマチ性心臓病
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生や新規アウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。既知の心血管疾患統計とCOVID-19合併症に関する個別事例の紹介にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国の慢性心血管疾患の統計データと、院内感染したCOVID-19患者個人の症例報告に焦点を当てたもので、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではないため対象国としての発生報告には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Des jeunes de Kisangani apportent leur soutien aux équipes de la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Youth from Kisangani lend their support to the Ebola response teams.
article.articleSummary: In Kisangani, DR Congo, amid the 17th Ebola outbreak in Tshopo province, at least 109 Ebola cases, more than 35 deaths, and over 44 recoveries have been recorded. On 25 November, about ten youths gathered outside the Ebola Treatment Center to show moral support to frontline health workers. They carried banners and praised staff, whose efforts have saved lives despite constraints and delays in some bonus payments. The center's director welcomed the solidarity as morale-boosting for those caring for patients. Health authorities warned that Ebola remains active in several Kisangani communes and urged strict adherence to preventive measures; the youths observed barrier gestures during the event. Community involvement is deemed essential to sustaining the outbreak response in Tshopo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：キサンガニの若者たちがエボラ対応チームへの支援を表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中アウトブレイク（第17次、109症例・35人以上死亡）であり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準にも該当するためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 既存の進行中アウトブレイクに関する続報記事だが、感染拡大が継続している地域で死亡者数も多く、既存シグナルとしてのフォローアップが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox volta a preocupar no Brasil após aumento de casos; veja o que se sabe sobre o surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox concerns return in Brazil after a rise in cases; see what is known about the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) concerns have resurfaced in Brazil, with 1,499 diagnoses in 2026 to date, a 39.4% rise from 1,075 in all of 2025. In São Paulo, 120 cases were reported by Nov 24, up from 81 in October and 22 in September, signaling intensified activity but well below the 2022 peak when Brazil recorded 10,591 cases. Experts attribute the rise to a mix of factors: after the 2022 outbreak risk perception declined even as the virus continued circulating (1,989 cases in 2024). Ongoing transmission chains, a large pool of susceptible individuals, limited vaccination coverage, and diagnostic challenges—all with some lesions being discreet—may fuel increases. Virologist Clarissa Damaso (UFRJ) says a single cause cannot be determined; crowded events and close contact likely facilitate transmission, but evidence for a specific trigger remains lacking.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで症例増加によりMpoxへの懸念が再燃、流行について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が前年比39.4%増加し社会的関心が高まっており、継続的な感染連鎖とワクチン接種率の低さから流行しやすさの基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 2022年の大規模流行後、リスク認識の低下にもかかわらずウイルスの継続的な循環が示唆されている。重症度や政府対応に関する情報は記事中に明記されておらず不明。

article.articleHeadline: Τυφοειδής πυρετός: Ο αρχαίος "δολοφόνος" που αποκτά αντοχή στα αντιβιοτικά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Typhoid fever: The ancient "killer" that is developing resistance to antibiotics.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella Typhi–driven typhoid fever is increasingly antibiotic-resistant and crossing borders. A Lancet Microbe study estimates about 11 million cases and more than 100,000 deaths annually, with 70% of the burden in South Asia and substantial cases in Sub-Saharan Africa, Southeast Asia, and Oceania. Genomic analyses of 3,489 isolates from Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and India (2014–2019) plus 4,169 genomes from >70 countries (1905–2018) map emergence and spread of resistant lineages. Evidence shows at least 197 cross-border transmissions, including 59 intercontinental events; travel-associated cases have appeared in the United Kingdom and United States. Resistance to older antibiotics emerged in the 1970s; fluoroquinolones in the 1990s, with Pakistan’s 2016 XDR lineage becoming dominant within three years, and azithromycin resistance emerging in Bangladesh around 2013. As of publication, strains remain azithromycin- and carbapenem-susceptible, but rising azithromycin resistance could undermine oral therapy. Authors urge vaccination, improved water and sanitation, genomic surveillance, and expanded vaccination programs, noting data gaps in sub-Saharan Africa and Oceania.

triage.headline_ja: 腸チフス：抗生物質耐性を獲得しつつある古代の『殺し屋』
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はLancet Microbe誌の研究論文に基づく腸チフス薬剤耐性の長期的傾向に関する科学的レビューであり、特定の急性アウトブレイクや新規事象を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は2014-2019年の既存ゲノムデータに基づく学術研究の紹介であり、特定の突発的アウトブレイクを示すものではない。インド以外の対象国（パキスタン、バングラデシュ、ネパール）も言及されているが地域リストに含まれないため除外。英国・米国は旅行関連症例として言及されているが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D: Governo de Minas mobiliza 820 municípios no combate aos focos do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day: Minas Gerais government mobilizes 820 municipalities in the fight against Aedes aegypti breeding sites.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, launches the D-Day Arboviroses Fight, mobilizing 820 municipalities to curb Aedes aegypti breeding as the rainy season nears. The event on Saturday, 28 November, includes 96% municipal participation with activities across streets, health units, schools, and public spaces: social mobilization, mass cleanups, home visits, educational blitzes, and distribution of materials. Subsecretary Eduardo Prosdocimi notes about 80% of standing-water breeding sites are inside homes, underscoring household involvement. Since 2023, the state invested ~R$300 million in surveillance, vector control, vaccines, and SUS capacity, including the VigiDrones policy with ~R$30.5 million for drone-based geomonitoring to identify and address breeding sites. Epidemiological snapshot (Jan–Nov 2026): dengue 50,083 cases, 54 deaths; chikungunya 15,788 cases, 6 deaths; Zika 13 cases, 0 deaths. Dengue vaccination: 441,433 doses (2025, ages 10–14) and 612,997 doses (Jan–Oct 2026).

triage.headline_ja: Dデー：ミナスジェライス州政府、ネッタイシマカの繁殖地対策のため820自治体を動員
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性ベクター対策キャンペーンの報道であり突発的異常事象ではないが、デング熱等の症例・死亡数が継続的に報告されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ミナスジェライス州における例年の雨季前ベクター対策キャンペーンの報道。デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数は報告されているが、州政府は既に大規模な予防的対応（監視・予防接種・ドローン活用等）を実施中であり、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ES registra 5.566 casos de Covid-19; veja faixa etária mais afetada - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Espírito Santo records 5,566 COVID-19 cases; see the most affected age group - Folha Vitória.
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo, Brazil, reported 5,566 COVID-19–related influenza-like syndrome cases from January to November 2026, with adults 18–59 years constituting the majority, followed by older adults, per the state Health Secretariat (Sesa). In epidemiological week 46 (Nov 15–21), 3,407 new cases were recorded, and there was a rise among children, especially under one year, indicating transmission across all ages. Hospitalizations and deaths remain below 2025 totals (7,082 cases that year). By week 43 (through Oct 31), Espírito Santo had 2,073 cases and 15 deaths. Nationally, Brazil logged 118,851 COVID-19–related influenza-like syndrome cases by Nov 4, with the Ministry classifying activity as low risk. Sesa warns outbreaks may recur with new variants or waning vaccination coverage. Seniors and immunocompromised individuals should seek timely care; vaccination should be up to date; maintain hygiene and avoid crowded, poorly ventilated spaces.

triage.headline_ja: エスピリトサント州、COVID-19症例5,566件を記録；最も影響を受けた年齢層を見る - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性COVID-19動向の定期報告であり、保健当局も低リスクと分類。入院・死亡は前年を下回り、特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省はこの活動を低リスクと分類しており、定例の疫学週報告に基づく記事。新規変異株やワクチン接種率低下による再流行の可能性には言及があるが、現時点での異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Parnaíba realiza Dia D contra a dengue com vacinação e visitas domiciliares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parnaíba holds D-Day against dengue with vaccination and home visits
article.articleSummary: Parnaíba, Brazil, will host a D-Day against dengue on Friday, November 27, featuring educational activities, vaccination for children and adolescents, and home visits to tackle Aedes aegypti breeding sites. The event starts at 8:40 a.m. at the Domingos Rubem Uchôa Early Childhood School and includes an educational theatre performance along with dengue vaccination for youths aged 10–14. Community health workers and vectors control teams will conduct in-home visits to guide residents and identify potential mosquito breeding sites. Preventive guidance emphasizes home measures: keep water tanks covered, eliminate containers that collect standing water, clean gutters, and maintain clean yards. The initiative, organized by the Municipal Health Secretariat through Epidemiological Surveillance, aims to expand prevention efforts and raise awareness about dengue transmission and control.

triage.headline_ja: パルナイーバ市、ワクチン接種と家庭訪問によるデング熱対策「Dデー」を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に対する通常の予防啓発活動・ワクチン接種イベントであり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的なデング熱予防啓発・ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知記事であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: إصابات "إيبولا" تتجاوز 12 ألفاً والوفيات تقترب من 6 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola infections exceed 12,000 and deaths near 6,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain) has surpassed 12,000 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths as of November 26, 2026. The outbreak, declared mid-May in Ituri province in the northeast, has spread to 8 of 26 provinces. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo; delayed detection, ongoing armed conflict, and strained health services have accelerated transmission, making this the second-largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak on record after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). About 15% of new cases arise from known contacts, indicating many transmission chains remain undetected. Reuters satellite imagery suggests the official death toll may be substantially underestimated in two of the hardest-hit regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ感染者数が1万2000人を超え、死者数は6000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が12,000例・死者約5,900人に達し、未承認のワクチン・治療薬、武力紛争による対応困難、検出漏れの拡大など複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州を起点に8/26州へ拡大したエボラ流行を主題としている。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外。承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがないブンディブギョ株であり、歴史上2番目に大きい流行とされ、死者数は過小評価の可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina registra aumento de 120% nos casos prováveis de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina Records a 120% Increase in Probable Dengue Cases
article.articleSummary: Santa Catarina, Brazil, reports a 120% rise in probable dengue cases. In the first three weeks of November 2026, 727 probable cases compared with 331 in the same period in 2025. From January 1 to November 25, the state logged 3,838 probable dengue cases, with 1,587 laboratory-confirmed. No dengue-related deaths were recorded in this period. The Health Secretariat warns of a potentially larger season influenced by El Niño and emphasizes prevention. Residents are advised to dedicate at least ten minutes weekly to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, remove standing water from containers, water tanks, gutters, drains, and tires. Watch for symptoms such as high fever, headache, muscle pains, and red rash; seek healthcare if symptomatic. Alarm signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, dizziness, or bleeding, requiring immediate medical care.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、デング熱疑い症例が120％増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部州で季節性デング熱の疑い症例が増加しているが、死亡者なし・既知の病原体であり、通常の季節的流行拡大の範囲内と考えられる。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: El Niñoの影響による季節性デング熱の増加で、州保健局が予防啓発を行っている段階。死亡例なく重症化情報もないため、現時点でフルRRAへの移行は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 60 Fall Ill After Having Food At Religious Event In Rajasthan's Bundi
article.articleSummary: Sixty people fell ill after consuming dal-bati and churma at a religious ceremony in Pipliya village, Hindoli block, Bundi district, Rajasthan. The Jujhar Ji Swamini ceremony at Laxman Raigar’s house drew 200–300 attendees; several hours later, victims reported vomiting, diarrhea and stomach pain. At Hindoli Community Health Centre, 15 patients were admitted (initially 10, then five more) with one in critical condition referred to Bundi District Hospital. Medical teams collected food samples from the event and sent them to a laboratory for testing to identify the cause. Authorities and hospital staff responded to the incident, while villagers voiced concerns about hospital facilities. The article notes laboratory sampling but does not report results, linking the outbreak to the communal feast at the event.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州バンディで宗教行事での食事後に60人が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒（集団食事起因の嘔吐・下痢）とみられ、感染症の人-人伝播や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。原因は調査中だが局地的な事案。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品由来の非感染性/単発的集団発生）であり、感染症危機管理上の優先度は低い。原因物質の検査結果待ちだが、現時点で病原体の人-人感染の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de covid-19 aumentam no Rio. Saiba quem pode se vacinar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in Rio de Janeiro. Find out who can be vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro registered 2,424 confirmed COVID-19 cases from November 15–21, 2026—the year's weekly high—with public test positivity rising from 25.9% to 34.3%. November totals reached 5,473 cases and six deaths. Free vaccination via SUS targets: children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant individuals, adults 60+ years, immunocompromised, people with comorbidities, health professionals, and persons with permanent disabilities. Booster guidance: elderly and immunocompromised every six months; pregnant individuals receive one dose per pregnancy; other special groups—annual vaccination; children should complete the basic schedule per the Ministry of Health. In Rio de Janeiro city, vaccines are available at Family Clinics, Municipal Health Centers, and the Carioca Vaccination Super Center in Botafogo, open daily 08:00–22:00. Bring ID and vaccination card. Additional measures to reduce transmission include well-ventilated spaces, hand hygiene, and masking when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでCOVID-19感染者数が増加。ワクチン接種対象者について
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な感染者数増加に関する定例報道であり、異常性や深刻度、国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既存のワクチン接種体制で対応可能と判断される。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に世界的に流行している疾患であり、本記事はリオデジャネイロ市の定例感染状況報告とワクチン接種案内に過ぎない。死亡者数（11月で6名）も相対的に少なく、公的医療体制（SUS）による通常対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, Congo’s eastern Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has topped 12,000 confirmed cases, with 12,021 cases reported and nearly half dying, making it the fastest-growing and deadliest outbreak in Congo’s 17 events and potentially surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of about 11,000. Declared in May, the outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of the sick or deceased, underscoring the need for rapid isolation, contact monitoring, and safe burials. The epicenter is Bunia in Ituri province, where fighting between the army and Convention pour la révolution populaire rebels has displaced people toward the city. WHO Ebola incident manager Dr. Catherine Smallwood said about a dozen people, including two WHO staff, were evacuated to Bunia after three days trapped in Akwe amid crossfire, as response capacity wanes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、症例数12,000人に達し一部対応要員が避難
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行がコンゴ史上最速・最多死亡の流行となり12,000例を超え、治療薬・ワクチン未承認かつ武力紛争により対応能力が低下しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州・ブニア）のみが主題であり、Angolaへの言及はないため除外した。武力紛争による人口移動と対応要員の避難が国際的拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaausbruch in Zentralafrika: Mehr als 12.000 bestätigte Ebolafälle in DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa: More than 12,000 confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports over 12,000 confirmed Ebola cases (12,021 infections) and 5,904 deaths, the heaviest outbreak since 2016. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. It was officially declared in mid-May in the northeastern Ituri province and has since spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. Experts say the epidemic remains uncontrolled, with only about 15% of new cases linked to known contacts, indicating many transmission chains are undetected. Regional conflicts hinder care and contact tracing, leaving the health system strained. In hopeful news, a study involving the Catholic University of Eichstätt-Ingolstadt found that the cheap anti-diarrheal drug loperamide was associated with markedly lower mortality among Ebola patients treated in West Africa from 2013–2016; results published in The Lancet Global Health, based on about 5,500 patients. Africa CDC notes ongoing, uncontrolled transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラ発生：コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例12,000人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で12,000人超の確認症例・致死率約49%という大規模アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し、感染経路の85%が追跡不能で、紛争により対応が困難な状況であり、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確に該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる2016年以降で最大規模のアウトブレイク。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争地域での対応困難、感染連鎖の大半が未検出という点から、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として最優先でフルRRAに進めるべき事案。Angolaは発生地域に含まれているが記事サマリー上で言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño offers lead time -- not certainty -- against dengue in South Asia
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk in Kerala, India could be forecast by a model blending Pacific ENSO signals with local climate data (temperature, humidity, rainfall). In Kerala, about 40% of years with high modelled dengue coincide with El Niño, while roughly 57% of years with low modelled incidence align with La Niña. Pacific sea-surface temperatures correlate with Kerala cases three months ahead; including local weather can extend lead time to five months, though ENSO remains a weaker signal. A multi-variable approach—climate plus ENSO plus vector surveillance and health data—improves prediction but cannot specify outbreak start or magnitude. Such forecasts provide months for preparedness: review hotspots, circulating serotypes, diagnostics, stocks, staffing, and referral pathways. The 2023–24 El Niño coincided with the largest global dengue epidemic, Americas >90% of cases; Sri Lanka saw DENV-2 resurgence in 2025–26, raising risk, but no surge by November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョは南アジアのデング熱に対して確実性ではなく準備期間を与える
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はケララ州のデング熱発生を気候シグナル（ENSO）から予測する研究モデルを紹介する科学解説記事であり、実際のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は気候予測モデルに関する学術的内容であり、実際のデング熱流行の報告ではない。スリランカでのDENV-2再興についても言及されているが、2026年11月時点で急増は確認されていない。スペイン・カナリア諸島は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola u Kongu: Više od 12.000 zaraženih, 5.900 umrlih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: More than 12,000 cases, 5,900 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 12,000 confirmed infections and about 5,900 deaths, with the World Health Organization classifying the situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as of November 18, 2026. Authorities report over 12,000 infections and nearly 5,900 deaths; the WHO’s November 17 update logged 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths across eight provinces and 68 health zones. The outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu. Bundibugyo virus, one Ebola species, currently has no approved vaccines or specific treatment; control relies on early detection, isolation, contact tracing, and protective measures. The WHO notes very high risk in the DRC and low risk elsewhere; no travel or trade bans are advised, but surveillance and rapid health responses must be intensified.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：感染者1万2000人超、死者5900人
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと認定した大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ種）流行であり、死亡者数・感染者数ともに甚大でIHR基準を複数満たすため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナル。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを宣言しており、ワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認のブンディブギョ種エボラの大規模流行。DRC国内リスクは非常に高いが、他地域へのリスクは低いとWHOは評価。渡航・貿易制限は推奨されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: UN says outbreak driving spike in gender-based violence in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is driving increased gender-based violence against women and girls, UNICEF reports. In Bunia and at the Rwampara displacement site, containment measures—restricting movement to markets and public gatherings—have disrupted daily livelihoods. Unable to engage in small-scale trading, many women face heightened financial precarity, and fear of infection has reduced access to healthcare. With donor funding, a local organization is providing medical care, psychosocial support and vocational skills training to women and girls to bolster economic self-reliance. The situation shows how outbreak responses can intensify vulnerabilities even as they aim to curb transmission. As of 26 November 2026, these interventions seek to mitigate impacts while the Ebola outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:国連、コンゴでの流行がジェンダーに基づく暴力の急増を招いていると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行が、移動制限などの対策を通じて女性・少女へのジェンダーに基づく暴力を悪化させており、国際的な人道支援の必要性が示されているためWPRO基準とで社会的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規発生情報ではなく、既存の流行による二次的な社会的影響（ジェンダーに基づく暴力の増加）に焦点を当てている。ルワンダの避難民サイト（Rwampara）が言及されているが、同国内での感染拡大を示す記述はないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Alagamentos podem aumentar casos de leptospirose; saiba como prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flooding can increase leptospirosis cases; learn how to prevent.
article.articleSummary: Flooding from heavy rains raises leptospirosis risk in Paraná, Brazil, where water and mud may be contaminated with Leptospira from animal urine, especially rats. Leptospirosis presents with fever, vomiting, and diarrhea and can be fatal in severe cases. Health officials warn that contaminated floodwater and mud pose exposure risks during cleanup. Suspected cases should seek medical care. According to the Paraná State Health Secretariat (Sesa), 266 confirmed leptospirosis cases had been recorded through November, a figure close to last year’s 277. Roselane Oliveira, head of the Sesa zoonoses and intoxications surveillance division, highlights water contamination risk after heavy rains; infectious disease specialist Camila Ahrens stresses continued vigilance after floods.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水によりレプトスピラ症の症例が増加する可能性、予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラナ州における季節的な洪水関連のレプトスピラ症注意喚起であり、症例数も前年並みで異常性や国際的拡大の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 例年並みの症例数（266件 vs 前年277件）であり、季節性の公衆衛生啓発記事に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola accentue les violences faites aux femmes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak exacerbates violence against women.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak worsens violence against women and girls, with movement restrictions, economic hardship, limited access to care, and rising gender-based violence per UNICEF. In Bunia and the Rwampara displacement site, containment measures disrupt daily life and push women out of markets, increasing financial precarity and exposing some to exploitation. Fear of infection also deters women from seeking health services. Kasemire Mugavu (Bunia) and others describe loss of market-based income, now limited to field work, and heightened vulnerability for women in camps who endure exploitative relationships to survive. SOFEPADI, supported by UNICEF and in partnership with the University of Washington, monitors gender-based violence, offers safe spaces where women and girls receive medical care, psychosocial support, and vocational training to boost economic autonomy. The outbreak adds a major protection challenge alongside medical response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ流行が女性への暴力を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で進行中のエボラ流行に関する報道であり、Ebolaは重篤性・国際的拡大リスクが高い疾患であるため、社会的影響の記事であってもIHR基準を複数満たすと判断しPICKUPとする。
triage.notes: 記事本体はエボラ流行に伴う女性への暴力・経済的困窮といった二次的社会影響に焦点を当てているが、背景にあるDRC東部のエボラ流行自体は既知の重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため、継続的なモニタリング対象として扱う。Rwanda（Rwampara避難民サイト）への言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Likouala/Santé : Le préfet du département lance la campagne de vaccination contre le choléra - Agence Congolaise d'information
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Likouala/Health: The prefect of the department launches the cholera vaccination campaign - Congolese Information Agency.
article.articleSummary: Cholera vaccination campaign launched in Likouala, Republic of the Congo, with Impfondo the launch site on 25 November. Prefect Jean-Pascal Koumba inaugurated the preventive campaign targeting the elderly and children aged two years and above to complement hygiene promotion and access to drinking water, amid recurrent flooding that drives transmission. Vaccination teams will go door-to-door. Since 8 August, Likouala has recorded 734 cholera cases and 38 deaths as part of the evolving outbreak, according to the departmental crisis committee on floods and cholera. The launch followed a session evaluating the epidemic and response strategies, aided by audiovisuals to illustrate epidemiology and flood-related health consequences, aimed at strengthening coordination and field responses. The Prefect praised public authorities and thanked President Denis Sassou-N'Guesso and UN agencies for addressing the department’s humanitarian emergency.

triage.headline_ja: リクアラ州保健：県知事がコレラワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始 - コンゴ情報機関
triage.triage_reason: 8月以降734例・38人死亡の継続的コレラ流行があり、洪水による曝露継続、人道危機としてUN機関の支援を受けているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ共和国（リクアラ州、インポンド）のコレラ流行に関するものであり、DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）は本文中で言及されていないため対象国リストに該当する国は存在しない。コンゴ共和国自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com Mpox foge de hospital e prefeitura aciona polícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with Mpox escapes from hospital and city hall calls the police.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in a 36-year-old man in Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, Brazil, left Hospital Universitário after diagnosis, interrupting isolation and care. The notifiable Mpox patient, hospitalized in Divinópolis' central-west region, absconded, raising transmission concerns. Municipal Health Secretariat teams, including Social Outreach and the Street Clinic, are mobilized to locate him and restore medical care while enforcing isolation to prevent spread. City Hall also notified Civil and Military Police to assist in searches and related actions. Mpox, caused by monkeypox virus, transmits mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, secretions, and contaminated objects; maintaining isolation during the contagious period is essential. The incident highlights legal implications: Article 268 of the Brazilian Penal Code punishes violations of sanitary measures, with 1 month to 1 year’s detention and fines; additional penalties depend on circumstances. No current whereabouts provided.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox患者が病院から逃走、市当局が警察に通報
triage.triage_reason: 単発のMpox患者が隔離を離脱した個別事例であり、現時点で地域的な集団発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていないが、感染拡大リスクの観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一患者の隔離離脱事例であり、感染拡大の実態や新規症例数については不明。続報で地域内の感染状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode agravar falta de água no Nordeste e aumentar risco de doenças; entenda os perigos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could worsen water scarcity in the Northeast and increase the risk of diseases; understand the dangers.
article.articleSummary: El Niño-driven drought, extreme heat, and irregular water supplies threaten Northeast Brazil, elevating risks of gastrointestinal infections and expanding Aedes aegypti breeding habitats. The combination can limit access to safe drinking water and promote reliance on untreated or contaminated sources, increasing GI illness and diarrhea and potentially disrupting gut microbiota. Rural areas are especially affected; IBGE 2023 data show only 43.9% of rural households in the region rely on the general water network as their main supply. A national study across 1,814 municipalities found that a 5°C increase in daily mean temperature was linked to a 22% higher risk of hospitalization for GI infections in the following nine days, with infants under one year most affected. Water storage in open containers during drought can fuel dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. Region, season, and local conditions modulate impacts. A dossier with recommendations aims to reduce exposure during drought.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョが北東部ブラジルの水不足を悪化させ、病気のリスクを高める可能性；その危険性を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染者数や流行発生の報告ではなく、気候変動に伴う将来的なリスク予測・啓発記事であるため、現時点でのシグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、デング・ジカ・チクングニアの媒介蚊増加リスクへの言及があり経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Gavi secures 1.5 million vaccine doses as health workers flee violence in DRC
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak continues amid escalating violence that disrupts containment efforts. Gavi has secured access to up to 1.5 million doses of ChAdOx1 BDBV, an experimental Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine, through an advance purchase commitment announced on 24 November. The candidate vaccine, developed jointly by the Serum Institute of India and the University of Oxford, aims to help end the outbreak, described as the deadliest of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's 17 Ebola outbreaks. The outbreak persists with about 400–500 new cases weekly, bringing total confirmed cases to more than 11,600 and deaths to 5,678 since it began. Children account for more than a third of deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Luis Lobianco revela batalha da irmã contra tuberculose e faz alerta | Gshow
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Luis Lobianco reveals his sister's battle against tuberculosis and issues a warning | Gshow.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actor Luis Lobianco revealed his sister Isabela Teodoro battled tuberculosis after weeks of severe symptoms and misdiagnoses. The non-pulmonary TB affected her throat, with intense throat pain making it difficult to drink water, plus tremors, night sweats, high fever, weakness, and rapid weight loss. After multiple visits to both public and private clinics, doctors finally confirmed TB following additional evaluations by a pulmonologist. He emphasized that TB can affect any body part, not only the lungs. Isabela began treatment the day after confirmation through Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS). The regimen is strong and has heavy side effects, but she has begun to feel relief—no longer experiences pain when eating, and has regained taste. Lobianco urged followers to seek persistent symptoms and to trust a good doctor, noting early investigation can save lives.

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja más de 5,900 muertos en el Congo y la OMS declara emergencia internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves more than 5,900 dead in the Congo and the WHO declares an international emergency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 5,900 people and confirmed 12,021 cases as of November 26, 2026. The World Health Organization has declared it a public health emergency of international concern. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments, drives the surge, with a case-fatality rate of 49.1%. The epicenter is Ituri province (about 67.7% of cases), with transmission to 69 health zones across eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ubangi South and Ubangi North. The outbreak began in May 2026; it is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second deadliest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. About 3,332 recoveries; two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers; 85.1% of contacts are traced. Imported or linked cases have appeared in Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France, with some patients evacuated to Europe. Response includes rapid teams, treatment centers, checkpoints, and community outreach, but funding and security challenges persist.

triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、致死率49.1%で複数国への感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad Residents Flag Irregular Fogging, Seek Action To Curb Mosquito Menace
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad residents across Kukatpally, Manikonda, Peerzadiguda, Tukaram Gate, Seethaphalmandi, Chintal, Saidabad and Moosarambagh report a worsening mosquito menace amid irregular fogging by the City Municipal Corporation (CMC) across three municipalities. Several locals say fogging is intermittent or has not occurred in their areas, forcing families to rely on repellents and keep children out of parks. A CMC entomology official said fogging occurs every 15 days, with special teams deployed for malaria hotspots, but emphasized that fogging is only a minor component of control. The focus instead is on anti-larval operations, house visits and vector-borne disease awareness campaigns. Residents were urged to observe a weekly dry day to clear stagnant water, as authorities seek to strengthen Hyderabad's vector-control efforts as of 26 November 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la Monusco évacue dix soignants engagés dans la riposte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: MONUSCO evacuates ten health workers involved in the Ebola outbreak response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ten health workers involved in the Ebola outbreak response were evacuated on 25 November 2026 from Bunia, Ituri, in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, by MONUSCO peacekeepers. Among them was a physician and nurses from the Akwe regional reference hospital in Bunia; they were escorted to Mongbwalu and then airlifted to Bunia. The operation followed deteriorating security in Djugu Territory, with clashes between FARDC and the CRP in Fataki, Bule, and Gina. Bangladeshi UN blue helmets had established a mobile base on Nov 22 in Akwe, Damas and Mbidjo around Mongbwalu to protect civilians, but rough terrain, bad roads, and a fragile wooden bridge hampered the planned route. The evacuees’ work was central to the Ebola response and to safeguarding affected populations amid violence and displacement. MONUSCO’s involvement underscores protection of health personnel and securing access to care in outbreak areas.

article.articleHeadline: Especialista do HDT-UFNT orienta sobre prevenção da dengue durante período chuvoso. - O Jornal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HDT-UFNT specialist advises on dengue prevention during the rainy season. - The Journal.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention remains a year-round priority as rainfall boosts Aedes aegypti breeding, says Tobias Garcez, infectious disease specialist at the Hospital of Tropical Diseases, UFNT, part of HU Brasil. Individual actions to eliminate standing water—pots, under air conditioners, tires, or bottles—benefit the whole community. Dengue symptoms include sudden high fever, myalgia, retro‑orbital and joint pain, fatigue, rash, and GI symptoms; warning signs of severe dengue include persistent abdominal pain, intractable vomiting, spontaneous bleeding, or near‑syncope with low blood pressure, requiring urgent care. High‑risk groups: chronic kidney disease, hypertension, COPD, hematologic or cardiovascular disease; pregnant women require extra monitoring for complications. Aedes aegypti also transmits Zika and chikungunya. Vector control and vaccination are key; the Qdengua vaccine from Takeda is given in two doses, 3 months apart, currently to 10–14‑year‑olds. It was added to Brazil’s calendar in February 2024. HDT-UFNT has been part of Rede HU Brasil since 2015, under SUS.
