article.articleHeadline: L'implication des jeunes dans la Task force sollicitée pour vaincre Ebola à Beni (Secrétariat de la Task force Ebola) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The involvement of young people in the Ebola Task Force tasked with defeating Ebola in Beni (Secretariat of the Ebola Task Force) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 26 November 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, youths from various community groups were engaged by a member of the Ebola Task Force to mobilize against Ebola, urging voluntary participation as Beni currently serves as the epidemic’s epicenter. The Task Force is described as a temporary, mission-focused group aiming to minimize incidents and prevent spread, while rallying community leaders to take ownership of the Ebola response. The article notes that Beni imported the 17th Ebola outbreak from Ituri province, making it more affected than Mungwalu, the locality where the Bundibunjo Ebola strain was first identified. It also notes that some youths were among the earliest victims, linked to a perception of mass arrogance, underscoring the need for adherence to barrier measures and sustained community resilience to defeat Ebola.

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: casos voltam a crescer no Brasil; conheça a variante PJ.2.1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: cases are rising again in Brazil; meet the PJ.2.1 variant.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil, driven by the SARS-CoV-2 PJ.2.1 lineage, first identified in Canada in May and now detected across Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Rio Grande do Sul and Santa Catarina, with broader spread in eight states plus the Federal District. The WHO is monitoring PJ.2.1, assessing low additional risk to global health; no confirmed increase in severity or vaccine resistance. OPS/PAHO notes no proven higher transmissibility. IOC/Fiocruz sequencing (96/167 samples; Oct 17–Nov 6) found PJ.2.1 in 58% of samples. InfoGripe shows 17% positivity in the week ending Nov 7, the highest in 2026, with severe cases rising in eight states plus DF, though overall severity remains low. Vaccination remains key: updated vaccines neutralize PJ.2.1; antivirals via SUS within five days for older adults (60+) and immunocompromised; vaccine schedule: 60+ semestral dose; immunocompromised every six months; pregnant per pregnancy.

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo llega a 12.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo reaches 12,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 12,000 confirmed cases as of 26 November 2026, with about half of the 12,021 infections resulting in death. The fast-growing outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and has no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of the sick or deceased. Containment relies on rapid isolation and treatment, surveillance of exposed contacts, and safe burials, but is hampered by armed conflict, poor roads, and violence fueled by distrust and misinformation. Fighting resumed in Iga-Barrière near Bunia, causing renewed displacement toward Bunia, a major Ebola response hub in Ituri province. The Convention for the Revolution of the People (CRP) is one of more than 100 armed groups; it was founded last year by Thomas Lubanga.

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança em oito estados e DF: veja o que diz o alerta da Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 spreads to eight states and the Federal District: see what Fiocruz's alert says.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 drives renewed pressure in Brazil, responsible for 40.6% of deaths from respiratory viruses. InfoGripe shows rising hospitalizations for severe acute respiratory syndrome in eight states and the Federal District, though overall incidence remains below peaks. In four weeks, SARS-CoV-2 accounted for 22% of all positive diagnoses for severe respiratory infections nationwide. A new genetic lineage, PJ.2.1, has entered the WHO monitoring list and has been detected in several states and Brasília, with Rio de Janeiro reporting rising admissions tied to the variant. Fiocruz cautions attribution to PJ.2.1 is not definitive given limited sequencing. Rio de Janeiro sees most admissions among infants up to 2 years and elderly; Pará reports an alert due to infections in children and youths up to 14. Regions with increases: Southeast (SP, RJ, MG, ES); South (RS, SC, PR); Northeast (BA); Midwest (DF). Mato Grosso shows fluctuations; Rio reports co-circulation of metapneumovirus and influenza A/B.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19が8州と連邦直轄区で拡大：Fiocruzの警告内容
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19による入院が複数州で増加し、新たな遺伝系統PJ.2.1がWHO監視リスト入りしたが、因果関係は未確定で深刻な公衆衛生緊急事態や国際的拡大の明確な証拠はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 新変異株PJ.2.1がWHO監視リストに追加され複数州・連邦直轄区で検出されているが、Fiocruzは重症化との関連を確定的に断定していない。乳幼児・高齢者の入院増加、メタニューモウイルス・インフルエンザA/Bとの共流行も報告されており、今後の推移（変異株の拡大状況、重症度の確定）を継続的に監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Private Providers in Bengaluru Lack Awareness of Standards for Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: TB care standards in India (STCI) have not reached many private providers in Bengaluru, South India. A qualitative study using focus group discussions with private medical college specialists and in-depth interviews with freelancing subspecialists and general practitioners (Jan 2018–Jul 2019) found pervasive unawareness of STCI among private providers, a key component of India's TB service delivery. Barriers include a communication gap between the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) and private practitioners, absence of dissemination platforms (such as mobile apps), and limited ground-level implementation efforts. The study underscores the need for renewed NTEP outreach to percolate standards to private providers via digital platforms and direct, one-on-one engagement in Bengaluru to improve adherence to TB care guidelines.

article.articleHeadline: Guarapuava realiza Dia D de combate à dengue com serviços de saúde e atividades para crianças nesta sexta (27)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarapuava holds Dengue Fight Day with health services and activities for children this Friday (27).
article.articleSummary: Guarapuava, Brazil hosts Dia D de Enfrentamento às Arboviroses to combat dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. On Friday, 27 November 2026, from 9:00 to 16:00, activities occur on Rua Vicente Machado in front of the Guarapuava Bus Terminal, offering health services and educational outreach. The Guarapuava Health Surveillance team provides guidance, inspections, and basic screenings (blood pressure, glucose). Emphasis is on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites—avoid standing water, keep water tanks sealed, and clean gutters—to prevent arbovirus transmission. The program includes recreational activities for children, such as inflatables and a trampoline. Community participation is encouraged to sustain preventive measures year-round, especially during warmer, wetter periods. The event combines health promotion, vector-control education, and free health checks to raise awareness and reduce arbovirus risk.

article.articleHeadline: Nem toda ferida é igual: saiba identificar os sinais que podem indicar mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not all wounds are the same: learn to identify the signs that may indicate mpox.
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreaks continue in Brazil, with confirmed cases rising from 665 on 5 November to 1,170 by 18 November, per the Ministry of Health. In São Paulo, 348 cases were reported in 2026 as of 25 November, including 81 in October and 120 from 1–24 November. The mpox virus, in the same family as smallpox, largely follows a favorable course, but immunocompromised individuals are at higher risk of severe disease. Core symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, chills, weakness, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that can affect genitals, anus, mouth, face, hands, and feet. Diagnosis requires physician assessment and laboratory analysis of lesion material. Transmission occurs through direct contact with lesions, contaminated items, and prolonged close contact, not only sexual contact. Isolation, mask use, and hand hygiene are recommended until complete healing. Vaccination is offered by SUS to priority groups with a two-dose, 28-day interval schedule.

triage.headline_ja: すべての傷が同じではない：Mpoxを示す可能性のある兆候の見分け方
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続中のMpoxアウトブレイクにおける症例数増加（665→1170件）が報告されているが、記事自体は症状啓発を主目的とした教育的内容であり、新規の異常事象とは言えないため、症例数の推移を注視する。
triage.notes: 症例数は2026年11月5日の665件から11月18日の1170件へ増加しており継続的な拡大傾向にある。SUSによるワクチン接種体制は既に稼働しており、国内対応で管理可能とみられる。記事は主に症状識別に関する啓発内容。

article.articleHeadline: OMS monitora nova variante da Covid que já chegou ao ES; veja se linhagem é mais perigosa - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO monitors a new COVID-19 variant that has already reached Espírito Santo; see if the lineage is more dangerous - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, the World Health Organization is monitoring SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1, identified in Espírito Santo, Brazil, in 53.9% of Covid-19 samples from September–November 2026 (Sesa). The lineage has been detected in Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and the Federal District, based on 63 sequenced samples. In Espírito Santo, Covid-19 test positivity rose to 31.9%, up 8 percentage points week-over-week, with 5,566 cases in 2026 so far. The WHO classification as a variant under monitoring does not imply higher severity; mutations may favor transmission. First seen in Canada (May 2026), PJ.2.1 spread in North America in H2 2026 and reached Brazil by late August. Symptoms resemble flu or cold: fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose. SUS vaccines protect against severe disease; ventilation, masking, and care for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが新型コロナ変異株を監視、エスピリトサント州にも到達済み；より危険な系統か確認
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視対象とする新変異株(PJ.2.1)がブラジル複数州で確認され陽性率も上昇しているが、重症度増加の明確な根拠はなく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: WHOは本系統を『監視下の変異株』に分類しており、重症度上昇を示唆するものではないと明記されている。カナダは初検出地だが記事の主題はブラジル国内の拡大状況。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox en las Américas, comercio marítimo, Haití, conflicto y ébola...Las noticias del jueves. | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox in the Americas, Maritime Trade, Haiti, Conflict and Ebola... Thursday's News.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases are rising across the Americas. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) urges enhanced epidemiologic surveillance and preventive measures, including vaccination, as of January–November 2026. Thirteen countries in the region reported 3,269 confirmed mpox cases and four deaths. Brazil accounts for the largest burden with 1,325 cases, with a sustained rise since September. PAHO notes increasing detection of the Ib lineage variant in the region. The disease continues to disproportionately affect men who have sex with men. Transmission is mainly via close physical contact with an infected person. Common symptoms include skin rashes, fever, and myalgias. PAHO recommends individuals with compatible symptoms seek medical care and prioritizes vaccination for groups at higher risk of infection.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ大陸でのMpox、海上貿易、ハイチ、紛争とエボラ…木曜日のニュース。
triage.triage_reason: アメリカ大陸13カ国で3,269例・死亡4例が報告され、ブラジルが最大の症例数（1,325例）を占め9月以降増加傾向。Ib系統の検出増加という異常性もありIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はアメリカ大陸全体のMpox増加を報告しているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。スペイン（カナリア諸島）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Ib系統変異株の地域内検出増加が特記されており、クレードI/II双方の監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Officials: Ebola cases pass 12,000 in DR Congo, deaths rise to 5,900
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases and 5,900 deaths since the outbreak began six months ago. As of November 26, 2026, four eastern provinces—North Kivu, Ituri, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo—are affected, with Ituri accounting for about 67.7% of cumulative cases. Renewed armed clashes hamper aid work, with MONUSCO reporting significantly deteriorated security, widespread displacement, and threatened access to health services. A Bangladeshi Rapid Deployment Battalion evacuated 10 health workers sheltering at a hospital. While surveillance, laboratory capacity and contact tracing have improved, more than 80% of new infections are detected outside known contact lists, and gaps persist due to insecurity, population movement, mistrust, health-system constraints, PPE shortages, and funding gaps. Ebola risk remains very high in DR Congo and high in Kenya and Nigeria, where cases are reported without documented community transmission, with no new outbreak zones beyond the core area.

triage.headline_ja: 当局：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が12,000人を超え、死者数は5,900人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生が12,000例・死者5,900人に達し、治安悪化により対応が阻害されるなど深刻かつ国際的懸念が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア・ナイジェリアでもリスクが高いとされるが、両国とも地域コミュニティ感染の確認はなく対象国リスト外（ナイジェリア・ケニア・バングラデシュは対象国に含まれないためverified_locationsから除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu confirma segundo caso de mpox em menos de uma semana e investiga outras duas suspeitas - Acontece Botucatu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu confirms second mpox case in less than a week and investigates two other suspected cases - Acontece Botucatu
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Botucatu, São Paulo state, Brazil, reports two confirmed mpox cases in November, with a new patient a woman aged 30–34 confirmed by the São Paulo State Health Secretariat. The first case, a man 40–44, was diagnosed earlier in the week and managed at home without hospitalization. Two additional suspected mpox cases are under investigation, while a third notification has been ruled out. Reported symptoms include fever, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that can appear on the face, trunk, hands, feet, mouth, and genital region. Mpox spreads mainly through close contact with infected skin lesions, bodily secretions, or contaminated objects. Authorities advise symptomatic individuals to seek medical care and avoid close contact until evaluated. Botucatu remains under epidemiological monitoring to track progression and identify new infections.

triage.headline_ja: ボツカツ市で1週間以内に2例目のmpox症例を確認、他2件の疑い例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地域で少数のmpox症例が確認されているが、重症度は低く(自宅管理)、国際的拡大の兆候は現時点で乏しいため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 軽症例が中心で入院なし。地域保健当局が疫学監視を継続中。続報での感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Puducherry govt. intensifies dengue surveillance, preventive measures amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Puducherry UT (India) with over 1,510 cases reported through November 2026 and four deaths in recent weeks; 476 cases in November as of Nov 25, the year’s highest monthly spike. Identified hotspots include Mudaliarpet, Murungapakkam, Kosapalayam, Mettupalayam, Reddiyarpalayam, Lawspet, Gorimedu and urban areas of Villianur and Ariyankuppam. In response, the government has launched emergency measures, holding high-level meetings, intensifying fogging, anti-larval work, public campaigns, cleaning, and surveillance; implementing dry day observances in schools, source reduction, fever surveillance, and introducing larvivorous fish; Rapid Response Teams comprise medical officers, ANMs, ASHA workers, nurses, and LAD staff. Hospitals expanded fever beds (GH: 38; Medical College: 72) though bed occupancy is high. Officials urge residents to maintain clean surroundings, seek testing at government hospitals for fever, and avoid self-medication or using aspirin/ibuprofen without medical advice. Dengue symptoms include high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, rashes, nausea.

triage.headline_ja: ポンディシェリ州政府、デング熱症例増加を受け、サーベイランスと予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例4件・症例1,510件超と公衆衛生への影響が見られ、ベクター媒介疾患としての流行継続性があり、行政が緊急対応を開始している（WPRO基準3項目該当、行政関心あり）ため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドにおいて季節性の流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死亡者数増加と病床逼迫が見られるため、国内公衆衛生対応の経過観察・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola und Krieg in der DR Kongo: Kongos Aufständische gehen viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and war in the DRC: Congo's insurgents go viral.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri region continues amid heavy fighting. Since May, official figures report about 12,000 Ebola infections and roughly 6,000 deaths. In Iga Barrière, near Mongbwalu, fighting by the CPR militia led by Thomas Lubanga disrupted Ebola operations headquartered in Bunia, with seven people killed in a UN-reported firefight; the town was retaken on Tuesday, and by Thursday the corridor stood within about 25 kilometers of Bunia, a city of nearly one million. In the south, the M23/FRN coalition under ex-president Joseph Kabila expanded along Lake Edward, driving mass displacement toward Beni, 150 km south of Bunia, where the army has its main headquarters. Islamist ADF forces also attacked villages and Ebola centers, further hindering containment and endangering patients and health workers; UN peacekeepers have evacuated healthcare staff.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラと戦争：コンゴの反乱軍が拡散
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で大規模なエボラ流行（感染約12,000人、死亡約6,000人）が継続しており、武装勢力との戦闘により対応が妨げられ、国連職員の避難や保健従事者への危険が生じている。重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際支援も必要とされているためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率が約50%と非常に高く、通常のエボラ流行と比べても異常。武装勢力（CPR、M23/FRN、ADF）による攻撃で封じ込め対応が著しく妨げられており、紛争下での公衆衛生危機として重大視すべき。Australiaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文に記載なく除外。

article.articleHeadline: OPS alerta por viruela del mono; México registra 107 casos y dos muertes por mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO warns about monkeypox; Mexico reports 107 cases and two deaths from mpox.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) alert: PAHO/OPS reports rising detection of clade Ib mpox across nine Mexican states, especially Mexico City and Nuevo León, with 107 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in 2026. Of 30 clade Ib cases identified in 2025–2026, 22 were detected in the last eight weeks; 13 cases involve international travel, 17 are under investigation. Clade Ib, identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 2023, may have higher transmissibility; evidence on severity remains under study. In the Americas, 3,269 mpox cases and four deaths were reported Jan–Nov 2026 across 13 countries, Brazil accounting for 1,325 cases and 1 death. Transmission is via sexual and close physical contact; common symptoms include skin eruptions with lesions, fever, headache, sore throat, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and fatigue, lasting 2–4 weeks, with lesions on face, hands, genitals, anal region, and mouth. OPS urges stronger labs, timely detection, and vaccination as a complement to other measures; mpox remains circulating after the 2025 end of the international emergency.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOがサル痘（Mpox）について警告：メキシコで107例、2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxクレードtbの複数国への拡大、死亡例の発生、渡航関連症例の存在から国際的拡大リスクが高く、PAHOが支援強化を呼びかけているためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地域はメキシコ（対象国リスト外）だが、米州全体の集計値としてブラジルで1,325例・1死亡が報告されているためBrazilのみを対象国として計上。DRCはクレードIbの起源地として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地として記述されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta: Luis Lobianco desabafa e faz revelação sobre luta da irmã contra a tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: Luis Lobianco opens up and reveals his sister's battle against tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: On 26 November 2026, Brazilian actor and comedian Luis Lobianco disclosed on Instagram his sister Isabela Teodoro’s battle with tuberculosis. He described a prolonged diagnostic delay as early symptoms were repeatedly mistaken for a common cold or viral infection by both public and private healthcare providers. As the disease advanced, Isabela experienced fever, extreme weakness, tremors, night sweats, and severe sore throat that made drinking water painful before tuberculosis was confirmed. Lobianco warned that the bacteria are airborne and stressed the importance of a strong emotional and professional support network during treatment. He also highlighted the impact on families, with ongoing treatment updates shared publicly.

triage.headline_ja: アラート：ルイス・ロビアンコが胸の内を明かし、姉妹の結核との闘いについて告白
triage.triage_reason: 著名人の家族の個人的な闘病体験を扱った芸能記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一個人の闘病記であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての集団発生や異常な感染状況を示す情報はない。著名人関連で一定の社会的関心はあるが、疫学的シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: ജില്ലയിൽ പക്ഷിപ്പനി തുടർക്കഥ,​ കർഷകർക്ക് തീരാദുരിതം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian Influenza Saga Continues in the District, Farmers in Dire Straits.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza continues to afflict Alappuzha district, Kerala, inflicting severe and recurring losses on poultry farmers, including smallholders, threatening thousands of livelihoods. Calls focus on moving beyond temporary post-outbreak compensation toward long-term preventive measures. Migratory waterfowl visiting Vembanad Lake, Kuttanad, and nearby paddy fields are under scientific scrutiny for health status and potential spillover to domestic flocks. Authorities urged to establish joint surveillance by the Wildlife and Animal Husbandry departments and to implement practical measures to minimize contact between wild and farmed birds. The objective is to protect migratory birds and farmers’ livelihoods alike. Independent inquiry is sought into interstate laboratory involvement and financial interests. Proposals advocate establishing a Virology Institute in Alappuzha to study avian and other viral diseases, assess foreign vaccines, and promote country-appropriate vaccine development. Government action is urgent to replace culling with vaccines and evidence-based prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 県内で鳥インフルエンザが継続、農家に深刻な被害
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザの継続発生で、渡り鳥から家禽へのスピルオーバーリスクが懸念されるが、ヒト感染の報告はなく公衆衛生への直接的影響は現時点で不明。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽（動物）における鳥インフルエンザの繰り返し発生と、それに伴う農家の経済的損失、渡り鳥との接触管理や監視体制強化の必要性を主題としている。ヒト感染例の記載はなく、影響カテゴリも'animals'のみ。地域はケララ州アラップーザ県（インド）。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola au Nord-Kivu : le gouverneur Évariste Somo demande le remplacement du représentant de l'Incident Manager | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in North Kivu: Governor Évariste Somo calls for the replacement of the Incident Manager's representative | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces coordination challenges as military Governor Évariste Somo Kakule calls for replacing the Incident Manager's representative, Célestin Mwanzebe Mpoyi. In a letter to the Minister of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare, Somo cites insufficient collaboration between Mpoyi’s delegation and the provincial coordination, jeopardizing the synergy needed by responding teams to quickly control the outbreak. He notes that while Mpoyi was welcomed initially, the surveillance data available to the minister indicates the response has not achieved the required mobilization and effectiveness. Somo specifically blames the delegate for collaboration gaps and asks for a replacement with a cadre more willing to follow provincial directions and work closely with the coordination. The move highlights divergences within North Kivu’s Ebola response and a push for greater harmonization of interventions to master the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:北キブ州のエヴァリスト・ソモ知事がインシデントマネージャー代表の交代を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2基準に該当しやすい重篤疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州での対応体制の不調和が報じられており、国際的拡大リスクや管理可能性の観点から懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行の感染状況そのものよりも、対応体制の内部対立（州知事とインシデントマネージャー代表との調整不全）に焦点を当てている。既存のアウトブレイクであり新規発生ではないが、対応の実効性低下が流行制御に影響する可能性があるためPICKUPとした。

article.articleHeadline: Amambai aposta em mosquito estéril para combater a dengue em MS - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amambai bets on sterile mosquitoes to fight dengue in Mato Grosso do Sul - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Amambai, Mato Grosso do Sul, will be the first municipality in the state and the third in Brazil to deploy sterile insect technique against Aedes aegypti. The program will be carried out in Aldeia Amambai with releases of sterilized male mosquitoes to mate with females, preventing the production of offspring and gradually reducing the population that transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Indigenous health agents and health professionals have received training, and traps have been installed to monitor mosquito presence and track the strategy. The releases are planned for Saturday, November 28, 2026 at 9:00 local time, at Escola Municipal Guarani Kaiowá. The article notes that, despite the technology, residents must still eliminate standing water and other breeding sites to maximize impact.

triage.headline_ja: アマンバイ市、マットグロッソ・ド・スル州でデング熱対策に不妊虫技術を導入へ
triage.triage_reason: これは蚊媒介感染症対策（不妊虫技術の導入）に関する予防的取り組みの報道であり、新規の感染症発生や異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊対策（不妊虫放出プログラム）の導入に関する内容であり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の報告ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Itajaí prevê soltar Wolbitos no começo de dezembro para combater dengue - Visor Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itajaí plans to release Wolbitos in early December to combat dengue - Visor News
article.articleSummary: Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti releases are planned in Itajaí, Brazil, starting early December 2026 to combat dengue. The Itajaí Department of Epidemiological Surveillance (DVE) participated in a national Wolbachia meeting in Curitiba (PR) on November 25, with support from the Ministry of Health and Fiocruz. The Wolbito (Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes) strategy aims to reduce transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya by diminishing the mosquitoes' ability to transmit these viruses. Itajaí joins municipalities already using the method or preparing implementation; the city’s dengue control program, led by coordinator Lúcio Vieira, views the releases as a key preventive measure to lower dengue cases and prevent deaths. The effort reflects a broader public health initiative to modify vector populations and interrupt transmission at the source.

triage.headline_ja: イタジャイ、12月初旬にデング熱対策としてウォルビト(ウォルバキア感染蚊)の放出を計画
triage.triage_reason: これはデング熱等の予防的ベクター対策（ウォルバキア法導入）に関する通常の公衆衛生プログラムの報道であり、異常な発生や緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の予防を目的としたウォルバキア感染蚊放出プログラムの計画報道であり、現行の流行や異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: João Pessoa registra 21 casos de Mpox e prefeitura reforça orientações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: João Pessoa records 21 Mpox cases and the city hall reinforces guidelines
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in João Pessoa: As of 26 November 2026, the Municipal Health Secretariat outlined the care pathway for suspected Mpox in the capital. Since January, João Pessoa reported 55 Mpox notifications: 21 confirmed, 10 under investigation, 23 discarded. Suspected cases should go to one of the UPAs, with care in isolated examination rooms to reduce exposure. The protocol includes case identification, diagnostic-sample collection, notification to Epidemiological Surveillance, and follow-up; hospital referral if needed. Diagnosed patients should isolate at home until skin lesions heal and crusts fall, per health-team guidance. Core symptoms: fever, body aches, and skin eruptions/lesions. Transmission is mainly by close contact with infected individuals, especially lesions and mucous membranes. Vaccination follows Ministry of Health criteria for groups such as people living with HIV/AIDS, PrEP users, and lab workers handling the virus; pre-exposure vaccination is at CRIE, Avenida Júlia Freire 35, Torre, Mon–Fri 8–12 and 13–16.

triage.headline_ja: ジョアン・ペソアでMpox 21例確認、市役所がガイドラインを強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一都市における既知疾患（Mpox）の局地的な症例報告であり、公衆衛生体制は整備されているが、継続的な発生動向の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの対応が確立されており、重症例や死亡の報告はない。市当局が既存プロトコルに基づき対応中であることから、現時点ではWATCHとする。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 12 тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo exceeded 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to escalate, with 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths reported as of a Thursday, marking the second-largest and deadliest outbreak since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The ongoing surge challenges health services due to delayed case detection, continued armed conflict, and an overwhelmed health system, compounded by the absence of approved treatments and vaccines for this Ebola strain. Africa CDC data cited in the report show only about 15% of new cases are known contacts, leaving most transmission chains undetected. Independent analysis by Reuters using satellite imagery suggests official mortality figures may substantially underestimate true fatalities, at least in two of the most affected districts. Transmission continues across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ確認症例数が12,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%・12,000人超の大規模流行で、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、武力紛争下で接触者追跡が困難なため国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリーではDRC国内の流行拡大のみが主題であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。Reuters独自分析では公式死亡者数が過小評価されている可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en RD del Congo supera los 12.000 contagios y 5.900 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 12,000 cases and 5,900 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths (as of Nov 24, 2026), with 66 new cases and 37 deaths reported in the last 24 hours. The global case-fatality rate stands at 49.1%, and about 1,092 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation, with contact tracing at 85.1%. The outbreak spans 69 health zones across eight provinces: Ituri; North Kivu; South Kivu; Upper Uele; Lower Uele; Tshopo; Ubangi North; Ubangi South. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for 67.7% of cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus maintains the situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. About two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, signaling delayed detection and tracing gaps. Africa CDC/UA warn the crisis could seed a continental outbreak amid insecurity and displacement. Cases linked to Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, with evacuations to France/Europe; vaccination efforts include Ervebo and experimental vaccines, though funding and security challenges impede response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行、感染者12,000人・死者5,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%・感染者12,000人超の大規模流行でWHOがPHEICを維持しており、近隣国への拡大や国際的な避難・支援が発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの関連症例、フランス/欧州への避難について言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないか、DRCでの流行に関連する二次的言及であるため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de mpox no Brasil chega a 1.499 casos em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox outbreak in Brazil reaches 1,499 cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox outbreaks in Brazil reach 1,499 confirmed cases by November 24, 2026, with 56 probable and 1,484 suspected, and one death in October in Rio de Janeiro. A November surge centers in SP, RJ and Ceará, with SP at 120 confirmed cases by November 24, up from 22 in September. The 2022 outbreak reached 10,591 cases and 14 deaths; 2024 had 1,989; 2025 1,075. On Nov 8 Brazil purchased 25,000 mpox vaccine doses through PAHO; price US$65 per dose; two doses 28 days apart; intradermal administration enables five doses per vial. Vaccination targets high-risk groups: people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 <200, PrEP users, lab workers handling mpox samples, and 18–49-year-olds with medium/high-risk exposure. Transmission occurs via close contact and sexual contact; MSM accounted for 92.8% of cases outside Africa; 96.3% of transmissions via sexual contact; 13.6% hospitalizations. Clade 1b appears predominant, with no increased lethality over clade 2b.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのMpox流行、2026年に1,499症例に達する
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例・入院例を伴う継続的なMpox症例増加（特にサンパウロ州で急増）が確認されており、IHR基準の2項目（深刻性・異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 2026年11月時点でサンパウロ州の症例が9月22件から11月120件へ急増。PAHO経由でワクチン2.5万回分を調達済みで、国内対応は進行中。クレード1bが優勢だが致死率はクレード2bと同程度とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Lobianco relata demora em diagnóstico de tuberculose da irmã: 'Muita dor'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lobianco reports delay in diagnosing his sister's tuberculosis: 'So much pain'.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actor Luis Lobianco described delays in diagnosing his sister, Isabela Teodoro, who was ultimately diagnosed with throat tuberculosis (laryngeal TB). Initial symptoms—similar to flu, with severe sore throat, tremors, night sweats, fever, weakness, and eventual weight loss—led doctors in both public and private sectors to treat her condition as a viral illness. After weeks of worsening symptoms, Isabela independently suspected TB via online AI tools; a professional confirmed the diagnosis, which required an invasive secretion test that demanded anesthesia. Scheduling proved difficult, with weeks-long delays, until an emergency visit enabled a pulmonologist consult within the public system (SUS). As of 2026-11-26, she receives treatment through SUS, reports no remaining pain and regained taste, though remains weak. The account highlights diagnostic delays and the impact on care access in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ロビアンコ氏、妹の結核診断の遅れを語る:「とても辛かった」

article.articleHeadline: Pilus Genes Sbp1 and Sbp3 Modulate Streptococcus Suis Virulence and
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis, serotype 2, sequence type 1 from Thailand (strain 26154) drives virulence via the srtBCD pilus island. Inactivation of pilus-associated genes sbp1 or sbp3 diminishes damage to human epithelial monolayers and impairs early bacterial attachment and internalization, without affecting in vitro growth. RNA profiling shows broad transcriptional down-regulation across the srtBCD locus and key virulence determinants in both mutants, with sbp1 deletion nearly abolishing transcription throughout the cluster, while sbp3 deletion yields substantial but less complete repression. Biofilm assays reveal divergent effects: Δsbp3 markedly reduces early and sustained biofilm formation; Δsbp1 reduces early biomass but accumulates more biofilm during maturation. These results indicate sbp1 and sbp3 regulate virulence beyond pilus structure, affecting CC1-associated lineages and zoonotic potential. The pathogen causes costly disease in swine and severe invasive infections in humans.

article.articleHeadline: Alerta | Secretaria de Saúde confirma primeiro caso de mpox em Rondonópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert | Health Department confirms first mpox case in Rondonópolis.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) case confirmed in Rondonópolis, Mato Grosso, Brazil. The patient, a man, had sexual contact with someone who recently traveled to Brazil’s Northeast region. He presented at a private hospital in Rondonópolis and was seen by an infectious disease specialist. After notification to the Municipal Health Secretariat on November 19, the Central Laboratory of Mato Grosso (Lacen-MT) confirmed mpox infection. Epidemiological Surveillance in Rondonópolis and the State Health Secretariat (SES/MT) have been notified and are conducting routine follow-up and surveillance actions. Mpox is caused by mpox virus (MPXV), an Orthopoxvirus. Symptoms typically include fever and headache, with primary skin lesions; most cases are mild to moderate but complications can occur in immunocompromised individuals. Transmission occurs mainly through close direct contact with an infected person (skin lesions, wounds, crusts, secretions, bodily fluids), as well as contaminated objects and, with prolonged close respiratory contact."

article.articleHeadline: В Петербурге госпитализировали двух человек с оспой обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people with monkeypox were hospitalized in St. Petersburg.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, two travelers from Thailand were hospitalized in St. Petersburg, Russia, with laboratory-confirmed monkeypox. Both patients were promptly admitted to an infectious-disease hospital; their condition is stable and life-threatening risk is absent. An epidemiological investigation was conducted, with a full set of anti-epidemic measures implemented. The scope of contact persons was established, and those contacts are under continuous medical supervision. Officials stated that transmission has been prevented and that these are imported cases, with no evidence of ongoing local spread. The response highlights rapid hospitalization, laboratory confirmation, contact tracing, and isolation to curb spread. No additional cases have been reported among travelers or healthcare workers.

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் பாதிப்பு: கடலூா் மாவட்டத்தில் மேலும் 10 ஆயிரம் கோழிகள் அழிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu impact: a further 10,000 chickens have died in Cuddalore district.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) outbreak in Tamil Nadu's Cuddalore district, with Nochiikkadu in Naduthittu area reporting two poultry farms where more than 10,000 chickens were culled on Thursday. NIHSAD in Bhopal confirmed H5N1 on a farm at Kattiyanguppam on Nov 13. Following central guidelines, over 50,000 chickens within a 1 km radius of the infected premises were slaughtered. Control measures include disinfection, movement restrictions, and a three-month ban on chicken farming and sales in affected areas. A national surveillance team from NCDC and state authorities assessed the human infection risk on Nov 21. Separately, two farms near Nochiikkadu’s Naduthittu area reported sudden chicken deaths on Wednesday and Thursday; samples were sent to the Namakkal diagnostic lab and large pits dug to bury 10,000+ birds with pesticide powder spread. Residents question why preemptive action wasn’t taken earlier; officials have not yet explained.

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da covid-19 já circula em oito estados brasileiros e entra sob monitoramento da OMS; veja os sintomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant is already circulating in eight Brazilian states and is under monitoring by the WHO; see the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, the World Health Organization is monitoring SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1, a descendant of Omicron, now predominant in samples analyzed by Fiocruz in Rio de Janeiro. The variant has also been detected in São Paulo, Paraná, Bahia, Espírito Santo, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina and the Federal District. WHO regards the added public health risk as low, though PJ.2.1 may bind ACE2 more efficiently, potentially increasing transmissibility versus other lineages such as XFG. The rise in COVID-19 cases is not solely attributed to this lineage; low vaccination coverage and reduced preventive measures likely contribute. Symptoms resemble typical respiratory infections: fever, body aches, runny nose, cough, hoarseness, sore throat. Vaccination should continue to be updated, especially for elderly, immunocompromised, pregnant, children under 5; boosters every six months for older/immunocompromised; routine vaccination for 6 months–<5 years; one dose per pregnancy; health workers per SUS calendar.

triage.notes: WHOは追加的な公衆衛生リスクを低いと評価。感染力増加の可能性はあるが重症度上昇の明確な証拠はなく、ワクチン接種率低下や予防対策の緩みも症例増加の要因とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Alta da Covid-19 em 2026: o que saber sobre o vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 surge in 2026: what to know about the virus
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 surge in Minas Gerais, Brazil, Oct–Nov 2026: SARS-CoV-2 positivity rose from 1.19% to 10.87% in five weeks, with Fiocruz noting rising SRAG cases linked to COVID-19. Hospitalizations remain low and current waves are generally less intense, not signaling a new pandemic. Factors include circulation of new variants and waning immunity; MG's vaccination coverage is 54.96%, far below the 90% target. A new lineage, PJ.2.1, identified in Brazil in the second half of 2026, is more transmissible; no evidence yet of worse disease or reduced vaccine protection. PJ.2.1 has been detected in MG, SP, ES, PR, RS, SC, MT, and DF, but data are insufficient to prove direct links to case increases. Symptoms include sore throat, runny nose, cough, fever, headache, fatigue, myalgia, anosmia/ageusia, and diarrhea; some infections are asymptomatic. Testing uses rapid antigen and RT-PCR; vaccination remains free via SUS, with boosters advised for older adults and high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年のCOVID-19急増：このウイルスについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州で新変異株PJ.2.1によるCOVID-19陽性率上昇が報告されているが、重症化や入院増加の明確な証拠はなく、パンデミックの兆候ではないとされているため、継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 新変異株PJ.2.1は感染性が高いとされるが、病原性増強やワクチン効果低下の証拠はなし。入院率は低く、現時点では季節的な流行の範囲内と評価される。ワクチン接種率が目標の90%を大きく下回る54.96%である点は今後の感染拡大要因として注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Isiro: les fidèles catholiques appelés à appliquer les mesures barrières - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Isiro: Catholic faithful urged to apply barrier measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Isiro-Niangara diocese, Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompted Catholic leaders to urge barrier measures and hygiene practices. During the tenth anniversary of his episcopate, Bishop Dieudonné Madrapile urged parishioners to follow health authorities’ preventive messages and to protect themselves as the Ebola epidemic persists. He highlighted faith’s historic role in curbing epidemics and called Christians to maintain firm prayer while adhering to hygiene and preventive guidelines. The appeal was delivered in the Maranatha prayer room of the charismatic renewal, with Bishop Emile Mushosho of Mahagi-Nyoka present. Madrapile is also Apostolic Administrator of Isangi. The report underscores ongoing Ebola concerns in the region and the need to combine spiritual commitment with public health guidance; no case counts are provided.

article.articleHeadline: Madárvonulás: mekkora a járványügyi kockázat?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird Migration: How Large Is the Epidemiological Risk?
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, autumn wild bird migration raises infectious disease concerns for poultry. While migratory waterfowl can carry avian influenza virus, risk to poultry farms cannot be attributed solely to migrating birds. Avian influenza viruses exist as low-pathogenic (LPAI) and high-pathogenic (HPAI) lineages. LPAI infections in birds are often mild or asymptomatic; HPAI can cause rapid disease progression with massive mortality in domestic poultry, notably turkeys and chickens. The influenza virus is highly mutable, with genetic reassortment potentially altering pathogenicity, virulence, and host range. Migratory birds can introduce the virus, but farm introduction and spread have multiple routes beyond wild birds. Since 1959, Scotland first isolated an HPAI strain; in 1997 Hong Kong reported the first human infections and deaths, though sustained human-to-human transmission has not been observed. High-density poultry farms warrant strict biosecurity; ongoing surveillance and modeling are essential.

triage.triage_reason: 本記事は渡り鳥とHPAI/LPAIに関する一般的な疫学解説記事であり、1959年スコットランドや1997年香港の歴史的事例を背景説明として引用しているに過ぎず、現在進行中の具体的な発生事例を報じていない。
triage.notes: 記事は鳥インフルエンザの一般的な疫学背景（LPAI/HPAIの違い、遺伝子再集合、サーベイランスの重要性）を解説する教育的内容であり、特定の対象国における新規発生報告ではない。1959年スコットランド初分離、1997年香港での初のヒト感染・死亡例は歴史的文脈としての言及のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Стало известно о состоянии новых пациентов с оспой обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The condition of new monkeypox patients has become known.
article.articleSummary: Two people in Saint Petersburg have been diagnosed with monkeypox after returning from Thailand. Lab confirmation confirmed the diagnosis; both patients are in an infectious disease hospital under medical supervision, with their condition described as satisfactory and not life-threatening. A circle of close contacts has been identified and are under observation, and anti-epidemic measures are in place; authorities say the outbreak risk is contained. Monkeypox spreads via close physical contact (touch, kissing, sexual contact) and via contaminated objects; infected animals (not only monkeys but rodents) can also transmit the virus. In mid-October, five monkeypox patients were reported in Saint Petersburg, with similar stable status. In April 2026, Russia’s Rospotnadzor head Anna Popova described the global situation as tense but ruled out domestic spread or a new pandemic. Imported cases highlighted; surveillance ongoing.

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgını ülke tarihinin en büyüğü oldu! Aşısı ve onaylı tedavisi yok
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo became the largest in the country's history! There is no vaccine or approved treatment.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo lineage in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths, the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. It began in May in Ituri province (246 suspected cases, 65 deaths) and has spread to eight provinces, including Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, amid conflict and community resistance. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola virus; North Kivu has the highest fatality rate (over 55% of confirmed cases). The WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17 after cases were detected in Uganda; Kenya reported its first imported Ebola case on October 6. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak—primarily in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone—caused about 30,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Iracemápolis registra 10 casos de Covid e reforça importância da vacinação | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Iracemápolis records 10 COVID-19 cases and reinforces the importance of vaccination | Rápido no Ar.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases in Iracemápolis, Brazil total 10 from February, March, April, May, June and November 2026, with one hospitalization and no deaths to date. The municipal Health Department emphasizes vaccination as the main tool to prevent complications, hospitalizations, and deaths, noting that SARS-CoV-2 remains circulating in Brazil and in São Paulo state in 2026. Public health guidance targets high-risk groups, including older adults, pregnant individuals, the immunocompromised, and people with chronic conditions. Vaccination is available at USF Dr. Angelo Arlindo Lobo by appointment via WhatsApp (19) 99704-2182, with clinic hours 7:00–12:00 and 13:00–15:30. Additional prevention measures include well-ventilated environments, frequent hand hygiene, covering coughs/sneezes, avoiding close contact when symptomatic, masking for those with symptoms, and seeking medical care for persistent or worsening symptoms. Monitoring uses e-SUS Notifica, SIVEP-Gripe, and NIES to track cases and severe outcomes.

Rospotrebnadzor notes that diagnostic test systems permit rapid detection of the monkeypox virus, supporting quick confirmation and outbreak management. The report emphasizes ongoing monitoring by the regional Rospotrebnadzor service and a cautious approach while awaiting laboratory results. Thailand is identified as the travel origin; no symptom details or exact exposure dates are provided.

article.articleHeadline: Mpox en las Américas, comercio marítimo, Haití, conflicto y ébola...Las noticias del jueves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox in the Americas, maritime trade, Haiti, conflict, and Ebola... Thursday's news.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is rising in the Americas: 3,269 laboratory‑confirmed cases and 4 deaths across 13 countries in Jan–Nov 2026, led by Brazil with 1,325 cases and a rise since September. The Pan American Health Organization notes increasing detection of the Ib variant and that the disease continues to disproportionately affect men who have sex with men. Transmission is mainly via close contact; common symptoms include skin rashes, fever, and muscle pains. Vaccination and strengthened surveillance for at‑risk groups are urged. In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, Ebola virus disease outbreaks persist; MONUSCO has intensified protection for civilians and health workers amid fighting, with displacement threatening essential services. Ten health workers were evacuated after more than three days at Akwe hospital; four days earlier, 380 civilians were returned to a camp housing about 70,000. Haiti’s health system is strained, with only 24.5% of facilities fully functional and about 4.9 million people needing care in 2026, prompting calls for sustained international support and protection of health personnel.

triage.notes: 記事は複数トピックのまとめニュースで、Mpox（ブラジル中心、Ib variant増加）とDRC・Ituri州のエボラ流行継続、ハイチの医療崩壊を扱う。ハイチ・スペイン（カナリア諸島）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has spread to 8 provinces! The death toll has approached 6,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to eight provinces, with 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths reported, per the DRC Ministry of Health via Anadolu Agency, as of 26 November 2026. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or treatment, and WHO calls this the largest Ebola outbreak recorded in the DRC to date. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri province (initial 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths) and has expanded to Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri now the outbreak center and North Kivu showing >55% case fatality. Cross-border spread includes Uganda and Kenya; WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Kenya reported its first imported case on Oct 6, with a US-backed 50-bed quarantine center halted by court order amid local resistance. Background: the 2014 West Africa outbreak caused ~11,000 deaths.
