triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みで、DRC史上最大のエボラ流行とされる。

article.articleHeadline: debotuca: Botucatu confirma segundo caso de mpox em novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: debotuca: Botucatu confirms second mpox case in November.
article.articleSummary: Botucatu, Brazil, confirms second mpox (monkeypox) case in November 2026. The patient is a woman aged 30–34, with laboratory confirmation by the State Health Secretariat. The two mpox cases reported in Botucatu occurred this November; the first case was a man aged 40–44. The municipality is actively investigating two additional suspected mpox cases, while one notification was discarded after evaluation. mpox, previously known as monkeypox, is being monitored by local health authorities as part of ongoing surveillance during a period of apparent local activity. The article does not provide details on exposure or travel for the cases.

triage.headline_ja: ボトゥカトゥ市、11月に2例目のmpox症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方都市でmpox症例が2例確認され、疑い例の調査も継続中だが、重症度や感染経路等の詳細情報が不足しており、国際的拡大の兆候も明確でないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方ニュース記事であり、地域の公衆衛生当局によるサーベイランスの一環として報告されている。疑い例が複数調査中であり、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Двоих зараженных оспой обезьян госпитализировали в Петербурге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people infected with monkeypox were hospitalized in Saint Petersburg.
article.articleSummary: Two new monkeypox cases were detected in Saint Petersburg, Russia, involving two men who recently returned from Thailand. Diagnostic tests confirmed monkeypox infection. Both patients were hospitalized, transferred to a separate isolation unit, and their condition described as satisfactory and not life-threatening. Rospotrebnadzor epidemiologists launched a full anti-epidemic investigation and implemented the standard containment measures. Authorities traced contacts who had interacted with the travelers before hospitalization and began medical monitoring; officials said further spread in Saint Petersburg is unlikely. Monkeypox is a rare viral disease caused by a virus related to smallpox; typical symptoms include high fever and a rash. This autumn 2026, the city has seen multiple cases, with five people hospitalized in October and all surviving.

triage.headline_ja: サンクトペテルブルクでサル痘（エムポックス）感染者2名が入院
triage.triage_reason: ロシア国内での輸入症例2件であり、症状は軽微で封じ込めも実施済み。対象国（タイ）は渡航歴として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はロシアであるため対象外。
triage.notes: 患者はタイから帰国した渡航者だが、感染確認・入院・対応はロシア（サンクトペテルブルク）で行われており、タイでの発生事実はサマリーから確認できないため対象国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진 만2천명 넘어...시신 관리 혼란에 유가족 분통
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000... bereaved families outraged by chaos in handling the dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 cumulative confirmed cases, with 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths (case fatality 49.1%) as of November 24, 2026. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Amid rising cases, families report chaotic corpse handling, including inability to locate loved ones, lack of notification before burial, and alleged disappearance of bodies from morgues. Insecurity with rebel clashes forcing evacuation of health workers, plus wage arrears at treatment facilities and checkpoints, hampers outbreak control. WHO notes about two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers. Cross-border risk is raised by Kenya, which reports 9 cases and 2 deaths; legal controversy over US-supported isolation facilities underscores systemic weaknesses and community mistrust in the response.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラ確認症例が1万2000人を突破…遺体管理の混乱に遺族が怒り
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）累計12,021例・致死率49.1%という重大な公衆衛生危機であり、ケニアへの越境拡大、治安悪化による対応能力低下、ワクチン・治療法不在など複数のIHR・WPRO基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ケニアでの9例・死亡2例の報告や米国支援の隔離施設に関する法的論争も記載されているが、対象国リストにケニア・米国は含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率49.1%、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株である点、反政府勢力の衝突による医療従事者避難、遺体管理の混乱によるコミュニティの不信感も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Itaúna registra morte por Covid-19 e 546 casos confirmados da doença em novembro - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itaúna records a death from COVID-19 and 546 confirmed COVID-19 cases in November - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Itaúna, Brazil, reports 546 confirmed COVID-19 cases from 1–26 November, with four hospitalizations and one death due to Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) associated with COVID-19. Leading symptoms include hoarseness, sore throat, dry cough, runny nose, fever, fatigue, and body/head pains. Epidemiological Surveillance notes that hoarseness alone does not confirm infection with the new variant; diagnosis requires testing, and lineage identification demands specialized analysis. To boost care, three Basic Health Units—UBS Parque Jardim, UBS Cidade Nova, and UBS Padre Eustáquio—operate extended hours (7:00–22:00, Monday–Friday); vaccination against COVID-19 is available there and at UBS Central (7:00–16:00). The Health Secretariat advises symptomatic individuals to seek their reference UBS; if positive, the unit team will monitor and guide recovery.

triage.headline_ja: イタウナ市、11月にCOVID-19による死亡1例と確定症例546例を記録 - Portal MPA
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の地方自治体レベルでの通常の月次報告であり、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、地域の通常の感染状況報告（ルーティンサーベイランス）に該当する。死亡1例、入院4例と重症度は低く、地域の医療体制（UBS）で対応可能とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Mpox dobram e chegam a quatro no Piauí; nove pacientes continuam em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases double and reach four in Piauí; nine patients remain under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Piauí, Brazil, has four confirmed cases in Teresina as of 26 November 2026, up from two three days earlier, with nine more under investigation. The first 2026 case was confirmed in October; three more in November, all men aged 30–39 (three) and 40–49 (one). Nationwide, Brazil reported 838 mpox cases in November (1,631 confirmed in 2026), plus 66 probable and 1,948 suspected, with one death. São Paulo leads with 605, Rio de Janeiro 474, Ceará 220; in the Northeast, 310 confirmed, 17 probable, 525 suspected, no deaths. Piauí ranks 17th with four confirmations, tied with Mato Grosso do Sul; 2025 had no confirmed cases. Transmission is by close contact; symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headaches, and weakness. Vaccination via SUS targets specific groups, two doses 28 days apart, not at UBS; available at CRIE (Hospital Infantil Lucídio Portella) and CTAs in Teresina; eligible groups include HIV with low CD4, PrEP users, lab workers, and 18–49-year-olds at medium/high risk.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州でMpox症例が倍増し4例に、9人の患者が調査継続中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続中のMpox流行の一部としての地域的症例増加報告であり、新規クレードや異常な変化は確認されていないが、症例増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル全土で2026年通算1,631例確認済みの既存流行の継続報告であり、Clade Iの言及はなくClade IIの既知流行と推測される。地域（ピアウイ州）レベルでの症例増加は全国的に見れば小規模。

article.articleHeadline: Jardim Eldorado recebe mutirão de limpeza, combate à dengue e atendimento à população de Cordeirópolis - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jardim Eldorado receives a cleanup drive, dengue control, and services for the residents of Cordeirópolis - Portal Veloz
article.articleSummary: Jardim Eldorado, in Cordeirópolis, launches Prefeitura Presente, a multi-secretariat effort to bring public services, environmental cleanup, health, education, and citizenship initiatives directly to neighborhoods. The first phase runs 27–28 November, starting with a Cata-Treco waste collection to remove items that can collect water and breed Aedes aegypti; residents should place materials outside their homes the evening before. On 28 November, the Day D against dengue occurs from 8:00 to 11:00, with awareness and prevention work by municipal staff alongside health agents; the Jardim Eldorado Health Post will offer various services. Escola Municipal Geraldo Rocha hosts environmental education activities, obstacle-by-breeding-site exchanges for prizes, PET bottle collection, reading corner, children’s workshops, cultural activities, and student project exhibits. If it rains, house visits are suspended. A second phase is scheduled for 5 December, 8:00–11:00, at the same school with public input, animal sterilization/microchip registration, and Cadastro Único guidance at CRAS Eldorado.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルディン・エルドラドでコルデイロポリス住民向けの清掃活動・デング対策・各種サービスを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地域デング予防啓発・清掃活動に関する記事であり、異常な発生や重症例・大規模流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例的な地域清掃・デング予防活動の告知であり、感染症アウトブレイクを示すものではない。発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが、イベントとしての異常性がないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Cases Top 12,000 as Fighting Forces Some Health Workers to Evacuate
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases and more than 5,900 deaths, spreading to eight of the DRC's 26 provinces. The outbreak, first detected in May in Mongbwalu, remains the deadliest among Congo's 17 outbreaks and is approaching the West Africa 2014-16 toll. About 15% of new cases come from contacts known to health authorities; undercounting may occur in hard-hit areas. No new cases have been reported in Kenya or Nigeria, and no other countries have confirmed cases, though regional readiness and cross-border surveillance are urged. Response is hindered by lack of community trust, poor infrastructure, and armed conflict between the army and rebel groups led by Thomas Lubanga. About a dozen people, including two WHO personnel, were evacuated to Bunia after three days trapped in Akwe; Mongbwalu teams were moved, with MONUSCO aiding evacuations amid difficult terrain and a damaged bridge.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱症例が12,000人を超え、戦闘により一部の医療従事者が避難を余儀なくされる
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyoウイルス）が12,000例・5,900人以上の死者を出し8州に拡大、武力紛争により対応が阻害されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で該当項目が多く、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでは新規症例なしと明記されており、これらは除外。コンゴ国内の武力紛争による対応阻害、MONUSCOによる支援、国境を越えたサーベイランスの必要性が強調されている。致死率の高さ（約49%）と2014-16年西アフリカ流行に迫る規模から重大な公衆衛生危機と判断。

article.articleHeadline: В Петербурге госпитализировали двух человек с оспой обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people hospitalized with monkeypox in St. Petersburg.
article.articleSummary: Two laboratory-confirmed monkeypox cases in Saint Petersburg, Russia, involve residents who recently returned from Thailand. Both patients are hospitalized in an infectious diseases hospital in satisfactory condition with no life threat; epidemiological tracing identified contacts under constant medical surveillance, and officials say transmission has been contained. Monkeypox is a rare viral disease more dangerous for the immunocompromised; early symptoms include fever, malaise, and lymphadenopathy, followed by a rash that progresses from macules to vesicles to ulcers with crusts. Mild cases typically resolve in about 14–21 days. Transmission occurs mainly through close skin-to-skin or mucosal contact and exposure to lesion contents or crusts; animal-to-human transmission is possible. Earlier in November, a 50-year-old man with monkeypox was admitted to Domodedovo Hospital in Moscow Region after returning from Barcelona; this was the region’s fourth case that month, with a stable condition.

triage.headline_ja: サンクトペテルブルクで2人がサル痘（エムポックス）で入院
triage.triage_reason: 発生はロシア国内（タイからの帰国者の輸入症例）であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではない。症状も軽症で感染拡大は制御されているとされる。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（サンクトペテルブルク・モスクワ）での輸入エムポックス症例についてであり、タイやスペインは感染者の渡航先として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではない。対象国リストに該当する発生国はないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: casos graves crescem em 8 estados e no DF com avanço da variante PJ.2.1 monitorada pela OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Severe Cases Rise in Eight States and the Federal District as the PJ.2.1 Variant Advances, Monitored by the WHO.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 severe cases rose in eight Brazilian states and the Federal District during 15–21 November 2026, with the PJ.2.1 lineage (Omicron descendant) detected in eight states plus DF, comprising 58% of Rio de Janeiro city samples (Oct 17–Nov 6, 2026). The WHO classified PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring on 19 November 2026; no evidence yet of increased clinical severity. SUS data show 180,105 SRAG cases in 2026, with 95,350 (52.9%) lab-confirmed for a respiratory virus. In the four weeks to 21 November, rhinovirus led positives (42.3%), followed by SARS-CoV-2 (22%), RSV (7.6%), influenza A (5.7%); COVID-19 SRAG deaths accounted for 40.6%. High SRAG by COVID-19 in Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Bahia and DF; Rio de Janeiro reports co-circulation with metapneumovirus and influenza A/B, affecting children <2 and the elderly. Pará at SRAG alert (children/adolescents ≤14; labs pending). PJ.2.1 first detected in Canada (May 2026); arrived in Brazil (Aug 2026). Fiocruz notes eight states + DF and rising hospitalizations in Centro-Sul and Bahia. Global context: mpox rising in the Americas; Ebola Bundibugyo in DRC/Uganda; measles and cholera outbreaks noted.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：WHOが監視中のPJ.2.1変異株の拡大に伴い、8州および連邦直轄区で重症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視対象に指定した新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル国内で急速に拡大し、複数州で重症COVID-19症例と関連死亡が増加しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内のCOVID-19新変異株PJ.2.1の拡大と重症化動向が主題。DRC/UgandaのEbola、mpox、麻疹、コレラ等はグローバル文脈として言及されているのみで、本記事の発生地域としては該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Makin Meluas di Kongo, 5.904 Orang Meninggal dan 8 Provinsi Terdampak : Okezone News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak Spreading Further in Congo, 5,904 People Dead and 8 Provinces Affected: Okezone News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is escalating, with confirmed cases exceeding 12,000 and 5,904 deaths as of 26 November 2026, per the Ministry of Health. Cumulative cases reach 12,021, including 5,904 fatalities. The outbreak has expanded from one province in May to eight provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi. Ongoing transmission is increasingly difficult to control due to armed conflict, security disruptions, and community resistance to health interventions. In response, Ebola teams have been temporarily relocated from Mongbwalu pending a security reassessment. The report underscores a rising containment challenge amid conflict and access barriers across the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行がさらに拡大、死者5,904人、8州に影響：Okezoneニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が8州に拡大し、1万2千人超の症例と約6千人の死者を出しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 紛争・治安悪化とコミュニティの抵抗により封じ込めが困難化しており、致死率も高い（約49%）。国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D em Coxim conscientiza sobre combate a dengue em pontos da cidade neste sábado - O melhor da informação!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day in Coxim raises awareness about the fight against dengue at various locations around the city this Saturday - The best in information!
article.articleSummary: Dengue, Zika, and chikungunya prevention efforts are underway in Coxim, Brazil, via a D-Day awareness campaign by the City Hall’s Municipal Health Secretariat and Vector Control Coordination. On Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 08:00 to 10:00, teams will conduct four educational operations at key city locations—the traffic lights at Avenida Virgínia Ferreira and Avenida Filinto Müller (downtown), Praça dos Pescadores, and in Silviolândia near the first speed bump on Avenida Luiz Gonzaga. Working with Endemic Disease Control Agents and Community Health Agents, they will display banners and hand out informational leaflets to motorists and pedestrians. The campaign aims to instruct residents on domestic practices to eliminate standing water, reduce Aedes aegypti breeding sites, and lower the number of notified arbovirus cases of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in Coxim.

triage.headline_ja: コキンでデング熱対策啓発のD-デー、今週土曜日に市内各所で実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生啓発活動に関する記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱）の予防啓発キャンペーンに関する内容であり、具体的な感染拡大や症例急増の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Após visitar comunidade do 'ET Bilu', atriz Rosa Marya é internada com leishmaniose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After visiting the 'ET Bilu' community, actress Rosa Marya is hospitalized with leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: Actress Rosa Marya Colin, known for playing Tia Nastácia in the 2007 Sítio do Picapau Amarelo, is hospitalized at Humap-UFMS to treat leishmaniasis. She had been visiting the Zigurats community in Corguinho, Mato Grosso do Sul, where the ET Bilu story gained notoriety, and stayed about a week before symptoms began. As of November 26, 2026, she remains in hospital receiving medications and antibiotics; doctors expect another week of treatment. Leishmaniasis is transmitted by female sandflies; skin ulcers are common, with possible internal organ involvement in severe cases. The SUS provides free medicines for all forms, and early treatment leads to cure. Local authorities report concerns about outsiders arriving infected and transmission to residents near vegetation. Fumigation was not authorized by the state due to habitat and potential impacts on bees. Suspected cases also in Furnas da Boa Sorte, Assentamento Vista Alegre, and other rural Corguinho areas.

triage.headline_ja: 『ET Bilu』コミュニティ訪問後、女優ロザ・マリヤがリーシュマニア症で入院
triage.triage_reason: 単発の著名人感染例だが、同地域で複数の疑い症例が報告されており、媒介生物(サシチョウバエ)による地域内伝播の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: リーシュマニア症はブラジルの一部地域で地方病的に発生しており、本件は著名人の感染報道だが、周辺地域での複数疑い症例や防除（燻蒸）対応の制約など地域的な公衆衛生対応の課題を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 aumenta casos no Brasil e SC é um dos primeiros estados atingidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant increases cases in Brazil, and Santa Catarina is one of the first states affected.
article.articleSummary: SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 detected in Santa Catarina and eight other Brazilian states, per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin (Nov 26, 2026). The variant, classified by the WHO as a variant under monitoring, was identified via IOC/Fiocruz sequencing and may be more transmissible. Santa Catarina is among the first states with circulation; Fiocruz reports rising SRAG cases caused by coronavirus in the state, though overall incidence remains low. Other confirmed detections: Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, and the Federal District. While genomic data are not yet enough to link PJ.2.1 to case increases, vaccines continue to protect against severe disease. Semana Epidemiológica 46 (Nov 15–21) shows rising severe Covid-19 across Centro-Sul: MG, SP, RJ, ES, PR, SC, RS, plus DF and Bahia; MT oscillates. National SRAG: 180,105 cases in 2026; 95,350 lab-confirmed; SARS-CoV-2 accounts for 22% of positives and 40.6% of deaths in the last four weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がブラジルで症例増加、サンタカタリーナ州が最初に影響を受けた州の一つに
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下変異株に分類した新系統PJ.2.1がブラジル複数州で確認され、重症呼吸器症候群（SRAG）報告が増加しているため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOが監視下変異株（variant under monitoring）に分類したPJ.2.1がFiocruz/IOCのゲノム解析で複数州から検出。伝播性増加の可能性があるが、現時点で症例増加との因果関係は未確定。ワクチンは重症化予防に有効とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz explica nova linhagem da Covid-19 e reforça importância da vigilância genômica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz explains new lineage of COVID-19 and reinforces the importance of genomic surveillance.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-26, the identified COVID-19 lineage PJ.2.1 underscores the need for genomic surveillance and international monitoring. A Fiocruz virologist explains how the World Health Organization classifies new lineages to track variant behavior and regional circulation, guiding public health responses. Genomic surveillance detects genetic changes, monitors dissemination, and analyzes evolution over time to help manage ongoing virus circulation. Vaccines remain a focus, with calls to continuously review scientific data to assess the epidemiological scenario. Importantly, the PJ.2.1 designation alone does not imply increased disease severity or reduced vaccine protection. The interview details lineage classification, vaccine response considerations, and the researchers’ ongoing monitoring efforts.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス、COVID-19新系統を解説しゲノムサーベイランスの重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 新系統PJ.2.1の検出自体は重症度や感染性の増加を示すものではなく、専門家による一般的なゲノムサーベイランスの解説記事であり、緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は新系統PJ.2.1について科学的解説を行う内容で、重症度増加やワクチン効果低下を示唆するものではないと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue sobrecarrega UPA de Vilhena com quase 750 atendimentos em um só dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever overwhelms Vilhena's urgent care unit with nearly 750 patient visits in a single day.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever overwhelms Vilhena's urgent care unit with nearly 750 visits in a single day. In Vilhena, Rondônia, Brazil, authorities treat the dengue situation as an epidemic, placing heavy pressure on the public health system. On 25 November 2026, the Unidade de Pronto Atendimento (UPA) logged about 750 attendances between 7:00 and midnight, underscoring the outbreak's severity. The report emphasizes the importance of residents recognizing dengue symptoms and following health team guidance. The municipality continues to strain public services, and the article does not report any deaths. This outbreak highlights dengue as an epidemic in Vilhena, signaling the need for vigilance, prevention measures, and timely care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱によりヴィリェナの救急医療ユニットが逼迫、1日で約750件の受診
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ロンドニア州ヴィリェナで当局がデング熱を「流行」として扱い、1日約750件もの受診が発生し医療体制に大きな負荷がかかっているため、WPRO基準の複数該当とメディア報道（社会的関心）からフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで季節的に流行する既知の感染症であり国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクは低いが、地域医療システムへの急激な負荷と当局による「流行」宣言から地域レベルでの経過観察・フルRRAの価値はあると判断。死亡例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Assistente relata sofrimento e coceira após contrair sarna em escola de Campo Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Assistant reports suffering and itching after contracting scabies at a Campo Grande school.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreaks are affecting Campo Grande, the capital of Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with three concurrent outbreaks monitored by Sesau and Semed, totaling about 100 cases, including 63 in a prison. The surge began in classrooms of a municipal early childhood education school; educators, assistants, and students report itching and body rashes, with nocturnal itchiness and small skin lesions. Timeline: November 19 a coworker developed symptoms and was diagnosed; by November 23 the assistant began itching and others followed. Transmission occurs mainly through prolonged skin contact or sharing of clothes, linens, and bedding; it is not linked to poor hygiene. Management includes oral medications and topical lotion, separate laundry, and 24 hours of absence after starting effective treatment. Authorities emphasize monitoring, contact tracing, and that schools may not automatically close.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデの学校で疥癬に感染した補助教員が苦しみとかゆみを訴える
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大性が低く、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクもない局地的な集団発生であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症で治療可能な皮膚疾患であり、学校・刑務所内の濃厚接触による局地的集団感染。重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: Tribunal de Kenia ordena detener obras de centro de EE.UU. contra el ébola en Laikipia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court orders halt to construction of U.S. Ebola center in Laikipia.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court halted the construction of a U.S.-funded Ebola quarantine center at Laikipia Air Base near Nanyuki after ruling the government violated the constitution by concealing terms of the bilateral agreement with Washington and omitting public consultation. The 50-bed facility must stop until transparency and public participation are ensured, though it had been used in July to quarantine seven U.S. humanitarian workers from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The ruling follows months of controversy over the project, including contempt orders against Health Minister Aden Duale and ongoing protests in Laikipia. Context: the DRC Ebola outbreak, the seventeenth since 1976, has 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths across eight provinces, with Ituri accounting for 67.7%. Uganda reports end of transmission; Kenya has nine cases and two deaths; Nigeria has an imported case. Africa CDC notes only 15% of new infections arise from known contacts; WHO calls it the worst Congolese outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの裁判所、ライキピアにおける米国出資のエボラ対策センター建設の停止を命令
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は過去最悪規模（12,021例、5,904死亡）とWHOが評価しており、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事本文の主題はケニアの検疫施設建設を巡る司法判断だが、背景情報としてDRCのエボラ流行（史上最悪規模、複数国への拡大）が記載されており、公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 avança no Brasil e é monitorada pela OMS; veja o que se sabe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant is spreading in Brazil and is monitored by the WHO; see what is known.
article.articleSummary: WHO is monitoring the SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 as it circulates in Brazil, including Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Paraná, Bahia, Espírito Santo, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, and the Federal District. PJ.2.1, an Omicron-descendant identified in Canada in May 2026, reached Brazil by late August. Fiocruz reported the lineage in 96 of 167 Rio de Janeiro samples (58%), suggesting predominance. The variant carries mutations increasing ACE2 receptor affinity, potentially aiding entry, but there is no evidence of higher transmissibility or more severe disease. Symptoms resemble other COVID-19 and respiratory infections: fever, body aches, runny nose, cough, hoarseness, sore throat; confirmation requires sequencing. Updated vaccines neutralize PJ.2.1, and boosters are advised for older adults and immunocompromised every six months; routine vaccination for children 6 months to under 5 years; one dose per pregnancy; health workers per MoH guidance; those with overdue doses should visit a health unit.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がブラジルで拡大し、WHOが監視中；分かっていることまとめ
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル複数州で優勢になりつつありWHOが監視しているが、重症度や感染力上昇の明確な証拠はなく、現時点では情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: WHOが監視対象としている変異株だが、記事内では重症度・伝播性の増加を示す証拠はないと明記されている。カナダは起源地として言及されるのみで発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 25 detentos testam positivo para Covid-19 em presídio de MG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 25 inmates test positive for COVID-19 in a prison in Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: 25 inmates tested positive for COVID-19 at Mariana prison in the Central region of Minas Gerais, Brazil, confirmed by Sejusp on 26 November 2026. After the first case, inmates in the affected gallery underwent active screening; all cases have mild symptoms and are under medical follow-up. The facility is following state health protocols to curb transmission. Separately, a 23-year-old detainee died after being diagnosed with COVID-19 at Ceresp Gameleira in Belo Horizonte; he was hospitalized in the public network and also had pneumonia. In Belo Horizonte, positive tests rose to 7% in the last week of October 2026—the year's highest rate—up from 1% earlier that month. For 2026, BH reported 27,885 suspected cases, 449 confirmations, and nine deaths, eight of whom were 60+. Authorities emphasize vaccination for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の刑務所で受刑者25人が新型コロナウイルス陽性
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の流行疾患であり、本事例は軽症が中心で通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 刑務所内という閉鎖環境でのクラスター発生だが、症状は軽度で地域の医療体制内で対応可能。ブラジルにおけるCOVID-19陽性率の季節的増加の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso confirma primeiro caso de Mpox em 2026 e monitora outros cinco suspeitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso confirms first Mpox case in 2026 and monitors five other suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: As of November 26, 2026, Mato Grosso's Health Secretariat confirmed the first mpox case of 2026, in a Rondonópolis resident. Lab confirmation from Lacen-MT. Surveillance monitors five suspected cases; 11 of 16 notifications in 2026 have been discarded, with five still under investigation; no mpox deaths have been reported in Mato Grosso to date. In 2025 Mato Grosso recorded four mpox cases. Mpox is caused by a virus and mainly spreads through direct contact with lesions, crusts, or bodily fluids, including sexual contact or prolonged close contact, and can also transmit via shared personal items. Symptoms include skin lesions, blisters or spots on the face, hands, feet, mouth, or genital/anal regions, sometimes with fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, and swollen lymph nodes. Guidance: seek care for symptoms; isolate until lesions heal; vaccination targets priority groups defined by the Ministry of Health, such as people living with HIV/AIDS with lower immunity.

triage.headline_ja: マトグロッソ州、2026年初のMpox症例を確認、他5件の疑い例を監視中
triage.triage_reason: 単発の確認例で死亡例なく、過去にも同程度の発生があり、通常のサーベイランス範囲内の事象と考えられるため。
triage.notes: 2025年にも同州で4例報告されており、既知の風土病的状況下での単発例。死亡報告なし、重症度・異常性ともに低い。

article.articleHeadline: Alta de casos de Covid faz procura por autotestes crescer e farmácias ficam sem estoque em Uberaba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in COVID-19 cases drives demand for self-tests, and pharmacies run out of stock in Uberaba
article.articleSummary: Rising COVID-19 activity in Uberaba, Brazil, drives demand for self-testing with pharmacies reporting stockouts and price variation (R$34-R$54.90). Public health data show 101 new confirmed cases in Uberaba from Nov 15–21, up from 47 the previous week, based on 288 public tests with 93 positives; influenza-like illness syndromic visits increased from 390 to 529. Autotests are antigen-based, yield 15–30 minutes, and can be self-administered, most reliable in days 2–5 of symptoms. Negative results may be false negatives; symptomatic individuals should seek health care and consider retesting. Positive results indicate probable infection; high-risk groups (elderly, pregnant, immunocompromised, chronic disease) should obtain guidance. Importantly, stock availability varies by store; some expect replenishment within a week, others have already placed orders with 1–2 day delivery estimates. Emphasis on testing timing (3rd–5th day) and urgent symptoms require emergency care.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19感染者の増加により自己検査キットの需要が急増、ウベラバの薬局で在庫切れ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地域における季節性COVID-19・インフルエンザ症例の増加と自己検査キットの需要・流通状況に関する通常の公衆衛生報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（対象国リスト外）の一地方都市における季節的なCOVID-19・インフルエンザ様疾患の増加と検査キット需要に関する内容。重症例・死亡等の深刻な影響の記載はなく、通常の季節変動の範囲内とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí tem quatro casos de Mpox confirmados e outros nove estão em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí has four confirmed Mpox cases and nine more are under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Four Mpox cases are confirmed in Piauí, Brazil, with nine more under investigation as of 26 November 2026. All four patients are men aged 30–49; three new confirmations occurred in November after the first 2026 diagnosis in October. Piauí ranks 17th in the country for confirmed cases, tied with Mato Grosso do Sul; 2025 had no confirmed cases in the state. Nationally, Brazil reported 838 Mpox cases in November, totaling 1,631 confirmed, 66 probable, and 1,948 suspected in 2026, with one death. São Paulo leads with 605 confirmations, followed by Rio de Janeiro (474) and Ceará (220). In the Northeast, 310 confirmed, 17 probable, and 525 suspected cases have been reported, with no deaths. Mpox spreads via direct contact with lesions or bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions. Lab confirmation is required. Vaccination in Piauí targets high-risk groups and contacts, available at CRIE (Hospital Infantil Lucídio Portella) and CTAs; other municipalities via Estrategia de Vacinação Especial. Up to 20,000 doses authorized nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州でMpox確定症例4件、さらに9件が調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で継続しているMpoxアウトブレイクの一部であり、州レベルでの症例増加報告だが重症度は低く、既存の監視・ワクチン接種体制下で管理されているため、直ちにフルRRAを要する新規シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: ブラジル全国で2026年に1,631件の確定症例、死亡1例と報告されており、既に全国的な監視・ワクチン接種プログラムが稼働中。ピアウイ州は症例数順位17位であり、局地的な増加は見られるが急激な異常拡大や重症化は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : appel à protéger les structures sanitaires et relancer la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: appeal to protect health facilities and relaunch the response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, Kinshasa-based INSP appeals to protect health facilities and relaunch the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in Ituri Province, DRC, targeting the 17th outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain in Nizi. The statement warns security developments could disrupt response operations, including patient care, epidemiological surveillance, and contact tracing. It calls for safeguarding health structures, guaranteeing free movement of response teams, and maintaining continuity of care and follow-up. The appeal emphasizes protecting patients, healthcare workers, and facilities as a humanitarian and public health imperative, urging calm and adherence to official prevention measures. The INSP reiterates commitment, with the Government and partners, to ending the outbreak and interrupting transmission chains despite security challenges.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：保健施設の保護と対応再開を求める呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）第17次アウトブレイクにおいて、治安悪化により対応活動（患者ケア、疫学調査、接触者追跡）が妨げられる懸念があり、重大な公衆衛生リスクと国際的拡大・管理支援の必要性が示唆される。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中アウトブレイク（第17次、ブンディブギョ株）の継続報道。治安情勢の悪化が対応活動に影響を与える可能性があり、続報・フルRRAでの詳細評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Thymol and Naphthalene Repel Urban Malaria Vectors in Laboratory and
article.articleSummary: Thymol and naphthalene function as volatile spatial repellents against urban malaria vectors in India. In a spatial repellency assay with Anopheles stephensi from Jaipur, Rajasthan, at 27°C and 70% RH, both compounds reached a maximum spatial activity index of 0.675 and a median effective dose of 0.052%, outperforming oleic acid and several multi-compound blends. Molecular docking and dynamics across eleven odorant receptors and binding proteins supported a mechanism for airborne deterrence. Dose-dependent repellency occurred from 0.05% to 0.35%, tested on 1,400 female mosquitoes over two replicates, using acetone-treated emanators delivering vapour through Whatman papers. The work addresses insecticide resistance limiting indoor control; India’s malaria-prone population is around 93%, with ca. 1.5 million annual cases and Plasmodium falciparum accounting for ~40%. Spatial repellents may reduce entry into homes in India and neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: チモールとナフタレンが実験室および計算モデルで都市部のマラリア媒介蚊を忌避
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は忌避剤の実験室・計算科学的研究であり、実際の感染症発生や症例急増を報告するものではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はラジャスタン州ジャイプルで実施された実験室研究（忌避剤の有効性評価）に関するものであり、実際のマラリア流行状況や症例報告ではないため、イベントとしての対象国指定は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Thanksgiving nos EUA ocorre sob o maior surto de sarampo em 35 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thanksgiving in the U.S. takes place amid the largest measles outbreak in 35 years.
article.articleSummary: As Thanksgiving arrives, the United States faces its largest measles outbreak in 35 years, with 6,039 cases and nine deaths in 2026 through November 24, per the CDC. The holiday travel surge raises transmission risk, and the threat extends to Brazil. Measles and COVID-19 are spreading nationwide, with COVID-19 rising in 34 of 50 states and higher activity in Nevada, Utah, Tennessee, and Florida; hospitalizations sit at about 1.5 per 100,000 in mid-November, up from 1.2. Measles transmission has persisted for more than a year, resulting in the loss of measles-free status in 2026. Vaccination coverage for the MMR vaccine declined between 2019-2020 and 2025-2026, leaving roughly 280,000 kindergarteners unprotected. Travel projections estimate about 81.5 million Americans will travel 80 km or more through Nov 30, amplifying indoor-contact exposure and cross-border import risk; travelers should verify vaccination before trips.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、感謝祭を過去35年で最大の麻疹アウトブレイクの最中に迎える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、米国での麻疹流行が35年ぶりの規模で死者も発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は米国内での麻疹・COVID-19流行が主題であり、米国は対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルへの『脅威の拡大』は言及されているが、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Difficulties in collecting samples following community deaths reported in Isiro - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Isiro, Haut-Uele Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, faces challenges collecting samples after community deaths. A provincial Ebola response briefing on November 26, 2026, noted that family reluctance often follows late-arriving teams; officials urged real-time reporting of deaths to the response coordination unit to trigger rapid mobilization by surveillance, prevention and IPC teams. Families must be informed about the importance of sample collection, and teams should engage communities to enable safe, dignified burial procedures. The briefing also outlined strategies to bring response teams closer to communities. It announced deployment of teams to supervise checkpoints and disinfection points under IPC measures in the Watsa health zone to strengthen the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：イゾロでのコミュニティ内死亡報告後、検体採取に困難 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部ハウトウエレ州でエボラ出血熱のコミュニティ内死亡が報告され、検体採取の遅延や家族の抵抗など対応上の課題が顕在化しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は州レベルの対応ブリーフィング内容で、検体採取困難やコミュニティでの遺体安全埋葬手順の必要性が強調されている。既存のエボラ対応活動の一環である可能性が高く、続報で感染者数・死亡者数・封じ込め状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: North Kivu: Assistance project for Ebola-affected families announced in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC's North Kivu province (Beni): On 26 November 2026, a delegation from the Ministry of Social Affairs announced a project to assist families affected by Ebola. The plan, presented to provincial authorities in Beni, will recruit and identify social and para-social workers to deliver daily support, including food assistance and cash, within a broader recovery and social reintegration framework. Implementation starts with mobilizing personnel who will operate as community-based support workers; subsequent aid will be shaped in consultation with the identified households. The initiative is a collaboration with a partner described as reliable, mobilizing resources to provide emergency assistance and address urgent needs on the ground. The effort forms part of ongoing Ebola outbreak response efforts in the area, extending beyond immediate emergency relief to longer-term support.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニでエボラ被災家族支援プロジェクトを発表 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する被災家族支援策であり、致死率の高い疾患の継続的発生と国際的支援の必要性が確認されるためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発生そのものではなく既存のエボラアウトブレイクへの社会的支援プログラムに関する報道だが、疾患の重篤性と継続的な公衆衛生対応の必要性からPICKUPと判定。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: PNG has largest HIV epidemic in the Pacific - report
article.articleSummary: Papua New Guinea has the largest HIV epidemic in the Pacific, with about 110,000 people living with HIV and a 1.5% adult prevalence. The Asia-Pacific region totals roughly 7.1 million people living with HIV. In the Pacific, new infections rose 65% since 2010 and AIDS-related deaths 19%. Fiji shows rapid growth, with an estimated 1,700 new infections in 2025; both sexual transmission and injecting drug use drive the epidemic. In Palau, Solomon Islands, and Vanuatu, diagnoses are rising; prevention knowledge is limited—40% of new infections in the Pacific occur among young people, and in Fiji fewer than one in three had comprehensive knowledge. ART coverage ranges from about 88% in Australia/NZ to 57% in PNG and 22% in Fiji. About 1.3 million in Asia-Pacific were undiagnosed in 2025, and over 2 million were untreated; Cambodia >90% treatment, while Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Fiji, Indonesia, Mongolia, Pakistan, Philippines <50%.

triage.headline_ja: パプアニューギニア、太平洋地域で最大のHIV流行国 - 報告書
triage.triage_reason: HIVは長期にわたる慢性的な流行であり、本記事は太平洋地域（PNG、フィジー等）の統計報告であって、急性の公衆衛生イベントではない。対象国リストに含まれる国（インドネシア・フィリピン）は地域統計の一部として言及されているのみで記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパプアニューギニア・フィジー・パラオ・ソロモン諸島・バヌアツなど太平洋諸国のHIV流行状況であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシア・フィリピンは治療カバー率の統計データとして言及されているのみで、イベントの発生地として扱うべきではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Branco entra em alerta por avanço de casos de SRAG, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Branco goes on alert due to a surge in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases, according to Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: Rio Branco, Acre, is among four Brazilian capitals with Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) activity at alert, risk, or high risk, and a long-term rising trend per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin for Epidemiological Week 46 (Nov 15–21, 2026). Belém (PA) and Rio de Janeiro (RJ) also show long-term increases; in RJ, the rise is concentrated in children under 2 and older adults. Porto Velho (RO) reports higher SRAG incidence in adults 65+. Brasília (DF) and Cuiabá (MT) appear at alert/risk levels but without signals of long-term growth. Nationally, Pará and RJ are at alert; Pará’s growth is mainly among children up to 14 with no confirmed causative virus yet. In RJ, activity is driven by Covid-19, metapneumovirus, and influenza A/B. Severe Covid-19 cases continue to rise in Centro-Sul states, DF, and Bahia, with Mato Grosso oscillating. The spread may relate to waning immunity and SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 (OMS-monitored), detected across multiple states via GISAID.

triage.headline_ja: リオ・ブランコ、重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)症例の増加でアラート発令、フィオクルスが指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でSRAG(COVID-19、メタニューモウイルス、インフルエンザ)の長期的増加傾向が確認され、WHO監視下の新規SARS-CoV-2系統PJ.2.1の関与が疑われるため、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器病原体(COVID-19、メタニューモウイルス、インフルエンザA/B)が同時に流行しており、新規SARS-CoV-2系統PJ.2.1(OMS監視下)がGISAIDを通じて複数州で検出されている点が特に注目される。免疫低下との関連も指摘されており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OPS alerta por repunte de mpox en América; Honduras no reporta casos este año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO warns of mpox resurgence in the Americas; Honduras has not reported any cases this year.
article.articleSummary: PAHO issued an epidemiological alert warning of mpox (monkeypox) resurgence in the Americas. As of epidemiological week 43 (Oct 25–31, 2026), 13 countries reported 3,269 confirmed mpox cases and four deaths, led by the United States (1,457), Brazil (1,325), Chile (143), Canada (108), and Mexico (107); additional cases were reported in Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Jamaica, Paraguay, and Peru. Honduras has not reported mpox cases in 2026, though the country has had at least 47 cases since the first case on Aug 12, 2022 in a man from Distrito Central. Since Jan 2022 through Nov 20, 2026, the Americas recorded 76,084 cases and 202 deaths across 31 countries/territories. OPS urges sustained surveillance, expanded diagnostic capacity, transmission-chain investigations, and genomic surveillance. Mpox spreads mainly via direct contact with lesions, intimate/sexual contact, or contact with contaminated objects; symptoms include rash, fever, headache, muscle pains, lymphadenopathy, and fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOが米州でのmpox再興を警告；ホンジュラスは今年症例報告なし
triage.triage_reason: PAHOが公式に疫学的警報を発出し、13カ国で3,269例・4死亡を確認、ブラジルを含む複数国での継続流行が確認されており、国際的拡大とサーベイランス強化要請が明記されているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 対象国リストのうち記事主題として明確に症例数（1,325例）が報告されているのはブラジルのみ。米国・カナダ・メキシコ等は対象国リスト外のため除外。ホンジュラスは2026年症例なしと明記されているが対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: PBH confirma suspeita de sarna humana em Emei, mas aulas continuam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PBH confirms suspected human scabies at EMEI, but classes continue.
article.articleSummary: Belo Horizonte's Municipal Health Secretariat (PBH) confirms suspected human scabies at EMEI Urca Confisco in the Urca neighborhood, Pampulha, with the Center for Strategic Information in Health Surveillance (CIEVS) notified and monitoring the situation. All prevention and control measures have been recommended and established; there is no indication of classroom suspension by Epidemiological Surveillance. As of 26 November 2026, Minas Gerais reports scabies outbreaks in 43 municipalities, up from 11, distributed across regions with a concentration in the South of MG and Campo das Vertentes (31 of 43). Four cities are in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, four in the Centro-Oeste, and others in Vale do Aço, Norte, and the Central region. Scabies is caused by a microscopic mite, causing intense nocturnal itching; primary transmission is direct, prolonged skin contact, with risk in schools and through sharing personal objects.

triage.headline_ja: PBH、エミAIで疥癬の疑いを確認、しかし授業は継続
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州で疥癬の発生自治体数が11から43に急増しており経過観察が必要だが、重症度は低く国際的拡大のリスクも低いためPICKUPには該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬はブラジルの対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。ミナスジェライス州での自治体数急増（11→43）は学校等での感染拡大の可能性を示唆しており、続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: "Takto umierať ľudí som nikdy nevidel." Cintoríny odhaľujú desivú pravdu o obetiach smrteľnej infekcie | tnlive.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: I've never seen people die like this. Cemeteries reveal the terrifying truth about the victims of a deadly infection.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo is facing the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history, caused by Bundibugyo virus. Official figures exceed 11,600 infections and 5,600 deaths, but satellite imagery of cemeteries and local burial records (analyzed by Reuters-linked Seznam Zprávy and Papalocal) suggest deaths are far higher, with cemetery expansion accelerating since mid-May. In Bunia, excess mortality by early November surpassed official deaths by more than 50%; in Mongbwalu, the CECA cemetery shows over 200 burials since March, with up to 15 funerals daily at peak. The virus spreads through contact with the deceased; many deaths occur at home, complicating reporting. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; emphasis is on safe burials and timely hospital care. Testing delays, armed conflict, and aid cuts hinder surveillance. WHO had estimated in July that the outbreak could be two to four times larger than reported.

triage.headline_ja: 「こんな死に方をする人々を見たことがない」墓地が明かす、致死性感染症の犠牲者に関する恐ろしい真実
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が継続し、公式統計を大幅に上回る死者数が墓地調査から示唆されており、ワクチン・治療法未承認、紛争下での監視困難など公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念が複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOはすでに7月時点で公式報告の2〜4倍の規模である可能性を指摘しており、既存のアウトブレイク対応の継続的モニタリングが必要。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認（ブンディブギョウ型）である点が特に深刻。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 국내 독감 기승, 중국엔 3가지 바이러스 동시 유행..."백신 접종이 가장 중요" [앵커리포트]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu is surging domestically, three viruses are circulating simultaneously in China... "Vaccination is the most important" [Anchor Report].
article.articleSummary: China faces a simultaneous influenza surge with three circulating virus types: A(H1N1) 56.2%, A(H3N2) 15.5%, and influenza B 28.3%, based on recently analyzed positive samples cited by Chinese media. The concurrent circulation raises reinfection concerns due to limited cross-immunity between strains. Data show rising numbers of influenza-suspected patients with fever ≥38°C and cough or sore throat, along with increasing hospitalized influenza patients and deaths where a prior influenza diagnosis occurred within 30 days. Experts emphasize vaccination as the key preventive measure, noting that vaccines may not fully prevent infection but can reduce severity and improve outcomes. Immunity typically develops in 2–4 weeks, so prompt vaccination is advised. The report reinforces influenza as a life-threatening acute respiratory infection, not merely a severe cold, underscoring public health vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 国内インフルエンザ猛威、中国では3種類のウイルスが同時流行…「ワクチン接種が最も重要」[アンカーレポート]
triage.triage_reason: 中国で季節性インフルエンザ3種が同時流行し入院・死亡例増加との報告だが、季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の可能性があり、新型病原体や異常な国際拡大の明確な根拠は不明。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行報告であり、新規病原体の出現ではない。韓国国内の流行状況も言及されているが対象国リストに韓国は含まれないため除外。続報で重症度や死亡率の推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Бројот на заболени со ебола во Конго надмина 12.000- починале над 5.900 луѓе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in Congo exceeded 12,000; more than 5,900 people have died.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 12,000 infections and 5,900 deaths as of 2026-11-26. Declared in mid-May in Ituri province (northeast Congo), it has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola. Delayed case detection, ongoing armed conflict, and an overwhelmed health system have accelerated transmission. Africa CDC notes only about 15% of new cases come from people already known to authorities, indicating many transmission chains remain unidentified. This outbreak is the second-largest and deadliest on record, after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that infected over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000. Reuters satellite imagery suggests the official toll in the two hardest-hit Congo regions may be significantly undercounted.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万2000人を超え、死者は5900人以上に達した
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが12,000人感染・5,900人超死亡に達し、8州に拡大、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく武力紛争下で医療体制も逼迫しているため、国際的関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、Africa CDCによれば新規症例の約85%が既知の感染経路に紐づかない未同定の伝播であることから、封じ込めが極めて困難な状況。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ史上2番目の規模・致死数。衛星画像から公式統計が過小評価されている可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths in DR Congo exceed 5,900
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 5,904 people out of 12,021 laboratory-confirmed cases, as of 27 November 2026. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain. It was declared in mid-May in the northeastern Ituri province and has since spread to eight of the DRC's 26 provinces. Government data show sustained transmission across multiple regions, with response teams continuing containment, surveillance, and patient care efforts to curb the outbreak. No details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ出血熱による死者数が5,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRC8州に拡大し、死者5,904人・感染者12,021人という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 希少なブンディブギョ株によるアウトブレイクで、イトゥリ州から26州中8州へ拡大しており、継続的な封じ込め・サーベイランス対応が行われている。既に大規模発生であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue ganha força com proposta de expansão da Wolbachia em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against dengue gains momentum with proposal to expand Wolbachia in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: As of 26 November 2026, dengue is advancing in Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting a proposal to widen the Wolbachia-based mosquito program to curb transmission. The Wolbachia strategy releases mosquitoes carrying the Wolbachia bacterium, which reduces dengue virus spread by lowering vector competence. The approach is already deployed in multiple countries and in several Brazilian municipalities, with reported positive results cited in debates on dengue control. The article underscores ongoing prevention and vector-control needs in Santa Catarina and positions expansion of Wolbachia as a key measure to mitigate outbreaks. No specific case counts, deaths, laboratory-confirmation data, or infection sources are provided in the report; the emphasis is on scaling a proven intervention to reduce dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策、サンタカタリーナ州でのウォルバキア拡大案により勢いづく
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は同地域で既知の流行病であり、本記事はワクチン様の既存ベクター対策（ウォルバキア）拡大提案を報じるもので、症例数・死亡者数等の異常事態を示すデータはなく、社会的関心や緊急性も限定的。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数の報告なし。既存の蚊媒介対策プログラムの拡大提案に関する記事であり、新規または異常な発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 5900 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Congo exceed 5,900
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,904 deaths among 12,021 laboratory-confirmed cases, according to government data as of 27 November 2026. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain and was first declared in mid-May in Ituri Province, in the northeastern region of the country. It has since spread to eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces. Government health authorities say response teams are continuing to work to contain transmission and manage the outbreak. Data are based on government-reported laboratory-confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が5,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し、死者5,904人・確認症例12,021人と大規模であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%と高く、8州に拡大中。継続的なモニタリングと国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 afeta 25 detentos de presídio em Minas Gerais; Sejusp fala em sintomas leves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 affects 25 inmates at a prison in Minas Gerais; Sejusp reports mild symptoms.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 affects 25 inmates at Presídio de Mariana in the Central region of Minas Gerais, Brazil, with all reporting mild SARS-CoV-2 symptoms. After the first confirmed case, Sejusp-MG ordered active screening in the gallery; all inmates were tested and isolated in separate cells, with care by prison health teams and adherence to health ministry protocols. Separately, Ceresp Gameleira in Belo Horizonte’s West region was isolated after a 23-year-old detainee died from Covid-19; he was hospitalized for pneumonia and diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2. The SGVC prohibited entry/exit movements at Ceresp Gameleira, and Depen-MG moved the male intake to Complexo Penitenciário Nelson Hungria in Contagem. Sejusp-MG notes that, per health protocols, all inmates in the affected gallery will undergo active respiratory-symptom screening; authorities state that all measures regarding the death were taken by the prison administration.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の刑務所でCOVID-19が収容者25人に感染、州保安局は軽症と発表
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内の局地的なCOVID-19集団発生であり、軽症が主体。死亡例が1件あるが既存の対応プロトコルで管理されており、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に確立した既知の病原体であり、刑務所という閉鎖環境での集団感染は想定内の事象。死亡者1名はあるが地域当局で対応済み、国際的な懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro registra alta de casos de Covid em novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro reports a rise in COVID-19 cases in November.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Rio de Janeiro state shows rising activity in November 2026: as of Nov 26, the state records 19,158 confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infections, 626 hospitalizations, and 80 deaths in 2026. Epidemic indicators rose in weeks 44-46 (Nov 1–21), with positivity rate increasing from 25.9% to 34.3%. Emergency care for influenza-like illness rose in adults from 1,652 to 1,981 visits, and in children from 859 to 1,048. Omicron lineage was present throughout 2026; since August a sublineage MC.10.1.7 rose in September-October, with current circulating sublineages PJ.2.1 and RF.5.3 now predominant in samples. Vaccination: 742,634 doses administered in 2026 as of Nov 25, compared to 674,168 in 2025. Vaccination strategy remains aligned with the Ministry of Health’s National Immunization Program guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ、11月にCOVID-19症例の増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19症例増加であり、通常の疫学的変動の範囲内と考えられるが、陽性率上昇や新規亜系統の流行があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 新規Omicron亜系統（PJ.2.1、RF.5.3）が優勢となっているが、重症度増加や医療逼迫の明確な記載はなく、ワクチン接種も継続中で管理体制は機能している模様。季節性の流行として国内で対応可能と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: HIV প্রতিরোধে বড় সাফল্য, ভারতীয় সংস্থার হাত ধরে আফ্রিকায় পৌঁছল মারণরোগের টিকা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A major breakthrough in HIV prevention, a vaccine for a deadly disease has reached Africa with the aid of an Indian organization.
article.articleSummary: Lenacapavir, a long-acting HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis injection, has reached Africa via affordable generics. A first shipment of 300,000 vials arrived in Zambia, with Uganda and Zimbabwe slated to receive supplies next; Indian firm Hetero Labs Ltd is coordinating the rollout. Gilead Sciences originally developed the injection, and after favorable clinical trials in 5,000 girls and women, the WHO approved its use for HIV prevention in 2025. The two-dose-per-year regimen costs about $28,000 per person, a major access barrier. To reduce price, Gilead licensed six manufacturers for generics; Hetero Labs Ltd and Dr. Reddy Labs are among licensees, with generic prices around $40 per injection. Global Fund calls Africa shipments a major breakthrough. Sub-Saharan Africa bears a heavy HIV burden, with South Africa alone reporting about 800,000 people living with HIV; global HIV deaths last year were about 570,000. As of Nov 2026, roughly 189,000 people had received this prevention injection; 2027 targets include ten African countries and India launch plans.

triage.headline_ja: HIV予防における大きな躍進、インドの企業の支援によりアフリカにワクチンが到達
triage.triage_reason: HIV予防薬の供給拡大に関するポジティブな保健医療進展のニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はHIV予防薬レナカパビルのジェネリック版のザンビアへの供給開始を報じるもので、感染症の流行・アウトブレイク情報ではない。ウガンダ・ジンバブエへの供給は今後予定だが未到着のため対象外。南アフリカ・インドは背景情報としての言及のみで主題国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 全国流感处于中流行水平 检测阳性率上升 中疾控发布提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nationwide influenza at a moderate level; positivity rate rising; China CDC issues a reminder.
article.articleSummary: As of November 27, 2026, China's CDC reports that for November 16–22, 2026, national sentinel surveillance shows influenza activity at a moderate (mid-season) level, with rising positivity in southern and northern provinces. Among laboratory-confirmed positives, influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 accounts for 65.0%, A(H3N2) 9.7%, and influenza B/Victoria lineage 25.3%. The 5–14 years age group shows higher positivity than other ages. The agency notes that most regions are in the peak season for respiratory infections and urges vaccination, alongside multi-disease protection. Public health advice includes covering mouth and nose with a tissue, scarf, or elbow when coughing or sneezing, practicing hand hygiene, avoiding touching eyes/nose/mouth with unclean hands, and wearing masks in crowded settings to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 全国のインフルエンザ活動は中流行レベル、陽性率上昇、中国疾病予防管理センターが注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況報告であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。中国CDCによる定例サーベイランス情報の範囲内。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告。既知の株（H1N1pdm09、H3N2、B/Victoria）による通常の冬季流行であり、新規変異株や異常な重症化の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Veja por que os casos graves de Covid-19 voltam a aumentar no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: See why severe COVID-19 cases are rising again in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil, potentially linked to the new PJ.2.1 variant, according to Fiocruz's Infogripe bulletin. Virologist Paola Cristina Resente from Instituto Oswaldo Cruz notes this trend across the Americas. The World Health Organization classifies PJ.2.1 as a 'variant under monitoring' due to mutations in the spike protein that may increase infectivity, though there is no evidence of greater disease severity. In Rio de Janeiro, genomic surveillance in partnership with the Municipal Health Secretariat found that 58% of analyzed samples belonged to PJ.2.1. Federal guidance emphasizes vaccination for priority groups, including the elderly and children under four, since vaccines provide protection against severe forms for circulating variants. Testing remains essential for controlling infections, conducted mainly in sentinel sites and hospitals. In addition to seniors and young children, immunocompromised or respiratory patients should keep their vaccination schedule up to date per the Health Ministry.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新型コロナウイルスの重症例が再び増加している理由
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1によるCOVID-19症例増加が報告されているが、WHOは『監視対象変異株』と位置づけており重症度増加の証拠はなく、現時点では深刻な公衆衛生インパクトは確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: スペイン(カナリア諸島)が発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文はブラジル（特にリオデジャネイロ州）の感染状況に焦点を当てており、スペインでの発生については言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Flu activity climbs to mid-high level as positive rate hits 24%
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in the Health Bureau area has risen to a mid-to-high level, with a weekly positive rate of 24.3% (Nov 15–21), well above the 15.2% threshold. Lab surveillance shows circulation of influenza B and A subtypes H3 and H1; activity was stable February–October before this surge. Children are hardest hit: emergency department visits for influenza-like illness rose 38% in four weeks (363→501), while adult visits remained stable. Clusters increased from four to 13 last week, mainly in kindergartens and schools, predominantly influenza A; a Santa Rosa de Lima Secondary School cluster involved four Form 5 girls with fever and cough starting Nov 22; three tested positive for influenza A; cases mild, no severe complications. Vaccination uptake is satisfactory: care homes >80%, schools ~70%; free vaccination extended to all residents since Nov 16, with about 141,000 doses this year (62,000 for 50+ and elderly). Unvaccinated residents, especially elderly, pregnant women, young children, and those with chronic illnesses, are urged to vaccinate before December travel; immunity takes 2–3 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ活動が中~高水準に上昇、陽性率24%に達する
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、軽症例が中心で重症化や異常事態は確認されていないため、通常の季節変動の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: マカオ（中国特別行政区）における季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告。学校・幼稚園でのクラスター増加が見られるが、全例軽症で重篤な合併症はなく、ワクチン接種率も良好。公的機関による通常の感染症監視業務の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Treated, cured, then sick again: Why tuberculosis keeps returning to haunt patients
article.articleSummary: Recurrent pulmonary TB haunts Indian TB patients, including Navjot Singh, 42, among those relapsing after treatment at NITRD in Mehrauli and Rajan Babu Institute in GTB Nagar. Over 22 years, TB struck thrice; relapse can occur when original bacteria survive, reinfection, dormant bacilli awaken, or treatment fails. Molecular testing and drug susceptibility help detect resistance. A 2024 NLM review of 75,224 patients found recurrent TB in 2.9%; a 2026 Lancet Global Health study of 1,076 survivors in Maharashtra found 7% redeveloped TB within 12 months. India accounts for about a quarter of global TB, with 2024 estimates of 27.1 lakh new cases and over 3 lakh deaths; worldwide 10.7 million cases and 1.23 million deaths (WHO 2025 report). Many patients abandon treatment, as with Abdesh Singh in Mangolpuri who stopped after 3-4 months; poverty, crowding, malnutrition, stigma drive relapse. HIV co-infection worsens risk and requires TB diagnosis and close follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 治療、治癒、そして再発：結核が患者を苦しめ続ける理由
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける結核の再発・治療中断に関する既知の構造的課題を扱う解説記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の慢性疾患（結核）の疫学的解説記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため見送りと判定。
